# 2018: current events archive

**Source-preservation edition.**

This chronological reference preserves 4,653 Wikipedia event assertions across 365 dates, including topic hierarchy, original citations and pinned revisions. SQLite is authoritative; this UTF-8 Markdown is its readable companion.

Source selection and wording are Wikipedia’s, and are not certified exhaustive, impartial or factually correct. Publication does not imply independent checking of every assertion. Original wording, errors and dated reporting figures remain visible. Editorial accounts are separately labeled and cited.

Database: [2018.sqlite](2018.sqlite). Edition SHA-256: `f7e681ab3aeeafa481a565ea3a545d9378c473c5ea4fd3c8583b91d4dc61b063`. Publication: `preservation-release-1.0`. Extraction/Markdown profile: `annual-series-1.0`. Date: 2026-10-21.

Original entries without attached citations: 3. These have separate editorial evidence. Full-event reviews complete: 2; partial: 1; without a full-event review: 4,650. Partial reviews leave unsupported details explicit.

Exact original daily files, Wikipedia payloads/metadata and prior extraction candidates are embedded losslessly, with hashes, an exact retirement manifest and Git checkpoint. Wikipedia attribution and CC BY-SA obligations remain applicable. Publisher URLs identify evidence; full publisher articles and images are not reproduced.

Template display uses explicit original arguments without calculated conversions, live expansion or inferred links. Unsupported template markup and source reliability tags remain visible. Orphan topics and malformed/unbulleted material are preserved with the handling notes below; no missing child or event is invented.

Commented-out source assertions remain labeled non-event material in the database and handling notes; they are excluded from ordinary event totals.

## January

### 2018-01-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088870216](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%201&oldid=1088870216>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Kashmir conflict.

**Archived source account.** An armed standoff between Indian security forces and Kashimiri rebels at a paramilitary base ends after 36 hours and leaves eight people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/01/dead-kashmir-base-raid-ends-36-hours-180101153350541.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-01-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Boycott, Divestment and Sanctions.

**Archived source account.** An American Jewish rabbi publishes an ad in The Washington Post calling the New Zealand pop singer Lorde a "bigot" after she cancelled her concert in Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Post](<http://m.jpost.com/Opinion/Lorde-and-BDS-bigots-should-be-boycotted-and-exposed-as-hypocrites-522583>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Value Added Tax (VAT) has been introduced in Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates for the first time.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-42508883>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A boat capsizes in the north of Indonesian Borneo, leaving at least eight people dead.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-42534117>).

<a id="event-2018-01-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are killed in a plane crash in Northland, New Zealand.

Source citations (as archived): [1 News](<https://www.tvnz.co.nz/one-news/new-zealand/two-people-dead-in-microlight-plane-crash-northland>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Pakistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump tweets that Pakistan has been a "safe haven" for terrorists from Afghanistan and has given America "nothing but lies &amp; deceit" after getting more than $33 billion in U.S. aid.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/5083272/donald-trump-pakistan-tweets/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-01-4-2"></a>

Context: Pakistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan asks U.S. Ambassador to Pakistan David Hale to clarify Trump's remarks. Pakistani Prime Minister Shahid Khaqan Abbasi calls for Cabinet and National Security Council meetings to discuss the tweet.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://beta.latimes.com/world/asia/la-fg-pakistan-trump-tweet-20180101-story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Pakistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan's Defence Minister accuses the U.S. of giving Pakistan "nothing but invective &amp; mistrust" after receiving "land &amp; air communication, military bases &amp; intel cooperation that decimated Al-Qaeda over last 16yrs".

Source citations (as archived): [AOL](<https://www.aol.com/article/news/2018/01/01/pakistan-responds-to-trumps-tweet-us-has-given-us-nothing-but-invective-and-mistrust/23321077/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-01-5-1"></a>

Context: Legal history of cannabis in the United States.

**Archived source account.** California becomes the latest and most-populated state to legalize the recreational use of cannabis.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42532776>).

<a id="event-2018-01-01-5-3"></a>

Context: Brazil prison riots.

**Archived source account.** An apparent gang riot at Colonia Agroindustrial prison in Goiânia, Brazil, results in nine deaths and 14 inmates injured. Authorities report 233 prisoners escaped but now only 95 prisoners remain at large.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/02/deaths-reported-after-inmates-battle-at-brazilian-prison>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-prison-riot/nine-dead-in-latest-outbreak-of-brazilian-prison-violence-idUSKBN1EQ1AD?il=0>).

<a id="event-2018-01-01-5-5"></a>

Context: Law of Alaska.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. state of Alaska eliminates the posting of bail in criminal cases, replacing it with a points-based system, rating the defendant on their previous criminal history, their danger to the public, and their probability of showing up to court hearings.

Source citations (as archived): [US News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/alaska/articles/2018-01-01/alaskas-criminal-bail-changes-to-point-based-system?int=news-rec>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-01-6-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Ten people die at the protests overnight, with twelve deaths total so far as the protests enter their fifth day.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42532784>).

<a id="event-2018-01-01-6-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Switzerland.

**Archived source account.** Alain Berset takes office as President of the Swiss Confederation. At 45 years of age, Berset is the youngest president of Switzerland since 1934.

Source citations (as archived): [Swissinfo](<https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/alain-berset-_youngest-swiss-president-in-84-years-takes-office/43783510>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-01-01-7-1"></a>

Context: 2018 PDC World Darts Championship.

**Archived source account.** In darts, Rob Cross wins the PDC World Darts Championship (on his debut) defeating Phil Taylor (in his last career match) 7–2 in the final.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/darts/42537507>).

### 2018-01-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088870296](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%202&oldid=1088870296>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-01-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Vice Media suspends two of its top executives as it investigates allegations made against them.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Entertainment/wireStory/vice-suspends-top-execs-sexual-misconduct-report-52098240>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-02-1-1"></a>

Context: United States antitrust law.

**Archived source account.** Citing national security concerns, the U.S. government blocks Ant Financial's acquisition of MoneyGram.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-moneygram-intl-m-a-ant-financial/u-s-blocks-moneygram-sale-to-chinas-ant-financial-idUSKBN1ER1R7>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-02-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Pasamayo bus crash.

**Archived source account.** A coach bus plunges off a cliff on a coastal road in Peru, killing at least 48 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-42546980>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/peru-bus-crash-1.4470304>).

<a id="event-2018-01-02-2-3"></a>

Context: Woburn Safari Park fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire at Woburn Safari Park kills 13 patas monkeys.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/jan/02/fire-kills-13-monkeys-at-woburn-safari-park>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Palestine–United States relations, Israel–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump tweets that the U.S. may withhold future payments to the Palestinian authority, over 350 million dollars per year, because they are "no longer willing to talk peace" with Israel, and that Israel "would have had to pay more" in return for his recognition of Jerusalem as Israel's capital.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/us-news/1.832723>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/02/trump-palestinians-israel-jerusalem-320228>).

<a id="event-2018-01-02-3-3"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korean President Moon Jae-in, responding to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un's offer during his New Year’s Day address, proposes a meeting to discuss the Winter Olympics and North Korea's nuclear program next Tuesday at the border city of Panmunjom.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/02/world/asia/south-north-korea-olympics-talks.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-42538323>).

<a id="event-2018-01-02-3-5"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump responds to Kim Jong-un's claim of having North Korea's nuclear missile launch button on his desk, boasting that the size of the nuclear missile launch button on his own desk is larger and more powerful than Kim's.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2018/01/02/politics/donald-trump-north-korea-nuclear/index.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-42549687>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/03/world/asia/trump-tweet-button-north-korea.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-02-3-7"></a>

Context: Illegal immigration from Africa to Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israel announces plans to deport African migrants residing in the country illegally. Migrants will be given 90 days to leave the country or face imprisonment.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-42541515>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-02-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Joshua Boyle, a Canadian man recently rescued from a Taliban linked group, is arrested on 15 charges, including assault, sexual assault, and unlawful confinement.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/3941734/joshua-boyle-charges-criminal/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-02-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine prisoners have escaped from a Berlin, prison over the last five days, with two escaping today.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42551732>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-02-5-1"></a>

Context: United States Senate.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator Orrin Hatch announces that he will retire in January 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [Salt Lake Tribune](<http://www.sltrib.com/news/politics/2018/01/02/hatch-will-hang-it-up-after-this-term/>).

### 2018-01-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1161450028](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%203&oldid=1161450028>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber attacks a mosque in Gamboru, Nigeria, killing 11 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/nigeria-suicide-bomber-hits-mosque-in-borno-state/a-42010204>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Storm Eleanor.

**Archived source account.** Winter storm Eleanor moves from the British Isles to continental Europe with one dead in France as well as injuries and material losses in Germany, Netherlands and Switzerland.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42555358>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Law of Iceland.

**Archived source account.** A new Icelandic law goes into effect which requires government agencies and companies with more than 24 full-time employees to prove they are paying men and women equally, as required by existing legislation.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/01/03/575403863/companies-in-iceland-now-required-to-demonstrate-they-pay-men-women-fairly>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/03/world/europe/iceland-equal-pay.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-03-2-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Ethiopia.

**Archived source account.** Ethiopian Prime Minister Hailemariam Desalegn announces that Ethiopia will drop charges against all political prisoners and close down the infamous prison camp of Maekelawi.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.apnews.com/e85f4cbac73a475286d9c091d1e42a29/Ethiopia-to-release-all-political-prisoners,-close-camp>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-03-3-1"></a>

Context: Presidential Advisory Commission on Election Integrity.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump dissolves the voter fraud commission noting the cost to the public of litigating against lawsuits from states objecting to the voter information requested.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-election/trump-dissolves-election-fraud-panel-after-states-balk-at-data-requests-idUSKBN1ET01F>); [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2018/01/03/politics/presidential-election-commission/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-01-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Computer security.

**Archived source account.** Security researchers disclose two hardware vulnerabilities—Spectre, which affects most modern processors, and Meltdown, which affects most Intel chips.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cyber-intel/security-flaws-put-virtually-all-phones-computers-at-risk-idUSKBN1ES1BO>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2018/jan/04/meltdown-spectre-computer-processor-intel-security-flaws-explainer>).

<a id="event-2018-01-03-4-3"></a>

Context: Largest known prime number.

**Archived source account.** The Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search announces the discovery of the latest largest known prime number, a Mersenne prime with 23,249,425 digits, equal to 277,232,917 − 1.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<http://www.ibtimes.com/largest-known-prime-number-found-rare-over-23-million-digits-2637539>).

### 2018-01-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1358833161](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%204&oldid=1358833161>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Afghanistan War.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber attack near a group of security personnel investigating illegal drugs and alcohol dealing in Kabul, Afghanistan, kills at least 20, wounding another 27 policemen. The Islamic State claims responsibility for the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/04/world/asia/isis-kabul-suicide-attack.html>); [AP](<http://time.com/5089352/kabul-afghanistan-suicide-attack-police/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Munich Re reports that the insurance industry faces record claims of US$135 billion from natural catastrophes, such as the Mexico earthquakes, South Asian floods, California wildfires and Atlantic hurricanes in 2017. Overall economic losses from natural disasters are estimated at the second highest amount since 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [Insurance Journal](<https://www.insurancejournal.com/news/national/2018/01/04/476093.htm>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-04-2-1"></a>

Context: January 2018 North American blizzard.

**Archived source account.** The Norwegian Cruise Line's Norwegian Breakaway cruise ship travels through the storm, delaying its arrival in New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/newyork/news/cruise-through-storm/>); [Cruisefever.net](<https://cruisefever.net/winter-storm-grayson-delays-cruise-ship-arrival-new-york/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-04-2-2"></a>

Context: January 2018 North American blizzard.

**Archived source account.** A massive winter storm hits the East Coast of the United States with up to 18 inches of snow predicted to fall between The Carolinas and Maine. So far, three people have died in North Carolina and one person has died in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/huge-swath-us-hit-winter-061934751.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-04-2-4"></a>

Context: 2018 Kroonstad train crash.

**Archived source account.** A Shosholoza train collides with a vehicle at a crossing near Kroonstad in the Free State, South Africa, killing 19 and injuring at least 100 people.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-42565653>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/africa/south-africa-train-crash-latest-truck-collision-passengers-injured-hennenman-kroonstad-free-state-a8141261.html>); [News24](<https://www.news24.com/SouthAfrica/News/death-toll-in-free-state-train-crash-rises-to-12-rescuers-search-for-more-bodies-20180104>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Pakistan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department suspends its security assistance to Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/us-suspends-security-assistance-pakistan-trump-tweets/story?id=52149646>).

<a id="event-2018-01-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Treasury sanctions five Iranian entities associated with Iran's ballistic missile program.

<a id="event-2018-01-04-3-5"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea accepts South Korea's proposal for official talks, and will meet on January 9 to discuss North Korea's possible involvement with the 2018 Winter Olympics in South Korea. These are the first high-level talks between the Koreas in more than two years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2018/01/04/asia/north-korea-south-korea-talks-intl/index.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-42574870>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Marijuana policy of the Donald Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Attorney General Jeff Sessions rescinds three Obama-era memos that had adopted a policy of non-interference with states that have legalized recreational marijuana.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://apnews.com/19f6bfec15a74733b40eaf0ff9162bfa>).

<a id="event-2018-01-04-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United Airlines flight headed from Chicago to Hong Kong makes an emergency landing in Anchorage, Alaska, after a passenger allegedly became unruly.

Source citations (as archived): [KTUU-TV](<http://www.ktuu.com/content/news/Flight-to-Hong-Kong-diverted-to-Anchorage-468105743.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-04-5-1"></a>

Context: Virginia House of Delegates election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** A drawing is held to resolve a tied election between Democrat Shelly Simonds and Republican David Yancey, with Yancey being randomly chosen as the winner.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/republican-wins-draw-tied-virginia-house-delegates-race/story?id=52142132>).

### 2018-01-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1361320137](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%205&oldid=1361320137>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-05-0-1"></a>

Context: Northern Rakhine State clashes.

**Archived source account.** ARSA insurgents, using small arms and homemade land mines, ambush a Burmese military convoy in the village of Turaing. Three members of Myanmar's security forces are reportedly wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-42595275>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/07/rohingya-insurgents-say-they-have-no-option-but-to-fight-myanmar>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-01-05-1-1"></a>

Context: Donald Trump on social media.

**Archived source account.** Twitter, in response to criticism over its handling of U.S. President Donald Trump's account, says it will not block world leaders or remove their controversial tweets.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-twitter-trump/twitter-says-world-leaders-like-trump-have-special-status-idUSKBN1EU23K>).

<a id="event-2018-01-05-1-3"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Four women accuse film and television producer, director, and writer Paul Haggis (Crash and Million Dollar Baby) of sexual misconduct including two rapes.

Source citations (as archived): [Hollywood Reporter](<https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/four-women-accuse-paul-haggis-sexual-misconduct-including-two-rapes-1072015>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-05-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Luxor hot air balloon crash.

**Archived source account.** A hot air balloon crashes due to strong winds in Egypt's Luxor Governorate. A tourist from Australia is killed and 12 other tourists are injured. The Egypt Aviation Authority says there were 20 passengers on the balloon.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2018/01/05/middleeast/balloon-crash-egypt/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Accession of Turkey to the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan says he is "tired" of waiting for the European Union to approve Turkey's membership in the political union.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/01/erdogan-turkey-tired-eu-membership-process-180105213814481.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-05-3-2"></a>

Context: Accession of Turkey to the European Union.

**Archived source account.** French President Emmanuel Macron suggests that Turkey could have a "partnership" with the EU instead of full membership.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20180105-french-president-macron-suggests-partnership-deal-turkey-eu-not-membership-erdogan>).

<a id="event-2018-01-05-3-4"></a>

Context: Palestine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** An anonymous U.S. State Department official says no decision has been made on the scheduled January 1, 2018, $125-million payment to the UNRWA (United Nations Relief and Works Agency), which administers aid for Palestinian refugees. Media reports had stated the money was frozen. The official added the government is still reviewing U.S. assistance to the Palestinian Authority and has until January 15 to resolve the issue.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-usa/u-s-official-denies-that-funds-for-palestinian-refugees-frozen-idUSKBN1EU1ZN>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/367674-us-freezes-payment-to-un-agency-for-palestinian-refugees-report>).

<a id="event-2018-01-05-3-6"></a>

Context: Belgium–Netherlands relations.

**Archived source account.** Belgium and the Netherlands, by swapping 48 acres of land, agree that one section of their border is now the center of the Meuse River. This is expected to fix a police jurisdiction problem.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/01/05/Belgium-Netherlands-change-their-mutual-border-in-48-acre-land-swap/9271515174185/>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/belgium-netherlands-national-border-change-meuse-vise-eijsden-maastricht-a8141166.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-05-3-8"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Iran.

**Archived source account.** During a session of the United Nations Security Council, the United States repeat its "unapologetic" support for the ongoing Iranian protests. Russia denounces the "veiled \[U.S.\] attempt to use the current moment to continue to undermine" the JCPOA. France calls to "be wary of any attempt to exploit this crisis for personal ends".

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/05/world/middleeast/un-iran-protests-debate.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-05-4-1"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Senators Chuck Grassley and Lindsey Graham of the United States Senate Committee on the Judiciary refer the British spy Christopher Steele to the U.S. Department of Justice for a potential criminal investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/senators-make-criminal-referral-dossier-author-doj-52166564>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-05-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of the United States.

**Archived source account.** National Security Agency director Admiral Mike Rogers plans to retire this spring. President Donald Trump is expected to nominate a successor later this month.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/05/nsa-mike-rogers-to-retire-267634>); [New York Magazine](<http://nymag.com/daily/intelligencer/2018/01/nsa-chief-mike-rogerss-classified-retirement-memo-leaks.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-01-05-6-1"></a>

Context: Ozone depletion.

**Archived source account.** NASA research, published in Geophysical Research Letters, implies that the ozone layer is starting to recover due to man's actions. The decline in ozone-depleting chemicals, specifically chlorine from chlorofluorocarbon (an effect from the 1980's CFC ban, say the scientists), has resulted in 20 percent less depletion since 2005.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<http://www.newsweek.com/nasa-hole-earths-ozone-layer-finally-closing-humans-did-something-771922>).

<a id="event-2018-01-05-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six-time U.S. NASA astronaut John Young dies at the age of 87. He was the 9th man who walked on the Moon.

Source citations (as archived): [Time Magazine](<http://amp.timeinc.net/fortune/2018/01/06/astronaut-john-young-dead>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-rallies-guards/iran-guards-say-unrest-fomented-by-foreign-enemies-defeated-idUSKBN1EW085>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-07-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man is killed in Stockholm after he picks up a grenade that detonates. According to police, there has been an increased use of hand grenades by criminal groups in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [CTV](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/man-dies-in-stockholm-after-picking-up-suspected-grenade-1.3748866>).

<a id="event-2018-01-07-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed in La Concepción, Mexico, near the Pacific coast resort of Acapulco, following violent clashes involving gunmen, a community police force, and state police in the southern state of Guerrero.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/armed-clashes-kill-11-mexicos-troubled-guerrero-state-52196333>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-07-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Egypt.

**Archived source account.** The former Prime Minister of Egypt, 76-year-old Ahmed Shafik, retracts his candidacy for the upcoming presidential elections.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-politics/egyptian-ex-pm-ahmed-shafik-says-wont-run-for-presidency-idUSKBN1EW0MV>).

<a id="event-2018-01-07-4-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** The Pakatan Harapan alliance chooses 92-year-old former prime minister Mahathir Mohamad as their candidate Prime Minister in the upcoming Malaysian general election. Opposition leader Anwar Ibrahim will be released from jail on June 8. Mahathir and Anwar join forces in the election.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/world/expm-mahathir-mohamad-to-contest-malaysian-elections-in-bid-to-oust-najib-razak-20180107-h0et5k.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-07-4-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Sadeq Ameen Abu Rass, not Saleh's son Ahmed, is named as the successor to late Ali Abdullah Saleh as leader of the General People’s Congress party.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security/yemeni-party-names-new-leader-after-saleh-killed-idUSKBN1EW0JN>).

<a id="event-2018-01-07-4-7"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Trond Giske announces his permanent resignation as deputy leader of Norway's Labour Party after several sexual assault accusations. He also gives up his position in the Norwegian parliament's finance committee.

Source citations (as archived): [Jamaica Observer](<http://www.jamaicaobserver.com/latestnews/Norway_Labour_party_deputy_leader_resigns_amid_sex_claims?profile=1228>).

### 2018-01-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256158577](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%208&oldid=1256158577>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-08-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pharmaceutical company Pfizer discontinues research into treating patients with Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/science/2018/01/08/hunt-alzheimers-cure-suffers-heavy-blow-pfizer-pulls-research/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-08-1-1"></a>

Context: Sanchi oil tanker collision.

**Archived source account.** MV Sanchi is still ablaze this morning and it continues to leak oil. Chinese officials mention the danger of explosion and sinking.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-42600720>); [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2018/01/08/asia/china-tanker-freighter-collision-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-08-1-2"></a>

Context: Sanchi oil tanker collision.

**Archived source account.** The body of a crew member is found on the ship.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-shipping-accident-oil-body/body-found-on-burning-iranian-oil-tanker-idUSKBN1EX0HZ>).

<a id="event-2018-01-08-1-4"></a>

Context: 2018 Kadovar eruption.

**Archived source account.** All residents are evacuated, 500 of them to the nearby island of Blup Blup, while the once-dormant Kadovar volcano in the Schouten Islands, Papua New Guinea, erupts for the first known time, sending an ash cloud 2.1 km above sea level.

Source citations (as archived): [carbonated tv](<http://www.carbonated.tv/viral/dormant-papua-new-guinea-volcano-kadovar-erupts-forces-evacuation>); [News.com.au](<http://www.news.com.au/travel/travel-updates/incidents/dormant-volcano-kadovar-wakes-with-first-eruption-in-known-history-spews-lava/news-story/4daf02b16b210e069362091c39027a50>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-08-2-1"></a>

Context: Law of India.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of India orders a review of Section 377, a colonial-era law that criminalizes consensual sex between men, and of the Court's December 2013 verdict that upheld the law. In August 2017, the Supreme Court ruled that all Indian citizens have a constitutional right to privacy, noting in the judgment that "sexual orientation is an essential attribute to privacy."

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/08/world/asia/india-gay-sex-ban.html>); [Hindustan Times](<http://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/supreme-court-reopens-case-related-to-constitutional-validity-of-section-377-that-criminalises-homosexuality/story-Czf7PJna1suqcvxmtvEuxM.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-08-3-1"></a>

Context: Temporary protected status in the U.S..

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration will, in 18 months, end the Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for immigrants from El Salvador living in the U.S. under the TPS issued after a series of devastating earthquakes in 2001. The Department of Homeland Security estimates about 200,000 Salvadorans will be impacted.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-42613178>).

<a id="event-2018-01-08-3-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Tunisian protests.

**Archived source account.** Amid protests against rising prices and tax increases, a protestor is killed and five others are injured in clashes with security forces in the Tunisian town of Tebourba.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-economy-protests/one-person-killed-during-protests-in-tunisia-state-news-agency-idUSKBN1EX2DD?il=0>).

<a id="event-2018-01-08-3-4"></a>

Context: 2018 Tunisian protests.

**Archived source account.** Congressman Mario Díaz-Balart, in a statement, comments, "... while living conditions may have slightly improved, El Salvador now faces a significant problem with drug trafficking, gangs and crime."

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2018/01/08/politics/temporary-protected-status-el-salvador/index.html>); [House.gov](<https://mcgovern.house.gov/news/documentsingle.aspx?DocumentID=397106>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-01-08-4-1"></a>

Context: 2018 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. government's highly classified Zuma satellite is reportedly lost after being launched by SpaceX on a Falcon 9 Full Thrust rocket from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station. Northrop Grumman, who built the satellite, and SpaceX have both refused to confirm the mission's failure due to its classified nature.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/01/08/highly-classified-us-spy-satellite-appears-to-be-a-total-loss-after-spacex-launch.html>); [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/business/la-fi-spacex-spy-satellite-20180108-story.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2018-01-08-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 in English football.

**Archived source account.** Video assistant referee (VAR) technology makes its debut in an English club competition during a 2017–18 FA Cup match between Brighton &amp; Hove Albion and Crystal Palace.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/42604127>).

<a id="event-2018-01-08-5-3"></a>

Context: NCAA Division I Football Bowl Subdivision.

**Archived source account.** In the College Football Playoff National Championship, Alabama defeats Georgia 26–23 in overtime. It is the second national title for Alabama in three years, the sixth for coach Nick Saban, and the 17th officially claimed by Alabama.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/college-football/game?gameId=400953415>).

### 2018-01-09

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 851278586](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%209&oldid=851278586>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-09-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Steve Bannon steps down as executive chairman of Breitbart News amid a dispute with U.S. President Donald Trump over comments he made about the Trump family in Michael Wolff's Fire and Fury.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-42628201>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-09-1-2"></a>

Context: 2017–18 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season / Cyclone Ava.

**Archived source account.** At least 29 people are dead and 22 are missing in the aftermath of a strong tropical cyclone striking Madagascar.

Source citations (as archived): [Firstpost](<http://www.firstpost.com/world/tropical-cyclone-ava-hits-madagascar-leaves-29-dead-over-17-thousand-displaced-4293943.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-09-1-4"></a>

Context: 2018 Southern California landslides.

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people are killed by mudslides following heavy overnight rains in areas of Santa Barbara County, California, where last month's wildfires destroyed forests and destabilized the land.

Source citations (as archived): [SF Gate](<http://www.sfgate.com/news/us/article/California-storm-follows-fires-bringing-new-12483375.php>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/weather/rains-southern-california-send-rivers-mud-homes-trigger-fire-n836016>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/09/us/california-mudslides.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-09-1-6"></a>

Context: 2018 Swan Islands earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 7.6 earthquake strikes north of Honduras, resulting in tsunami warnings in the Caribbean.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/415431-caribbean-honduras-earthquake-tsunami/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-09-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** In the first inter-Korean talks in two years at the Panmunjeom-Paju "Truce Village" (DMZ), both parties agree on the need to ease tensions and hold military talks. North Korea also agrees to participate in the 2018 Winter Olympics in Pyeongchang, South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [The Korea Herald](<http://www.koreaherald.com/view.php?ud=20180109001008>).

<a id="event-2018-01-09-2-3"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations, Health-related incidents at the United States Embassy in Havana.

**Archived source account.** An anonymous senior State Department official says that United States Secretary of State Rex Tillerson decided to convene a special-panel Accountability Review Board to further investigate the "attacks" at the U.S. embassy in Havana.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cuba-usa-investigation/tillerson-to-order-new-probe-of-havana-embassy-health-attacks-idUSKBN1EY1W9>).

<a id="event-2018-01-09-2-5"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Iranian protests.

**Archived source account.** Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei says that Iran has extinguished the unrest and has foiled attempts to turn legitimate protests into an insurgency to overthrow the Islamic Republic. He went on to identify the United States, Britain, Israel, the People's Mujahedin of Iran and "a wealthy government" in the Persian Gulf among Iran's foreign enemies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-protests-khamenei/iran-has-foiled-plot-to-use-protests-to-overthrow-system-leader-says-idUSKBN1EY0Z8>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-09-3-1"></a>

Context: Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals.

**Archived source account.** The United States District Court for the Northern District of California issues a nationwide injunction blocking the rescission of the DACA program, ordering the Trump administration to restart and maintain the program as the legal challenge(s) to the president's decision go forward.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/09/us/trump-daca-improper.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-09-3-3"></a>

Context: Gerrymandering in the United States.

**Archived source account.** A three-judge federal panel rules North Carolina's congressional district map was illegally gerrymandered because legislators relied too heavily on partisan affiliation in drawing constituencies. This is the first time a federal court has struck down a redistricting plan for partisan gerrymandering.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/01/10/576966545/n-c-gerrymandered-map-ruled-unconstitutional-by-panel-of-judges>); [The Atlantic](<https://www.theatlantic.com/politics/archive/2018/01/north-carolina-partisan-gerrymander/550139/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-09-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Poland, Cabinet of Mateusz Morawiecki.

**Archived source account.** New ministers of defence, finance, interior, health, environment and foreign affairs, amongst others, are appointed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-poland/eyeing-troubled-eu-ties-polands-president-fires-top-ministers-idUSKBN1EY17D>); [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-politics-factbox/factbox-poland-reshuffles-its-government-idUSKBN1EY23J>).

<a id="event-2018-01-09-4-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Egypt.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Egypt approves, with a two-thirds majority in favour, extending the nationwide state of emergency for a further three months, starting January 13.

Source citations (as archived): [Ahram Online](<http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/64/287823/Egypt/Politics-/Egypts-parliament-extends-nationwide-state-of-emer.aspx>).

<a id="event-2018-01-09-4-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Spain, 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Artur Mas announces that he is resigning as president of the PDeCAT party.

Source citations (as archived): [Turkey Telegraph](<http://www.turkeytelegraph.com/politics/artur-mas-announces-that-he-leaves-the-presidency-of-the-pdecat-h14913.html>).

### 2018-01-10

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273651838](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2010&oldid=1273651838>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-10-0-1"></a>

Context: Colombian conflict.

**Archived source account.** After failing to reach agreement on an extension of the 101-day ceasefire, hostilities resume between Colombia's government and ELN forces.

Source citations (as archived): [Colombia Reports](<https://colombiareports.com/colombia-govt-eln-rebels-resume-hostilities-ceasefire-ends/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-10-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ivorian soldiers in Bouaké attack the Coordination Center for Operational Decision-Making military base, seizing their weaponry and setting the base on fire after accusations that the unit was spying on them. Last year the soldiers were involved in a series of mutinies.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ivorycoast-military/soldiers-loot-arms-burn-military-base-in-ivory-coasts-second-largest-city-idUSKBN1EZ18P>).

<a id="event-2018-01-10-0-4"></a>

Context: Rohingya persecution in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Senior General Min Aung Hlaing posts on Facebook that Myanmar Army troops and Rakhine State villagers killed 10 Rohingya Muslims whose bodies were found in a mass grave in Inn Din village. This is the first time Myanmar's military has officially acknowledged extrajudicial actions against the Rohingya. Fortify Rights chief executive officer Matthew Smith says the two Reuters journalists who have been jailed since December 12, 2017, were investigating the same mass grave referenced by Min Aung Hlaing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/worldviews/wp/2018/01/10/in-a-first-burmese-military-admits-soldiers-killed-rohingya-found-in-mass-grave/?utm_term=.60d7e9f0b500>).

<a id="event-2018-01-10-0-6"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The United States Central Command launches an investigation into a video posted on YouTube which appears to show a U.S. service member firing on civilians inside a truck on a road in Afghanistan. The montage video, titled "Happy Few Ordnance Symphony", has since been removed.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/10/military-investigating-shooting-afghanistan-battlefield-video-276534>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-10-1-1"></a>

Context: Sanchi oil tanker collision.

**Archived source account.** China says no major oil spill has been detected after MV Sanchi disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/china-says-no-major-oil-spill-after-iran-tanker-collision-9847846>).

<a id="event-2018-01-10-1-2"></a>

Context: Sanchi oil tanker collision.

**Archived source account.** A fire on the oil tanker rages for the fourth day. An explosion forces rescue teams to retreat as 31 sailors remain missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-shipping-accident-oil/explosion-on-iranian-oil-tanker-forces-rescue-team-to-retreat-idUSKBN1EZ03L>).

<a id="event-2018-01-10-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tom Wolf, the Governor of Pennsylvania, issues a disaster declaration over the "heroin and opioid epidemic”, starting an Opioid Operational Command Center at the Pennsylvania Emergency Management Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [The Morning Call](<http://www.mcall.com/news/nationworld/pennsylvania/capitol-ideas/mc-nws-pennsylvania-wolf-opioid-heroin-disaster20180110-story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-10-2-1"></a>

Context: Immigration policy of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency conducts operations at 98 7-Eleven stores in 17 states, arresting 21 people suspected of being illegal immigrants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-7-eleven/u-s-immigration-operation-targets-7-eleven-stores-in-17-states-idUSKBN1EZ2RI>).

<a id="event-2018-01-10-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Hellenic Coast Guard seizes the Tanzanian-flagged cargo ship Andromeda – allegedly bound for Libya, loaded with 410 tonnes of explosives – in Heraklion, Greece. 102 safety deficiencies are found, and 8 crew members are arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Maritime Executive](<https://www.maritime-executive.com/article/freighter-arrested-for-smuggling-explosives>); [Creta Live](<https://translate.google.com/translate?sl=el&amp;tl=en&amp;js=y&amp;prev=_t&amp;hl=en&amp;ie=UTF-8&amp;u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.cretalive.gr%2Fcrete%2Fkinhth-bomba-to-andromeda&amp;edit-text=>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-10-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Tunisian protests.

**Archived source account.** More than two hundred people are arrested across Tunisia as protests against economic conditions continue to grip the North African country. At least 49 police officers have been injured during clashes with protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-42624639>).

<a id="event-2018-01-10-3-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Tunisian protests.

**Archived source account.** A Jewish school on the Tunisian island of Djerba is firebombed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tunisia-protests/protests-hit-tunisia-for-third-night-as-pm-warns-of-clampdown-idUSKBN1EZ0OI>).

<a id="event-2018-01-10-3-4"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Mexico.

**Archived source account.** President Enrique Peña Nieto accepted the resignation of three secretaries of his cabinet, including the Secretary of the Interior, Miguel Ángel Osorio Chong.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-politics/mexicos-interior-minister-steps-down-idUSKBN1EZ2MP>).

### 2018-01-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256158601](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2011&oldid=1256158601>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-11-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Two 16-year-old Palestinians are shot and killed in separate clashes with the Israeli army.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/palestinians-2-teens-killed-in-clashes-with-israeli-army/2018/01/11/d3894d0a-f6ed-11e7-9af7-a50bc3300042_story.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-01-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bowing to pressure, French publisher Gallimard suspends plans to reprint a compendium of "violently antisemitic pamphlets" by novelist Louis-Ferdinand Céline.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/11/plan-to-publish-antisemitic-texts-by-french-writer-celine-off-after-outcry>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-11-2-1"></a>

Context: Walmart employee wages.

**Archived source account.** Walmart announces that it will increase the minimum wage for its U.S. employees to $11 per hour and close 50 Sam's Club stores.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2018/01/11/walmart-boosts-minimum-wage-11-hands-out-bonuses-up-1-000-hourly-workers/1023606001/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-11-2-3"></a>

Context: Legal status of cryptocurrency.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean Ministry of Justice announces that it is a preparing a bill to ban cryptocurrency trading through exchanges.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News Australia](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-01-11/south-korea-flags-ban-cryptocurrency-trading-rattles-market/9322140>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-11-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Southern California mudflows.

**Archived source account.** The Santa Barbara County Sheriff's Office reports this afternoon that up to 43 people are still missing from Tuesday's mudslides as rescuers continue to search through Montecito’s massive debris field; this morning the report had been eight missing. The casualty numbers are expected to rise.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-mudslide-recovery-mainbar-20180111-story.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-11-4-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration through the U.S. Justice Department establishes the Hezbollah Financing and Narcoterrorism Team to assist with the DEA's Project Cassandra investigation into groups supporting Hezbollah.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-hezbollah/attorney-general-sessions-sets-up-hezbollah-investigation-team-idUSKBN1F01V3>).

<a id="event-2018-01-11-4-3"></a>

Context: United States–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom, France, and Germany call on U.S. President Donald Trump to endorse the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20180111-iran-nuclear-deal-eu-urges-trump>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-11-5-1"></a>

Context: Media of the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** The Securities and Exchange Commission revokes the license of Rappler over its use of Philippine Depository Receipts (PDRs) issued to Omidyar Network. The commission ruled that the provisions of the PDRs issued by Rappler to Omidyar violates constitutional restrictions on foreign ownership and control of companies. Critics of the administration of President Rodrigo Duterte condemned the move as an "attack on press freedom".

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News](<https://www.gmanetwork.com/news/money/companies/639728/sec-revokes-rappler-s-certificate-of-incorporation/story/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-media/philippine-regulator-revokes-news-sites-license-over-ownership-rules-media-outraged-idUSKBN1F40TE>).

<a id="event-2018-01-11-5-3"></a>

Context: Murder of Zainab Ansari.

**Archived source account.** The rape and murder of six-year-old girl Zainab in Pakistan has sparked outrage across the country. Two people die in protests in Kasur city.

Source citations (as archived): [Dawn](<https://www.dawn.com/news/1382243/6-year-old-zainabs-autopsy-suggests-child-endured-rape-captivity-before-murder>).

<a id="event-2018-01-11-5-5"></a>

Context: Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act.

**Archived source account.** The United States House of Representatives passes a bill to reauthorize, for a period of six years, a key foreign intelligence collection program, permitted by Section 702. Changes to the program will require the FBI to get a probable cause warrant if it wants to view the contents of Americans' communications swept up in the process.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://time.com/5099528/house-passes-spy-program-fisa/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-11-5-7"></a>

Context: WikiLeaks, Julian Assange political asylum and life at the Ecuadorian embassy.

**Archived source account.** It is revealed that Ecuador granted citizenship to Julian Assange. Ecuador granted him asylum in August 2012 and he has remained in the Embassy of Ecuador in London avoiding extradition to Sweden on rape charges. Subsequently, Swedish authorities dropped the charges in May 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/media/2018/jan/11/julian-assange-is-made-ecuadorian-citizen-in-effort-to-resolve-impasse>).

<a id="event-2018-01-11-5-9"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Twitter posts disseminate claims that actor Kirk Douglas (aged 101) had been accused in the past of having sexually assaulted actress Natalie Wood when she was 16 years old (\{\{circa\|1954\}\}).

Source citations (as archived): [Mediaite.com](<https://www.mediaite.com/online/twitter-calls-out-golden-globes-for-honoring-kirk-douglas-accused-of-raping-natalie-wood-not-a-good-look>).

<a id="event-2018-01-11-5-11"></a>

Context: 1964 Murders of Chaney, Goodman, and Schwerner.

**Archived source account.** Former Ku Klux Klan organizer and convicted murderer Edgar Ray Killen dies in prison at the age of 92.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/12/obituaries/edgar-ray-killen-convicted-in-64-killings-of-rights-worker-dies-at-92.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-12-3-2"></a>

<a id="event-2018-01-12-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mexicans react with incredulity after President of Mexico Enrique Peña Nieto appointed Alberto Bazbaz to the position of head of the CISEN intelligence service. Bazbaz is known for having overseen a 9-day search for a missing girl, Paulette Gebara Farah, who was eventually found dead in her own bed.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-13-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In South Africa, several H&amp;M stores are closed following protests over a controversial advertisement that was featured in the store's webpage. The advertisement showed a black child model wearing a green hoodie reading "Coolest Monkey in the Jungle". Several stores are also ransacked by protesters from the Economic Freedom Fighters over the advertisement.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-h-m-advertising-safrica-idUSKBN1F20KK>); [CNN Business](<https://money.cnn.com/2018/01/13/news/companies/hm-south-africa/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-13-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An emergency alert warning of an inbound ballistic missile is accidentally sent out across the U.S. state of Hawaii at 8:07 HST, before being cleared as a false alarm 38 minutes later. This event caused panic and disruptions across the state on the archipelago inhabited by roughly 1.7 million people.

<a id="event-2018-01-15-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people are arrested in Perris, California, after 13 people aged between 2 and 29 years old are found being held captive at their house, including some "shackled to their beds with chains and padlocks". They are all believed to be siblings.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-42698562>).

<a id="event-2018-01-15-5-5"></a>

Context: Chinese espionage in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Jerry Chun Shing Lee, a former U.S. Central Intelligence Agency officer, is arrested at New York's Kennedy International Airport and held without bail by the Brooklyn federal court. He faces charges that, after he left his job, he kept notebooks filled with classified information about undercover agents and assets which he allegedly used to help China identify informants and dismantle a U.S. spying network.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cia-officer/ex-cia-officer-arrested-for-retaining-classified-information-idUSKBN1F52SE>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/16/us/politics/cia-china-mole-arrest-jerry-chun-shing-lee.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/ex-cia-officer-charged-with-taking-notebooks-full-of-classified-information/2018/01/16/1f629634-fb06-11e7-a46b-a3614530bd87_story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-15-6-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Egypt.

**Archived source account.** The nephew of assassinated Egyptian president Mohamed Anwar al-Sadat announces that he will not run in March’s presidential election, blaming an environment of fear surrounding the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/15/sadat-nephew-and-sisi-critic-drops-egyptian-presidential-bid>).

<a id="event-2018-01-15-6-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Romania.

**Archived source account.** Romanian Prime Minister Mihai Tudose resigns after losing the support of the Social Democratic Party.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-romania-government-pm/romanias-pm-resigns-after-losing-partys-backing-idUKKBN1F42IZ?il=0>).

<a id="event-2018-01-15-6-5"></a>

Context: Rohingya persecution in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Win Myat Aye, Myanmar's minister of social welfare, relief and resettlement, announced that his country would begin repatriating Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh beginning on January 23, 2018. Burmese officials also promised that a newly built camp for repatriated refugees would also be finished by that date.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/myanmar-says-1st-camp-for-rohingya-will-be-ready-next-week/2018/01/15/7415cea2-fa58-11e7-9b5d-bbf0da31214d_story.html>); [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/myanmar-camps-rohingya-ready-week-52350604>).

<a id="event-2018-01-15-6-7"></a>

Context: Partition and secession in California.

**Archived source account.** A group of Californians criticize their state government and declare their desire to form a new U.S. state called New California.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/best-states/articles/2018-01-16/activists-seek-to-create-51st-state-new-california>).

<a id="event-2018-01-15-6-9"></a>

Context: Politics of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Nine out of the twelve members of the U.S. National Park Service's advisory board resign out of protest over their treatment by Interior Secretary Ryan Zinke.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/nearly-all-members-of-national-park-service-advisory-panel-resign-in-frustration/2018/01/16/b322ef5e-fae3-11e7-ad8c-ecbb62019393_story.html>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/01/17/578525840/majority-of-national-park-service-board-resigns-citing-administration-indifference>).

### 2018-01-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1288658918](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2016&oldid=1288658918>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-16-0-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Caracas helicopter incident.

**Archived source account.** The Venezuelan government confirms that Óscar Pérez, the rogue pilot responsible for the Caracas helicopter incident in June 2017, was killed in a firefight with the Venezuelan Army yesterday. Two police officers and seven people from Pérez's group were killed, and six members of Pérez's group were arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2018/01/15/americas/venezuela-oscar-perez-dead/index.html>); [teleSUR](<https://www.telesurtv.net/english/news/Venezuela-Seven-Killed-in-Operation-Against-Terror-Cell-Responsible-for-Helicopter-Attack-20180116-0012.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-01-16-1-1"></a>

Context: Animal welfare and rights in Europe.

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament approves a call to ban electric pulse fishing, seen by some as cruel.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/business/articles/2018-01-16/eu-parliament-calls-for-ban-on-electric-pulse-fishing>).

<a id="event-2018-01-16-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints (Mormon Church) names Russell M. Nelson as the 17th President of the Church.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/01/16/578311260/mormon-church-names-russell-m-nelson-as-new-leader>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-16-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dow Jones Industrial Average reaches 26,000 points for the first time, after surpassing the 25,000-mark on January 4.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/business/ct-biz-dow-hits-26000-20180116-story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-16-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a strategy claimed as "towards healthier products", Nestlé sells its United States confectionery business, number 4 on the market, to Ferrero SpA for $2.8 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nestle-m-a-ferrero/health-conscious-nestle-sells-u-s-candy-to-ferrero-for-2-8-billion-idUSKBN1F5268>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-16-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Colombian Army Mi-17 helicopter crashes near Segovia, Antioquia, in northern Colombia, killing ten people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-colombia-crash/colombian-army-helicopter-crash-kills-10-idUKKBN1F52KP?il=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-16-4-1"></a>

Context: Palestine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States will withhold $65 million for Palestinian aid paid via the United Nations Relief and Welfare Agency stating that UNRWA needs to make unspecified reforms. The U.S. says it will provide $60 million, 48 percent of the regular payment.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-usa/u-s-withholds-65-million-in-palestinian-aid-after-trump-threat-idUSKBN1F52GA>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-16-5-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Kosovo.

**Archived source account.** Oliver Ivanović, the head politician of the Kosovo Serb party Freedom, Democracy, Justice, is killed outside his office in North Mitrovica in a drive-by shooting. Aleksandar Vučić, the President of Serbia says his government treats this as an act of terrorism.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42701712>).

<a id="event-2018-01-16-5-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Over 1,800 muslim clerics in Pakistan issue a fatwa aimed at prohibiting the use of suicide bombing, declaring it haram..

Source citations (as archived): [Sputnik](<https://sputniknews.com/middleeast/201801161060796179-muslim-clerics-forbid-suicide-attacks/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-16-6-1"></a>

Context: U.S. Special Counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** The New York Times reports that Special Counsel Robert Mueller subpoenaed Steve Bannon last week to testify before a grand jury. The House Intelligence Committee issues a second subpoena, via powers seldomly used by Congress, following Bannon's testimony today that, while he was willing to answer questions, the White House instructed him not to answer questions related to his White House tenure.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2018/01/16/politics/robert-mueller-steve-bannon/index.html>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/donald-trump/bannon-subpoenaed-house-committee-after-refusing-answer-questions-n838191>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/16/us/politics/steve-bannon-mueller-russia-subpoena.html?hp&amp;action=click&amp;pgtype=Homepage&amp;clickSource=story-heading&amp;module=first-column-region&amp;region=top-news&amp;WT.nav=top-news>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-01-16-7-1"></a>

Context: Climate of Russia.

**Archived source account.** Temperatures reach −67 C in Russia's Yakutia region, four degrees shy of the record low of −71 C recorded in 2013 in Yakutia's village of Oymyakon.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/even-eyelashes-freeze-as-parts-of-russia-hit-67-degrees-celsius-9868586>).

### 2018-01-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1288661254](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2017&oldid=1288661254>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-17-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two Americans and two Canadians are abducted by unknown gunmen in Kaduna State, Nigeria. Two police officers are killed after engaging in a firefight with the abductors.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-kidnapping/kidnappers-abduct-two-americans-two-canadians-in-nigeria-two-police-killed-idUSKBN1F61XS>).

<a id="event-2018-01-17-0-2"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Suspected Boko Haram suicide bombers kill 12 people and injure 48 others, in Maiduguri, Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security/suspected-boko-haram-suicide-bombers-kill-12-injure-48-idUSKBN1F627C?il=0>).

<a id="event-2018-01-17-0-4"></a>

Context: Insurgency in the North Caucasus.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-01-17-1-1"></a>

Context: France–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** The Bayeux Tapestry, which depicts the Norman conquest of England, is to be displayed in the United Kingdom for the first time after French President Emmanuel Macron agreed to loan it out for the first time in 950 years. Subject to the outcome of tests, the loan is expected to happen somewhere after 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-42713552>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-17-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Sapphire Aviation Bell UH-1H Iroquois crash.

**Archived source account.** Five people are killed, including Zimbabwean politician Roy Bennett, and another is seriously injured in a helicopter crash near Raton, New Mexico, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-42749583>).

<a id="event-2018-01-17-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed, including a local store owner, when a Piper PA-23 crashes into water off the coast of Mastic Point, North Andros, Bahamas.

Source citations (as archived): [Tribune 24/7](<https://www.tribune242.com/news/2018/jan/18/breaking-news-small-aircraft-en-route-new-providen/?news=>).

<a id="event-2018-01-17-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people are killed when a Turkish Air Force CASA/IPTN CN-235 crashes in a remote area during a training flight near Lake Eğirdir in Yalvaç District, Isparta Province, Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/investigations/2018/01/17/3-soldiers-die-after-turkish-military-training-aircraft-crashes-in-isparta>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-17-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean Ministry of Unification announces that both North Korea and South Korea will march together under the Korean Unification Flag during the opening ceremony of the 2018 Winter Olympics.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://edition.cnn.com/2018/01/17/asia/north-south-korea-olympics-flag-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-17-3-3"></a>

Context: Visa policy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Homeland Security discontinues the eligibility of citizens of Belize, Haiti, and Samoa to obtain H-2A and H-2B visas for temporary work.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-immigration-haiti/trump-administration-bars-haitians-from-u-s-visas-for-low-skilled-work-idUSKBN1F702O>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-17-4-1"></a>

Context: Freedom of the press, Media of the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** Following the Securities and Exchange Commission of the Philippines' revocation of Rappler's license, the National Bureau of Investigation of the Philippines launches a probe into Rappler.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-media/philippines-orders-further-probes-into-news-site-that-angered-duterte-idUSKBN1F61J1>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-17-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Catalonia opens the new legislature. Roger Torrent (ERC) is named Speaker. Three parliamentarians in jail vote through proxies, the five parlementarians in exile in Belgium do not. Carles Puigdemont (PDeCAT, JuntsxCat), through his spokesman, considers it "perfectly plausible" for him to be president remotely. Spanish Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy says that he will not restore Catalonia's autonomous powers if the regional parliament permits Puigdemont to lead the government from exile.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42718192>).

<a id="event-2018-01-17-5-3"></a>

Context: Freedom of the press, Fake News Awards.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump tweets a link to the Republican National Committee's "Fake News Awards", won by ten stories and tweets that he considers misreported. The link also honors ten ways the President "has been getting results" thus far.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/17/trump-fake-news-awards-345482>).

### 2018-01-18

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088976178](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2018&oldid=1088976178>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-18-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Emirates airline announces an order for up to 36 Airbus A380s. Emirates is already the aircraft's largest operator, with a fleet of over 100.
