#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-18-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Aktobe bus fire.

**Archived source account.** A bus carrying Uzbek migrant workers catches fire in Kazakhstan's Aktobe Region, killing 52 people. Five people escape and are treated by rescue workers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-42729597>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-18-2-1"></a>

Context: France–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** French President Emmanuel Macron meets with British Prime Minister Theresa May at the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/emmanuel-macron-theresa-may-france-uk-be-my-guest-to-norway-model-brexit/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Serbia.

**Archived source account.** Police in Serbia arrest three Australians, one of them Rohan Arnold, a known businessman, for allegedly smuggling 1,280 kg of cocaine into Sydney in 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [Sydney Morning Herald](<http://www.smh.com.au/act-news/canberraregion-businessman-arrested-in-serbia-over-500million-cocaine-haul-20180118-h0k5gj.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-01-18-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** In a world's first, a drone rescues two swimmers off the coast of Lennox Head, New South Wales in Australia by dropping a safety device to them. John Barilaro, the Deputy Premier of New South Wales, praises the rescue as historic.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/drone-rescues-swimmers-in-australia-in-world-first-9873048>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-42731112>).

### 2018-01-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1322356660](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2019&oldid=1322356660>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-01-19-0-1"></a>

Context: Pan-Amazon region synod:.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis visits Peru and meets 4,000 members of the indigenous communities from the Amazon rainforest. He states that the people of the Amazon are threatened now more than ever, and questions the conservationist policies that affect the Peruvian rainforest. In Puerto Maldonado, he asks for the indigenous communities to be recognized as partners instead of as minorities. He calls on the Peruvian people to put an end to practices that degrade women, and criticizes the sterilization of indigenous women.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<http://aa.com.tr/en/americas/pope-francis-visit-to-chile-and-peru-comes-to-an-end/1038139>); [America](<https://www.americamagazine.org/faith/2018/01/19/peru-pope-francis-says-church-stands-peoples-amazon-and-earth>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-19-1-1"></a>

Context: Turkish military intervention in Afrin.

**Archived source account.** With a cross-border artillery bombardment into the Afrin Canton, Turkey starts its announced military campaign to "destroy" the Syrian Kurdish YPG group.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-turkey/turkey-shells-syrias-afrin-region-minister-says-operation-has-begun-idUKKBN1F80XH>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Protests against Rodrigo Duterte.

**Archived source account.** Journalists in the Philippines protest the government's decision to cancel the license of Rappler.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Philippine Star](<http://www.philstar.com/headlines/2018/01/19/1779322/palace-black-friday-protest-shows-freedom-democracy-alive>); [Channel News Asia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/rappler-philippine-duterte-move-to-close-news-website-9877794>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-19-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Fifteen people are injured and an infant is killed after a car hits a group of pedestrians near Copacabana Beach in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The police report that the driver had an epileptic seizure.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-42742877>).

<a id="event-2018-01-19-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The bodies of ten Syrian men are found after a snowstorm on the Lebanon–Syria border. The Lebanese Army says they tried to enter Lebanon illegally. Two presumed people smugglers are arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Star](<https://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/Lebanon-News/2018/Jan-19/434462-6-bodies-found-on-lebanon-syria-smuggling-route.ashx>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sudan's National Intelligence and Security Service arrests 7 journalists who were covering this week's economic protests in Khartoum. The charges are unclear.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/19/world/africa/sudan-journalists-arrests.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-19-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Outside the Fleury-Mérogis prison, French police clash with prison guards who are striking over the detention conditions in French jails.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-security-prison/french-police-clash-with-prison-guards-in-protest-over-jail-conditions-idUSKBN1F81W7>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-19-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of China.

**Archived source account.** Citing a national "fervor", the Communist Party of China proposes writing the Xi Jinping Thought into the state constitution, after it was already added to the party constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-politics/china-to-enshrine-xis-thought-into-state-constitution-amid-national-fervor-idUSKBN1F812P>).

<a id="event-2018-01-19-5-3"></a>

Context: Politics of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Presenting a new national defense strategy, the United States Secretary of Defense, Jim Mattis, says terrorism is no longer the focus of the national security of the United States. Now it is competition between great powers.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42752298>).

<a id="event-2018-01-19-5-5"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** A spokesperson for Prime Minister Theresa May says the government has seen no plans for Foreign Secretary Boris Johnson's idea of building a road bridge across the English Channel between France and the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/01/19/boris-johnson-wants-to-build-a-bridge-to-france.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-19-5-7"></a>

Context: Political appointments by Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Carl Higbie, Corporation for National and Community Service Chief of External Affairs, apologizes and resigns from his position with the agency that runs AmeriCorps after racist and anti-Muslim remarks he made in 2013 are reported by CNN.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/01/19/579111221/carl-higbie-resigns-from-trump-administration-after-bigoted-comments-surface>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-01-19-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Atlas V rocket successfully deployed the fourth SBIRS satellite for the United States Air Force. This launch completes the geosynchronous segment of SBIRS and provides a global missile detection system for the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Spaceflight 101](<http://spaceflight101.com/atlas-v-launches-fourth-sbirs-missile-warning-satellite/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-19-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twitter announces it is notifying 677,775 people in the U.S. that they had some contact with the Kremlin-linked troll farm, Internet Research Agency, during the 2016 election period. The count of Russian-linked bot accounts is now 50,258, the company having identified an additional 13,512 bot accounts since its November Congressional briefing.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/19/twitter-users-russian-trolls-437247>); [Mumbrella](<https://mumbrella.com.au/facebook-announces-plans-to-let-users-decide-publishers-trustworthiness-494813>).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42758188>).

<a id="event-2018-01-20-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The state government of Minas Gerais, Brazil, declares a health emergency in three areas, Belo Horizonte, Itabira and Ponte Nova, over an outbreak of yellow fever.

Source citations (as archived): [Outbreak News](<http://outbreaknewstoday.com/minas-gerais-declares-yellow-fever-state-emergency-43094/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-20-3-1"></a>

Context: South China Sea disputes, Philippines v. China.

**Archived source account.** China claims its sovereignty was violated when a United States Navy ship sailed close to the Scarborough Shoal near the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/01/20/asia-pacific/china-accuses-u-s-sailing-warship-near-disputed-scarborough-shoal-south-china-sea/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-20-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Romanian protests.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of demonstrators protest in Bucharest and major cities against perceived corruption and changes to the judiciary. Romanians in diaspora stage protests in dozens of cities worldwide in solidarity with the anti-corruption movement in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://www.apnews.com/876196c724d345cca606dbd78340a205/Tens-of-thousands-stage-anti-corruption-protest-in-Romania>); [Balkan Insight](<https://www.balkaninsight.com/en/article/romanians-resume-anti-corruption-protests-01-20-2018>).

<a id="event-2018-01-20-4-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Women's March.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands protest in D.C., with thousands of protesters turning out in Los Angeles, Chicago, Philadelphia, and other cities throughout the United States and the world in cities such as Rome, Italy internationally, in support of women's rights.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/20/us/womens-march.html>); [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2018/01/20/womens-march-anniversary-dc-352231>).

<a id="event-2018-01-20-4-5"></a>

Context: Odebrecht case in Guatemala.

**Archived source account.** Former presidential candidate Manuel Baldizón is captured in the United States accused of receiving bribes from Odebrecht.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-guatemala-corruption/guatemala-businessman-to-face-graft-charges-after-u-s-deportation-idUSKBN1FA0T2?il=0>).

### 2018-01-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1270270526](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2021&oldid=1270270526>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-21-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Inter-Continental Hotel Kabul attack.

**Archived source account.** Six insurgents kill at least 18 people, including 4 Afghans and 14 foreigners, in a 13-hour gun battle. The Afghan Interior Ministry says that the siege ended when the last gunman was shot dead. NATO reports that "no foreign troops" died. The Taliban claim that they sent five suicide bombers armed with hand grenades and AK-47 assault rifles. The Afghan government blames the attack on the Pakistan-based Haqqani network.,,

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/kabul-intercontinental-hotel-attack-today-updates-2018-1-22/>); [AP](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/gunmen-attack-afghanistan-s-intercontinental-hotel-kabul-n839471>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-42766623>).

<a id="event-2018-01-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Turkish military intervention in Afrin.

**Archived source account.** Turkish President Erdoğan announces that Turkish Army ground troops have entered the district of Afrin in Syria. Turkish Prime Minister Binali Yıldırım says the goal is to establish a 30-km safe zone.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/state-media-turkish-forces-enter-syria/4217230.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Turkish military intervention in Afrin.

**Archived source account.** France's Foreign Minister Jean-Yves Le Drian calls for an emergency meeting of the United Nations Security Council to address the Turkish incursion into Northern Syria's Afrin Region. The UNSC will convene on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-france/french-calls-for-emergency-security-council-meeting-on-syria-idUSKBN1FA0K5>); [Daily Sabah](<https://www.dailysabah.com/diplomacy/2018/01/21/un-security-council-to-convene-upon-frances-call-over-turkeys-anti-terror-op-in-syrias-afrin>); [Reuters²](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-middle-east-crisis-syria-un/security-council-to-discuss-syria-on-monday-french-foreign-minister-idUSKBN1FA110>).

<a id="event-2018-01-21-1-3"></a>

Context: Jordan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** King Abdullah II of Jordan tells U.S. Vice President Mike Pence the U.S. has to rebuild "trust and confidence" to achieve a two-state solution in Israel after the U.S. recognized Jerusalem as Israel's capital.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-mideast-pence-jordan/jordans-king-tells-pence-u-s-must-rebuild-trust-after-jerusalem-decision-idUSKBN1FA0FS>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-21-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Women's March.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands protest for a second day throughout the United States in support of women's rights.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://www.cnn.com/2018/01/21/us/womens-march-sunday-trump/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-21-2-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Somalia.

**Archived source account.** President Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed fires Taabit Abdi Mohamed as mayor of Mogadishu and replaces him with his information minister, Abdirahman Omar Osman.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-politics/somali-president-sacks-mogadishu-mayor-names-replacement-idUSKBN1FA08S>).

<a id="event-2018-01-21-2-5"></a>

Context: Democratic Republic of the Congo general election.

**Archived source account.** The Kabila government begins blocking internet access in the capital Kinshasa at midnight, after a Catholic lay group's call to march today, in defiance of a government ban on public demonstrations. A joint statement was released by the American and British embassies on Twitter the day prior, applauding "Congolese citizens exercising their constitutional right to assemble peacefully in support of the full implementation" of the Sylvester agreements of December 2016. The statement also said that those who do not protect these fundamental human rights must be held accountable "at the highest level".,,

Source citations (as archived): [Het Laatste Nieuws](<https://www.hln.be/nieuws/buitenland/congolese-regering-legt-internet-in-kinshasa-plat~af69ccdd>); [AP](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-01-21/congo-police-fire-tear-gas-to-disperse-demonstrators>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-protests/congolese-security-forces-kill-six-while-dispersing-anti-kabila-protest-idUSKBN1FA0KJ>).

<a id="event-2018-01-21-2-6"></a>

Context: Democratic Republic of the Congo general election.

**Archived source account.** Congolese security forces kill at least six protesters and fire tear gas in Kinshasa. 57 people are wounded and dozens of arrests are made in protests across the country, notably in Mbuji-Mayi, Goma, Lubumbashi and several other places.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-congo-protests/congolese-security-forces-kill-three-while-dispersing-anti-kabila-protest-idUSKBN1FA0KJ>).

<a id="event-2018-01-21-2-8"></a>

Context: United States federal government shutdown of January 2018.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump says on Twitter that if the shutdown stalemate continues, Republicans should consider the "nuclear option" parliamentary procedure in the Senate. Majority leader Mitch McConnell is opposed to taking this step, a spokesperson said.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-01-21/key-day-could-yield-fast-deal-or-long-impasse-shutdown-update>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/01/21/mcconnell-opposes-shutdown-nuclear-option-trump-urged-in-tweet.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-21-2-9"></a>

Context: United States federal government shutdown of January 2018.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate schedules a vote for noon Monday to fund the government through February 8. Since the Senate did not reach a budget compromise late Sunday evening, hundreds of thousands of federal workers will face furloughs on Monday and many federal government offices will remain closed though some facilities, such as the Smithsonian Museums and the National Zoo, are scheduled to be open.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/powerpost/trump-launches-new-round-of-partisan-attacks-as-government-shutdown-hits-day-2/2018/01/21/0560aece-fe35-11e7-a46b-a3614530bd87_story.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42769951>); [Reuters](<https://in.reuters.com/article/usa-shutdown-trump/government-still-shut-down-on-monday-as-u-s-senate-fails-to-clinch-deal-idINKBN1FA0OJ>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/370046-shutdown-grinds-into-workweek-after-senate-fails-to-clinch-deal>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-01-21-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** Rocket Lab successfully launches test rocket Electron into orbit from Mahia Peninsula, New Zealand, becoming the first rocket to reach orbit using an electric-pump-fed engine, after the original rocket launch in May 2017 had to be aborted by safety officials.

Source citations (as archived): [1 News](<https://www.tvnz.co.nz/one-news/new-zealand/lift-off-watch-rocket-lab-successfully-launch-their-electron>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2018-01-21-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 NFL playoffs.

**Archived source account.** In American football, the Philadelphia Eagles win the National Football Conference, defeating the Minnesota Vikings 38–7, making it to their first Super Bowl since 2004.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC Sports](<http://profootballtalk.nbcsports.com/2018/01/21/hello-super-bowl-underdog-eagles-dominate-vikings-38-7/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-21-4-2"></a>

Context: 2017–18 NFL playoffs.

**Archived source account.** The New England Patriots win the American Football Conference title, defeating the Jacksonville Jaguars 24–20.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox Sports Australia](<http://www.news.com.au/sport/american-sports/nfl-afc-and-nfc-championship-games-live-coverage-video-scores/news-story/46a40091c02847b2c299701f1c84a494>).

### 2018-01-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088917189](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2022&oldid=1088917189>).

#### Armed conflict and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-22-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven people die in clashes between security forces and worshippers taking part in an Ethiopian Orthodox religious ceremony marking Timkat (Epiphany) in Woldiya, Amhara, Ethiopia, over the weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-violence/weekend-clashes-during-ethiopia-religious-festival-leave-seven-dead-idUSKBN1FB25N>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-0-2"></a>

Context: South Thailand insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A motorcycle bomb kills at least three people and wounds 22 others at a market in Thailand's southern Yala Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-thailand-south-bomb/bomb-at-pork-stall-in-market-in-thailands-south-kills-three-wounds-22-idUSKBN1FB05M>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Net neutrality in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Montana Governor Steve Bullock signs an executive order that bars any Internet service provider with state contracts from blocking or charging more for faster delivery of websites to any customer in the state. Montana is the first state to respond this way to the FCC's December 14, 2017, net neutrality ruling.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/22/technology/montana-net-neutrality.html>); [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/technology/370133-montana-becomes-first-state-to-implement-net-neutrality-rules-following-fcc>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-22-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Mount Mayon activity.

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology raises Mount Mayon's alert level to 4, its second highest volcano category which indicates a hazardous eruption is imminent. Mayon's activity, which began the afternoon of January 13, 2018, has displaced about 40,000 residents in Albay Province on Luzon island.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/mayon-volcano-alert-raised-again-hazardous-eruption-believed-imminent-n839791>); [CNN Philippines](<http://cnnphilippines.com/regional/2018/01/22/Mayon-Volcano-alert-level-4-Phivolcs.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-2-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Mount Mayon activity.

**Archived source account.** Mayon erupts at 12:43 p.m. (PST). The eight-minute phreatomagmatic eruption was a dense, five-kilometer tall column of volcanic ash, followed by two explosion-type earthquakes. Fountains of intense but sporadic lava, which lasted between three to 30 minutes, began at 9:37 p.m.

Source citations (as archived): [GMA News Online](<http://www.gmanetwork.com/news/scitech/science/640692/8-minute-mayon-explosion-produced-5-km-high-volcanic-ash-column/story/>); [PHIVOLCS bulletin](<http://www.phivolcs.dost.gov.ph/index.php?option=com_content&amp;view=article&amp;id=8377:mayon-volcano-bulletin-23-january-2018-800-am-&amp;catid=70:latest-volcano-bulletin&amp;Itemid=500008>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion on an oil rig in the U.S. state of Oklahoma leaves one injured and five people reported missing.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/oklahoma-oil-rig-1.4498440>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A landslide pushes a bus into a ravine in Colombia, killing 13 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-colombia-accident/landslide-pushes-colombian-bus-into-ravine-killing-at-least-13-idUSKBN1FB066>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-22-3-1"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as Israeli capital.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Vice President Mike Pence declares during a speech in the Israeli parliament that the new U.S. embassy located in Jerusalem will open in 2019, sooner than generally expected.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/22/us-israel-open-jerusalem-embassy-sooner-expected-mike-pence>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-3-3"></a>

Context: Palestine–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** After a meeting with the President of the State of Palestine Mahmoud Abbas, High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Federica Mogherini again assures President Abbas that the European Union supports his ambition to have East Jerusalem as capital of a Palestinian state.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-israel-abbas/abbas-wins-eu-backing-for-palestinian-capital-in-east-jerusalem-idUSKBN1FB1NR>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-3-5"></a>

Context: Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe.

**Archived source account.** Italian politician Michele Nicoletti becomes the new President of the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [PACE](<http://assembly.coe.int/nw/xml/News/News-View-EN.asp?newsid=6922&amp;lang=2&amp;cat=15>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-3-7"></a>

Context: Tariffs in United States history.

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump imposes Section 201 tariffs on imported solar panels and washing machines.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/business/ct-biz-trump-tariffs-20180122-story.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-22-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Germany.

**Archived source account.** German nurse and convicted serial killer Niels Högel is charged with 97 further counts of murder.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/jailed-german-serial-killer-charged-with-97-new-counts-of-murder/a-42253838>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Carles Puigdemont, ex-President of Catalonia, travels to Denmark while Spanish Attorney General requests the European Arrest Warrant. The Speaker of the Catalan Parliament appoints Puigdemont to be invested as President. Spain's Supreme Court refuses to reactivate the arrest warrant.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42772758>); [RTE](<https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2018/0122/935018-puigdemont-arrest-warrant/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-5-3"></a>

Context: United States federal government shutdown of January 2018.

**Archived source account.** The United States Senate reaches an agreement to reopen federal agencies through to February 8. A bill is working its way through the legislative process. The first Senate vote was 81–18..

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/7cab698916344a84894a2ae97c1ab395/The-Latest:-Senate-advances-bill-to-reopen-government>).

<a id="event-2018-01-22-5-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Liberia.

**Archived source account.** George Weah takes office as President of Liberia, and Jewel Taylor as Vice President. It is the first peaceful transition between two Liberian presidents in 74 years.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/22/world/africa/liberia-george-weah.html>).

#### Sport

Context: USA Gymnastics sex abuse scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/usa-gymnastics-board-leaders-resign-under-pressure-amid-larry-nassar-n839896>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-23-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Alaska earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A 7.9 magnitude earthquake occurs in the Gulf of Alaska. A tsunami warning is issued for coastal Alaska and British Columbia, and the entire U.S. West Coast is placed under a tsunami watch. Areas of Alaska remain under a tsunami advisory. It is tied as the sixth-largest earthquake ever recorded in the United States, but there are no reports of significant damage or fatalities.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News UK](<http://news.sky.com/story/tsunami-warning-after-huge-alaska-quake-11219220>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/tsunami-warning-for-much-alaska-coast-follows-earthquake-live-updates/>); [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us2000cmy3#executive>).

<a id="event-2018-01-23-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three people, two employees of a television company and a Brazilian Air Force sergeant, are killed when their Robinson R44 crashes into the sea at Praia de Pina, Recife, Pernambuco, Brazil.

<a id="event-2018-01-23-8-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 NBA season.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-01-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Monetary policy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Financial analysts interpret remarks by United States Secretary of the Treasury Steven Mnuchin as an indication that the United States may change the strong dollar policy that it has held since the 1990s. This is evidenced by the fact that he did not deliver the usual message that a strong dollar is good for America.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/01/25/us-dollar-slammed-as-mnuchin-abandons-strong-dollar-mantra.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-25-2-2"></a>

Context: Monetary policy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Mario Draghi, the President of the European Central Bank, says that Mnuchin's comments are contrary to a decades-old agreement not to "target" each other's exchange rate. The European Central Bank keeps its policy unchanged for now despite citing the euro's surge as a source of uncertainty with respect to its strong currency policy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-ecb-policy/ecb-hits-out-at-washington-for-talking-down-the-dollar-idUKKBN1FD38G>).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-germany-turkey-tanks/germany-freezes-any-decision-on-tanks-upgrade-for-turkey-idUKKBN1FE1PR>); [Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Turkey-expects-solidarity-from-Germany-after-tanks-upgrade-move-539802>).

<a id="event-2018-01-25-5-1"></a>

If passed by the state legislature, any changes would need to be approved by the Department of Transportation and Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-brazil-politics-analysis/brazils-left-sticks-by-wounded-lula-no-plan-b-idUKKBN1FE2LE>).

<a id="event-2018-01-28-2-0"></a>
