Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2018/1/28/16942626/strava-fitness-tracker-heat-map-military-base-internet-of-things-geolocation>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/28/fitness-tracking-app-gives-away-location-of-secret-us-army-bases>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Shipwrecks in 2018.

**Archived source account.** Seven survivors from the MV Butiraoi, six adults and a baby, are found in a dinghy and rescued, four days after the 50-passenger ferry sank in Kiribati. New Zealand rescuers say there is a lot of debris near the dinghy, but no sign of anyone else.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/kiribati-ferry-sinking-survivors-rescued-after-drifting-in-pacific-for-four-days-11226034>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-28-4-1"></a>

Context: China–Japan relations.

**Archived source account.** Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi meets with Japanese Foreign Minister Tarō Kōno in Beijing and says they hope to work to improve relations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-japan/china-says-hopes-to-get-japan-ties-back-on-track-idUSKBN1FH026>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-28-5-1"></a>

Context: Mass shootings in the United States, Crime in Pennsylvania.

**Archived source account.** Four people are shot and killed at a car wash in the Melcroft suburb of Saltlick Township in Pennsylvania. A fifth person, believed to be the gunman, is severely injured.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/fayette-county-pennsylvania-melcroft-shooting-car-wash-multiple-dead-live-updates/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-28-5-2"></a>

Context: Mass shootings in the United States, Crime in Pennsylvania.

**Archived source account.** Four people are shot and killed in a house in Reading, Pennsylvania.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2018/01/29/no-suspects-quadruple-shooting-pennsylvania-home/1075922001/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-28-6-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Cypriot presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Nicos Anastasiades wins the first round of the election, but is well short of an absolute majority required to win outright. He will face his rival from the 2013 election, Stavros Malas, in the second round.

Source citations (as archived): [Cyprus Mail](<http://cyprus-mail.com/2018/01/28/anastasiades-malas-second-round-horse-trading-begin-losing-candidates/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-28-6-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Finnish presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Sauli Niinistö takes an unprecedented first round victory after receiving 62.7 percent of the votes.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-01-28/finnish-president-on-track-for-new-term-in-historic-first-round>).

<a id="event-2018-01-28-6-5"></a>

Context: 2017–2018 Russian protests.

**Archived source account.** Russian opposition politician Alexei Navalny is arrested by police at a protest rally in Moscow. His arrest comes shortly after police raid the headquarters of his unregistered Progress Party in an apparent attempt to disrupt online broadcasts of opposition rallies against Vladimir Putin, while police say they were looking for a bomb. Navalny is released from police custody without charge late Sunday but needs to appear in court later.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/28/russian-police-raid-alexi-navalnys-office-on-day-of-anti-putin-rallies>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-election-navalny-release/russian-opposition-leader-navalny-released-after-rally-lawyer-idUSKBN1FH0X4>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-01-28-7-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Australian Open.

**Archived source account.** Swiss tennis player Roger Federer successfully defends his title in the five-sets men's singles final against Marin Čilić, winning his sixth title at the Australian Open and becoming the first man to win 20 titles in Grand Slam tournaments.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/tennis/story/_/id/22241355/what-australian-open-champ-roger-federer-does-defies-logic/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-28-7-3"></a>

Context: Royal Rumble (2018).

**Archived source account.** In professional wrestling, Shinsuke Nakamura wins the 31st Royal Rumble match. Asuka wins the 32nd, the first all-woman version. Both receive championship matches at WrestleMania 34. Former UFC women's bantamweight champion Ronda Rousey returns to WWE.

Source citations (as archived): [Sports Illustrated](<https://www.si.com/wrestling/2018/01/28/royal-rumble-2018-wwe-ronda-rousey>).

### 2018-01-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031321](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2029&oldid=1256031321>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-29-0-1"></a>

Context: Bus plunge.

**Archived source account.** A bus plunges into the Bhairab River after falling off a bridge in Murshidabad district, West Bengal, India, killing at least 36 people. The late response by rescuers to save passengers leads to violence between local residents and police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-42855962>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Toronto.

**Archived source account.** Toronto Police charge landscaper Bruce McArthur with a total of five counts of first-degree murder, after garden planters containing the remains of three additional people are found on a property linked to him.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC News](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/toronto/bruce-mcarthur-update-1.4508413?utm_content=buffer796b3&amp;utm_medium=social&amp;utm_source=twitter.com&amp;utm_campaign=buffer>).

<a id="event-2018-01-29-1-3"></a>

Context: Mass shootings in the United States, Crime in Pennsylvania.

**Archived source account.** The gunman who fatally shot four people at a car wash in the Melcroft suburb of Saltlick Township in Pennsylvania the previous day dies at a hospital from a self-inflicted gunshot wound.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/01/29/us/pennsylvania-car-wash-shooting/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-29-2-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Minutes before the registration deadline, a second candidate, Moussa Mostafa Moussa, fulfills paperwork to participate in the 2018 presidential election. Leading opposition members called for a boycott, saying that a wave of repression has cleared the field of challengers to President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-egypt-politics/egypts-elections-find-last-minute-challenger-to-sisi-idUSKBN1FI1BB>).

<a id="event-2018-01-29-2-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Romania.

**Archived source account.** Viorica Dăncilă (PSD) is confirmed as Romania's first female Prime Minister. She is Romania's third premier in less than 13 months.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/world/europe/romania-s-first-female-premier-to-face-eu-scrutiny-and-street-protests-1.3372565>).

<a id="event-2018-01-29-2-5"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Andrew McCabe resigns as Deputy Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation amid a dispute with President Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/us-politics/andrew-mccabe-trump-deputy-fbi-director-resigns-steps-down-row-oval-office-a8184126.html>).

### 2018-01-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086689912](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2030&oldid=1086689912>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-30-0-2"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present) / Battle of Aden (2018).

**Archived source account.** The Southern Transitional Council (STC) takes control of the Yemeni port city of Aden following two days of fierce fighting in the city which has left dozens dead. Yemeni Prime Minister Ahmed Obeid bin Daghr, and members of the President Abdrabbuh Mansur Hadi-led government are confined to the presidential palace which has been surrounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-clashes/yemen-separatists-capture-aden-government-confined-to-palace-residents-idUSKBN1FJ17E>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-01-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Reports surface about the publication on January 29 by the United States of a list of Russian politicians and oligarchs that the U.S. government was required by CAATSA to draw up. Russian President Vladimir Putin says that the list, on which he is not included, is an "unfriendly act" that complicates ties between the two countries.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC1](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-42870021>); [BBC2](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42873848>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-30-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 State of the Union Address.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump delivers his first State of the Union Address to the 115th United States Congress in the chamber of the House of Representatives.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/30/us/politics/trump-state-of-the-union.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-30-2-3"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Speaker of the Parliament of Catalonia delays the session of investiture of Carles Puigdemont after the suspension by the Constitutional Court of the telematic investiture. Roger Torrent insists that Puigdemont is the only candidate, disobeying the decision of the high court.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/30/catalonia-parliament-postpones-carles-puigdemont-investiture-president>).

<a id="event-2018-01-30-2-4"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Shortly after the decision, demonstrators assaulted the Parliament gardens as a form of protest, facing the Mossos d'Esquadra.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/ccaa/2018/01/30/catalunya/1517325771_576406.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-30-2-6"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Kenyan general election, 2017.

**Archived source account.** Raila Odinga stages a swearing in ceremony in Nairobi in which he names himself the 'People's president'.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/01/30/world/africa/raila-odinga-kenya.html>).

### 2018-01-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1260735539](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20January%2031&oldid=1260735539>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-01-31-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A BBC study finds that, \{\{as of\|October 2017\|lc=y\}\}, the Taliban presently maintains control of or has some territorial presence in 70% of Afghanistan, with full control of 14 districts (totaling 4% of the country) and demonstrating an open physical militant presence in 263 others (encompassing the remaining 66% of the group's occupied territory).

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-afghanistan-taliban-study/taliban-active-in-70-percent-of-afghanistan-bbc-study-finds-idUSKBN1FK03C>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-01-31-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Crozet, Virginia train crash.

**Archived source account.** An Amtrak train carrying Republican lawmakers to a retreat in West Virginia collides with a garbage truck in Crozet, Virginia. At least one person dies and one person is seriously injured. The White House states that there are no serious injuries among members of Congress or their staff.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/01/31/582126343/train-carrying-gop-lawmakers-hits-garbage-truck-in-virginia>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-01-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Belgium.

**Archived source account.** Renaud Hardy, a suspected serial killer from Mechelen, Belgium, confesses to two murders and two attempted murders ahead of his February assizes case in Tongeren.

Source citations (as archived): [De Standaard](<http://www.standaard.be/cnt/dmf20180131_03331677>).

<a id="event-2018-01-31-2-3"></a>

Context: Cannabis in California.

**Archived source account.** San Francisco District Attorney George Gascón announces the city will retroactively apply California's new marijuana laws to nearly 5,000 felony convictions, expunging or reducing misdemeanors and felonies dating to 1975.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-san-francisco-marijuana-20180131-story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-31-2-5"></a>

Context: Federal Reserve System.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia rules, by a 7–3 vote, that the independent structure of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau is constitutional. A separate case involving directorial succession is under appeal; lower courts have approved the president's selection of Mick Mulvaney as head of CFPB.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/01/31/582296244/appeals-court-backs-key-part-of-the-structure-of-consumer-watchdog-agency>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-01-31-3-1"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Theresa May orders Phillip Lee, a Justice minister, to "air his views in private" after he suggested that Brexit planning should be based on evidence rather than dogma.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/politics/brexit-theresa-may-leaked-papers-minister-disciplined-phillip-lee-uk-economy-leave-halted-latest-a8187236.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-31-3-2"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** MPs vote 236–220 in favour of moving out of the Houses of Parliament for six years while the Palace of Westminster undergoes repairs at a cost of around £4 billion. The move out of Westminster will not occur before 2025. It will be the first time MPs have moved out of the Palace of Westminster since World War II.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/mps-vote-to-leave-parliament-during-six-year-refurbishment-11231458>).

<a id="event-2018-01-31-3-4"></a>

Context: Politics of Guinea-Bissau.

**Archived source account.** President José Mário Vaz appoints Artur Silva as Prime Minister of Guinea-Bissau, succeeding Umaro Sissoco Embaló, who resigned on January 16th.

Source citations (as archived): [CGTN Africa](<https://africa.cgtn.com/2018/01/31/guinea-bissau-president-names-new-pm-in-bid-to-end-crisis/>).

<a id="event-2018-01-31-3-6"></a>

Context: Political appointments by Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Dr. Brenda Fitzgerald resigns as head of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention following a report that she purchased stock in food, health insurance, and tobacco companies shortly after taking up her federal government position.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/01/31/dr-brenda-fitzgerald-head-of-the-centers-for-disease-control-and-prevention-resigns.html>).

<a id="event-2018-01-31-3-8"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Private messages between former President of the Generalitat of Catalonia Carles Puigdemont and Antoni Comín, the exiled regional minister of Health, come to light, in which the former President confesses that the secession procedure "is over", opening, once again, tensions between the pro-independence political parties and more confusion about the future of Catalonia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jan/31/this-is-over-puigdemonts-catalan-independence-doubts-caught-on-camera>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-01-31-4-1"></a>

Context: January 2018 lunar eclipse.

**Archived source account.** A lunar eclipse is seen in Oceania, Asia, and North America, coinciding with a supermoon and blue moon.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.latimes.com/visuals/photography/la-me-super-blue-blood-moon-pictures-2018-htmlstory.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-01-31-5-1"></a>

Context: 2018 FIA Formula One World Championship.

**Archived source account.** The upcoming Formula One season will abandon the practice of using "grid girls", arguing that the practice does not "resonate" with Formula One's values. Four days before, the Professional Darts Corporation abandoned the use of "walk-on girls" to accompany men onto the stage.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/01/31/motorsport/formula-one-to-stop-using-grid-girls-2018/index.html>).


## February

### 2018-02-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1301824441](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%201&oldid=1301824441>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-02-01-0-1"></a>

Context: Persecution of Muslims in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** The existence of five mass graves in northern Rakhine State is confirmed by the Associated Press through multiple eyewitness testimonies and video evidence. Many of the bodies in the graves were Rohingya victims of the Gu Dar Pyin massacre.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.apnews.com/ef46719c5d1d4bf98cfefcc4031a5434>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-02-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Canadian Senate agrees with the House of Commons to make the Canadian national anthem, "O Canada", gender neutral. The second line of the song will now read "in all of us" instead of "in all thy sons."

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/02/01/582520660/canadian-national-anthem-revised-with-gender-neutral-language>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-02-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Apple Inc. briefly removes the Telegram messaging service from its iOS App Store. Telegram CEO Pavel Durov says Apple claims "inappropriate content" is available on the service.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2018/2/1/16958990/telegram-apple-app-store-removal-inappropriate-content>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-02-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people are killed in a fire at a Japanese residential facility for people in financial difficulty.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-42899032>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-02-01-4-1"></a>

Context: China–Holy See relations:.

**Archived source account.** A framework accord between the Vatican and China on the appointment of bishops is ready and could be signed in a few months in what would be an historic breakthrough in relations, according to a senior Vatican source.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-pope-china-exclusive/exclusive-china-vatican-deal-on-bishops-ready-for-signing-source-idUKKBN1FL685>).

<a id="event-2018-02-01-4-3"></a>

Context: United States–Mexico relations.

**Archived source account.** United States Secretary of State Rex Tillerson arrives in Mexico to meet with President Enrique Peña Nieto and Foreign Secretary Luis Videgaray.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-usa-tillerson/mexico-debate-swirls-over-opaque-talks-with-u-s-as-tillerson-lands-idUSKBN1FL6G9?il=0>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-02-01-5-1"></a>

Context: School shootings in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Two 15-year-old students are seriously wounded and three other people injured in a shooting at Sal Castro Middle School in Los Angeles, California. A 12-year-old female student is taken into custody.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/02/01/us/los-angeles-sal-castro-middle-school-shooting/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-01-5-3"></a>

Context: Human rights in the State of Palestine.

**Archived source account.** The Palestine Liberation Organization "rejects and condemns" the United States decision to put Hamas leader Ismael Haniyeh on the OFAC SDN terror blacklist.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/plo-condemns-us-blacklisting-of-hamas-leader-haniyeh/>).

<a id="event-2018-02-01-5-5"></a>

Context: Slender Man stabbing.

**Archived source account.** Morgan Geyser is sentenced to 40 years in a mental institution for her role in the attempted murder of Payton Leutner.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/2nd-teen-slender-man-stabbing-case-remain-institutional/story?id=52752635>).

<a id="event-2018-02-01-5-7"></a>

Context: 2018 Calais migrant violence.

**Archived source account.** 5 people are shot and 17 others sustain injuries during mass fighting between Afghan and Eritrean migrant groups in Calais, France. A 37-year old Afghan man is suspected of having critically wounded four Eritrean teenagers at a queue for food handouts.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42912670>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-02-01-6-1"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Tom Shannon, the United States Under Secretary of State for Political Affairs, announces he will be resigning for personal reasons. The State Department's third-ranking official and its most senior career diplomat says he will stay on until a successor is named.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-diplomact-shannon/no-3-u-s-diplomat-quits-in-latest-departure-under-trump-idUSKBN1FL5HO>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-02-01-7-1"></a>

Context: 2018 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** NASA confirms that Scott Tilley, a Canadian amateur astronomer and satellite tracker, has rediscovered NASA's IMAGE (Imager for Magnetopause-to-Aurora Global Exploration) satellite while he was searching for the U.S. government's classified Zuma satellite. NASA engineers will try to analyze the data from the spacecraft to learn more about the state of the spacecraft.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/nasa-sateillite-lost-discovered-12-years-later-amateur-astronomer-scott-tilley-image-canada-a8188926.html>); [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2018-01-nasa-re-discovered-image-satellite.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-01-7-2"></a>

Context: 2018 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** A soyuz 2.1a/fregat M carrying 2 satellites Kanopus v-3 and v-4 and 9 cubesats successfully launched into LEO.

Source citations (as archived): [Source](<https://www.russianspaceweb.com/kanopus-v3-v4.html>).

### 2018-02-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088977103](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%202&oldid=1088977103>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-02-02-0-1"></a>

Context: China–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** Amid a perceived erosion of freedoms in Hong Kong, British Prime Minister Theresa May concludes a three-day visit to China, said to have generated £9 billion in trade deals.

Source citations (as archived): [Hong Kong Free Press](<https://www.hongkongfp.com/2018/02/02/uks-theresa-may-busy-winning-trade-deals-china-care-hong-kongs-blatant-erosion-freedoms/>).

<a id="event-2018-02-02-0-3"></a>

Context: History of YouTube.

**Archived source account.** YouTube announces that YouTubers who make "egregious" content will be punished. Critics of the move call it censorship.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-42917180>).

<a id="event-2018-02-02-0-4"></a>

Context: History of YouTube.

**Archived source account.** YouTube, in a move to boost transparency and combat propaganda, announces that it will start to label videos by broadcasters that receive state-funding.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/media/372183-youtube-announces-plan-to-combat-propaganda>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-02-02-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Sibanye Gold incident.

**Archived source account.** All 955 South African miners, who were stuck in the Beatrix gold mine near Welkom in central Free State province since Wednesday, have been brought to the surface. Earlier, 65 other workers were rescued. No serious injuries have been reported. The accident apparently happened when a strong storm knocked over an electric power tower triggering the huge power cut.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-42914132>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-sibanye-gold-miners/workers-who-were-trapped-in-south-africa-gold-mine-brought-to-surface-idUSKBN1FM0FY>); [OkayAfrica](<http://www.okayafrica.com/950-south-african-miners-are-trapped-underground/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-02-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Mexico–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Mexico's Secretary of Foreign Affairs Luis Videgaray Caso, flanked by visiting United States Secretary of State Rex Tillerson and Canadian counterpart Chrystia Freeland, rejects "any option that would imply the use of violence" on the subject of Venezuela. On the eve of his visit, Tillerson had defended the 19th-century United States policy in Latin America and suggested that the Venezuelan Army could manage a "peaceful transition" from President Nicolás Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics-usa/venezuela-military-ouster-remarks-dog-tillerson-in-latin-america-idUSKBN1FM1ZA>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-02-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in France.

**Archived source account.** After two days of questioning, influential Islamic academician and Oxford professor Tariq Ramadan is charged with the alleged rape of two women and jailed in Paris.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/society/2018/feb/02/oxford-professor-of-islamic-studies-charged-with-raping-two-women>).

<a id="event-2018-02-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 Finsbury Park attack.

**Archived source account.** As the sole perpetrator of the 19 June 2017 attack on Muslims in London, Darren Osborne is sentenced to life in prison after being found guilty of murder.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/02/finsbury-park-attacker-darren-osborne-jailed-life-180202125638681.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-02-3-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 Las Vegas shooting.

**Archived source account.** An Arizonan ammunition dealer is charged in a Nevada federal court with "conspiracy to manufacture and sell armor-piercing ammunition without a license" after his fingerprints were discovered on unfired armor-piercing ammunition inside Stephen Paddock's suite.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lasvegas-shooting-arrest/man-charged-over-armor-piercing-bullet-sale-to-las-vegas-gunman-idUSKBN1FN01N>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-02-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Nunes memo.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump authorizes Congress to release the Nunes memo, against the wishes of the FBI, Department of Justice, and lawmakers from both sides, all of whom say that the document's release poses a risk to national security.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/02/02/582666768/trump-leans-into-attack-on-fbi-as-clock-ticks-toward-release-of-nunes-memo>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2018/02/02/trump-approves-release-controversial-nunes-memo-fbi-surveillance-russia-campaign/1082196001/>).

<a id="event-2018-02-02-4-2"></a>

Context: Nunes memo.

**Archived source account.** The document is released through the House Intelligence Committee's website. Opinions on the memo were largely mixed, with Democrats, some Republicans and several national security experts suggesting that certain details in the document confirm prior reports surrounding the reasoning for the FBI's decision to conduct the investigation. Critics of the memo suggested that its release was a partisan attempt to undermine and discredit Special Counsel Robert Mueller's investigation into possible ties between Trump's presidential campaign and Russian intelligence associates, and posed a risk to national security.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/02/02/politics/republican-intelligence-memo/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-02-4-4"></a>

Context: Nuclear Posture Review.

**Archived source account.** The United States releases a new policy on nuclear arms, the first update since 2010. It calls for the introduction of two new types of weapons in the U.S. nuclear arsenal: low-yield nuclear submarine-launched ballistic (SLBM) and cruise (SLCM) missiles.

Source citations (as archived): [Denver Post](<https://www.denverpost.com/2018/02/02/pentagon-nuclear-arms-policy/>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/parallels/2018/02/02/582087310/buried-in-trumps-nuclear-report-a-russian-doomsday-weapon>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-02-02-5-1"></a>

Context: Football in Lithuania.

**Archived source account.** FK Panevėžys, a Lithuanian football club from the second-level I Lyga, is allegedly duped into signing Barkley Miguel Panzo based on fabricated data from a Wikipedia page. However, the club apologizes on 3 February for "the appearance of incorrect information" on its website.

Source citations (as archived): [SPORTbible](<http://www.sportbible.com/football/news-lithuanian-club-duped-into-signing-player-from-fake-wikipedia-page-20180202>); [FK Panevėžys](<http://fk-panevezys.lt/2018/02/03/del-situacijos-su-barkliu-migeliu-panzo/>).

### 2018-02-03

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1104011291](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%203&oldid=1104011291>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-02-03-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The London-based Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports that unidentified rebel factions have shot down a Russian Sukhoi Su-25 jet over the Idlib Governorate, near Maarrat al-Nu'man, also killing its pilot. The pilot had escaped with his parachute but was killed on the ground while he fought with a pistol to evade capture. No groups claim responsibility. Russia's Ministry of Defence corroborates this version of events.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/syria-rebels-shoot-down-russian-jet-capture-pilot-monitor/a-42442483>).

<a id="event-2018-02-03-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Interfax agency states that Russia retaliated with a missile attack, killing at least 30 Al-Nusra militants in North-West Syria with "precision-guided weapons".

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/02/03/syria-rebels-shoot-down-russian-jet-monitoring-group-says/303713002/>).

<a id="event-2018-02-03-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** According to Sputnik agency, Tahrir al-Sham, allegedly including Al-Nusra Front, claims in a social media post that it downed the Russian jet with a shoulder-launched anti-aircraft missile.

Source citations (as archived): [Sputnik News](<https://sputniknews.com/middleeast/201802031061334492-syria-su25-jihadists-jet-missile/>).

<a id="event-2018-02-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish Army suffers its deadliest day of Operation Olive Branch so far after seven soldiers are killed in clashes with the Kurdish YPG.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-42934041>).

<a id="event-2018-02-03-0-6"></a>

Context: War in North-West Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing, revindicated in an email to journalists by the Pakistani Taliban, kills at least 11 soldiers and injures 13 at an army unit camp's sports area in the Kabal area of the Swat Valley, in Northwestern Pakistan, according to Pakistan Army figures.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<http://www.thejakartapost.com/news/2018/02/04/suicide-bomber-kills-11-soldiers-in-nw-pakistan.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-02-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Macerata shooting.

**Archived source account.** A shooting in Macerata, Italy, leaves six African immigrants wounded. The suspect is arrested and the case is being treated as a racially motivated crime.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42930749>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-02-03-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** 15760 Albion (previously 1992 QB1), the first discovered Kuiper belt object, is officially named by its discoverers.

Source citations (as archived): [Minor Planet Center](<https://minorplanetcenter.net/iau/ECS/MPCArchive/2018/MPC_20180131.pdf#page=955>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-02-03-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 UCI Cyclo-cross World Championships.

**Archived source account.** Sanne Cant outduels Katie Compton in women's elite race at the UCI Cyclo-cross World Championships in Valkenburg, Netherlands, winning her second title.

Source citations (as archived): [CX Magazine](<https://www.cxmagazine.com/sanne-cant-katie-compton-women-2018-cyclocross-world-championships-valkenburg-report>).

### 2018-02-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1362368064](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%204&oldid=1362368064>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-02-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Cabinet of Israel decides to legalize a previously unauthorized outpost "deep inside the \[occupied\] West Bank", Havat Gilad, allegedly in reaction to the recent killing of an Israeli rabbi there.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/israel-legalizes-outpost-in-response-to-recent-murder/4238247.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Israeli authorities tear down parts of a European Union-funded school in the Palestinian village of Abu Nuwar, on the occupied West Bank, saying it was built illegally. Palestinians say this is the fifth such demolition since 2016, with residents and NGO's each time reconstructing it.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-school/israeli-authorities-knock-down-part-of-bedouin-school-in-west-bank-idUSKBN1FO0M2>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-02-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Cayce, South Carolina train collision.

**Archived source account.** An Amtrak passenger train collides with a freight train in Cayce, South Carolina, U.S., and is derailed. Two people are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [Huffington Post](<http://www.huffingtonpost.co.uk/entry/amtrak-train-derail-collision-south-carolina_us_5a76e01be4b06ee97af35b33>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-42935764>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/02/04/us/amtrak-south-carolina-crash/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Anglo-Eastern Group oil tanker with 22 Indian crew members on board is reported missing off the coast of Benin. The area is well known for piracy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-42938518>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Four construction workers are killed after a crane collapse in Jatinegara, Jakarta, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [Detik](<https://news.detik.com/berita/d-3849000/4-orang-tewas-ini-kronologi-ambruknya-crane-ddt-di-jatinegara>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-02-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Costa Rican general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Costa Ricans head to the polls to elect a new President, amidst a gay rights controversy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-costarica-election/costa-rica-votes-for-new-president-amid-gay-rights-controversy-idUSKBN1FO04W>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-2-2"></a>

Context: Costa Rican general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Fabricio Alvarado Muñoz (National Restoration Party) and Carlos Alvarado Quesada (Citizen Action Party) will face each other in the second round.

Source citations (as archived): [The Tico Times](<http://www.ticotimes.net/2018/02/05/costa-rica-meets-its-new-presidential-candidates-fresh-from-the-middle-of-the-pack>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-2-4"></a>

Context: Cypriot presidential election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Cyprus is set to elect a new President in a second round of voting. Candidates include incumbent Nicos Anastasiades and AKEL candidate, Stavros Malas.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-cyprus-election/cyprus-heads-back-to-polls-for-presidential-runoff-idUSKBN1FO047>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-2-5"></a>

Context: Cypriot presidential election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Nicos Anastasiades is declared the winner.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/02/cyprus-election-anastasiades-leads-presidential-race-180204145720573.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-2-7"></a>

Context: Ecuadorian referendum and popular consultation, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Ecuador is set to hold a referendum consisting of seven questions for voters to approve or reject.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ecuador-politics/ecuador-votes-on-re-election-limits-likely-dashing-correa-comeback-idUSKBN1FO045>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-2-9"></a>

Context: Politics of Yemen.

**Archived source account.** 2011 Nobel Peace Prize co-winner Tawakkol Karman is ordered suspended from the Islah party's ranks after she likened the Saudi-led intervention in Yemen to "reckless adventurism" and "ugly occupation".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-yemen-security-islamist/yemen-islamist-party-suspends-membership-of-nobel-laureate-karman-idUSKBN1FO0DB>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-2-11"></a>

Context: Macedonia naming dispute.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of people demonstrate in Athens against the willingness manifested by the Cabinet of Greece to make concessions in the long-standing dispute with the Republic of Macedonia.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe](<https://www.rferl.org/a/greece-macedonia-balkan-name-dispute-protest-athens/29017009.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-04-2-13"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Robert Doyle resigns as Lord Mayor of Melbourne after allegations of sexual misconduct were made against him. Melbourne City Council is investigating the allegations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-42940408>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-02-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Asteroid close approaches to Earth in 2018.

**Archived source account.** As predicted, a ~600 meter asteroid named (276033) 2002 AJ129 makes a close approach to Earth of 0.028 Astronomical units (4.2 million km, 2.6 million mi).

Source citations (as archived): [Space](<https://www.space.com/39588-fast-asteroid-aj129-flyby-super-bowl-sunday.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-02-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Super Bowl LII.

**Archived source account.** The Philadelphia Eagles win their first Super Bowl, defeating the New England Patriots 41–33. It is their first championship title.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/066eef805dd24fc4b57359a3d4746c08/Foles,-Eagles-outshoot-Patriots-for-1st-Super-Bowl,-41-33>).

### 2018-02-05

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1088977489](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%205&oldid=1088977489>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-02-05-0-2"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict / 2018 Ariel stabbing.

**Archived source account.** An Israeli rabbi is stabbed to death by an Israeli Arab outside the Israeli-occupied West Bank settlement of Ariel.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians/israeli-killed-in-palestinian-stabbing-attack-israeli-officials-idUSKBN1FP1WK>).

<a id="event-2018-02-05-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian government airstrikes pound rebel-held Eastern Ghouta enclave near the capital Damascus, killing at least 23 civilians including four children.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/02/air-strikes-kill-23-syria-ghouta-monitor-180205144157441.html>); [Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/syria-strikes-said-to-kill-23-civilians-in-rebel-area-near-damascus/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-02-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Wall Street stock market sheds 4.6% of its value, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropping a record 1,175 points at close. At one point during the day, the benchmark index loses a record 1,579 points.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/02/05/583325123/stocks-extend-losses-with-dow-dropping-more-than-300-points-at-the-open>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-42942921>); [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/2018/02/05/dow-falls-300-points-open-extending-declines-last-week/306400002/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-02-05-2-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** After talks with Prime Minister of the United Kingdom Theresa May and Secretary of State for Exiting the European Union David Davis in London, E.U. chief negotiator Michel Barnier calls on the United Kingdom to make a choice on what sort of future relationship it wants with the European Union after Brexit.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-britain-eu-trade/eus-chief-negotiator-tells-britain-time-has-come-to-make-a-brexit-choice-idUSKBN1FP0SJ>).

<a id="event-2018-02-05-2-3"></a>

Context: Netherlands–Turkey relations, Aftermath of the 2017 Dutch–Turkish diplomatic incident.

**Archived source account.** The Netherlands withdraw their ambassador in Ankara and say that they will not accept a new Turkish ambassador in The Hague. Dutch foreign minister Halbe Zijlstra says, "We have not agreed on how to normalise ties."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-42943825>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-02-05-3-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Kenya.

**Archived source account.** Esmond Bradley Martin, a world-renowned ivory investigator whose detailed reports contributed to the fight against elephant poaching and the illegal wildlife trade, is murdered at his home in Kenya.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2018/feb/05/leading-ivory-trade-investigator-killed-in-kenya>).

<a id="event-2018-02-05-3-3"></a>

Context: Politics of the Maldives.

**Archived source account.** The President of the Maldives, Abdulla Yameen, declares a 15-day state of emergency. Security forces storm the Supreme Court of the Maldives in a bid to block the court-ordered release of jailed opposition politicians. Police arrest former President Maumoon Abdul Gayoom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-42950997>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-maldives-politics-gayoom/maldives-police-arrest-former-president-gayoom-spokesman-idUSKBN1FP2IZ>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-02-05-4-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Scientists using data from the Chandra X-ray Observatory discover new exoplanets in galaxies beyond the Milky Way for the first time.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/mach/science/first-planets-beyond-milky-way-may-have-been-discovered-ncna844861>); [National Geographic](<https://news.nationalgeographic.com/2018/02/exoplanets-discovery-milky-way-galaxy-spd/>).

### 2018-02-06

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1005415462](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%206&oldid=1005415462>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-02-06-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Hualien earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Multiple earthquakes, including a magnitude 6.4 earthquake, strike near Hualien City, Taiwan. At least 9 people are killed and over 250 are injured, with extensive damage to many structures in the city.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/asia/taiwan-earthquake-latest-updates-magnitude-tsunami-warning-hualien-damage-buildings-east-south-china-a8197496.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-02-06-1-1"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** In the United States, billionaire Steve Wynn, best known for his casino hotels and resorts, resigns as CEO of Wynn Resorts following sexual harassment reports, including a $7.5 million settlement with a former worker at his Las Vegas resort.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/02/06/business/steve-wynn-resigns.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-02-06-2-1"></a>

Context: Freedom of the press in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** Turkey detains nearly 600 people for social media posts and protests opposing the Afrin offensive in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-turkey-security/turkey-detains-nearly-600-for-opposing-syrian-offensive-idUSKBN1FP109>).

<a id="event-2018-02-06-2-3"></a>

Context: Politics of the Maldives.

**Archived source account.** Former President of the Maldives Mohamed Nasheed calls from exile for other countries to intervene in a political crisis engulfing the island nation. Nasheed asks India to help release prisoners and the United States to curb leaders' financial transactions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-42958179>).

<a id="event-2018-02-06-2-5"></a>

Context: Amendment to the Act on the Institute of National Remembrance.

**Archived source account.** Polish President Andrzej Duda ratifies a controversial Holocaust bill, despite angry protests from Israel and the United States. Duda defends the legislation, which will make it illegal to accuse the Polish state of complicity in the Holocaust during the Nazi occupation.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-42959076>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-02-06/far-right-groups-demand-polish-president-sign-holocaust-bill>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-02-06-3-1"></a>

Context: Falcon Heavy test flight.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX successfully launches its Falcon Heavy rocket, a feat the space company hopes will lead to increased commercial and national security missions. Both boosters were successfully landed and recovered. The core didn't land and was softly ditched in the water near the drone ship. The rocket launched Elon Musk's Tesla Roadster, playing "Life on Mars" by David Bowie, which is expected to be in an elliptic orbit of the sun, close to Mars, for several hundred million years.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/business/la-fi-spacex-falcon-heavy-launch-20180206-story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-06-3-3"></a>

Context: Ozone depletion.

**Archived source account.** Scientists (in the article published in the journal Atmospheric Chemistry and Physics) warn that the ozone layer that protects people from the sun's ultraviolet radiation is recovering only over less populated areas.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2018/feb/06/ozone-layer-not-recovering-over-populated-areas-scientists-warn>).

### 2018-02-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1218716415](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%207&oldid=1218716415>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-02-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syrian state media say that Israeli warplanes attacked a military position in Jamraya, Rif Dimashq Governorate, from Lebanese airspace, with the Syrian Air Defense Force intercepting most of the missiles. The target is rumored to be a weapon research facility.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-02/07/c_136957080.htm>).

<a id="event-2018-02-07-0-3"></a>

Context: American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War, United States attacks on the Syrian government.

**Archived source account.** United States Central Command says that it killed more than 100 pro-government troops in "self-defense" strikes 8 km east of the Euphrates de-confliction line that was reportedly agreed with Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.rappler.com/world/regions/middle-east/195568-us-led-strikes-kill-pro-regime-personnel-syria>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-02-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Procter and Gamble announces that it will close its plant in Kansas City, Kansas, and reduce operations at its plant in Iowa City, Iowa, as the company plans to shift production to factories in Tablers Station, West Virginia, and Cincinnati, Ohio, by 2020.,

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/money/nation-now/2018/02/07/procter-gamble-plant-cuts/316907002/>); [Kansas City Star](<http://www.kansascity.com/news/business/article198918024.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-02-07-2-1"></a>

Context: Macedonia naming dispute.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Macedonia Zoran Zaev states that his country is ready to add a geographical qualifier to its name in order to end the dispute. He also says that his government renamed the country's main airport and a key highway.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-macedonia-greece/macedonia-says-ready-to-change-its-name-and-end-row-with-greece-idUSKBN1FQ2OY>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-02-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Politics of the European Union.

**Archived source account.** The European Parliament votes 447–196 to dismiss Ryszard Czarnecki (PiS) as one of its 14 vice-presidents, for calling fellow Polish parliamentarian Róża Thun (Civic Platform) a "szmalcownik" (meaning Nazi collaborator). It is the first time that the parliament invokes the powers of Article 21 of the Treaty on European Union to dismiss a senior office holder. Czarnecki remains a Member of the European Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/european-parliament-dismisses-polish-vice-president-ryszard-czarnecki-over-nazi-slur/a-42485239>).

<a id="event-2018-02-07-3-3"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Rob Porter resigns as White House Staff Secretary after two of his ex-wives make allegations of physical and emotional abuse. Porter denies the allegations, which were first published by the Daily Mail.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/feb/07/white-house-aide-rob-porter-resigns-domestic-abuse-allegations>).

<a id="event-2018-02-07-3-5"></a>

Context: DREAM Act.

**Archived source account.** Nancy Pelosi breaks the record for the longest speech in the United States House of Representatives. The 77-year-old Democrat spoke for eight hours non-stop, pleading for a vote to protect "Dreamer" immigrants who illegally immigrated and face the threat of deportation.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/us-politician-nancy-pelosi-delivers-record-eight-hour-filibuster-on-immigration-11241502>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-02-07-4-1"></a>

Context: Prehistoric Britain.

**Archived source account.** Without peer-review publication researchers at London's Natural History Museum state that the DNA extracted from "Cheddar Man" reveals that early inhabitants of Great Britain had blue eyes and dark skin. The name "Cheddar Man" was given to a fossil of a human man that lived thousands of years ago, which was discovered in 1903. Some scientists in the field state that the sample may have been contaminated with modern DNA weakening the results.,,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-42939192>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/02/07/world/europe/uk-cheddar-man-skeleton-skin.html>); [Gene Expression](<https://www.gnxp.com/WordPress/2018/02/06/the-genome-of-cheddar-man-is-about-to-be-published/>).

### 2018-02-08

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1294955930](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%208&oldid=1294955930>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-02-08-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / American-led intervention in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Syria and the Russian Federation once again state that the United States' military presence in Syria is "illegal". United States and US-backed forces now have control of about a quarter of Syrian territory.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/syria-accuses-us-of-aggression-after-its-warplanes-strike-pro-government-forces/2018/02/08/bab1502a-0cb4-11e8-8890-372e2047c935_story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-08-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Battle of Khasham.

**Archived source account.** A force of five hundred Syrian pro-government troops supported by tanks and artillery launched a ground assault on a local headquarters of the Syrian Democratic Forces near the town of Khasham, in the Deir ez-Zor Governorate. More than one hundred Syrian government fighters were killed in the battle, including Russian private military contractors of Wagner Group.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/blogs/post-partisan/wp/2018/02/09/in-syria-russian-bad-faith-turns-fatal/>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-02-08-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Germany.

**Archived source account.** Germany's trade surplus shrank in 2017 for the first time since 2009, reflecting strong domestic demand.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-economy-trade/germanys-trade-surplus-shrinks-for-first-time-since-2009-idUSKBN1FS0VD>).

<a id="event-2018-02-08-1-3"></a>

Context: Japan–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** After a meeting with top Japanese business and British government executives in 10 Downing Street, Japan's ambassador to Britain warns that companies may discontinue their UK operations if a Brexit without a new trade deal makes them unprofitable.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/business/2018/02/08/japan-issues-stark-warning-trade-deal-no-10-meeting/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-02-08-2-1"></a>

Context: Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action.

**Archived source account.** A senior European External Action Service official says that the European Union, in order to protect its companies doing business with Iran, could implement "blocking regulations" based on a legal framework set up in 1996 for E.U. trade with Cuba, should the United States pull out of the 2015 nuclear deal and restore its sanctions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-nuclear-eu/eu-could-impose-blocking-regulations-if-u-s-pulls-out-of-iran-deal-idUSKBN1FS2FG>).

<a id="event-2018-02-08-2-3"></a>

Context: Commonwealth of Nations.

**Archived source account.** The Gambia formally rejoins the Commonwealth five years after its former President Yahya Jammeh withdrew the West African country, calling it a "neocolonial institution".

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2018/02/08/gambia-rejoins-commonwealth-as-it-seeks-to-rebuild-world-standing>).

<a id="event-2018-02-08-2-5"></a>

Context: Belgium–Netherlands relations.

**Archived source account.** A judge in Amsterdam delays the extradition of the man suspected of a lethal stabbing on the Bruges Market Square, citing concerns over the living conditions in Belgian jails.

Source citations (as archived): [Knack](<http://kw.knack.be/west-vlaanderen/nieuws/criminaliteit/nederland-levert-verdachte-steekpartij-niet-uit-omwille-van-reputatie-belgische-gevangenissen/article-normal-299797.html>); [Het Laatste Nieuws](<https://www.hln.be/nieuws/binnenland/lamentabele-toestanden-in-belgische-gevangenissen-nederland-wil-verdachte-van-dodelijke-steekpartij-op-markt-in-brugge-niet-overleveren~a7aa616b>).

<a id="event-2018-02-08-2-7"></a>

Context: United States–Guatemala relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump meets with Guatemalan President Jimmy Morales. Trump thanks Morales for having supported the decision of the United States to recognize Jerusalem as Israel's capital. They discuss various issues about the crisis in Venezuela, drug trafficking and the UN anti-corruption commission.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/trump-thanks-guatemalan-president-for-his-support-on-jerusalem-embassy-move/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-02-08-3-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Bermuda.

**Archived source account.** Bermuda repeals same-sex marriage, becoming the world's first jurisdiction to legalise, then repeal same-sex marriage. However, about half a dozen same-sex marriages that took place in Bermuda between the Supreme Court ruling in May 2017 and the repeal will continue to be recognised.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/feb/08/bermuda-repeal-same-sex-marriage>).

<a id="event-2018-02-08-3-3"></a>

Context: Crime in Toronto.

**Archived source account.** The remains of six people found on a property in East York are linked to alleged serial killer Bruce McArthur.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/4014121/bruce-mcarthur-investigation-update/>); [National Post](<http://nationalpost.com/news/canada/newsalert-police-recover-remains-of-six-people-in-bruce-mcarthur-investigation>).

<a id="event-2018-02-08-3-5"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Mexican authorities arrest American-born Jose Maria Guizar Valencia, the alleged leader of the Zetas drug cartel, as he was entering a hotel in Mexico City's upscale neighborhood of Roma.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/world/mexico-americas/la-fg-mexico-zetas-cartel-20180209-story.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-43011495>).

Context: 2017–18 United States political sexual scandals.

**Archived source account.** Jeff Kruse announces his resignation from the Oregon State Senate, effective March 15, amid allegations that he sexually harassed female colleagues and other staffers. Kruse denies the allegations.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2018/02/08/oregon-state-sen-jeff-kruse-resigns-over-sexual-harassment-claims/322222002/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-02-09-4-1"></a>

Context: Human genetics.

**Archived source account.** Researchers at the University of Edinburgh claim they have successfully brought prepubescent-sourced, immature human egg cells to maturity in a laboratory for the first time. The work may be significant because it may allow the harvesting and preservation of eggs from young girls undergoing toxic cancer treatment before their lifetime reservoirs of those cells are destroyed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-42976858>); [Oxford Academic](<https://doi.org/10.1093/molehr/gay002>).

Context: Asteroid close approaches to Earth in 2018.

**Archived source account.** As predicted, asteroid 2018 CB, estimated to be between 15 and 40 metres (50–130 feet) in diameter, makes a fly-by past Earth at a distance of around 64,500 km (40,100 mi). This is the second asteroid to make a fly-by this week.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2018/feb/09/asteroid-passing-close-to-earth-today-not-need-to-worry>).

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Mikheil Saakashvili, leader of the opposition Movement of New Forces party, who has been stripped of his Ukrainian citizenship by Ukrainian president Petro Poroshenko on 26 July 2017, is detained by the Ministry of Internal Affairs in Kiev and deported from Ukraine to Poland.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News and World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-02-12/ex-georgian-leader-saakashvili-kidnapped-in-kiev-his-facebook-page>); [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/breaking-saakashvili-arrested-kyiv.html>); [Sputnik News](<https://sputniknews.com/europe/201802121061582323-saakashvili-kidnapped-kiev/>).

<a id="event-2018-02-12-6-3"></a>

Context: Politics of the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** Foreign Minister of the Netherlands Halbe Zijlstra admits to lying about having attended a meeting with Vladimir Putin in 2006. Zijlstra had said that Putin mentioned plans to expand Russia to include Belarus, Ukraine, and the Baltic states but now says that he was not present and borrowed the story from a source.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/dutch-foreign-minister-halbe-zijlstra-admits-to-lying-about-meeting-vladimir-putin/>); [De Telegraaf](<https://www.telegraaf.nl/nieuws/1660792/zijlstra-betuigt-spijt-over-leugen>).

<a id="event-2018-02-12-6-5"></a>

Context: Politics of New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister Bill English resigns as National Party leader.

Source citations (as archived): [Newshub](<http://www.newshub.co.nz/home/politics/2018/02/former-pm-bill-english-resigns-as-national-party-leader.amp.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-12-6-7"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump, United States federal budget.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump sends his US$4.4 trillion 2019 budget proposal to Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/02/12/us/politics/white-house-budget-congress.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-12-6-8"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump, United States federal budget.

**Archived source account.** President Trump also introduces his US$1.5 trillion federal infrastructure plan to several governors and mayors at the White House.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/transportation/infrastructure/373408-white-house-releases-55-page-infrastructure-proposal>).

<a id="event-2018-02-12-6-10"></a>

Context: Presidency of Rodrigo Duterte.

**Archived source account.** Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte calls for female communist rebels to be shot in the genitals. Duterte's comments are described as "a funny joke" by his spokesman, while drawing heavy criticism from others.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/02/duterte-shoot-female-rebels-private-parts-180212071345894.html>).

### 2018-02-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1294815876](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%2013&oldid=1294815876>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-02-13-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** United Airlines Flight 1175 traveling to Honolulu from San Francisco lands safely at Honolulu International Airport, Hawaii, after the pilots call for an emergency landing because of a loss of the engine cowling.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS12](<http://cbs12.com/news/nation-world/united-airlines-flight-makes-emergency-landing-in-hawaii-after-engine-cover-flies-off>).

<a id="event-2018-02-13-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** An overnight fire destroys parts of Haiti's historic Marché en Fer (Iron Market) in Port‑au‑Prince. It is unclear what started the fire.

Source citations (as archived): [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/overnight-fire-devastates-haiti-iconic-iron-market/4252734.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-02-13-1-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** In closed-door proceedings at an Israeli military court in Ofer Prison, near Ramallah, 17-year-old Palestinian activist Ahed Tamimi is indicted on 12 counts of assault and incitement. She is ordered held until the end of the trial, which is adjourned until next month.

Source citations (as archived): [PRI](<https://www.pri.org/stories/2018-02-13/palestinian-teen-made-famous-slapping-israeli-soldiers-video-has-been-ordered>); [VOA](<https://www.voanews.com/a/ahed-tamimi-on-trial/4251231.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-13-1-3"></a>

Context: United Kingdom football sexual abuse scandal.

**Archived source account.** Former association football coach Barry Bennell is convicted of 36 counts of indecent assault against youth footballers in the 1980s and 1990s, following a trial at Liverpool Crown Court.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-43050466>).

<a id="event-2018-02-13-1-5"></a>

Context: Corruption in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israeli police recommend indicting Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with charges of corruption and bribery. Netanyahu calls the accusations "baseless".

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/police-recommend-israeli-pm-benjamin-netanyahu-be-indicted-corruption-bribery-n847616>).

<a id="event-2018-02-13-1-7"></a>

Context: Corruption in Guatemala.

**Archived source account.** Former President Alvaro Colom and his entire government cabinet were arrested for their alleged participation in a new corruption case investigated by CICIG and the MP. They were sent to preventive detention at the Mariscal Zavala Military Center.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/guatemala-detains-ex-president-alvaro-colom-in-fraud-case/a-42570807>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-02-13-2-1"></a>

Context: Politics of South Africa.

**Archived source account.** South Africa's ruling African National Congress (ANC) formally requests that President Jacob Zuma step down after he refused to resign.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-43039928>).

<a id="event-2018-02-13-2-3"></a>

Context: Politics of the Netherlands.

**Archived source account.** Halbe Zijlstra offers his resignation as Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands. Minister Sigrid Kaag takes over the portfolio ad interim.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/livestream/2216964-kamerdebat-over-uitspraken-minister-zijlstra.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/dutch-foreign-minister-resigns-after-admitting-lying-about-attending-putin-meeting/2018/02/13/180a0582-10d9-11e8-a68c-e9374188170e_story.html>); [De Telegraaf](<https://www.telegraaf.nl/nieuws/1667523/kaag-neemt-taken-van-zijlstra-over>).

<a id="event-2018-02-13-2-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Germany.

**Archived source account.** Martin Schulz resigns as leader of the Social Democratic Party of Germany (SPD) with immediate effect. The mayor of Hamburg Olaf Scholz will serve as interim leader until a new leader is elected.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43052436>).

<a id="event-2018-02-13-2-7"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Russia wants YouTube and Instagram to remove videos posted by Alexei Navalny, a prominent opposition figure, describing his investigation into Oleg Deripaska, a Russian billionaire, with bribing Deputy Prime Minister Sergei Prikhodko and offering information about the 2016 U.S. election he had received from Paul Manafort.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/russia-threatening-block-youtube-instagram-video-oligarch/story?id=53046159>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-02-13-3-1"></a>

Context: Supersonic transport.

**Archived source account.** A new plane that would fly from London to New York City in three hours has just received crucial funding. The aircraft, officially named Quiet Supersonic Transport (QueSST) and dubbed the "Son of Concorde", was proposed by NASA and has just been given the go-ahead by US officials. QueSST could make its maiden voyage in 2021 if all goes according to plan. If so, it will halve the current travel time between London and New York City.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<http://metro.co.uk/2018/02/13/son-concorde-plane-fly-london-new-york-three-hours-7309260/>).

<a id="event-2018-02-13-3-3"></a>

Context: Antimicrobial peptides.

**Archived source account.** Scientists announce the discovery of malacidins, a new class of antibacterial chemicals.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-43032602>).

### 2018-02-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1346958389](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20February%2014&oldid=1346958389>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-02-14-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** High-level delegations from the Vatican and the Patriarchate of Moscow meet in Vienna discussing the gains in ecumenical work in the two years since Pope Francis met in Havana with Russian Orthodox Patriarch Kirill.

Source citations (as archived): [AsiaNews](<http://www.asianews.it/news-en/Cooperation-between-Catholics-and-Russian-Orthodox-two-years-after-the-Havana-meeting-43096.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-14-1-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Russian aircraft carry out airstrikes in Ma'arrat Hurma village in Idlib, Syria, killing seven civilians and injuring 10 others.

Source citations (as archived): [TRT World](<https://www.trtworld.com/mea/russian-airstrikes-kill-7-civilians-in-syria-s-idlib-15190>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-02-14-2-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Eurozone GDP rises by 2.5% in 2017, a pace not seen since 2007, and industrial production is up 5.2% year-on-year. The production of durable consumer goods is up 7.4% and capital goods, indicating investments, are up 7.6%.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://www.arabnews.com/node/1246321/business-economy>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-02-14-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A car crash at the headquarters of the United States National Security Agency at Fort Meade, Maryland, injures three people. Police officers shoot at the driver, who they say was attempting to attack the building.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2018/2/14/17011566/nsa-shooting-fort-meade>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-02-14-4-1"></a>

Context: Stoneman Douglas High School shooting.

**Archived source account.** A shooting at a high school in Parkland, Florida, leaves 17 people dead (14 of whom were teenagers), and 17 others wounded. The suspect is apprehended and identified as 19-year-old former student Nikolas Cruz. This is the deadliest high school shooting in U.S. history.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/02/14/us/florida-high-school-shooting/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-02-14-4-3"></a>

Context: Crime in South Africa.

**Archived source account.** The residence of the Gupta family is raided by the South African Police Service's elite Hawks unit and three people are arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-43055494>).

<a id="event-2018-02-14-4-5"></a>

Context: Stormy Daniels–Donald Trump scandal.

**Archived source account.** Michael Cohen, the private lawyer of U.S. President Donald Trump, says he made a "lawful" US$130,000 payment to porn star Stephanie Clifford, aka Stormy Daniels, from his own private funds. The statement to The New York Times comes after the Common Cause organization on January 22, 2018, filed a complaint about the payment with the Federal Election Commission.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trump-lawyer-michael-cohen-admits-paying-porn-actress/story?id=53077299>).

<a id="event-2018-02-14-4-7"></a>

Context: Crime in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan moves to ban two charities linked to terrorist Hafiz Muhammad Saeed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pakistan-militants-financing/pakistan-bans-charities-linked-to-u-n-designated-terrorist-official-idUSKCN1FY1SN>).

<a id="event-2018-02-14-4-9"></a>

Context: November 2015 Paris attacks.

**Archived source account.** After the first trial on the attacks, Jawad Bendaoud is acquitted. Bendaoud rented an apartment to two of the attackers but denied knowing what they planned. Mohamed Soumah is sentenced to five years in jail for acting as an intermediary, and Youssef Ait-Boulahcen to three years for failing to inform authorities.

Source citations (as archived): [Digital Journal](<http://www.digitaljournal.com/news/world/two-jailed-in-first-trial-linked-to-paris-attacks/article/514897>).

<a id="event-2018-02-14-4-11"></a>

Context: Disappearance of Maëlys de Araujo.

**Archived source account.** The remains of Maëlys de Araujo, a nine-year-old girl who disappeared from a wedding in France in August 2017, are found after suspect Nordahl Lelandais guides investigators to the site.

Source citations (as archived): [RTE.ie](<https://www.rte.ie/news/crime/2018/0214/940777-france-maelys-remains-found/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-02-14-5-1"></a>

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Mikheil Saakashvili, leader of the opposition Movement of New Forces party, who was deported from Ukraine to Poland, relocates to the Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [NOS](<https://nos.nl/artikel/2217162-michail-saakasjvili-vestigt-zich-in-nederland-na-uitzetting-oekraine.html>); [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-02/14/c_136976284.htm>).

<a id="event-2018-02-14-5-3"></a>

Context: Politics of South Africa.

**Archived source account.** Jacob Zuma resigns as President of South Africa effective immediately, following an ultimatum issued the day prior by African National Congress that ordered Zuma to step down as head of state or face a vote of no confidence by the South African Parliament to remove him from power within 48 hours of the declaration. Cyril Ramaphosa takes over as Acting President.

Source citations (as archived): [News24](<https://www.news24.com/SouthAfrica/News/zexit-live-will-zuma-respond-20180214>).

<a id="event-2018-02-14-5-5"></a>

Context: Zimbabwean general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Morgan Tsvangirai, opposition politician in Zimbabwe, dies of colon cancer at the age of 65, only months before a presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/02/zimbabwe-opposition-leader-morgan-tsvangirai-dies-180214191937072.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-02-14-6-1"></a>

Context: Concerns and controversies at the 2018 Winter Olympics.

**Archived source account.** A man is caught impersonating Kim Jong-un after walking through North Korea's cheerleading squad.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/kim-jong-un-impersonator-walks-through-north-koreas-olympic-cheer-squad-2018-2>).

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission blocks a Chinese-led group of investors from buying the Chicago Stock Exchange.

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 cyberattacks on Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom government and the United States White House accuse the Russian military of being responsible for the launch of the NotPetya malware in June 2017. The White House calls it the most destructive and costly cyberattack in history and says Russia will be met with unspecified "international consequences". Russia denies responsibility and dismisses the accusation as "groundless", lacking evidence, and "Russophobic".

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Examiner](<http://www.washingtonexaminer.com/white-house-accuses-russia-of-notpetya-cyberattack-threatens-unspecified-consequences/article/2649246>).
