<a id="event-2018-02-15-3-1"></a>

Context: Mexican general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** María de Jesús "Marichuy" Patricio Martínez, the National Indigenous Congress's independent pre-candidate for President of Mexico, is involved in a road accident while campaigning in Baja California Sur. Marichuy is reported as injured while a passenger of the vehicle is dead.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-election-crash/indigenous-mexican-presidential-candidate-injured-in-highway-accident-idUSKCN1FZ05R>).

<a id="event-2018-02-15-3-3"></a>

Context: Istanbul convention.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister of Bulgaria Boyko Borissov says that GERB, his party, will not ratify the convention due to lack of support from political parties. The treaty was designed by the Council of Europe to combat domestic violence and violence against women but critics say its language is vague, it could encourage youth to identify as transgender or third gender and it could lead to same-sex marriage in Bulgaria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-bulgaria-treaty/bulgarias-ruling-party-shuns-treaty-opposing-violence-against-women-due-to-lack-of-support-idUSKCN1FZ0FJ>).

<a id="event-2018-02-15-3-5"></a>

Context: Criminal justice reform in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee backed the Sentencing Reform and Corrections Act, a package to reduce some of the strictest federal sentencing rules along with reforms for the federal prison system, by a vote of 16–5.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/02/15/politics/sentencing-prison-reform-senate-grassley-sessions/index.html>).

**Archived source account.** Hailemariam Desalegn resigns as Prime Minister of Ethiopia after six years in office amid ongoing unrest in the Oromia and Amhara regions.

**Archived source account.** Cyril Ramaphosa is elected by the National Assembly as President of South Africa.

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** NASA's Kepler space telescope has discovered 95 new exoplanets.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/tech/science/2018/02/15/get-ready-some-galactic-context-almost-100-new-exoplanets-discovered/340687002/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-02-19-4-1"></a>

Context: Human impact on the environment.

**Archived source account.** In a Scientific Reports publication, researchers propose 1965 as the start of the Anthropocene era. In that year, human nuclear weapons testing caused a noticeable spike in radiocarbon in the heartwood of the world's remotest tree, a Sitka spruce on Campbell Island, New Zealand. The general scientific community has already been using 1950 as the year "Before Present", when nuclear weapons began to significantly affect the reliability of radiocarbon dating of objects whose organic matter content formed after that epoch.

Source citations (as archived): [The Conversation](<http://theconversation.com/anthropocene-began-in-1965-according-to-signs-left-in-the-worlds-loneliest-tree-91993>).

**Archived source account.** At least 25 people are killed in a fire at a drug-rehabilitation clinic in Baku, Azerbaijan.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov denies White House spokeswoman Sarah Huckabee Sanders' claim that Russia breached any international arms control pacts, after President Vladimir Putin's March 1 speech on nuclear weapons.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-putin-nuclear-kremlin/kremlin-rejects-u-s-charge-russia-in-breach-of-arms-control-treaties-idUSKCN1GE1BF>).

<a id="event-2018-03-02-2-3"></a>

Context: Cuba–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States permanently downgrades their embassy in Havana, making its status 'unaccompanied', meaning a post at which no family members are permitted to reside. The status change comes after alleged health attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Miami Herald](<http://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/cuba/article203114054.html>).

Context: 2016–2018 investigations involving Benjamin Netanyahu.

**Archived source account.** An Israel Police anti-corruption unit questions Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his wife Sara.

<a id="event-2018-03-02-3-3"></a>

Context: Cannabis in Greece.

**Archived source account.** The Hellenic Parliament passes a bill legalising the use of medical cannabis in Greece. New Democracy, Communist Party, Golden Dawn and the Union of Centrists voted against the government-sponsored bill.

Source citations (as archived): [Greek Reporter](<http://greece.greekreporter.com/2018/03/02/greece-approves-medicinal-cannabis-law/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-02-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** A student shoots his parents dead in a dorm at Central Michigan University in Mount Pleasant, Michigan, United States.,

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Italian general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Antonio Tajani, the current President of the European Parliament, accepts the offer of Silvio Berlusconi to stand as a candidate for Prime Minister of Italy for Forza Italia.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.it/20180302/silvio-berlusconi-announces-forza-italia-candidate-for-italian-prime-minister-election-european-parliament-president-antonio-tajani>).

<a id="event-2018-03-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Politics of the European Union.

**Archived source account.** European Union lawmakers strike a deal on opening up the 3.6 and 26 GHz bandwidths by 2020 to make room for the new 5G network.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-eu-telecoms-spectrum/eu-countries-lawmakers-strike-deal-to-open-up-spectrum-for-5g-idUSKCN1GE2IB>).

<a id="event-2018-03-02-4-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Germany, SPD party member vote on the 2018 coalition agreement of Germany.

**Archived source account.** Postal ballots of the 2018 SPD coalition party member vote are due. The vote will determine if the SPD is allowed to form a coalition with Angela Merkel's CDU.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-politics-spd-vote-factbox/factbox-what-happens-if-germanys-spd-votes-against-coalition-with-merkel-idUSKCN1GE26C>).

#### Sports

Context: Long-distance swimming.

Source citations (as archived): [SwimSwam](<https://swimswam.com/olympic-champion-maarten-van-der-weijden-breaks-24-hour-swim-wr/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-03-0-4"></a>

Context: Turkish military operation in Afrin.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Protectionism in the United States, United States–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** In a message on Twitter, U.S. President Donald Trump says the U.S. will apply a tax on cars made in the European Union if the E.U. "further" increases tariffs.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-03-2-1"></a>

Context: "Polish death camp" controversy.

**Archived source account.** Hours after the Polish so-called Holocaust Law about discussing of historical facts takes effect, the Polish League Against Defamation sues Argentinian newspaper Página/12, which it accuses of suggesting Poland was complicit in the Holocaust.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-poland/polish-group-sues-argentine-paper-under-new-holocaust-law-idUSKCN1GF0RF>).

<a id="event-2018-03-03-2-3"></a>

Context: Murder of Ján Kuciak.

**Archived source account.** On the day of the funeral of slain journalist Ján Kuciak, for lack of evidence, police release seven Italian nationals who are accused of links with the 'Ndrangheta mafia in a posthumously published investigative report by Kuciak.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Star](<http://www.dailystar.com.lb/News/World/2018/Mar-04/440157-slain-slovak-journalist-buried-as-police-free-suspects.ashx>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-03-3-1"></a>

Context: Stoneman Douglas High School shooting.

**Archived source account.** The Florida Senate rejects a bill to ban assault weapons and holds a moment of “silence and reflection” for the Parkland, Florida, victims.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/fla-senate-rejects-assault-weapons-ban-holds-moment-of-silence-for-shooting-victims/2018/03/03/698a68cc-1f23-11e8-9de1-147dd2df3829_story.html>).

#### Sports

#### Arts and culture

**Archived source account.** The Shape of Water wins a leading four awards, including Best Picture, followed by Dunkirk, which won three awards.

<a id="event-2018-03-04-0-2"></a>

Context: 90th Academy Awards.

**Archived source account.** The ceremony records its lowest U.S. television audience in recorded history, according to Nielsen Holdings.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43296448>).

#### Disasters and incidents

<a id="event-2018-03-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion followed by a building collapse kills four and injures 20 in Poznan, Poland.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-poland-blast-poznan/four-die-in-building-collapse-after-explosion-in-poland-idUKKBN1GG0VK>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-03-04-2-1"></a>

Context: Online advertising.

**Archived source account.** Advertisers remove their ads from InfoWars founder Alex Jones' YouTube channels. Many of the brands say they were not aware their adverts were being shown on the channel until being contacted by CNN.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/infowars-leading-brands-youtube-pull-alex-jones-a8239371.html>); [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2018/03/03/technology/youtube-ads-infowars-alex-jones/index.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2018-03-04-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 South African listeriosis outbreak.

**Archived source account.** South African officials determine that the country's ongoing listeriosis outbreak—which is already the world's deadliest listeriosis outbreak, killing over 180 people and sickening 1,000 more—was caused by contaminated "Polony" processed meat. The Ministry of Health issues a recall of contaminated products from RCL Foods and from Tiger Brands subsidiary company Enterprise Food and advises the public to avoid all processed meat products that are sold as ready-to-eat.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/safrica-disease-listeria/south-africa-traces-deadly-listeria-to-sausage-meat-issues-recall-idUSL5N1QM0I0>).

<a id="event-2018-03-04-4-2"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations / 2017–18 North Korea crisis.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump states North Korea was recently seeking talks with the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Chicago Tribune](<http://www.chicagotribune.com/news/nationworld/ct-trump-north-korea-talks-20180304-story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-04-4-4"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korean President Moon Jae-in announces he is sending two officials to meet with North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [The Week](<http://theweek.com/speedreads/758924/kim-jong-un-meeting-south-korean-officials-first-time>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-04-5-1"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** In a private speech to Republican donors at Mar-a-Lago, U.S. President Donald Trump congratulates Chinese President Xi Jinping on eliminating China's presidential term limits, reportedly advocates for similar action to be taken in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/03/03/politics/trump-maralago-remarks/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-04-5-3"></a>

Context: Italian general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Italians go to the polls today to elect the 630 members of the Chamber of Deputies and the 315 members of the Senate of the Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43272700>).

<a id="event-2018-03-04-5-5"></a>

Context: SPD party member vote on the 2018 coalition agreement of Germany.

**Archived source account.** SPD party members approve with 66% in favour to allow to form a coalition with Angela Merkel's CDU/CSU, ending a five-month political deadlock after the federal elections.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43276732>).

<a id="event-2018-03-04-5-7"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis, Spanish unionism.

**Archived source account.** 15,000 demonstrators gather in Barcelona, Spain, to support the mock region of Tabarnia—a hypothetical area that includes the least independentist areas of Catalonia—as a way to oppose Catalan independence and the declaration of independence on October 27.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/spanish-unionist-rally-mocks-catalan-separatist-movement/2018/03/04/03564792-1faa-11e8-946c-9420060cb7bd_story.html?utm_term=.88cb452cc071>).

<a id="event-2018-03-04-5-9"></a>

Context: Swiss referendums, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Swiss voters reject a proposal to scrap the television licence fee that provides the majority of funding for the Swiss Broadcasting Corporation. Swiss voters also approve the right of the federal government to levy VAT and direct federal tax until 2025.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43278646>).

<a id="event-2018-03-04-6-1"></a>

Context: Wildlife of Antarctica.

**Archived source account.** Scientists discover a large colony of more than 750,000 pairs of Adélie penguins on the Danger Islands in Antarctica.

Source citations (as archived): [WGN-TV](<http://wgntv.com/2018/03/04/scientists-find-huge-secret-colony-of-penguins/>).

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** Former Secret Intelligence Service (MI6) spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter are taken to a hospital in critical condition after being exposed to an unknown substance in Wiltshire, United Kingdom. Skripal was granted refugee status in the UK following a "spy swap" deal between the UK and Russia in 2010.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-43295134>).

<a id="event-2018-03-05-4-1"></a>

Context: Italian general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Italy faces a period of political instability after the results of the general election are almost complete. The populist Five Star Movement (M5S) is projected to be the largest party in the Italian Parliament with 32% of the vote. The party has long stated its hostility towards forming a coalition government.

Source citations (as archived): [The Wall Street Journal](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/italian-elections-results-pose-challenges-to-forming-government-1520242869>).

**Archived source account.** Former Prime Minister and candidate to the elections, Matteo Renzi, resigns as Secretary of the Democratic Party.

<a id="event-2018-03-05-4-4"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Speaker of the Catalan Parliament, Roger Torrent, proposes Jordi Sànchez i Picanyol as a candidate for President of the Generalitat of Catalonia, but he has been preventively jailed since 16 October 2017, accused of sedition. This happens after Carles Puigdemont resigns as a possible candidate, who, if elected, would have been a symbolic president with a symbolic government in Brussels. The candidacy of Sànchez also reportedly lacks one seat for a majority.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/ccaa/2018/03/05/catalunya/1520277825_272012.html>).

**Archived source account.** Republicans raise concern about U.S. President Donald Trump's plan to impose tariffs on metal imports. Speaker of the House Paul Ryan says he is "extremely worried" about the impact of a trade war, adding that it could "undermine economic gains".

**Archived source account.** A search team led by Paul Allen's company Vulcan, Inc., using his research vessel Petrel, announces the discovery of the wreck of the USS Lexington (CV-2) about 800 km off the eastern coast of Australia at a depth of around 3 km. <a id="event-2018-03-07-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Paul Golding and Jayda Fransen, leader and deputy of the British far-right organization Britain First, are convicted of hate crimes for posting things deemed offensive online. Golding is sentenced to 36 weeks in prison and Fransen to 18 weeks in prison for promoting Islamophobic activities and harassment.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/paul-golding-jayda-fransen-britain-first-leaders-guilty-religious-muslim-hate-crime-a8244161.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-43320121>).

Context: Crime in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Former United States Department of Justice attorney Jeffrey Wertkin is sentenced to 2½ years in prison for what prosecutors called the DoJ's "most serious" example of public corruption, which involved stealing more than 40 whistleblower fraud cases in 2016 with intentions to sell the secret information to companies under federal investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/ex-justice-dept-lawyer-caught-in-most-serious-internal-corruption-case-in-recent-memory/2018/03/08/560071e2-2262-11e8-86f6-54bfff693d2b_story.html>).

The measure also prohibits bump stocks, and creates a program for the arming of some teachers.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/florida-legislature-sends-gun-school-safety-bill-governor-n854701>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1359118592](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20March%2012&oldid=1359118592>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-03-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Acquisitions by Apple.

**Archived source account.** Apple Inc. buys digital magazine subscription app Texture for an undisclosed sum.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/03/12/apple-buys-texture-a-digital-magazine-subscription-service.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-12-0-3"></a>

Context: United States antitrust law.

**Archived source account.** Citing national security concerns, U.S. President Donald Trump blocks Broadcom's proposed acquisition of Qualcomm.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/03/12/trump-issues-order-prohibiting-broadcoms-bid-to-take-over-qualcomm.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-12-1-1"></a>

Context: US-Bangla Airlines Flight 211.

**Archived source account.** An aircraft operated by Bangladeshi airline US-Bangla Airlines crashes at Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu, Nepal, killing 49 of the 71 people on board.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-43369179>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal, Russia–United Kingdom relations.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister Theresa May says she believes it is "highly likely" that the Russian government was behind an attempt to murder Sergei Skripal and his daughter using a Novichok agent.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/theresa-may-russia-highly-likely-to-be-behind-poison-attack-on-ex-russian-agent/a-42947087>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Austin package explosions.

**Archived source account.** Police in Austin, Texas announce that three package bombs in recent days that have killed two people and injured one more appear to be connected. The packages were left off at three separate locations and were not placed there by any delivery service, police say.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/03/12/us/texas-austin-blasts/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Republicans on the House Intelligence Committee announce the end of their Russia investigation, against the objections of Democratic members. According to the investigation's preliminary findings, the 2016 Trump campaign did not collude with the Russian government, and, contrary to the U.S. intelligence community's previous conclusions, Russia did not have a preference for Donald Trump as a presidential candidate.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/house-republicans-say-investigation-found-no-evidence-russia-trump-collusion-n855986>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-03-12-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Superleague Greece.

**Archived source account.** The Superleague Greece season is suspended indefinitely by the Greek Ministry of Culture and Sports after PAOK FC owner Ivan Savvidis invaded the pitch with several bodyguards during a match against AEK Athens F.C. while armed with a gun, after his side had a late goal ruled out for offside.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/43369490>).

<a id="event-2018-03-12-5-3"></a>

Context: College basketball in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The field for the 2018 NCAA Division I Women's Basketball Tournament is announced. Connecticut, the only remaining unbeaten Division I team of either sex, is the top overall seed, with Notre Dame, Louisville, and Mississippi State as the other \#1 seeds.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.espn.com/womens-college-basketball/story/_/id/22737867/connecticut-huskies-top-seed-women-basketball-ncaa-tournament>).

<a id="event-2018-03-13-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2018-03-13-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus plunges into a ravine in the Amhara Region, Ethiopia, killing at least 38 people, mostly students.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/trump-ousts-tillerson-will-replace-him-as-secretary-of-state-with-cia-chief-pompeo/2018/03/13/30f34eea-26ba-11e8-b79d-f3d931db7f68_story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-13-5-1"></a>

Context: Trans-Neptunian objects.

**Archived source account.** 2015 TH367 (previously known as V774104), a 100–400 kilometer asteroid, is announced as possibly the fourth most distant known Solar System object from the Sun at nearly 90 (±10) times Earth's distance from the Sun.

<a id="event-2018-03-13-6-1"></a>

### 2018-03-14

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-03-14-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British physicist and cosmologist Stephen Hawking dies aged 76 at his home in Cambridge.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/science/2018/mar/14/stephen-hawking-professor-dies-aged-76>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/03/14/science/stephen-hawking-timeline.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-43396008>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-03-14-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Toys "R" Us announce that they will close down all of their stores in the United Kingdom after rescue talks fail, resulting in the loss of about 3,000 jobs.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2018/mar/14/toys-r-us-to-shut-all-uk-stores-resulting-in-3000-job-losses>).

<a id="event-2018-03-14-1-3"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Shortly after the announcement of the closure of Toys "R" Us stores in the UK, the company announced that they will close down all 800 stores in the United States, resulting in the loss of about 33,000 jobs.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/business/wp/2018/03/14/toys-r-us-to-close-all-800-of-its-u-s-stores/?utm_term=.b1aeca52f3c6>).

<a id="event-2018-03-14-1-4"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Ford issues a recall of 1.4 million vehicles, including some models of the Ford Fusion and the Lincoln MKZ, citing an issue where the steering wheel could come loose.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<http://money.cnn.com/2018/03/14/news/companies/ford-steering-wheel-recall/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-14-1-6"></a>

Context: Panama Papers.

**Archived source account.** Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca announces that it is shutting down due to the economic and reputational damage inflicted by its role in the global tax evasion scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/14/mossack-fonseca-shut-down-panama-papers>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two U.S. Navy aviators – a pilot and a weapons officer – are killed after they eject from their FA-18 fighter jet, which crashes into the sea off Key West, Florida.

Source citations (as archived): [Navy Times](<https://www.navytimes.com/news/your-navy/2018/03/14/super-hornet-crashes-near-key-west/>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/03/14/politics/navy-f-a-18-jet-crash/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-14-3-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of the Philippines.

**Archived source account.** Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte announces the withdrawal of the Philippines from the International Criminal Court (ICC) over "outrageous attacks" by United Nations officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-duterte-icc/duterte-to-withdraw-philippines-from-icc-after-outrageous-attacks-idUSKCN1GQ0MA>).

<a id="event-2018-03-14-3-3"></a>

Context: Australia–South Africa relations, South African farm attacks, Racism in South Africa.

**Archived source account.** Australian Home Affairs Minister Peter Dutton says white South African farmers could receive fast-track visas on "humanitarian grounds" amid calls to transfer land ownership from white to black farmers, and fears over the number of racially-motivated farm killings.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-43403408>).

<a id="event-2018-03-14-3-5"></a>

Context: Russia–United Kingdom relations, Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** The United Kingdom expels 23 Russian diplomats and cuts off all top-level ties with Russia as punishment for a reported attack with the Novichok military-grade nerve agent, an attack which Prime Minister Theresa May described as an "unlawful use of force by the Russian state against the United Kingdom".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/mar/14/may-expels-23-russian-diplomats-response-spy-poisoning>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/03/14/593419777/u-k-expels-23-russian-diplomats-over-use-of-military-grade-nerve-agent>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-russia/britain-expels-23-russian-diplomats-over-nerve-attack-on-ex-spy-idUSKCN1GQ03R>).

Context: Telford child sex abuse ring.

**Archived source account.** After an 18-month Sunday Mirror investigation, Theresa May has called for an inquiry "as quickly as possible" on reported Asian grooming gangs in Telford whereby up to 1,000 girls were lured from their families to be drugged, beaten, raped and even murdered.

Source citations (as archived): [The Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/politics/theresa-praises-sunday-mirrors-telford-12188617>).

Context: Pennsylvania's 18th congressional district special election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Democrat Conor Lamb declares victory in the special election of Pennsylvania's 18th congressional district. The final vote could still be determined by a recount if at least three voters in each precinct petition for one.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/03/14/us/politics/pennsylvania-congressional-race-conor-lamb-trump.html>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2018/03/14/pennsylvania-special-house-election-too-close-to-call-winner-may-be-determined-by-recount.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-16-1-1"></a>

Context: South African Arms Deal.

Source citations (as archived): [Zenit](<https://zenit.org/articles/apostolic-tribunal-of-cdf-finds-guam-archbishop-guilty/>).

Context: Catholic Church sexual abuse cases.

**Archived source account.** Another lawsuit is filed against the Catholic Church in Guam, bringing the total lawsuits alleging historical sexual abuse to 157. Louis Brouillard, who is now 96, was on Guam from 1948 to 1981, and is accused of abusing boys in 100 of the lawsuits the church is facing.

<a id="event-2018-03-19-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** "Gaudete et exsultate" ('Rejoice and Be Glad'; from Matthew 5:12) is the third apostolic exhortation of Pope Francis, dated on the Solemnity of Saint Joseph, and is subtitled "on the call to holiness in today's world". It addresses the universal call to holiness, with a focus "to repropose the call to holiness in a practical way for our own time".

In response to the fatal accident, Uber suspends self-driving car tests in all U.S. cities as well as Toronto.
