<a id="event-2018-03-20-4-8"></a>

Context: Shooting of Justine Damond.

**Archived source account.** Minneapolis Police formally charge Mohamed Noor with third-degree murder and second-degree manslaughter for the shooting death of Justine Damond.

Source citations (as archived): [Star Tribune](<http://www.startribune.com/minneapolis-police-officer-mohamed-noor-turns-himself-in-on-charges-in-justine-damond-killing/477405923/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-4-10"></a>

Context: Human rights in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations issues a report calling for an end to the nation's state of emergency, claiming it has been used to violate human rights. Turkey responds, calling the report "biased" and "unacceptable".

Source citations (as archived): [al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/03/turkey-slams-human-rights-report-180320112816045.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-4-11"></a>

Context: Human rights in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Human Rights says that Turkish authorities violated the rights of journalists Mehmet Altan and Sahin Alpay when they were arrested in the aftermath of a failed coup. The court ruled the men, one of whom is now serving life, were innocent and their rights to freedom of expression and to liberty had been violated.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2018/03/20/european-human-rights-court-condemns-turkey-over-jailed-journalists>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-4-13"></a>

Context: Human rights in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Department for Work and Pensions wins a court case holding that benefits claimants cannot raise arguments based on the European Convention on Human Rights at tribunals, and must instead go via the High Court.

Source citations (as archived): [The Canary](<https://www.thecanary.co/uk/2018/03/20/dwp-just-won-court-case-literally-allowing-ignore-disabled-peoples-human-rights/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-4-15"></a>

Context: Legal status of cryptocurrencies.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump issues an executive order banning U.S. entities from trading in the Venezuelan Petro cryptocurrency. Trump calls the digital currency, launched last month, an "attempt to circumvent U.S. sanctions".

Source citations (as archived): [al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/03/trump-bans-purchases-venezuela-cryptocurrency-petro-180320094506428.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-20-5-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Norway.

**Archived source account.** Norwegian justice minister Sylvi Listhaug resigns amid controversy over remarks on human rights and national security.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/20/norway-justice-minister-sylvi-listhaug-quits-avert-government-collapse>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-5-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Slovakia.

**Archived source account.** Protests continue in Slovakia after last week's collapse of the government, which included the resignation of Prime Minister Robert Fico.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/parallels/2018/03/20/594898912/slovakia-governments-collapse-not-enough-to-end-protests-over-journalist-s-murde>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-5-5"></a>

Context: Politics of Zambia.

**Archived source account.** Zambian Minister Bowman Lusambo is suspended by Parliament over an assault on a fellow lawmaker in October 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<http://www.africanews.com/2018/03/21/zambia-bans-cabinet-minister-from-parliament-for-slapping-lawmaker/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-03-20-6-1"></a>

Context: Eschatology in Norse mythology.

**Archived source account.** Analysis of ancient ice cores extracted from Greenland dates an eruption on Eldgjá volcano in Iceland. Iceland's largest eruption in the last 2,000 years was described in ancient poem Völuspá.

Source citations (as archived): [Infosurhoy](<http://www.infosurhoy.com/cocoon/saii/xhtml/en_GB/science/a-volcanic-explosion-1000-years-ago-was-so-brutal-it-slayed-icelandic-gods/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-6-3"></a>

Context: Extinction threshold.

**Archived source account.** Sudan, the last known male Northern white rhinoceros, dies in captivity, leaving two females as the only surviving members of the subspecies.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-43468066>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-6-5"></a>

Context: ESA missions.

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency announces a mission to study the atmospheres of exoplanets. Selected as Cosmic Vision medium class M4 mission, ARIEL is expected to launch in 2028.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-43477352>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-6-7"></a>

Context: Japan's space development.

**Archived source account.** Japan announces a fund worth US$940 million to encourage the foundation of new companies involved in space exploration.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/03/20/japan-offers-940-million-to-boost-nations-space-startups.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-20-6-9"></a>

Context: Marine debris.

**Archived source account.** A study commissioned by the UK government concludes marine plastic debris may treble within ten years, and predicts the "ocean economy" will double to US$3 trillion (£2 trillion) by 2030.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-43477233>).

### 2018-03-21

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086688353](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20March%2021&oldid=1086688353>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-21-0-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Houthis claim to have shot down a Royal Saudi Air Force F-15 jet over Sa'da province, Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Sputnik News](<https://sputniknews.com/middleeast/201803211062773665-houthi-rebels-saudi-arabia-jet/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Syrian government and rebel forces reach an agreement to allow 7,500 people to evacuate from rebel-held Harasta, Eastern Ghouta.

Source citations (as archived): [al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/03/evacuation-deal-fighters-eastern-ghouta-town-reached-180321144929829.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-0-5"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency, Dapchi schoolgirls kidnapping.

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram releases most of the 110 Nigerian schoolgirls it had kidnapped in February 2018, and warns against sending them back to school.

Source citations (as archived): [The Globe and Mail](<https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world/article-boko-haram-returns-most-schoolgirls-abducted-from-nigerias-dapchi/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-21-1-1"></a>

Context: Accidents and incidents involving helicopters.

**Archived source account.** A Eurocopter 120 helicopter carrying five people crashes into the sea near Hardy Reef off the Whitsunday Islands, Queensland, Australia. Two people are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2018/mar/21/whitsunday-helicopter-crash-deaths-great-barrier-reef-flight>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-1-3"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2015 Shoreham Airshow crash.

**Archived source account.** The Crown Prosecution Service charges pilot Andrew Hill with 11 counts of manslaughter by gross negligence and one count of endangering an aircraft over an accident at Shoreham Airshow in England.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/03/21/pilot-charged-manslaughter-shoreham-airshow-disaster-killed/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-1-5"></a>

Context: Metro Hotel Dublin fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire breaks out in the upper floors of a hotel and apartment block building in Ballymun, Ireland, near Dublin Airport. The fire affects the top seven floors of the building and two floors of apartments, without casualties.

Source citations (as archived): [RTE](<https://www.rte.ie/news/ireland/2018/0321/949172-ballymun-fire/>); [The Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/ireland/irish-news/fire-brigade-tackles-major-blaze-at-hotel-in-north-dublin-1.3435687>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-1-7"></a>

Context: History of autonomous cars.

**Archived source account.** Police release onboard video from an autonomous Uber car that fatally struck a pedestrian crossing the road in Tempe, Arizona.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43497364>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-21-2-1"></a>

Context: Israel–Syria relations.

**Archived source account.** Israel admits for the first time that it carried out an airstrike on a suspected nuclear reactor in Deir ez-Zor Governorate, Syria, on 6 September 2007. The strike allegedly killed ten North Korean workers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-syria-nuclear/israel-admits-bombing-suspected-syrian-nuclear-reactor-in-2007-warns-iran-idUSKBN1GX09K>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-2-3"></a>

Context: Austria–Israel relations.

**Archived source account.** Austrian foreign minister Karin Kneissl recalls diplomat Jürgen-Michael Kleppich from Israel after he is photographed wearing a t-shirt with slogans linked to Nazism.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.at/20180321/austria-orders-diplomat-home-from-israel-after-posing-in-nazi-t-shirt>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-2-5"></a>

Context: Economy of the African Union.

**Archived source account.** The leaders of 44 African Union states sign an agreement in Kigali, Rwanda, to create the African Continental Free Trade Area (CFTA).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-43489255>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-2-7"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** Russia holds a briefing on the case for all foreign diplomats in Moscow, where it accuses the United Kingdom of "withholding evidence."

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/mar/21/russia-uk-evidence-sergei-skripal-case>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-2-9"></a>

Context: Poland in the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Polish Foreign Minister Jacek Czaputowicz accuses the European Union of "double standards" and of suffering "a deficit of democracy". Poland and the European Commission are engaged in disputes over migrant quotas and proposed reform of Poland's judiciary.

Source citations (as archived): [al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/03/poland-accuses-eu-double-standards-180321161406615.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-21-3-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in Singapore.

**Archived source account.** The Singaporean Parliament approves the Public Order and Safety (Special Powers) Act, which makes it a crime to take pictures and relay information during terror attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/singapore/ban-photos-videos-messages-terrorist-posspa-10062836>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-3-3"></a>

Context: Austin serial bombings.

**Archived source account.** Mark Anthony Conditt, the main suspect in the serial bombings, dies after detonating a bomb in his vehicle while being pursued by Austin police officers. The police chief warns residents that while they believe the bomber is deceased, he may have sent more packages before his death.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/03/21/us/austin-explosions/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-3-5"></a>

Context: Crime in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** James Ibori, a former governor of Delta State, Nigeria, launches a bid to overturn his guilty pleas on corruption charges in the UK alleging police corruption.

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<http://www.africanews.com/2018/03/21/ex-nigerian-governor-ibori-appeals-against-fraud-conviction-accuses-british/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-3-7"></a>

Context: Alleged Libyan influence in the 2007 French elections.

**Archived source account.** Former President of France Nicolas Sarkozy is preliminarily charged with illegal funding of his 2007 presidential campaign, passive corruption and receiving money from Libyan embezzlement.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/french-official-says-sarkozy-charged-over-libyan-money-claims/4309395.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-3-9"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 Parsons Green bombing.

**Archived source account.** The Independent claims the Metropolitan Police misidentified material in convicted bomber Ahmad Hassan's possession as not related to ISIS when in fact it was produced by the group. The newspaper says it has submitted evidence to the Central Criminal Court that could affect Hassan's sentence.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/parsons-green-attack-police-missed-isis-evidence-bombing-tube-a8267601.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-3-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Police in the Philippines fatally shoot 13 suspected drug dealers in Bulacan.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20180325-philippines-police-shoot-dead-duterte-quits-icc>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-21-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar President Htin Kyaw resigns due to ill health. Vice-President Myint Swe, a former general, will become acting president until a new president is chosen.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/03/21/asia/myanmar-president-htin-kyaw-resigns-intl/index.html>); [U.S. News &amp; World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-03-21/myanmars-president-resigns-to-take-rest-from-duties>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-43482191>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-4-2"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Kerala declared jackfruit its official state fruit on March 21, according to the contemporaneous Times of India report. Kerala’s Directorate of Industries and Commerce independently records the designation in March 2018.

Editorial date: 2018-03-21. Checked: 2026-10-21. The designation and precise date are supported by the opened government and contemporaneous newspaper accounts.

Evidence: [Kerala Directorate of Industries and Commerce](<https://www.industry.kerala.gov.in/index.php/latest-news-blog/17-success-stories/404-chakkakkoottam-popularises-jackfruit-through-six-variety-products>); [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/thiruvananthapuram/jackfruit-declared-as-keralas-official-fruit/articleshow/63399673.cms>).

Original source account: Jackfruit becomes official state fruit of Kerala.

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2018-03-21-4-4"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Catalan activist Jordi Sànchez i Picanyol, imprisoned accused of sedition, drops his bid to lead the Catalan government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43483946>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-4-5"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Jordi Turull i Negre, ex-member of the dismissed regional government, who was imprisoned amid sedition and under investigation due to his connection in a corruption scandal involving CiU, is named candidate by the President of Catalan Parliament in an investiture for Thursday, March 22.

Source citations (as archived): [El Mundo](<http://www.elmundo.es/cataluna/2018/03/21/5ab2997aca4741920d8b45e9.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-4-7"></a>

Context: Resignation of Pedro Pablo Kuczynski.

**Archived source account.** Peruvian President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski resigns amid a vote buying scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-43492421>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-4-9"></a>

Context: Antiguan general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Voters in Antigua and Barbuda go to the polls, with Barbudan residents having to travel to Antigua in order to participate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/03/21/barbudans-forced-travel-antigua-vote-islanders-fear-future-land/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-4-11"></a>

Context: Politics of Kosovo.

**Archived source account.** In Kosovo, opposition lawmakers set off tear gas to prevent the ratification of a border treaty with neighboring Montenegro.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/03/21/europe/kosovo-parliament-tear-gas-intl/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-03-21-5-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Fifteen new exoplanets are discovered. Three of them, larger than Earth, are also discovered around the dwarf star K2-155. Furthermore, a 3D climate simulation was created to find out if K2-155d has water.

Source citations (as archived): [Health Thoroughfare](<https://www.healththoroughfare.com/news/15-new-alien-worlds-discovered-recently/6135>); [ScienceDaily](<https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2018/03/180312085057.htm>).

<a id="event-2018-03-21-5-3"></a>

Context: 2018 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** Three people (two American, one Russian) launch successfully from the Baikonur Cosmodrome aboard Soyuz MS-08 to the International Space Station as part of Expedition 55.

Source citations (as archived): [NASA](<https://www.nasa.gov/press-release/two-nasa-astronauts-among-crew-heading-to-international-space-station>).

### 2018-03-22

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256031499](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20March%2022&oldid=1256031499>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-22-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** A car bomb blast in Mogadishu, near the Weheliye hotel in the Somali capital, kills at least 14 people and injures 10 others. Al-Shabab claims responsibility for the blast.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/at-least-14-dead-several-hurt-in-car-bomb-in-somali-capital/ar-BBKyXh4?ocid=spartandhp>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Evacuations of 7,500 people from rebel-held Harasta, Eastern Ghouta begin. Rebels agree with the Syrian government and Russia for the displaced people to be exiled in Idlib Governorate.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/22/syrian-rebels-and-families-begin-exile-from-besieged-ghouta>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A market in the town of Harem, Idlib province, is reportedly struck by Russian aircraft, killing 35 people including 12 children.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/03/22/596279536/syrian-airstrike-hits-marketplace-near-turkish-border-killing-more-than-two-doze>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Yemeni forces launch a missile attack on Aramco's HQ in Najran, Saudi Arabia.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.com/Detail/2018/03/22/556244/Yemen-ballistic-missile-Saudi-Aramco>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-03-22-1-1"></a>

Context: Stop Enabling Sex Traffickers Act.

**Archived source account.** Craigslist deactivates its personals section in response to the U.S. Senate's passage of the bill.

Source citations (as archived): [Buzzfeed](<https://www.buzzfeed.com/carolineodonovan/sesta-sex-trafficking-act-craigslist-sex-workers?utm_term=.rr9JWbmbW#.eujBNg8gN>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-03-22-2-1"></a>

Context: Economic policy of the Donald Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Trade Representative Robert Lighthizer tells a Senate panel that President Donald Trump has decided to "pause" tariffs on steel and aluminium imports from the European Union, Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, Mexico, and South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-43505804>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-22-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Unipetrol explosion.

**Archived source account.** Six people are killed after an explosion at a Unipetrol plant in Kralupy nad Vltavou, Czech Republic.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43497063>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A four-storey building collapse kills two firefighters in Pennsylvania.

Source citations (as archived): [Snopes](<https://www.snopes.com/ap/2018/03/23/2-firefighters-dead-2-injured-building-collapse/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-22-4-1"></a>

Context: China–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump imposes tariffs on US$60 billion of Chinese goods, while also limiting China's ability to invest in the U.S. technology industry.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/economy/trump-moves-to-crack-down-on-china-trade-with-50-billion-in-tariffs-on-imported-products/2018/03/22/c09309e8-2de3-11e8-8ad6-fbc50284fce8_story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-4-3"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Qatar diplomatic crisis.

**Archived source account.** Qatar's Interior Ministry releases a list of individuals and entities it says are linked to terrorism. Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Egypt, who had demanded the list amid tensions with Qatar, welcome its release but criticise the time taken to prepare it.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<http://gulfnews.com/news/gulf/qatar/qatar-terror-list-validates-quartet-s-stance-says-gargash-1.2192723>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-4-5"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Poland.

**Archived source account.** Poland's ruling Law and Justice proposes changes to planned judicial reforms in response to European Union criticisms the plans threaten judicial independence. The European Commission is threatening Poland with sanctions over the reforms.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/poland-agrees-to-minor-changes-to-planned-judicial-reforms-in-response-to-eu-criticisms/a-43092508>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-4-6"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Poland.

**Archived source account.** Polish and U.S. authorities say the completion of the United States missile defense complex in Poland, part of a NATO project, will be delayed until 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [U.S. News and World Report](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-03-22/poland-says-us-missile-shield-site-delayed-until-2020>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-4-7"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Poland.

**Archived source account.** Poland's ruling Law and Justice's Arkadiusz Mularczyk says Germany owes Polish victims of World War II a total of 1.984 trillion zloty (US$543 billion, 440 billion euros) in compensation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/poland-puts-berlins-wwii-bill-at-440-billion-euros/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-4-9"></a>

Context: Russia–Sudan relations.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin accepts an invitation to visit Sudan from Sudanese President Omar al-Bashir.

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<http://www.africanews.com/2018/03/22/russia-s-putin-accepts-bashir-invitation-to-sudan/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-4-11"></a>

Context: Cyprus dispute.

**Archived source account.** The European Union calls on Turkey to cease military actions aimed at enforcing Turkish claims to disputed natural gas deposits. The bloc also asks Turkey to release detained EU citizens.

Source citations (as archived): [al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/03/turkey-slams-eu-statement-greece-cyprus-key-summit-180324073733977.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-22-5-1"></a>

Context: Murder of Maria Ladenburger.

**Archived source account.** Iranian immigrant Hussein Khavari is convicted of rape and murder in a case that provoked widespread discussion of refugee immigration to Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43498151>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-5-3"></a>

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** Ukrainian MP Nadiya Savchenko is arrested in Parliament over an alleged plot to attack Parliament and overthrow the government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43504396>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-5-5"></a>

Context: Alleged Libyan influence in the 2007 French elections.

**Archived source account.** In a statement to French investigating magistrates, ex-President Nicolas Sarkozy refutes corruption charges relating to alleged receipt of funding from the then President of Libya, Muammar Gaddafi, in 2007.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/03/22/sarkozy-kept-living-libya-accusations/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-5-7"></a>

Context: Crime in Brazil.

**Archived source account.** An open letter from international politicians, activists, journalists, and academics demands an independent commission be formed to investigate the assassination of Brazilian human rights activist Marielle Franco and her driver.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/22/marielle-franco-inquiry-letter-urges-brazil-authorities>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-5-9"></a>

Context: Cow vigilante violence in India since 2014.

**Archived source account.** An Indian court convicts eleven Hindus of murdering a Muslim man they discovered transporting beef, sentencing them to life. It is the first successful prosecution of cow vigilantism violence in India.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-43496017>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-5-11"></a>

Context: Palestinian government.

**Archived source account.** Two men accused of an attempt to assassinate Palestinian Authority Prime Minister Rami Hamdallah die in a shootout with security forces. Two Hamas security personnel also die.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Middle-East/Hamas-arrests-suspect-in-attempted-assassination-of-Palestinian-PM-546799>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-5-13"></a>

Context: Crime in Kenya.

**Archived source account.** The Kenyan Court of Appeals rules forced anal examinations on suspected homosexuals are illegal.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/kenya-court-outlaws-anal-exams-in-landmark-victory-for-gay-rights/a-43094775>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-5-15"></a>

Context: Sanctions against Iran.

**Archived source account.** Malta imposes a freeze on Pilatus Bank. The bank's Iranian chairman Ali Sadr Hashemi Nejad was arrested and charged in the United States earlier this week, accused of breaching United States sanctions against Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malta-banks/malta-freezes-pilatus-banks-operations-after-chairmans-arrest-idUSKBN1GY0Z9>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-1"></a>

Context: Protests against Emmanuel Macron.

**Archived source account.** People in 150 places across France take to the streets peacefully in a general strike to protest President Macron's economic reforms. Railways, airways, schools and power generation are affected.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/france-reform-protests/police-fire-teargas-as-strikes-challenge-macron-across-france-idINKBN1GY1QL>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-3"></a>

Context: Cyprus dispute.

**Archived source account.** Turkey announces it is to send a drilling boat to disputed waters claimed by both Cyprus and Northern Cyprus.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/22/turkey-to-send-drill-ship-to-contested-gas-field-off-cyprus>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-5"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** Detective Sergeant Nick Bailey, wounded when he came to the aid of the poisoned Russian dissidents, is discharged from hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-43506232>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-6"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** British Prime Minister Theresa May calls the incident "part of a pattern of Russian aggression against Europe" and promises to raise the matter at an upcoming European Union summit.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-43489457>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-7"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** An inquest is opened into the death of murdered Russian exiled dissident Nikolai Glushkov in London.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/nikolai-glushkov-inquest-live-updates-russia-businessman-murder-london-home-death-sergei-skripal-a8268226.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-8"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** The Court of Protection hears the Skripals are unable to communicate and may have suffered lifelong brain damage. It rules blood samples can be taken from the pair for analysis by the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons and grants the group access to medical records.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/sergei-skripal-yulia-nerve-agent-brain-damage-health-hospital-salisbury-a8269056.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-10"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** John Dowd, the most senior lawyer advising U.S. President Donald Trump on allegations of Russian electoral interference, resigns.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43506098>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/03/22/politics/john-dowd-white-house/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-12"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Jordi Turull fails in the first vote to become President of the Generalitat. The next session will be held on Saturday, March 24.

Source citations (as archived): [La Vanguardia](<http://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20180322/441828264201/parlament-catalunya-rechaza-investidura-jordi-turull-cup.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-13"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Marta Rovira, Carme Forcadell, ex-president of the Parliament and Dolors Bassa, ex-member of the dismissed government who was in prison accused of sedition, resigns as Deputy before the declaration in front of Supreme Court that will be held on March 23.

Source citations (as archived): [La Vanguardia](<http://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20180322/441831127329/rovira-bassa-forcadell-renuncian-actas-diputados.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-15"></a>

Context: Resignation of Pedro Pablo Kuczynski.

**Archived source account.** A Peruvian court confirms it will consider a request to impose a travel ban on President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski if his resignation is confirmed by lawmakers, who are considering whether to accept it. Some politicians have vowed to resist the resignation in favour of instead impeaching Kuczynski.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Jersey Herald](<http://www.njherald.com/article/20180322/AP/303229708#//>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-16"></a>

Context: Resignation of Pedro Pablo Kuczynski.

**Archived source account.** Peruvian Vice President Martín Vizcarra returns from Canada, where he is his nation's ambassador, in preparation to take over the Presidency.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/peru-s-ambassador-to-canada-is-set-to-become-peru-s-next-president-1.4587963>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-18"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump announces former United States Ambassador to the United Nations John R. Bolton will become his National Security Advisor, succeeding the outgoing H. R. McMaster.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/2018/03/22/trump-removes-h-r-mcmaster-national-security-adviser-replacing-him-john-bolton/425301002/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-22-6-20"></a>

Context: Antiguan general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Antigua and Barbuda's ruling Antigua and Barbuda Labour Party wins a second term in a landslide vote.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sun Daily](<http://www.thesundaily.my/news/2018/03/22/antigua-and-barbuda-ruling-party-wins-vote>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-03-22-7-1"></a>

Context: Human genetics.

**Archived source account.** DNA tests confirm Ata, an unusual six-inch-long mummy found in Chile in 2003, to be the remains of a newborn human with genetic mutations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-43489246>).

### 2018-03-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087101091](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20March%2023&oldid=1087101091>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-23-0-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the 2017 Parsons Green bombing.

**Archived source account.** Convicted terrorist Ahmed Hassan Mohammed Ali is jailed for life in London for one count of attempted murder and one of causing an explosion with intent to endanger life. He will have to serve 34 years before becoming eligible for parole.

Source citations (as archived): [Surrey Advertiser](<https://www.getsurrey.co.uk/news/surrey-news/parsons-green-explosion-trial-sunbury-14448223>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Carcassonne and Trèbes attack.

**Archived source account.** Four people are killed and 16 wounded when an extremist takes hostages in Trèbes, France. The suspect is killed by police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43512791>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/03/23/europe/france-trebes-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** A car bomb is driven into a crowd outside the Ghazi Muhammad Ayub Khan Stadium in Lashkar Gah, Helmund, before detonating. At least 13 people are killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-43519692>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-0-7"></a>

Context: Northern Mali conflict.

**Archived source account.** Malian Prime Minister Soumeylou Boubeye Maiga visits separatist rebel stronghold Kidal.

Source citations (as archived): [WBOY-TV 12 News](<http://www.wboy.com/news/malis-prime-minister-makes-rare-visit-to-rebelheld-kidal/1073805190>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-03-23-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of Denmark.

**Archived source account.** Boeing loses a case in Copenhagen city court against the Danish Ministry of Defense over access to documents used in the purchase of Lockheed Martin F-35 Lightning II fighters in preference over Boeing F/A 18 Super Hornets. Boeing argued the evaluation process used in the purchase had been "flawed".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-boeing-denmark/boeing-loses-case-against-denmark-over-fighter-jet-deal-idUKKBN1GZ21W>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-23-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 disasters in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** A fire at a condominium complex in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, kills at least 13 people and injures another 27, with most people dying of suffocation or jumping from high floors.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/fire-at-condominium-in-southern-vietnam-kills-at-least-13/2018/03/22/c0949974-2e3e-11e8-8dc9-3b51e028b845_story.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-23-3-1"></a>

Context: Poland in the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Polish Foreign Minister Jacek Czaputowicz asks the European Commission to halt its use of Article 7 of the Treaty on European Union against the nation in exchange for modifications to controversial proposed judicial reforms.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Poland](<http://thenews.pl/1/9/Artykul/355348,Poland-offers-compromise-wants-Brussels-to-halt-Article-7-procedure-FM>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-3-3"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal, Russia–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The European Union agrees with the United Kingdom's assessment of the incident, stating that "there is no plausible alternative explanation" to Russian involvement.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/03/23/596341516/eu-joins-u-k-in-saying-russia-very-likely-responsible-for-nerve-agent-attack>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-3-4"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal, Russia–European Union relations.

**Archived source account.** The EU ambassador to Russia is recalled from Moscow.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-43489457>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-3-6"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations, Cyberwarfare in Iran.

**Archived source account.** The United States charges and sanctions nine Iranians and the Iranian company Mabna Institute for hacking and attempting to hack hundreds of universities.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-cyber-iran/u-s-charges-sanctions-iranians-for-global-cyber-attacks-on-behalf-of-tehran-idUSKBN1GZ22K>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-3-8"></a>

Context: Cyprus dispute.

**Archived source account.** Turkey calls a statement of European Union support for Greek Cypriots in a dispute over offshore resources "unacceptable". Turkey has been using its Navy to prevent exploration by Cypriot vessels.

Source citations (as archived): [al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/03/turkey-slams-eu-statement-greece-cyprus-key-summit-180324073733977.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-3-10"></a>

Context: 2018 North Korea-United States summit.

**Archived source account.** New US National Security Advisor John R. Bolton says that President Donald Trump should insist on Libya-styled denuclearization for North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-bolton-northkorea/trump-should-insist-on-libya-style-denuclearization-for-north-korea-bolton-idUSKBN1GZ37A>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** Former President of South Korea Lee Myung-bak is detained on charges of taking bribes when he was in office.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-politics-corruption/south-korea-ex-president-lee-detained-on-graft-charges-idUSKBN1GY270>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-4-3"></a>

Context: School shootings in the United States.

**Archived source account.** One of the victims of the shooting at Great Mills High School in Maryland dies from her injuries.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/03/22/us/maryland-school-shooting-jaelynn-willey/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-4-5"></a>

Context: Crime in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Two lorry drivers receive prison terms, one of 14 years, for killing eight people when their vehicles collided with a bus on the M1 in Buckinghamshire, England, in 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-beds-bucks-herts-43520457>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-4-7"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections.

**Archived source account.** Tumblr shuts down 84 accounts linked to the Internet Research Agency.

Source citations (as archived): [The Outline](<https://theoutline.com/post/3871/tumblr-bans-accounts-associated-with-russian-election-meddlers?zd=1&amp;zi=ov6ua3g3>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-4-9"></a>

Context: Gun violence in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The US Department of Justice announces it will reclassify bump stocks as machine guns, effectively outlawing them.

Source citations (as archived): [Axios](<https://www.axios.com/sessions-effectively-bans-bump-stocks-727c6a1c-2dc6-4497-abba-0d2c82fcfbf2.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-4-11"></a>

Context: Human rights in the United States, Transgender personnel in the United States military.

**Archived source account.** US President Donald Trump issues an order banning "transgender persons who require or have undergone gender transition" from the military. Pentagon spokesman Major David Eastburn says this announcement will have no immediate practical effect for the military which will continue to recruit and retain transgender people in accordance with current law.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43525549>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/trump-order-would-ban-most-transgender-troops-serving-n859686>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-4-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** During a three-week US Border Patrol Operation Sandman near Yuma, Arizona, there are 204 arrests for human smuggling.

Source citations (as archived): [KYMA](<http://www.kyma.com/news/operation-sandman-leads-to-204-arrests/720318758>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-23-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen Catalan separatist politicians appear before the Spanish Supreme Court. Marta Rovira, who is "self-exiled" in Switzerland, does not attend.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-03-23/spain-wraps-up-judicial-probe-into-catalan-secession-attempt>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/catalan-separatist-politician-marta-rovira-ignores-court-summons-says-in-letter-she-has-chose-path-to-exile/2018/03/23/0e547f56-2e7d-11e8-8dc9-3b51e028b845_story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-5-2"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The judge remands Jordi Turull, Josep Rull, Carme Forcadell, Dolors Bassa and Raul Romeva into custody again.

Source citations (as archived): [New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/03/23/world/europe/spain-catalonia-separatists-judge.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-5-3"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Judge Llarena reactivates the European Arrest Warrants against Carles Puigdemont, Marta Rovira, and four fugitive ex-members of dismissed regional government.

Source citations (as archived): [El Mundo](<http://www.elmundo.es/espana/2018/03/23/5ab54cc3468aebe24f8b45db.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-5-5"></a>

Context: Abortion in Poland.

**Archived source account.** Thousands protest across Poland against the government's proposed restrictions on abortion.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/23/abortion-poland-mass-protests-against-tightening-of-law>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-5-7"></a>

Context: Resignation of Pedro Pablo Kuczynski.

**Archived source account.** The Peruvian Congress votes 105–12 to accept President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski's resignation.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/perus-congress-ready-replace-scandal-tainted-president-53954598>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-5-8"></a>

Context: Resignation of Pedro Pablo Kuczynski.

**Archived source account.** Vice President Martín Vizcarra is sworn in to replace Kuczyski.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/23/martin-vizcarra-peru-president-kuczynski>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-5-10"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Labour Party leader Jeremy Corbyn sacks Shadow Secretary of State for Northern Ireland Owen Smith after he called for a second referendum on European Union membership. He is replaced by Rochdale MP Tony Lloyd.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2018/mar/23/owen-smith-sacked-from-labour-party-frontbench>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-5-12"></a>

Context: Government shutdowns in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The United States government avoids another government shutdown when President Trump signs the 1.3 Trillion dollar omnibus spending bill into law. This bill ensures no more shutdown threats until October 1, 2018.,

Source citations (as archived): [Federal News Radio](<https://federalnewsradio.com/workforce/2018/03/last-months-spending-cap-deal-brings-more-certainty-to-march-23-shutdown-showdown/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-politics/wp/2018/03/23/trump-threatens-to-veto-omnibus-bill-because-it-does-not-address-daca-recipients/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-23-5-14"></a>

Context: Politics of Mauritius.

**Archived source account.** President Ameenah Gurib leaves the office after resigning on 17 March over a credit card from a NGO scandal. She is succeeded ad interim by Vice President Barlen Vyapoory.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/03/mauritius-ameenah-gurib-fakim-resigns-credit-card-scandal-180317135925154.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-03-23-6-1"></a>

Context: Fauna of Australia.

**Archived source account.** More than 140 pilot whales die in Hamelin Bay, Australia, after beaching themselves.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-43519439>).

### 2018-03-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 855183843](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20March%2024&oldid=855183843>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-24-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** A bomb planted beneath a car explodes in Alexandria, Egypt, as a motorcade carrying the city's head of security passes by, killing at least two people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/03/24/two-killed-bomb-attempted-assassination-alexandria-security/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-24-0-3"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** Saudi aircraft attack Houthi targets in residential areas of Hudaydah and Sa'dah, Yemen, killing at least seven civilians.

Source citations (as archived): [Press TV](<http://www.presstv.com/Detail/2018/03/24/556410/Saudi-Yemen-strikes>).

<a id="event-2018-03-24-0-5"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Greece.

**Archived source account.** An Afghan community centre is burned down in Athens, Greece. An extreme far-right group claims responsibility, and the United Nations condemns the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/greece-extreme-group-claims-arson-afghan-center-53960572>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-03-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Times reports their journalist, Bel Trew, had been expelled from Egypt shortly after her February 20 arrest. Trew had been given the option of a military trial or leaving the country.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/cd4964d9b8cb4905b0c97ed88216286f/Egypt-expels-British-reporter-ahead-of-presidential-election>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/23/bel-trew-egypt-british-journalist-expelled-the-times>).

<a id="event-2018-03-24-1-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Kids' Choice Awards.

**Archived source account.** The 31st annual Kids' Choice Awards takes place.

Source citations (as archived): [Hollywood Reporter](<https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/lists/kids-choice-awards-complete-list-winners-2018-1089562>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Kofu District Public Prosecutor’s Office in Japan announces nobody will be prosecuted over the collapse of the Sasago Tunnel, which killed nine and injured three. Officials say the collapse would have been difficult to predict.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/03/24/national/no-indictments-2012-fatal-tunnel-collapse-japan/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-24-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two men are rescued from a capsized dredger off Malaysia after 50 hours in an air pocket in the engine room. The death toll so far is nine, with rescue efforts underway to search for more survivors.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/chinese-sailors-rescued-50-hours-after-dredger-capsizes-off-malaysian-coast-11302286>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-24-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 inter-Korean summit.

**Archived source account.** North Korea accepts South Korea's proposal to hold high-level inter-Korean talks, scheduled to take place on March 29.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/03/23/asia/koreas-talks/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-24-3-3"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** A friend of poisoned exiled Russian spy Sergei Skripal claims Skripal had written to Vladimir Putin asking to return to Russia. Russia denies receiving such a letter.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-43523923>).

<a id="event-2018-03-24-3-4"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** The 23 British diplomats and their families expelled from the Russian Federation arrive on a flight from Moscow.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-43523923>).

<a id="event-2018-03-24-3-5"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** Investigators discover the Skripals switched off their mobile phones for four hours shortly before falling ill, and begin examining mobile phone data from everyone in Salisbury the day of the crime in a bid to link a phone to the poisoner.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/uk-news/mobile-phone-sergei-skripal-daughter-12248068>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-24-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A car is deliberately driven into a group of schoolgirls in Glasgow, Scotland, injuring five. Police launch an attempted murder probe.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-glasgow-west-43532397>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-24-5-1"></a>

Context: 2018 United States gun violence protests.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of thousands of people participate in the March for Our Lives protest around the world regarding gun violence, mass shootings and school shootings in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-43526413>); [PBS](<https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/what-you-need-to-know-about-this-weekends-march-for-our-lives>).

<a id="event-2018-03-24-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Peruvian ex-President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski's homes are raided by police investigating Operation Car Wash. A judge orders him to remain in Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/peru-former-president-kuczynski-barred-from-leaving-country-amid-corruption-probe/a-43120137>).

### 2018-03-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1362327430](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20March%2025&oldid=1362327430>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** A car bomb claimed by Al-Shabab kills five people including the driver and wounds around ten others outside Somalia's Parliament, Interior Ministry, and Presidential Palace buildings in Mogadishu.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/big-explosion-gunfire-parliament-somali-capital-53999508>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-0-3"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** Two suicide bombers strike a Shi'ite mosque in Herat, Afghanistan, killing one person and wounding seven others. Security forces kill one bomber while the device kills the other. ISIL claims responsibility.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/bomb-blast-hits-western-afghan-city/29122408.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-0-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2017–present).

**Archived source account.** ISIL releases a statement claiming responsibility for killing or wounding 103 Iraqi soldiers within one month. The group also claims to have abducted 13 more soldiers, and destroyed 12 armoured vehicles.

Source citations (as archived): [Iraqi News](<https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/islamic-state-group-claims-responsibility-for-killing-injuring-103-iraqi-troops/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-0-7"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** Houthi forces fire several Burkan-2 ballistic missiles at targets in Saudi Arabia with at least one person, an Egyptian national, being killed in Riyadh. The Royal Saudi Air Defense says it intercepted seven missiles, three of them targeting Riyadh, two targeting Jizan and one apiece targeting Najran and Khamis Mushait.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/saudi-arabia-says-it-intercepts-yemen-missile-over-riyadh/2018/03/25/023a03ea-307f-11e8-b6bd-0084a1666987_story.html?utm_term=.7845d32d1607>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-25-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Kemerovo fire.

**Archived source account.** A fire in the Winter Cherry complex, a shopping centre in Kemerovo, Russia, kills at least 64 people, the majority of which are children.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43531684>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-1-3"></a>

Context: South Korean ferry disasters.

**Archived source account.** A passenger ferry grounds off the coast of South Korea, injuring at least six people with The South Korean Coastguard evacuating all 163 on board.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel News Asia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asiapacific/coast-guard-rescues-163-aboard-ferry-that-hit-rocks-south-korea-10075134>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus and a lorry collide head-on near Kitonga, Tanzania, killing twenty six people and wounding nine others.

Source citations (as archived): [The Nation](<https://www.nation.co.ke/news/africa/Tanzania-car-accident/1066-4357600-1yviun/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-25-2-1"></a>

Context: Trump tariffs, South Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korea and the United States reach agreements on trade and steel tariffs.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-03-25/south-korea-says-agreement-made-with-u-s-on-trade-deal-tariffs>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-2-3"></a>

Context: Russia–European Union relations, Reactions to the poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** EU diplomatic chief Federica Mogherini holds crisis talks with Markus Ederer, the bloc's recalled ambassador to Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [France24](<http://www.france24.com/en/20180325-eu-russia-envoy-holds-crisis-talks-over-spy-poisoning>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-2-5"></a>

Context: Qatar–Russia relations, Modern conflicts in the Middle East.

**Archived source account.** Sheikh Tamim of Qatar visits Russia to discuss the situation in Syria, Yemen and Palestine.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/03/qatari-emir-russia-discuss-syrian-crisis-180325195253621.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A suspected drunk driver loses control while fleeing police in Maputo, Mozambique, strikes a crowd, and kills 21 people, injuring 30 more.

Source citations (as archived): [The Nation](<https://www.nation.co.ke/news/africa/Mozambique-road-crash-/1066-4357432-e2ircez/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-25-4-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Catalonia's ex-President Carles Puigdemont is detained in Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/03/25/former-catalan-president-carles-puigdemont-detained-germany/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-4-2"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Fugitive ex-minister Clara Ponsatí i Obiols says she will hand herself over to Police Scotland, who have received a copy of the European Arrest Warrant for her.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-43529496>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-4-3"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Protests erupt across Spain, especially in Barcelona, against Puigdemont's detention.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43535970>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-4-5"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Carcassonne and Trèbes attack.

**Archived source account.** A former French Parliamentarian candidate of the La France Insoumise party is arrested for tweeting that the death of Lt-Col Arnaud Beltrame was "great" and "one less vote for Emmanuel Macron."

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43534445>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-03-25-5-1"></a>

Context: Novae in the Milky Way galaxy.

**Archived source account.** Researchers publish observations of a possible nova (ASASSN-18fv) in the constellation Carina.,

Source citations (as archived): [AAVSO](<https://www.aavso.org/aavso-alert-notice-626>); [APOD](<https://apod.nasa.gov/apod/ap180325.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-5-3"></a>

Context: Kangaroo Route, History of Qantas.

**Archived source account.** Qantas Airways Flight QF9 becomes the first ever regularly scheduled non-stop flight between Australia and Europe after making the 17-hour journey from Perth to London.

Source citations (as archived): [The Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/uk/qantas-airways-flight-qf9-first-nonstop-flight-from-australia-to-uk-lands-at-heathrow-a3798501.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-25-5-5"></a>

Context: Climate of Europe.

**Archived source account.** An anomalous weather event caused due to dust from a sandstorm in the Sahara, leads to an orange snow blanketing several Eastern European countries, including Ukraine, Bulgaria, Romania and Russia. This weather event happens roughly every five years; a similar event occurred in Siberia in 2007.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/26/orange-snow-transforms-eastern-europe-into-mars>).

### 2018-03-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1179872381](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20March%2026&oldid=1179872381>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-26-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Six alleged members of the banned neo-Nazi group National Action appear in court. One is accused of planning to kill MP Rosie Cooper and another is charged with inciting murder.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/national-action-neo-nazi-terrorist-court-labour-mp-murder-plan-machete-rosie-cooper-latest-a8274521.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-03-26-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. firearms and ammunition manufacturer Remington Arms files for chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after amassing US$950 million worth of debt.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-03-26/cerberus-s-remington-gunmaker-seeks-bankruptcy-shield-from-debts>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-1-2"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Following a collapse of a farm and a large release of Atlantic salmon into the Pacific, the state of Washington bans the farming of Atlantic salmon in their territorial waters.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thesalt/2018/03/26/597019406/after-three-decades-washington-state-bans-atlantic-salmon-farms>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** China launches an oil futures market, with contracts denominated in yuan, in a bid to compete with oil benchmarks from the United States and Europe.

Source citations (as archived): [MarketWatch](<https://www.marketwatch.com/story/chinas-oil-futures-surge-on-their-debut-2018-03-26>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Kemerovo fire.

**Archived source account.** Witnesses and Russia's Investigative Committee say the Winter Cherry complex's exits were blocked and there were no alarms during the disaster.

<a id="event-2018-03-26-2-3"></a>

Context: US-Bangla Airlines Flight 211.

**Archived source account.** The death toll rises to 52 people as a survivor dies in hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [Khaleej Times](<https://www.khaleejtimes.com/international/rest-of-asia/us-bangla-plane-crash-survivor-shaheen-dies>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-2-5"></a>

Context: 2018 New York City Eurocopter AS350 crash.

**Archived source account.** The US National Transportation Safety Board releases a preliminary investigative report containing new information on the accident, in which five passengers drowned when they were trapped in the wreckage.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/03/26/us/nyc-helicopter-crash-ntsb-preliminary-report/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-2-7"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Volvo Ocean Race.

**Archived source account.** A British yachtsman falls overboard from Sun Hung Kai/Scallywag. A search and rescue operation launches, with one ship diverting from over 400 nautical miles away.

<a id="event-2018-03-26-2-9"></a>

Context: History of autonomous cars.

**Archived source account.** The governor of Arizona suspends all statewide-testing of Uber autonomous cars following the March 19 fatal accident involving Uber self-driving car research.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2018/3/26/17166326/uber-self-driving-autonomous-vehicle-ban-arizona-fatal-crash>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-2-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** A same-sex couple and three of their adopted children have been found dead at the bottom of a cliff at the coast of northern California, along with the wreckage of their SUV. After further investigation, authorities eventually deduced that it was very likely that the couple, which was previously known to have abused their children, intentionally drove off the cliff with them.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/04/02/us/family-suv-pacific-coast-crash-what-we-know/index.html>).

#### International relations

Context: Reactions to the poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** More than 100 Russian diplomats are expelled from over 20 countries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-43550938>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-3-2"></a>

Context: Reactions to the poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump orders the closure of the Russian consulate in Seattle.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-43550938>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** European Council President Donald Tusk and European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker conclude talks with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan. The parties say they have been unable to agree on human rights issues but pledge to hold more talks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/dbefa9e6-313d-11e8-b5bf-23cb17fd1498>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-3-4"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-26-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in France.

**Archived source account.** French police detain two men in connection with the murder of an 85-year-old Holocaust survivor who was found in the burned remains of her apartment. The prosecutor's office is investigating if the killing was "motivated by the real or supposed adherence to a religion".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-crime/french-police-investigate-possible-anti-semitic-killing-in-paris-idUSKBN1H22CN>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-4-3"></a>

Context: Carbanak.

**Archived source account.** Spanish police in Alicante arrest the suspected leader of a bank hacking scheme believed to have stolen over €1 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty](<https://www.rferl.org/a/spain-captures-bank-hack-mastermind-1-2-billion/29124973.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-26-4-5"></a>

Context: Carcassonne and Trèbes attack.

**Archived source account.** In regards to the March 23 attack that killed four people, French state prosecutor François Molins charges attacker Radouane Lakdim's 18-year-old girlfriend with terrorist conspiracy.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/mar/27/girlfriend-of-french-supermarket-killer-held-for-terrorist-conspiracy>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-03-26-5-1"></a>

Context: Egyptian presidential election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** The Egyptian electorate vote in their presidential election, with incumbent President Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi facing only one opponent.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/in-egypts-election-turnout-provides-the-only-suspense/2018/03/26/f29ee6f8-30b5-11e8-b6bd-0084a1666987_story.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-03-26-6-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** ArXiv publishes research that a gas giant may be orbiting a brown dwarf. The exoplanet, designated OGLE-2017-BLG-1522Lb, orbits its host at a distance of 0.59 AU and could be the first known gas giant to have formed inside the protoplanetary disk of a brown dwarf.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2018-03-astronomers-giant-planet-orbiting-brown.html>).

### 2018-03-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1087095880](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20March%2027&oldid=1087095880>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Old Bailey Justice Charles Haddon-Cave sentences convicted terrorist Umar Haque, who indoctrinated children he was teaching in London so that he could use them to commit attacks, to lifetime incarceration with parole eligibility only after 25 years.

Source citations (as archived): [The Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/crime/umar-haque-jailed-isis-fanatic-who-trained-army-of-children-to-for-terror-attacks-in-london-a3800411.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-27-0-3"></a>

Context: Islamophobic incidents in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Justice Michael Alexander Soole sentences Paul Moore to lifetime incarceration with a minimum imprisonment of 20 years for using his car to attack Muslims following a string of terror attacks in 2017 linked to Islamic extremism.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/mar/27/man-jailed-life-running-over-muslim-woman-leicester-paul-moore-zaynab-hussein>).

<a id="event-2018-03-27-0-5"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** NATO says the Afghan Air Force dropped its first laser-guided bomb on a Taliban compound on March 22. NATO have trained the Afghans in use of the equipment.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/afghan-air-force-drops-laser-guided-bomb-combat-54044424>).

<a id="event-2018-03-27-0-7"></a>

Context: Turkish involvement in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The government of Turkey states that eleven Kurdish militants have been killed near its Syrian border, and two soldiers were killed by an explosion in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [US News](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-03-27/turkey-says-kills-11-kurdish-militants-two-turkish-soldiers-killed>).

Context: History of autonomous cars.

**Archived source account.** U.S. graphics processing unit producer Nvidia suspends all its tests of self-driving cars.

Source citations (as archived): [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2018/3/27/17168606/nvidia-suspends-self-driving-test-uber>).

<a id="event-2018-03-27-1-3"></a>

Context: History of the electric vehicles.

Context: Maritime incidents in 2018.

**Archived source account.** Malaysian Maritime Enforcement Agency (MMEA) expands the search area to 560 square nautical miles for nine crewmen missing since March 21 from a capsized sand dredger off the coast of Malaysia. MMEA requests for the Indonesian National Search and Rescue Agency to assist in the operation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Malay Mail](<http://www.themalaymailonline.com/malaysia/article/search-area-expanded-for-capsized-sand-dredger>).

Context: 2017–18 Volvo Ocean Race.

**Archived source account.** Chilean search and rescue authorities declare that a crewman who fell overboard from a competitor vessel is lost at sea.

Context: 2018 in aviation.

**Archived source account.** The South Korean Aviation and Railway Accident Investigation Board issues its final report on the March 2016 near-collision between a China Southern Airbus A319 and a Korean Air Boeing 737-800 on a runway in Cheongju, South Korea. The Board reports the Airbus crew misunderstood the full meaning of the specific ground control runway instruction.

Context: Kim Jong-un and Xi Jinping's meeting.

<a id="event-2018-03-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Manchester Arena bombing.

**Archived source account.** A United Kingdom panel, chaired by the former head of the Home civil service, Lord Bob Kerslake, issues a report which concludes that firefighters were prevented from attending the scene of the bombing for two hours. The report makes more than 50 recommendations.

Those devices did not explode.
