<a id="event-2018-03-27-5-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Led overall by researchers at Aix-Marseille Université in France using NASA's Kepler Space Telescope, Nature Astronomy publishes observations of what may be a new exoplanet named K2-229b, whose attributes may resemble the planet of Mercury (hot, metallic, and dense).,,

Source citations (as archived): [Health Thoroughfare](<https://www.healththoroughfare.com/science/nasa-kepler-space-telescope-found-an-exoplanet-similar-to-mercury/6522>); [Phys](<https://phys.org/news/2018-03-newly-discovered-planet-hot-metallic-dense.html>); [Nature Astronomy](<http://www.nature.com/articles/s41550-018-0420-5>).

### 2018-03-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1357724234](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20March%2028&oldid=1357724234>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Sentencing Council for England and Wales issues new guidelines increasing the penalties for terrorist offences.,,

Source citations (as archived): [The Financial Times](<https://www.ft.com/content/9710702a-31cf-11e8-ac48-10c6fdc22f03>); [The Law Gazette](<https://www.lawgazette.co.uk/law/courts-issued-with-terrorism-guidance-in-sentencing-first/5065457.article>); [Sentencing Council for England and Wales](<https://www.sentencingcouncil.org.uk/news/item/new-sentencing-guidelines-for-terrorism-offences-published/>); [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/uk/uk-launches-tougher-sentences-for-terrorism-related-offences/articleshow/63520171.cms>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** A report by Max Hill QC, an independent reviewer of terrorism legislation, reviewing the police response to the March 2017 Westminster attack, concludes that the arrests of 12 people cleared of involvement were appropriate, as was the questioning of them on their religious beliefs.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/mar/28/westminster-attack-police-urged-to-review-questioning-of-terror-suspects>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-0-4"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italian counter-terror police arrest Elmahdi Halili on suspicion of planning attacks with knives and lorries, attempting to recruit terrorist attackers, and creating the first piece of Islamic State propaganda in Italian.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.it/20180328/anti-terror-raids-italy-elmahdi-halili-isis-propaganda>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-0-6"></a>

Context: Libyan Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** United States Africa Command announces that a March 24 airstrike in Ubari, Libya, killed Musa Abu Dawud, who was a wanted alleged senior member of al-Qaida.

Source citations (as archived): [Stars and Stripes](<https://www.stripes.com/news/africom-us-strike-in-libya-killed-wanted-senior-al-qaida-terrorist-1.519223>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-0-8"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2017–present).

**Archived source account.** Iraqi authorities announce the arrest of alleged senior Islamic State member Saab Abdullah al-Issawi in a military-supported airdrop in Anbar.

Source citations (as archived): [Iraqi News](<https://www.iraqinews.com/features/iraqi-forces-apprehend-islamic-states-desert-emir-in-anbar/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-0-10"></a>

Context: Somali Civil War (2009–present).

**Archived source account.** A car bomb near an International Committee of the Red Cross office wounds three people in Mogadishu, Somalia.

Source citations (as archived): [Anadolu Agency](<https://aa.com.tr/en/africa/car-bomb-blast-in-somali-capital-wounds-3/1102199>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-0-12"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Greece.

**Archived source account.** An anarchist group claims responsibility for a bombing outside a courthouse in Athens, Greece, on March 24.

Source citations (as archived): [eKathimerini](<http://www.ekathimerini.com/227150/article/ekathimerini/news/police-examining-remnants-of-bomb-that-went-off-near-courthouse-after-online-claim>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-03-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Conviviality PLC, owner of Wine Rack and Bargain Booze, announces it has been refused investment to stave off bankruptcy and will likely enter administration.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2018/mar/28/bargain-booze-owner-conviviality-on-brink-of-collapse>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates, with help from Korea Electric Power Corp., completes construction of the first reactor complex at the Barakah nuclear power plant 50 km west of Ruwais. The complex is the first Arab nuclear power plant.

Source citations (as archived): [The Mercury News](<https://www.mercurynews.com/2018/03/27/oil-rich-nation-to-open-arab-worlds-first-nuclear-power-plant/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-28-2-0"></a>

**Editorial account; source review complete.** Gran Turismo’s official service notice set the end of Gran Turismo 6 online services for March 28, 2018 at 12:00 UTC, while specifying that offline portions remained playable.

Editorial date: 2018-03-28. Checked: 2026-10-21. The service and date match the source assertion. The separate account distinguishes online closure from loss of offline gameplay.

Evidence: [Gran Turismo / Sony Interactive Entertainment](<https://www.gran-turismo.com/gb/news/00_5985704.html>).

Original source account: Shutdown of Gran Turismo 6 Online Servers

The original source entry had no attached citation; independent evidence is supplied above.

<a id="event-2018-03-28-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A partially-constructed building collapses onto a truck in Jacobs, Durban, South Africa, killing at least three people and hospitalising six more.,

Source citations (as archived): [News 24](<https://www.news24.com/SouthAfrica/News/developing-two-trapped-after-durban-building-collapses-on-truck-20180328>); [Eyewitness News](<http://ewn.co.za/2018/03/28/bodies-trapped-in-kzn-building-collapse-extracted>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A tank containing ethyl acetate explodes in a port in Livorno, Italy, killing two people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.it/20180328/livorno-port-explosion>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** California Highway Patrol search and rescue operations continue off the Californian coast for three children missing following a crash which killed five of their relatives. Their car drove out of a seaside unbarricaded parking lot and off of a 75-foot cliff into the sea on March 26.

Source citations (as archived): [KGW 8 News](<http://www.kgw.com/article/news/local/three-children-missing-after-parents-3-siblings-die-in-calif-crash/283-532481858>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-2-5"></a>

Context: Caribbean Airlines Flight 523.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Federal Judge Michael P. Shea of the U.S. District Court for the District of Connecticut in Hartford, Connecticut awards an injured passenger US$272,000 against Caribbean Airlines over the July 2011 airliner crash in Guyana.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/judge-awards-guyana-plane-crash-survivor-272000/2018/03/28/af1a0882-32ad-11e8-b6bd-0084a1666987_story.html?utm_term=.0c56ee42cdd2>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A New Zealand light aircraft pilot Rod Vaughan claims that his plane was brought down at Waihi after colliding with a drone. If true, it would be the first such incident in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuff](<https://www.stuff.co.nz/national/102701412/pilot-says-drone-likely-cause-in-waihi-plane-crash>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-03-28-3-1"></a>

Context: China–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** The governments of China and North Korea both confirm that North Korea's supreme leader Kim Jong-un met with China's paramount leader Xi Jinping in Beijing during the past four days. China states that North Korea is "committed to denuclearization" and willing to hold a summit with the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles-china/china-says-north-korea-pledges-denuclearization-during-friendly-visit-idUSKBN1H305W>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Reactions to the poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** Former Ukrainian President Viktor Yushchenko, himself the victim of a September 2004 poisoning, calls for military action to be considered against Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/ex-ukraine-leader-do-not-rule-out-military-action-against-russia-11306185>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-3-5"></a>

Context: Poland–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Poland signs a deal with the United States to buy a US$4.75 billion Patriot missile system.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-43574308>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-3-7"></a>

Context: Poland in the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Polish environment minister Henryk Kowalczyk says Poland alone should decide the fate of the protected Białowieża Forest, ahead of a European Court of Justice ruling on whether additional logging allowed by the Polish government at the UNESCO world heritage site breaches European Union rules.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-poland-environment/poland-says-it-should-decide-future-of-forest-at-center-of-eu-dispute-idUSKBN1H42ST>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Italy.

**Archived source account.** A judge in Catania, Italy, upholds the seizure of a Proactiva Open Arms ship that brought migrants to Sicily after refusing to hand them over to the Libyan Coast Guard.

Source citations (as archived): [The Libya Observer](<https://www.libyaobserver.ly/news/italian-judge-upholds-seizure-spanish-rescue-ship>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Crime in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** English judge Christine Henson fines St. Michael's Hospice in St. Leonards, at East Sussex, over the July 2015 fire in which three residents died.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-sussex-43553776>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-5"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** Police investigating the attack say they believe the Skripals were poisoned at Sergei Skripal's home.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/skripals-were-poisoned-at-their-home-police-believe-11307561>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-7"></a>

Context: History of autonomous cars.

**Archived source account.** Claims emerge that Uber had disabled Volvo's collision avoidance technology in the self-driving car involved in a fatal accident in Arizona.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-03-26/uber-disabled-volvo-suv-s-standard-safety-system-before-fatality>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-8"></a>

Context: History of autonomous cars.

**Archived source account.** Uber reaches an out-of-court settlement with the victim's family.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-autos-selfdriving-uber-settlement/uber-reaches-settlement-with-family-of-autonomous-vehicle-victim-idUSKBN1H5092>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-10"></a>

Context: Crime in Qatar.

**Archived source account.** Mubarak al-Ajji, named on a Qatari official list of wanted terrorists, wins second place at a government-sponsored triathlon and is photographed at the medal ceremony.

Source citations (as archived): [The Week](<http://www.theweek.co.uk/odd-news/92582/wanted-terrorist-finishes-second-in-qatar-triathlon>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-12"></a>

Context: Crime in Canada.

**Archived source account.** A court in Quebec City accepts guilty pleas to six murders and six attempted murders tendered by Alexandre Bissonnette on March 26 and lifts restrictions on reporting the pleas after he passes a psychiatric evaluation. The charges relate to the January 2017 Islamophobic shooting at a mosque that Justin Trudeau described as a terrorist attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/2139363/canadian-man-pleads-guilty-killing-6-2017-quebec>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-14"></a>

Context: Crime in China.

**Archived source account.** A Chinese court sentences Zhang Zhongsheng, the former Vice Mayor of Lüliang, Shanxi, to death. Zhongsheng was convicted of accepting bribes totaling 1.04 billion yuan (US$160 million).

Source citations (as archived): [The South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/china/policies-politics/article/2139335/death-penalty-godfather-chinese-coal-mining-town-over>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-16"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Orlando nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** The trial of Noor Salman, widow of Pulse nightclub shooter Omar Mateen, hears closing arguments. Jurors begin deliberations. During the trial it was revealed that Mateen's father was an FBI informant.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/03/28/us/noor-salman-pulse-trial-closing-arguments/index.html>).

Context: Cyberattacks.

**Archived source account.** Computers at Boeing are infected with the WannaCry ransomware.

Source citations (as archived): [The Seattle Times](<https://www.seattletimes.com/business/boeing-aerospace/boeing-hit-by-wannacry-virus-fears-it-could-cripple-some-jet-production/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-4-19"></a>

**Archived source account.** French left-wing activist Stephane Poussier receives a one-year suspended term for praising the death of a policeman in a terrorist attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/french-vegan-faces-terror-charge-over-dead-butcher-comment/>).

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Clara Ponsatí i Obiols, fugitive ex-Minister of Education of Catalonia, hands herself over to Police Scotland. She appears before court and is released on bail.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-03-28-6-1"></a>

Context: Australian Aboriginal languages.

**Archived source account.** The linguistics journal Diachronica publishes Australian research implying that a tracement of the country's indigenous languages can be made back to a single, common language known as Proto-Australian, which was spoken around 10,000-years ago.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-43564134>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-6-3"></a>

Context: Giant-impact hypothesis.

**Archived source account.** Research published in the journal Science Advances implies the Earth may have had water earlier than thought, and that terrestrial water could have survived the impact that created the Moon, the event which was previously hypothesised to be responsible for our planet's water.,

Source citations (as archived): [New Scientist](<https://www.newscientist.com/article/2165141-earth-had-water-even-before-the-collision-that-made-the-moon/>); [Science Advances](<http://advances.sciencemag.org/content/4/3/eaao5928>).

<a id="event-2018-03-28-6-5"></a>

Context: Galaxy formation and evolution.

**Archived source account.** Research published in the journal Nature implies the existence of a galaxy that appears to contain no dark matter, dubbed NGC1052-DF2. If confirmed it would be the first such galaxy discovered.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-43543195>); [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/nature25767>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2016 Berlin truck attack.

**Archived source account.** Italian police arrest five Tunisians suspected of links to Anis Amri, perpetrator of the December 2016 terror attack in Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-security-arrests/italy-anti-terrorism-swoop-linked-to-berlin-truck-attacker-idUSKBN1H50TL>).

<a id="event-2018-03-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Israel.

**Archived source account.** The Central District Attorney’s Office filed an indictment with the Israeli Lod District Court against Abed al-Karim Adel Asi for the murder of a rabbi on February 5 and the Haifa District Attorney’s Office filed an indictment against Malek Yusef Nahar Asadi for the March 4 attempted murder by ramming a car which injured four people.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Indictment-filed-against-Ariel-terrorist-547450>).

<a id="event-2018-03-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. District judge George B. Daniels of the District Court for the Southern District of New York has rejected the government of Saudi Arabia’s request to throw out lawsuits claiming the nation helped plan the September 11 attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/saudi-arabia-9-11-victims-lawsuit-us-court-allowed-twin-towers-terror-attack-september-a8279236.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** British automotive and aerospace engineering firm GKN (founded in 1759) is sold to British-based investment company Melrose Industries for £8.1 billion.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-43584083>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 6.9 earthquake strikes off the coast of New Britain Island, Papua New Guinea, at a depth of 35 km. There are no reports of immediate damage. \[ (BBC)

<a id="event-2018-03-29-2-3"></a>

<a id="event-2018-03-29-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 inter-Korean summit.

**Archived source account.** Authorities announce that the summit between the governments of North Korea and South Korea will take place on April 27, 2018.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-29-4-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Valencia, Venezuela fire.

**Archived source account.** An attempted prison break and subsequent rioting and fires at a police station in Valencia, Carabobo State, Venezuela, results in at least 68 people dead. Two women who were visiting inmates are thought to be among the dead. Prosecutor General Tarek Saab says an investigation into what has happened would begin immediately.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-43579108>).

<a id="event-2018-03-29-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A French animal rights activist is charged under counterterror legislation for praising the death of a butcher in a terror attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/french-vegan-faces-terror-charge-over-dead-butcher-comment/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-29-4-4"></a>

Context: Extradition law in the United States.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Department of Justice immigration Judge Jose A. Sanchez in Boston, Massachusetts, approves an extradition request from the government of Guatemala for Juan Alicio Samayoa Cabrera, who is wanted for trial for war crimes.

Source citations (as archived): [WBUR News](<http://www.wbur.org/news/2017/12/21/alleged-war-criminal-samayoa-denied-bail>).

<a id="event-2018-03-29-4-6"></a>

Context: Asylum in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Because the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) routinely failed to notify screened immigrant asylum-seekers of the one-year deadline for filing an actual asylum application, Western Washington state chief federal district judge Ricardo S. Martinez orders DHS to give those who missed the deadline another year to file their application, and to modify the DHS asylum system to avoid future problems.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/us-judge-opens-door-for-thousands-to-apply-for-asylum/2018/03/29/93720e20-33ae-11e8-b6bd-0084a1666987_story.html?utm_term=.752a54d11794>).

<a id="event-2018-03-29-4-8"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** A pair of women accuse The Ren &amp; Stimpy Show creator John Kricfalusi of sexually abusing them in the 1990s while they were minors. Kricfalusi, who was in his 40s at the time, admitted to Buzzfeed that he had an underage girlfriend during the years in question.

Source citations (as archived): [BuzzFeed](<https://www.buzzfeed.com/arianelange/john-kricfalusi-ren-stimpy-underage-sexual-abuse?utm_term=.ogbENOXON#.fo8Nq9b9q>).

<a id="event-2018-03-29-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** A car bomb kills five people and injures six others in Ajdabiya, Libya.

### 2018-03-30

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-03-30-0-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** A bomb targeting police in Dera Ismail Khan, Pakistan, kills three people and injures five others.

<a id="event-2018-03-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** A roadside bomb in Syria kills one British and one U.S. soldier and injures five more coalition personnel. It is the first death of a British soldier fighting ISIL.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/03/30/british-soldier-killed-ied-syria/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-30-0-4"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The government of Turkey rejects the government of France's offer to mediate in the conflict between Turkish armed forces and Kurdish YPG militia in Syria.

<a id="event-2018-03-30-0-6"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** On Land Day, the start of a planned six-week protest at the Israeli-Gazan border involving tens of thousands of Palestinians, Israeli forces kill 16 Palestinians and wound over 1,100 others as tens of thousands of protestors approach the border fence.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/6-gazans-said-wounded-as-thousands-flock-to-border-to-protest/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-protests/israeli-forces-kill-15-palestinians-in-gaza-border-protests-gaza-medics-idUSKBN1H60AV>).

<a id="event-2018-03-30-0-8"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Italy.

**Archived source account.** In the latest in a series of raids, Italian authorities detain 19-year-old Ilyass Hadouz in Fossano on suspicion of pro-ISIL extremism.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<http://www.euronews.com/2018/03/30/moroccan-terror-suspect-detained-in-italy>).

<a id="event-2018-03-30-0-9"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Italy.

**Archived source account.** National counter-terror prosecutor Federico Cafiero de Raho states that an estimated 50 people have returned to Italy after fighting with the Islamic State.

Source citations (as archived): [ANSA](<http://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2018/03/30/50-foreign-fighters-in-italy-2_3049e7bd-2499-4142-bbf4-7a43dfc2aded.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-30-0-11"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Orlando nightclub shooting.

**Archived source account.** A United States court jury in Florida finds the widow of Omar Mateen not guilty of assisting her husband in the June 2016 attack that killed 49 people.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/03/30/us/noor-salman-pulse-trial-verdict/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-30-0-13"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany.

**Archived source account.** Police in Germany announce that earlier this week they detained four Syrian nationals on suspicion of arson and attempted murder over a Turkish Muslim mosque firebombing in Ulm. Police say the attack "may have been politically motivated".

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.de/20180330/four-syrians-held-for-molotov-mosque-attack>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-03-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus carrying migrant workers from Myanmar catches fire near Bangkok, Thailand, killing twenty people and injuring one other.

Source citations (as archived): [Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/thailand-bus-fire-at-least-20-workers-killed-as-doubledecker-bus-goes-up-in-flames-a3802861.html>).

President Vladimir Putin claimed in his March 1 state of the nation speech that the new nuclear arsenal will be impossible for U.S.-engineered technology to intercept.

Context: Illegal immigration to the United States.

**Archived source account.** Mexican federal police and migration agents find 136 migrants in a locked truck abandoned near a freeway in Veracruz. Without water or food, the people from the countries of Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, and Nicaragua, including dozens of minors, were en route to the United States.

Context: Immigration to the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration through the United States Department of State publishes a 60-day notice of request for public comment, proposing to collect social media identities from nearly everyone who seeks entry into the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [The Indian Express](<http://indianexpress.com/article/world/us-visa-applicants-to-be-asked-for-social-media-history-5117680/>).

<a id="event-2018-03-30-4-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** Alexanda Amon Kotey and El Shafee Elsheikh, detained in Syria on suspicion of beheading hostages for Islamic State, claim their right to a fair trial has been breached by the government of the United Kingdom stripping them of citizenship.

Context: Terrorism in the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2018/03/30/maryland-man-gets-20-years-for-supporting-islamic-state.html>).

<a id="event-2018-03-30-4-17"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. sportswear brand Under Armour states that the personal details (including user names, email addresses and scrambled passwords) of about 150 million users of the MyFitnessPal application were compromised in one of the biggest hacks in history.

Jonathan Wehrle, former pastor of St. Martha's Catholic Church in Okemos, a Lansing suburb, for the embezzlement of more than $5 million from his parish. Wehrle already faces six criminal counts for using embezzled funds to pay for home construction (appraised for much more than a $1 million), maintenance, and purchases.,,

Source citations (as archived): [Lansing State Journal](<https://www.lansingstatejournal.com/story/news/local/2018/03/30/insurer-lansing-diocese-files-suit-against-okemos-priest-accused-embezzlement/471649002/>); [AP](<http://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/diocese-insurer-sues-michigan-priest-accused-embezzlement-54125005>); [Lansing State Journal²](<https://www.lansingstatejournal.com/story/news/local/2017/11/17/okemos-priest-appears-final-day-hearing-embezzlement-charge/871893001/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Gong to the church's top leadership group, the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles. They are respectively the first Latin American and first man of Asian descent to serve in this role.

<a id="event-2018-03-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S.-based automobile manufacturer Tesla confirms that one of their Model X cars was placed into Autopilot mode moments before a fatal crash in California, United States. Tesla's Autopilot system is not intended to operate independently and as such the driver is meant to have their hands on the wheel at all times. The recorder of the system logged that the driver did not have their hands on the wheel at the time of the crash.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43604440>).

<a id="event-2018-03-31-2-1"></a>

Although the prediction remains highly uncertain, the station may impact around Africa.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-03-31-4-1"></a>

Context: Crime in Russia.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Ministry of Internal Affairs detains Ziyavudin Magomedov, his brother Magomed Magomedov, and the chief executive of the Summa Group on charges of embezzlement of public funds and criminal association. A Moscow court orders Ziyavudin Magomedov, one of the richest Russians, to remain in pre-trial custody until May 30.,

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<http://tass.com/society/997067>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/russia-summa-detention/russian-tycoon-magomedov-to-stay-in-pre-trial-custody-until-may-idUSR4N1RC004>).

<a id="event-2018-03-31-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pakistani Interior Minister Ahsan Iqbal says the government will contest a court ruling allowing MML's participation in upcoming elections this year.

Context: Terrorism in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility for the deaths of four Christians in Quetta, Pakistan on April 2nd.

Source citations (as archived): [UCA News](<https://www.ucanews.com/news/four-catholics-killed-in-pakistan-terrorist-attack/81957>).

<a id="event-2018-04-03-0-16"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Police raid two homes in West Yorkshire and detain two men suspected of "being concerned in the commission, preparation or instigation of acts of terrorism".

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/terror-plot-west-yorkshire-two-men-arrested-police-latest-updates-dewsbury-counter-terrorism-north-a8286206.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-03-0-17"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The Police Service of Northern Ireland says it was firebombed at a march in Londonderry to commemorate a Troubles attack, calling the assaults an "attempt to kill or maim" officers.

Source citations (as archived): [News Letter](<https://www.newsletter.co.uk/news/crime/petrol-bomb-attacks-attempt-to-kill-psni-officers-1-8442063>).

<a id="event-2018-04-03-0-18"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Police launch an investigation after Robert McClenaghan, a convicted ex-Irish Republican Army bomber, claims online to have planted a large number of bombs during the Troubles.

Source citations (as archived): [News Letter](<https://www.newsletter.co.uk/news/psni-to-probe-claims-of-ex-ira-bomber-on-victims-forum-1-8441932>).

<a id="event-2018-04-03-0-20"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Failed suicide bomber Kurnia Widodo tells a court in Jakarta he believes imprisoned cleric Aman Abdurrahman is ISIL's Indonesian leader.

Source citations (as archived): [The Australian](<https://www.theaustralian.com.au/news/world/bombmaker-names-aman-abdurrahman-as-isis-leader-in-indonesia/news-story/18d3cb98e47e01c5ae7053405656b566>).

<a id="event-2018-04-03-0-22"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Italy.

**Archived source account.** Italian authorities say a major terror alert in Rome last week was for an innocent man whose fiancé had made false, anonymous accusations to the Italian embassy in Tunisia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Arabiya](<http://english.alarabiya.net/en/variety/2018/04/03/Woman-fabricates-terror-claims-on-Tunisian-fianc-causes-Rome-emergency-alert.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-04-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Censorship in the United Kingdom, Legal status of pornography.

**Archived source account.** The British Board of Film Classification issues draft guidelines outlining how it plans to enforce planned blocks on online pornography unless it comes with age verification systems. The blocks were initially planned to come into force this month.

Source citations (as archived): [Wired](<https://www.wired.co.uk/article/bbfc-porn-consultation-age-verification>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-04-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

<a id="event-2018-04-04-0-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Protests enter a second week, with the death toll from last week's clashes at the Israeli-Gazan border rising to 19. Hamas organisers direct participants to stay well back from the border fence to prevent further violence.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/palestinians/.premium-tens-of-thousands-of-palestinians-prepare-for-second-weekend-protest-1.5975456>).

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian Authority asks the United Nations to investigate.

<a id="event-2018-04-04-0-5"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Israeli human rights group B'Tselem launches a campaign calling on soldiers to refuse orders at the border.

Source citations (as archived): [+972](<https://972mag.com/btselem-to-israeli-soldiers-refuse-orders-to-shoot-gaza-protesters/134398/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-04-0-9"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Police questioning two men suspected of plotting terror attacks in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, are granted an extension until April 10 to detain the suspects.

Context: Terrorism in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** The Sohag Criminal Court in Egypt sentences 35 alleged Muslim Brotherhood members to life imprisonment and imposes prison terms on 155 more. Separately, a military court sentences four more to life imprisonment, imposes prison terms on two others, and acquits 13.

**Archived source account.** Glasgow Sheriff Court sentences HMP Barlinnie prison officer Brian Johnstone to three years imprisonment for repeatedly sexually assaulting two inmates in the showers and their cells between 2013 and 2016.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-glasgow-west-43670870>).

<a id="event-2018-04-06-6-12"></a>

Context: ValuJet Flight 592.

**Archived source account.** The FBI offers a US$10,000 reward for information leading to the capture of mechanic Mauro Ociel Valenzuela-Reyes, who is accused of triggering the 1996 disaster by mispackaging oxygen cylinders that caught fire in the DC-9's hold. He fled justice in 1999.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/06/us/valujet-fugitive-reward/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-06-6-14"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** A Central Criminal Court judge sentences Dutch-Somali terror convict Aweys Shikhey to eight years with an extended licence of four years. Shikhey received international attention for fantasy chats with a Kenyan online about murdering David Cameron, Queen Elizabeth II, Jews, and football fans.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<http://jewishnews.timesofisrael.com/somalian-who-planned-attack-on-jews-jailed-for-trying-to-join-isis/>); [NLTimes.nl](<https://nltimes.nl/2018/04/06/british-court-sentences-dutch-man-8-years-terrorism>).

<a id="event-2018-04-06-6-16"></a>

Context: 2018 in UFC.

**Archived source account.** Irish mixed martial arts fighter Conor McGregor appears in court and is released on bail after being charged with assault and criminal mischief.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/43665867>).

<a id="event-2018-04-06-6-18"></a>

Context: Human rights in North Korea.

**Archived source account.** The International Criminal Court rejects a petition to investigate North Korean leader Kim Jong Un for war crimes. The petition by Japanese families of alleged victims was turned down because the alleged wrongdoing predates Japan's 2007 joining of the ICC.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20180407_07/>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/05/german-court-says-carles-puigdemont-can-be-released-on-bail>).

Context: Facebook and Cambridge Analytica data breach.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-43680969>).

**Archived source account.** Virgin Galactic successfully tests VSS Unity, the first test since an October 2014 crash destroyed a previous version, VSS Enterprise.

### 2018-04-07

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-04-07-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Israeli troops shoot dead ten Palestinians near the Israel–Gaza barrier, including a Palestinian journalist, as protests continue.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-43667947>).

<a id="event-2018-04-07-0-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** A funeral is held for journalist Yasser Murtaja, shot at the fence wearing a press jacket covering tyre burnings by protestors yesterday. Israel denies targeting journalists intentionally and says it is investigating.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/07/hundreds-funeral-palestinian-journalist-gaza>).

<a id="event-2018-04-07-0-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defence Minister Avigdor Liberman both praise the military response, with Liberman accusing Murtaja of "putting himself in danger" by operating a drone.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/liberman-israels-preparation-on-the-gaza-border-proved-itself/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-07-0-5"></a>

Context: 2018 Münster vehicle ramming.

**Archived source account.** A man drives a van into a group of people in Münster, Germany, killing two and injuring 30. The driver then shoots and kills himself.

Source citations (as archived): [Express](<https://www.express.co.uk/news/world/942757/Germany-news-Cottbus-van-attack-police-alert>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/07/europe/germany-muenster-crash/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-07-0-7"></a>

Context: Terrorism in India.

**Archived source account.** Local authorities in Goa, India, issue a terror alert for the West Coast for fishing vessels, resorts, barges, and offshore casinos. The alert states a fishing vessel may be used to launch a terrorist attack. The Ports Minister states that Pakistan has seized an Indian fishing vessel in connection with the alleged plot.

Source citations (as archived): [The Financial Express](<http://www.financialexpress.com/india-news/goa-government-issues-alert-after-intel-on-possible-terror-attack-10-developments/1124751/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-07-0-9"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Metropolitan Police arrest a suspected terrorist at Gatwick Airport after he arrives on a flight from Morocco.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-43680838>).

<a id="event-2018-04-07-0-11"></a>

Context: Cyberattacks on Iran.

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Information and Communications Technology of Iran says hackers attacked its networks, leaving an image of US flags on screens. A researcher at Cisco's Talos security group acknowledges "several incidents in multiple countries" involving the use of their Smart Install protocol.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-cyber-hackers/iran-hit-by-global-cyber-attack-that-left-u-s-flag-on-screens-idUSKBN1HE0MH>).

<a id="event-2018-04-09-6-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Abderrahman Bouanane goes on trial in a courtroom set up within a prison in Turku, Finland, accused of two murders and eight attempted murders in an alleged terror attack. The charges, the first terrorism crimes ever charged in Finland, relate to a stabbing in Turku's main market square. Bouanane is charged with two counts of terror-related murder and eight counts of attempted murder with a terror-related motive.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/indonesian-preacher-gets-nine-years-jail-for-inciting-suicide-bomb-attack-in-jakarta>).

**Archived source account.** Adalah and Al Mezan say Gazan doctors had to amputate the legs of two young protestors wounded by Israeli fire after Israel refused permission for their transfer to Ramallah in the West Bank for treatment. Israel says the men were refused transfers because they were involved in violence.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/2-injured-gaza-protesters-said-to-lose-legs-after-access-to-west-bank-denied/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-12-0-5"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Egypt, citing humanitarian reasons, opens the Rafah border crossing between Gaza and the Egyptian Sinai Peninsula for three days.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/egypt-opens-gaza-border-ahead-of-new-protests-against-israel/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-12-0-6"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** The 9th International Conference on the Holy City of Jerusalem begins, with Israel denying access to the Palestinian Authority-hosted conference to a number of foreign invitees including a party of thirteen Indians, two buses containing academics, and Ghanan MP Ras Mubarak. Israel's ambassador to Ghana denies ever issuing Mubarak with permission to enter the Occupied Palestinian Territories, calling Mubarak a "propaganda machine" and claims it's a "complete lie".

Source citations (as archived): [al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/04/jerusalem-conference-guests-denied-entry-israel-180412141116195.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-12-0-9"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Siege of Eastern Ghouta.

**Archived source account.** Syrian government fighters remove the last rebels from Douma, completing the Syrian government's recapture of former rebel stronghold Eastern Ghouta.

Source citations (as archived): [al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/04/assad-government-forces-entire-eastern-ghouta-180412134000341.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-12-0-11"></a>

Context: Right-wing terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The High Court in Glasgow sentences Banff resident Connor Ward to life in prison with a minimum term of six years for plotting an anti-Islamic terror attack against mosques in Aberdeen.

Source citations (as archived): [The Press and Journal](<https://www.pressandjournal.co.uk/fp/news/aberdeenshire/1451904/banff-man-connor-ward-jailed-for-life-for-planning-terror-attacks-against-muslims/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-12-0-12"></a>

Context: Right-wing terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Two serving soldiers are cleared of terror offences related to banned neo-Nazi group National Action. A civilian is convicted.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-43747111>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-wales-mid-wales-43756623>); [Birmingham Mail](<https://www.birminghammail.co.uk/news/midlands-news/soldier-accused-recruiting-national-action-14411187>).

<a id="event-2018-04-12-0-13"></a>

<a id="event-2018-04-12-0-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ex-MI5 agent Jeremy Fleming gives his first public speech as head of GCHQ, revealing the United Kingdom launched a "major offensive cyber-campaign" against Islamic State. He also criticises Russia for actions such as launching the NotPetya virus and the poisoning of Yulia and Sergei Skripal, both actions Russia denies involvement in.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-43738953>).

<a id="event-2018-04-12-3-4"></a>

Tesla had drawn the NTSB's ire by releasing information publicly about its view of the case and about the car's Autopilot feature, something the Board does not allow during active investigations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tesla-crash-autopilot/tesla-withdraws-as-party-to-ntsb-autopilot-crash-investigation-idUSKBN1HJ2JS>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-04-12/tesla-withdraws-from-ntsb-crash-probe-over-autopilot-data-flap>).

### 2018-04-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1299429980](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20April%2013&oldid=1299429980>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-04-13-0-1"></a>

Context: Use of chemical weapons in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United Nations Security Council meets amid concerns of military strikes in Syria by the United States and its allies following a suspected chemical weapons attack in Syria last weekend, with the United States ambassador to the UN, Nikki Haley, accusing Russia of lies and covering for the government of Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, which she said had used chemical weapons at least 50 times in the past seven years of warfare, and the Russian ambassador to the UN, Vassily Nebenzia, blaming the United States, France and the UK for escalating tensions.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/as-un-security-council-meets-on-syria-haley-accuses-russia-of-lies-and-a-coverup/2018/04/13/e2853e46-3f21-11e8-974f-aacd97698cef_story.html?noredirect=on>).

<a id="event-2018-04-13-0-2"></a>

Context: Use of chemical weapons in the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The British government issues a statement saying it is "highly likely" the Assad regime used chemical weapons on its own people, and that since such an action could not go unchallenged, Britain would work with United States and France to coordinate an international response, without specifying what measures the United Kingdom would take.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/04/12/middleeast/uk-france-support-us-syria-airstrikes-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-13-0-4"></a>

<a id="event-2018-04-13-0-5"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jerusalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Breaking-News/Protesters-set-off-explosive-try-to-fly-kite-bomb-over-border-549740>).

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** The International Federation of Journalists, Norwegian Refugee Council, and Committee to Protect Journalists criticise Israeli authorities for shooting dead Yaser Murtaja during his coverage of the protests last week. The IFJ calls Murtaja's death murder and its general secretary accuses Israel of "fabricating lies" to support the killing.

Source citations (as archived): [The Jeruslalem Post](<http://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/Terrorist-or-journalist-Who-really-was-the-slain-Gazan-Yaser-Murtaja-549709>).

**Archived source account.** Police say a bombing took place in Barawe, Lower Shabelle, Somalia, at a football stadium yesterday, the first time a stadium in the country has been targeted, killed up to five spectators.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-somalia-security/bomb-kills-up-to-five-during-football-match-in-somalia-idUSKBN1HK0EY>).

President Lenín Moreno orders military operations on the Colombian border to catch the murderers, offering a reward of US$100,000.

<a id="event-2018-04-14-0-7"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–present).

**Archived source account.** The Taliban destroy an electricity pylon in Doshe, Baghlan, Afghanistan, overnight. The pylon carries imported power from Tajikistan and Uzbekistan, and its destruction causes widespread blackouts across several provinces and in capital Kabul.

Local media and Sky News reports an unidentified jet attacked the site, possibly as part of Western coalition airstrikes in the region, but al-Mayadeen denies any airstrike happened and said controlled explosions were carried out at the site yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/large-scale-explosion-reported-at-iranian-base-in-syria/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-04-15-0-1"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Yulia and Sergei Skripal.

**Archived source account.** UK Leader of the Opposition Jeremy Corbyn of Labour asks to see "incontrovertible evidence" before accepting Russia was responsible. Foreign Secretary Boris Johnson responds, saying it is "quite extraordinary" to question Russian involvement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-43774132>).

<a id="event-2018-04-15-0-3"></a>

Context: Afghanistan–Pakistan skirmishes.

**Archived source account.** Afghan and Pakistani forces exchange cross-border fire on the Durand Line, killing two Pakistan Army troops and injuring five others.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/violene-at-pakistan-afghan-border/4348823.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-15-0-5"></a>

Context: Sinai insurgency.

**Archived source account.** ISIL claims responsibility for an attack on a military base in the Sinai Peninsula, Egypt, yesterday that killed eight soldiers and injured fifteen. The Egyptian Military said 14 militants were killed in the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/islamic-state-claims-attack-in-egypts-sinai-that-killed-8/2018/04/15/42989678-40a5-11e8-b2dc-b0a403e4720a_story.html?noredirect=on&amp;utm_term=.5be4970f1790>).

<a id="event-2018-04-15-0-7"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Gazans launch a kite carrying a firebomb over the Israeli border near Kibbutz Kissufim, starting a fire in a field. It is the fourth such incident this week. Local authorities alert residents to be vigilant for potential repeat attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/gazans-fly-kite-with-petrol-bomb-into-israel-sets-field-afire/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-15-0-9"></a>

Context: Iraqi insurgency (2017–present).

**Archived source account.** A car bomb in Kirkuk, Iraq, kills and injures several civilians. The blast follows a bombing at Hor Rajab, Baghdad, earlier in the day that wounded one civilian.

Source citations (as archived): [Iraqi News](<https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/ten-iraqi-people-killed-injured-in-car-bomb-blast-in-kirkuk/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-15-0-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Israel Defense Forces announce the destruction of a Gaza-Israel tunnel thought to belong to Hamas, with Defence Minister Avigdor Liberman claiming it to be the longest tunnel found to date.

Source citations (as archived): [Jerusalem Online](<http://www.jerusalemonline.com/news/politics-and-military/military/idf-destroys-longest-terror-tunnel-recorded-to-date-35459>).

<a id="event-2018-04-15-0-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Militants disguised as United Nations troops attack two military bases near Timbuktu, Mali, using rockets and two car bombs. At least one soldier at the bases, used by France and the UN, is killed and more than twelve others are wounded.

<a id="event-2018-04-15-0-12"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<http://metro.co.uk/2018/04/16/russia-sends-reinforcement-warships-loaded-tanks-syria-7470337/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Grenfell Tower fire.

**Archived source account.** A leaked draft report by fire investigators BRS Global for the Metropolitan Police reveals new details of mistakes in the construction and refurbishment of Grenfell Tower in London. As well as flammable cladding the report finds errors in window and cavity installation. It concludes the fire would have not spread beyond a single flat and all 71 victims would have survived had refurbishment not been performed, and that victims may also have survived had they sought refuge behind fire doors protecting waste chute rooms on each floor.

Source citations (as archived): [The Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/london/shock-grenfell-dossier-reveals-disastrous-refurbishment-turned-tower-into-a-tinderbox-a3814866.html>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/grenfell-tower-refurbishment-structure-fire-hazard-building-regulations-leaked-report-latest-updates-a8306876.html>); [The Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/london/grenfell-tower-report-how-the-fire-began-on-the-fourth-floor-and-spread-throughout-the-block-a3814831.html>).

**Archived source account.** A warehouse in Cirebon, Indonesia, collapses onto a neighbouring arts centre where teenagers were preparing for a dance show. At least seven people die, six of them children.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/asia/se-asia/seven-killed-in-indonesia-building-collapse>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-04-18-0-2"></a>

Context: Basque conflict.

**Archived source account.** The Basque separatist terrorist group ETA apologises to "every victim" of its actions. The ETA killed more than 800 people in its 40-year history, committing terrorists attacks throughout Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43834750>).

<a id="event-2018-04-20-6-9"></a>

Context: Crime in Poland.

**Archived source account.** A court in Radom, Poland, hands a six-month suspended prison term and a 10,000 zloty fine to a Russian pilot who caused a security scare during Pope Francis's 2016 visit for World Youth Day. The Russian had flown from the Czech Republic to compete in an international aerobatics competition and unknowingly violated a no-fly zone imposed for the papal visit. After failing to contact the aircraft, local authorities scrambled two F-16 fighter jets to intercept it.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Poland](<http://www.thenews.pl/1/9/Artykul/359890,Penalty-for-Russian-pilot-who-triggered-alert-during-papal-visit-to-Poland>).

<a id="event-2018-04-20-6-10"></a>

Context: Crime in Poland.

**Archived source account.** Polish Justice Minister and Prosecutor General Zbigniew Ziobro announces plans for a change to national self defence law to allow people to use more force than their attacks, and orders prosecutors to abandon proceedings against a businessman who shot at a getaway car containing fleeing robbers.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Poland](<http://www.thenews.pl/1/9/Artykul/359850,Justice-minister-wants-immunity-for-people-who-defend-themselves>).

<a id="event-2018-04-20-6-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Department of Justice announces it intends to appeal yesterday's ruling that an unnamed detained ISIL suspect in the custody of U.S. troops in Iraq cannot be transferred to an unnamed foreign nation. The man has dual U.S.-Saudi Arabian citizenship.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/19/politics/isis-citizen-transfer/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-20-6-13"></a>

Context: Inn Din massacre.

**Archived source account.** A Myanmar police captain testifies in court that he and his colleagues were ordered by their superiors to entrap two Reuters journalists, who were arrested on 12 December 2017 for "possessing state secrets" under a colonial-era law. The journalists had been working on a report documenting the massacre at Inn Din.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-journalists/myanmar-police-set-up-reuters-reporters-in-sting-police-witness-idUSKBN1HR12Q>); [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/myanmar-policeman-testifies-arrested-reporters-were-set-up/4358822.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-20-6-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Iraqi judge hands a death sentence to an ISIL member who acted as a judge deciding on marriages in Mosul.

Source citations (as archived): [Kurdistan 24](<http://www.kurdistan24.net/en/news/881012d5-e116-4f69-a981-58e4067255f1>).

<a id="event-2018-04-20-7-3"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The UK Audit Office rejects a Treasury estimate of the cost of leaving the European Union that was repeated by Prime Minister Theresa May. Rather than the official £35–39 billion estimate, the watchdog says that figure misleadingly included £7.2 billion earmarked directly for private hands and did not include up to £3 billion in budget contributions and £2.9 billion in European Development Fund payments.

Source citations (as archived): [FXstreet](<https://www.fxstreet.com/news/uk-audit-office-brexit-divorce-bill-to-exceed-gbp-39bn-201804200312>).

### 2018-04-23

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-04-23-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Two more Palestinian protestors, aged 18 and 20, die from wounds sustained in clashes at the Israeli–Gazan border. Both were shot by Israeli troops.

Source citations (as archived): [US News](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-04-23/2-palestinians-die-of-wounds-sustained-in-gaza-protests>).

<a id="event-2018-04-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** A Saudi-led coalition airstrike kills Yemen's Supreme Political Council president Saleh Ali al-Sammad. He was considered the most senior Houthi official in Sana'a.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-43872482>).

<a id="event-2018-04-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen.

**Archived source account.** An airstrike hits a wedding procession in Bani Qa'is District in Yemen's northwestern Hajjah Governorate, killing between 22 and 33 people, according to Yemeni health officials.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/world/middle-east/article/2142967/saudi-attack-yemen-wedding-kills-least-20-wounds-dozens>).

<a id="event-2018-04-23-0-6"></a>

Context: 2018 Toronto van attack.

**Archived source account.** A van strikes a group of pedestrians in Toronto, Canada, killing ten and injuring sixteen. According to the Toronto Police Service, the driver, who fled the scene, was later arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43873804>); [Globe News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/4161785/pedestrians-hit-white-van-toronto/>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/23/toronto-van-crash-incident-latest-updates-canada>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-43875321>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<http://www.straitstimes.com/world/middle-east/jailed-egyptian-photojournalist-to-be-awarded-2018-press-freedom-prize>).

Source citations (as archived): [i24 News](<https://www.i24news.tv/en/news/international/173012-180423-oren-hazan-will-push-to-revoke-natalie-portman-s-citizenship>).

<a id="event-2018-04-23-3-1"></a>

The change follows a fire aboard the MV Finlandia Seaways a day before. The Scottish government seeks urgent talks between DFDS and Transport Secretary Humza Yousaf.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-edinburgh-east-fife-43864813>).

<a id="event-2018-04-23-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus crash in North Hwanghae, North Korea, kills 32 Chinese tourists and four North Koreans. A further two people are seriously injured.

<a id="event-2018-04-23-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Southwest Airlines cancels 128 flights in addition to 40 cancelled yesterday as it inspects the CFM56-7B engines mounted to its Boeing 737 fleet following a fatal accident.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/airplane-mode/southwest-cancels-dozens-flights-engine-inspections-wake-deadly-midair-explosion-n868371>).

Protests are held outside Airdrie Sheriff Court and English Defence League ex-leader Tommy Robinson sits in court to support Meechan.

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

A total of 40 deaths and 1,511 injuries are listed. More than 400 injuries are ascribed to gas inhalation.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/middle-east-news/palestinians/40-dead-5-511-wounded-un-figures-on-casualties-in-gaza-mass-protests-1.6030556>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Dhaka Tribune](<https://www.dhakatribune.com/bangladesh/court/2018/04/25/former-nsi-director-general-sent-to-jail-in-war-crimes-case/>).

**Archived source account.** Danish inventor and submariner Peter Madsen is convicted of the murder of Swedish journalist Kim Wall and sentenced to life in prison.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43894495>).

<a id="event-2018-04-25-3-5"></a>

Context: Golden State Killer.

**Archived source account.** Sacramento County Sheriff's Department arrest Joseph James DeAngelo in connection to the Golden State Killer case.

<a id="event-2018-04-25-3-7"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany, NSU Trial, NSU murders.

**Archived source account.** The terror trial of Beate Zschäpe hears closing arguments in Germany. In addition to a series of murders, Zschäpe stands accused of bombings and bank robberies.

Source citations (as archived): [The Local](<https://www.thelocal.de/20180425/mammoth-neo-nazi-terror-trial-enters-final-phase-in-munich>).

<a id="event-2018-04-25-3-9"></a>

Context: Crime in Israel.

**Archived source account.** Israeli border police officer Ben Deri receives a 9-month sentence for fatally shooting Palestinian teen Nadeem Nawara in 2014. Deri was convicted of causing the unarmed boy's death by negligence. No charges were brought over the shootings of two other teens, one of whom also died. The court heard Deri used live ammunition without authorisation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/25/israeli-policeman-jailed-fatal-shooting-palestinian-teenager-nadeem-nawara-border-ben-deri>).

<a id="event-2018-04-25-3-10"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indian guru Asaram Bapu is sentenced to life imprisonment for the rape of a child.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/self-styled-godman-with-millions-of-followers-jailed-for-life-for-raping-minor-11345893>).

<a id="event-2018-04-25-3-11"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scotland's Parliament approves a bill devolving authority for social care payments. The bill arranges staggered introduction with complete devolution by 2021 and formation of a new agency to administer it.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-scotland-politics-43885731>).

<a id="event-2018-04-25-3-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Turkish court convicts and sentences thirteen Cumhuriyet journalists accused of supporting terrorist organisations. The newspaper is critical of President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/apr/26/turkey-anti-erdogan-journalists-defiant-convictions-terror-charges>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-04-25-4-1"></a>

Context: Mausoleum of Reza Shah.

**Archived source account.** Reza Pahlavi, former crown prince and son of Iran's last Shah, asked authorities for access to the body of Reza Shah, through trusted doctors and scientific experts. He also added his grandfather must ultimately be buried again in Iran, in a manner that respects the wishes of their family and the Iranian people.

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/iran-mummy-reza-shah-pahlavi-mystery-shah-899257>).

<a id="event-2018-04-25-4-3"></a>

Context: United States elections, 2020, Donald Trump presidential campaign endorsements, 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [Arutz Sheva](<http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/Flash.aspx/416437>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-04-25-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017 North Korean nuclear test.

**Archived source account.** Scientists from the University of Science and Technology of China state that North Korea's nuclear test site, the Punggye-ri Nuclear Test Site at Mount Mantap, would have collapsed just minutes after the country performed its sixth nuclear test and opened up a hole of up to 656 ft in diameter. It has been one of the possible reasons given for North Korea agreement to suspend nuclear and missile tests.

Source citations (as archived): [Fortune](<http://fortune.com/2018/04/25/north-korea-nuclear-test-mountain-mount-mantap/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-25-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A flaw, called the "Ghost in the Locks" exploit, is reported with hotel keycard systems created by the Swedish lock company Assa Abloy. The company states that they began deploying a patch in February.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-43896360>).

<a id="event-2018-04-25-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency releases the largest-ever 3D map of stars in our galaxy from the Gaia spacecraft.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Monde](<http://www.lemonde.fr/sciences/article/2018/04/25/1-692-919-135-etoiles-cataloguees_5290217_1650684.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-25-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers detect light from 14 colliding galaxies. Due to the distances involved, the light comes from events which occurred around 12 billion years ago.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-43841025>).

Context: 2018 CONCACAF Champions League Finals.

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-04-27-7-1"></a>

Context: 2017 Pohang earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Scientific studies have offered evidence that a geothermal plant may have caused the earthquake in South Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2018-04-evidence-geothermal-pohang-earthquake.amp>).

<a id="event-2018-04-27-7-3"></a>

Context: Astrophysics.

**Archived source account.** A photograph from the Hubble Space Telescope reveals a companion star that survived the explosion of a supernova in galaxy NGC 7424. This brings strong evidence to a theory according to which Type IIb "stripped-envelope" supernovae are due to stellar companions capturing hydrogen from the progenitor star's envelope before its explosion.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Science_News/2018/04/27/Hubble-spots-surviving-companion-to-supernova-17-years-later/3291524836842/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-27-7-5"></a>

Context: De-extinction.

**Archived source account.** Biologists at the University of Melbourne announce plans to clone the extinct thylacine (Tasmanian tiger).

Source citations (as archived): [News Corp Australia](<http://www.news.com.au/technology/science/animals/not-science-fiction-any-more-the-tasmanian-tiger-could-soon-be-back-from-extinction/news-story/b26dcb89e8c28f1232b5153e2c2c07e7>).

<a id="event-2018-04-27-7-7"></a>

Context: Detached objects.

**Archived source account.** Astronomers from the Outer Solar System Origins Survey (OSSOS) announce the discovery of ~80 km asteroid \{\{mp\|2015 KE\|172\}\}, a detached object orbiting 44–222 times the distance from Earth to the Sun.

Source citations (as archived): [Minor Planet Center](<https://www.minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K18/K18H97.html>).

#### Sports

**Archived source account.** FIFA hands a lifetime ban to Marco Polo del Nero, President of the Brazilian Football Confederation, for taking bribes. He is also fined one million Swiss francs.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/43925205>).

<a id="event-2018-04-27-8-2"></a>

Context: European Athletics Indoor Championships.

**Archived source account.** The city of Toruń in Poland wins the right to host the 2021 European Athletics Indoor Championships, defeating Apeldoorn in the Netherlands.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Poland](<http://www.thenews.pl/1/5/Artykul/361050,Poland%E2%80%99s-Torun-to-host-2021-European-Athletics-Indoor-Championships>).

<a id="event-2018-04-28-0-6"></a>

<a id="event-2018-04-28-0-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hamas accuses the Palestinian Authority of performing a bombing against its own Prime Minister, Rami Hamdallah. Hamdallah escaped injury when his convoy was bombed during a visit to the Hamas-controlled Gaza Strip last month.

Source citations (as archived): [Middle East Eye](<http://www.middleeasteye.net/news/hamas-accuses-pa-over-bomb-attempt-its-own-premier-1419603310>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-04-28-1-1"></a>

Context: Art forgery.

**Archived source account.** 82 paintings at a museum dedicated to Étienne Terrus in Elne, France, are revealed as forgeries.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-43933530>).

<a id="event-2018-04-28-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cardinal Angelo Amato, acting on behalf of Pope Francis, beatifies Hanna Chrzanowska in Kraków, Poland. Chrzanowska dedicated her life to helping the sick and homeless and had worked with Cardinal Karol Wojtyła, who led her funeral services before he became Pope John Paul II.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Poland](<http://www.thenews.pl/1/9/Artykul/361021,Polish-nurse-beatified>).

<a id="event-2018-04-28-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Bone remains of more than 140 children and about 200 young llamas were found in the Peruvian city of Trujillo, near the Chan Chan citadel, according to a National Geographic publication. This discovery, which would date from the time of the little-known Chimú pre-Columbian civilization (about 550 years ago), would be, for researchers, the largest mass sacrifice of children in the American continent.

Source citations (as archived): [El Comercio](<https://elcomercio.pe/peru/la-libertad/precedentes-america-lugar-masivo-sacrificio-ninos-antiguo-peru-noticia-515313?foto=1>); [National Geographic](<https://www.nationalgeographic.co.uk/video/tv/history-101-chimu>).

<a id="event-2018-04-28-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A statue honouring comfort women, sex slaves raped by Japanese World War II soldiers, in Manila, Philippines, is removed less than five months after it was installed.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-04/28/c_137144177.htm>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-04-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A communal toilet collapses in Bhandup, Mumbai, India. Several people are trapped and require rescue, with two dying en route to hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [First Post](<https://www.firstpost.com/india/two-dead-in-mumbais-bhandup-after-wall-roof-of-community-toilet-collapse-probe-underway-4449247.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-04-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Sanctions against North Korea.

**Archived source account.** Australia and Canada deploy surveillance aircraft to Japan to monitor ship-to-ship transfers between North Korean vessels that bypass United Nations sanctions. The aircraft join a warship already deployed by the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/world/north-korea-un-sanctions-surveillance-1.4640082>).

<a id="event-2018-04-28-3-3"></a>

Context: Panmunjom Declaration, South Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** United States Defense Secretary James Mattis and South Korea Defense Minister Song Young-moo say they are committed to "a diplomatic resolution that achieves complete, verifiable and irreversible denuclearization" of North Korea, according to a Pentagon spokesperson. Mattis repeats the United States' "ironclad" commitment to defend its ally South Korea "using the full spectrum of U.S. capabilities."

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/mattis-reaffirms-ironclad-u-s-commitment-to-defending-south-korea-2018-04-28/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-28-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A judge in the U.S. state of Oklahoma dismisses charges against seven detainees over a prison riot that killed four at Cimarron Correctional Facility in 2015.

Source citations (as archived): [Stillwater News Press](<http://www.stwnewspress.com/news/charges-dismissed-in-fatal-prison-riot/article_67182bbd-f170-572b-80a5-62a82123fc48.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-28-4-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/scientology-sewage-leak-fined-sussex-church-pollution-river-medway-a8326821.html>).

The territory was later recaptured by U.S.-backed forces in a counter-attack spearheaded by the YPG with help from U.S.-led coalition jets that took off from American bases in northern Syria. The U.S. military says in a statement that the "coalition used established deconfliction channels to de-escalate the situation".

He claimed he was trying to stop a fight but was found guilty and sentenced for causing grievous bodily harm with intent, causing serious injury through dangerous driving and causing actual bodily harm. Teens Benjamin Thomas and Callum Banton pleaded guilty to affray for their part in starting the brawl which preceded the attack.
