#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2018-04-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Euthanasia in Australia.

**Archived source account.** David W. Goodall, an Australian scientist aged 104, announces his intention to travel assisted by Exit International to Switzerland to end his own life. Goodall is not terminally ill but says his quality of life has deteriorated with age.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2018/apr/30/david-goodall-australia-oldest-scientist-to-end-own-life-in-switzerland>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-04-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Uzbekistan.

**Archived source account.** Uzbekistan agrees to formally join the Turkic Council following a meeting between Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan in Tashkent.

Source citations (as archived): [APA](<http://en.apa.az/azerbaijan-politics/foreign-news/uzbekistan-to-join-cooperation-council-of-turkic-speaking-states.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-4-3"></a>

Context: South Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** South Korean president Moon Jae-in suggests that U.S. president Donald Trump should receive the Nobel Peace Prize for his efforts to help denuclearize the Korean Peninsula.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/asia_pacific/trump-should-get-the-nobel-peace-prize-for-north-korea-talks-says-souths-moon/2018/04/30/9f89798c-4c6d-11e8-b966-bfb0da2dad62_story.html?noredirect=on>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-4-5"></a>

Context: China–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** Chinese diplomat Wang Yi will travel to North Korea to meet with Kim Jong-un following the summit.

Source citations (as archived): [Upi](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/04/30/Chinas-top-diplomat-to-travel-to-North-Korea/7031525106755/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-4-7"></a>

Context: Ukraine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. State Department confirms the U.S. has completed a delivery of FGM-148 Javelin anti-tank missile systems to Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/amp/javelin-missile-delivery-ukraine-us-confirmed/29200588.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-4-9"></a>

Context: 2018 North Korea–United States summit.

**Archived source account.** The summit is considering to take place at the Peace House at the DMZ, where the North-South Korea summit was also held.

Source citations (as archived): [CBN](<http://www1.cbn.com/cbnnews/national-security/2018/april/dmz-peace-freedom-house-could-be-site-of-historic-us-north-korea-summit-nbsp>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-4-11"></a>

Context: Human rights in Vietnam.

**Archived source account.** The German daily Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung reports that last year’s visit of the Vietnamese public security minister and his entourage to Slovakia was used to cover for the abduction of a dissident Vietnamese entrepreneur Trịnh Xuân Thanh who had previously emigrated to Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [The Slovak Spectator](<https://spectator.sme.sk/c/20815700/german-media-vietnam-kidnapping-throughout-slovakia.html>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-4-13"></a>

Context: Poland in the European Union.

**Archived source account.** Polish Foreign Minister Jacek Czaputowicz says the nation will oppose European Union budget rules set to be introduced on May 2 by the European Commission. The proposals would see funding in the 2021-2027 budget cut for countries where democratic principles and the rule of law are deemed under threat.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/ap-interview-poland-against-eu-linking-funds-to-rule-of-law/2018/04/30/4b1f1814-4c6a-11e8-85c1-9326c4511033_story.html?noredirect=on&amp;utm_term=.eedcbfc7ac36>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-4-15"></a>

Context: Japan–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Japan lodges a formal complaint after footage appears on YouTube of a US F-16 fighter jet based at Misawa Air Base in Aomori flying at high speed and low altitude through mountains in an apparent breach of regulations. Japanese law prohibits aircraft from descending below 150 feet in non-residential areas.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/04/30/japan-complains-us-youtube-footage-emerges-fighter-jet-breaking/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-4-17"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The UK House of Lords approves amendments to the European Union (Withdrawal) Bill in defiance of the government, adding requirements for Parliament to have a final say on negotiations with the European Union and provisions for the families of existing migrants to join them in the UK.

Source citations (as archived): [BT](<http://home.bt.com/news/uk-news/peers-warned-against-thwarting-will-of-the-people-after-brexit-defeats-11364267858158>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-04-30-5-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Sweden.

**Archived source account.** SAPO arrests three in the greater Stockholm area suspected of plotting a terror attack. SAPO says the case has an international connection; local media reports one of the detainees is an Uzbekistani citizen.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/sweden-arrests-suspected-preparing-act-terror-54822245>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-5-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** ISIL terror suspect Husnain Rashid appears before Woolwich Crown Court in London. Rashid pleads not guilty to planning and encouraging terrorism, distributing terrorist material, and breaching a notice issued under the Regulation of Investigatory Powers Act. The charges include an allegation he posted details of Prince George's school and encouraged an attack against him.

Source citations (as archived): [ITV](<http://www.itv.com/news/granada/update/2018-04-30/lancashire-man-denies-terror-charges/>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-5-5"></a>

Context: 2008 Mumbai attacks.

**Archived source account.** Pakistan's Interior Ministry removes chief prosecutor Chaudhry Azhar from the case, which concerns the murders of 166 people. The Interior Ministry said Azhar did "not take the government line". Seven alleged Lashkar-e-Taiba members have been facing charges since 2009 but nobody has yet been convicted in Pakistan.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/pakistan/pakistan-removes-chief-prosecutor-of-mumbai-terror-attack-case-for-not-taking-govt-line/articleshow/63963272.cms>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Nations suspends Miriam Maluwa as director of the UNAIDS programme in Ethiopia. Maluwa is a key witness in allegations of sexual assault against a programme director, Luiz Loures. Loures is accused of attacking colleague Martina Brostrom in a lift and is due to leave his post today. Brostrom today said she has no confidence the UN will deliver justice as it reopens its investigation.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/accuser-in-unaids-sex-assault-case-rejects-new-probe/articleshow/63974520.cms>); [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/europe/un-suspends-key-witness-in-sexual-assault-probe/articleshow/63971334.cms>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-04-30-6-1"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Sajid Javid becomes the United Kingdom's Home Secretary following the resignation of Amber Rudd over the Windrush scandal. He is the first Home Secretary from an ethnic minority background.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-43946845>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Palestinian National Council, the legislative arm of the Palestinian Liberation Organisation, convenes for the first time in nine years in Ramallah. The agenda includes voting in a new eighteen-member PLO Executive Committee, transforming the Palestinian Authority into a state with its own institutions and monetary system, and cessation of ties with Israel. Gazan rivals Hamas are not invited.

Source citations (as archived): [al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/04/palestinians-pnc-palestinian-national-council-discuss-recognition-israel-180424144047076.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-04-30-7-1"></a>

Context: Russian floating nuclear power station.

**Archived source account.** Russia’s first floating nuclear power plant, the Akademik Lomonosov, sets sail across the Baltic Sea from St. Petersburg.

Source citations (as archived): [Alphr](<http://www.alphr.com/energy/1009217/russia-floating-chernobyl-nuclear-power-plant>).

<a id="event-2018-04-30-7-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The world's oldest known spider, a trapdoor spider known as "Number 16", dies of a wasp sting at the age of 43.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/worlds-oldest-known-spider-dies-australia-wasp-sting-032111961.html>).


## May

### 2018-05-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1272046375](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20May%201&oldid=1272046375>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-01-0-2"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War / Human rights violations during the Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** ISIL releases an execution video showing a prisoner being killed by explosives in Yarmouk Camp, Damascus.

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<http://metro.co.uk/2018/05/01/isis-prisoner-turned-human-bomb-latest-depraved-execution-video-7512459/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-0-3"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** At least 23 civilians die in an airstrike near Shadadi, Al-Hasakah Governorate. The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights has stated it is not clear who carried out the attack, listing Iraq and US-led coalition as two possibilities. The state-run Syrian Arab News Agency claims the US-led coalition is responsible.

Source citations (as archived): [BT](<http://home.bt.com/news/world-news/airstrikes-in-islamic-state-held-part-of-syria-kill-23-11364267968652>); [Middle East Monitor](<https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20180502-23-civilians-killed-in-syria-in-suspected-us-coalition-air-strikes/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-0-5"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bombing kills at least 24 people at a mosque in Mubi, Nigeria. Boko Haram are suspected of being behind the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-43967738>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-0-7"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** Pro-Hadi forces capture the Al Bareh Triangle and seize Houthi arms.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/news/gulf/yemen/yemen-army-retrieves-abandoned-al-houthi-arms-1.2214709>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-0-8"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present).

**Archived source account.** Several independent MPs urge Sudanese President Omar Al-Bashir to withdraw troops from Yemen where they are supporting a Saudi-led coalition fighting Houthi rebels.

Source citations (as archived): [AllAfrica](<http://allafrica.com/stories/201805010338.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-0-10"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian Islamic Jihad releases video of Israeli general Yoav Mordechai meeting with United Kingdom ambassador David Quarrey and observing the protests last week. Quarrey's visit came amid concerns of the Israeli Defence Forces using live ammunition and was intended to be kept secret.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/05/01/british-ambassador-israel-filmed-islamic-terrorist-group-secret/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-0-12"></a>

Context: Persecution of Muslims in Myanmar.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's military pledges to a U.N. delegation visiting Rakhine State that they will take "harsh" action against perpetrators of sexual violence in the region. The U.N. previously accused Myanmar's military of committing an ethnic cleansing of Rohingya Muslims in Rakhine State.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-rohingya-un/myanmar-military-assures-un-of-harsh-action-on-sexual-assault-idUSKBN1I22VL>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-0-13"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iraqi police and al-Hashd al-Shaabi troops raid ISIL locations in Hawija, Kirkuk, and seize tunnels and arms caches.

Source citations (as archived): [Iraqi News](<https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/iraqi-troops-raid-several-islamic-state-tunnels-hotbeds-in-oil-rich-kirkuk/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-0-14"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb in Mosul, Iraq, kills and injures seven policemen.

Source citations (as archived): [Iraqi News](<https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/7-policemen-killed-injured-in-deadly-bomb-attack-at-iraqi-train-station/>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-05-01-1-1"></a>

Context: Harvey Weinstein sexual abuse allegations.

**Archived source account.** American actress Ashley Judd sues Harvey Weinstein for defamation and sexual harassment, claiming he "torpedoed" her chance to be cast in The Lord of the Rings trilogy.

Source citations (as archived): [Herald Courier](<http://www.heraldcourier.com/community/entertainment/ashley-judd-sues-harvey-weinstein-for-defamation-and-sexual-harassment/article_2359d5f2-9b44-5417-9f01-990dd1dbcf9c.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Publisher Bloomsbury acquires Middle East and political publishing specialist I.B. Tauris.

Source citations (as archived): [The Bookseller](<https://www.thebookseller.com/news/bloomsbury-acquires-ib-tauris-776556>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of India orders the government to seek international help after examining photos submitted by environmentalists showing a change in colour of the Taj Mahal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-india-43967685>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-05-01-2-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Following the cancellation of the Williams &amp; Glyn bank formation, the Royal Bank of Scotland announces the closure of 162 RBS and subsidiary NatWest branches across the United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-43964273>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-2-2"></a>

Context: Economy of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Minimum alcohol pricing comes into effect in Scotland, mandating prices of at least 50p per unit. Scotland becomes the first country to introduce such a scheme.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/scotland-minimum-alcohol-prices-cost-50p-unit-frosty-jack-strongbow-smirnoff-vodka-cider-whisky-wine-a8330681.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** United States guitar manufacturer Gibson files for bankruptcy protection.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/business/2018/may/01/gibson-guitar-firm-files-for-bankruptcy-protection>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-05-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Incidents at Universal parks.

**Archived source account.** At Universal Studios Japan, the Flying Dinosaur roller coaster gets stuck 100 feet in the air, stranding about 64 people for nearly two hours.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/offbeat/japan-rollercoaster-gets-stuck-riders-left-hanging-upside-down-for-hours-1845639>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Edifício Wilton Paes de Almeida, a 26-story tower block in São Paulo, Brazil, is destroyed by a fire and consequent collapse. Neighbouring buildings are also damaged by fire. Authorities warn the casualty toll is "likely to be high".

Source citations (as archived): [Metro](<http://metro.co.uk/2018/05/01/residential-tower-block-collapses-huge-fire-rips-building-7511628/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** An avalanche in the Alps kills three skiers and injures two in Valais, Switzerland.

Source citations (as archived): [Gulf News](<https://gulfnews.com/news/europe/switzerland/swiss-alps-avalanche-leaves-3-dead-2-injured-near-glacier-1.2198008>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-05-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Dominican Republic–Taiwan relations, China–Dominican Republic relations.

**Archived source account.** The Dominican Republic severs ties with Taiwan and establishes diplomatic relations with China.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/01/asia/china-taiwan-dominican-republican-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Russia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** A Russian Su-27 fighter jet intercepts a United States P-8 Poseidon surveillance plane in international airspace over the Baltic Sea, with the US claiming the procedure was unprofessional and the aircraft came within 20 feet of each other.

Source citations (as archived): [KFDI](<https://www.kfdi.com/news/national/russian-fighter-jet-intercepts-us-navy-plane>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-4-5"></a>

Context: Iran–Morocco relations.

**Archived source account.** Morocco cuts diplomatic ties with Iran over its support for the Polisario Front, a Western Saharan independence movement.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/05/morocco-cuts-diplomatic-ties-iran-western-sahara-feud-180501173229190.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** The African Land Forces Summit opens in Abuja, Nigeria. Present are military delegations from 30 African nations plus representatives from Europe and the United States.

Source citations (as archived): [AllAfrica](<http://allafrica.com/view/group/main/main/id/00060314.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-4-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Poland takes over the rotating Presidency of the United Nations Security Council.

Source citations (as archived): [Radio Poland](<http://thenews.pl/1/10/Artykul/361449,Poland-takes-over-UN-Security-Council-presidency>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-01-5-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in England.

**Archived source account.** ISIL suspect Lewis Ludlow makes an initial appearance before Westminster Magistrates' Court accused of plotting a terror attack in London. He denies the offences and the case is transferred to the Old Bailey.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-kent-43962721>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-5-3"></a>

Context: May Day.

**Archived source account.** Far-left anarchists clash with riot police in central Paris, France. Several businesses are looted and set on fire, including a McDonald's restaurant and Renault garage. Hundreds are arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-may-day-france/riot-police-use-teargas-against-anarchists-at-paris-may-day-rally-idUSKBN1I23TG>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-5-5"></a>

Context: Far-right terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** West Midlands Police arrest five men and a woman suspected of membership of National Action, a neo-Nazi group banned as a terror group.

Source citations (as archived): [The Oxford Mail](<http://www.oxfordmail.co.uk/news/yourtown/banbury/15804237.Man_and_woman_arrested_over_membership_of_neo-Nazi_group__National_Action_/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Iran bans the Telegram messenger app, citing national security concerns.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-43963927>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** Catherine De Bolle from Belgium becomes the first woman to lead Europol.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/europol-europes-terror-defenses-pass-to-belgian-hands-eu-law-enforcement-agency-catherine-de-bolle/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-01-6-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Iraqi parliamentary election.

**Archived source account.** Muntadhar al-Zaidi, the Iraqi journalist who threw his shoes at George W. Bush in 2008, will run for Iraqi parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [BuzzFeed News](<https://www.buzzfeed.com/hayesbrown/george-w-bush-shoe-throw-president-iraq>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-6-3"></a>

Context: 2017–18 United States political sexual scandals.

**Archived source account.** Louisiana Secretary of State Tom Schedler announces that he will resign in one week, after being accused of sexual harassment.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times-Picayune](<http://www.nola.com/politics/index.ssf/2018/04/tom_schedler_resigns_as_secret.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-05-01-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Kenyan boxer Brian Agina goes missing as his team prepares to return from the Commonwealth Games in Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [AllAfrica](<http://allafrica.com/view/group/main/main/id/00060302.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-01-7-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Green Bay Packers and NC State player Carlos Gray is found dead after being shot at his home.

Source citations (as archived): [News Observer](<http://www.newsobserver.com/sports/article210208509.html>).

### 2018-05-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1350876280](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20May%202&oldid=1350876280>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Basque conflict.

**Archived source account.** Basque separatist group ETA (Euskadi Ta Askatasuna), which waged an insurgency against Spain between 1959 and 2011, announces its complete dissolution.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/02/basque-separatist-group-eta-announces-dissolution>).

<a id="event-2018-05-02-0-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** A fire started by an incendiary device attached to a kite by Palestinian protestors and flown into Israel burns for six hours. It is the largest fire so far after a string of firebombing attacks.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-fire-kites-spark-huge-blaze-in-israeli-fields-along-gaza-border/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-02-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A random shooting in al-Tarmia District, Baghdad Governorate, Iraq, kills at least eight people and wounds at least fourteen. The gunmen responsible remain at large and unidentified.

Source citations (as archived): [Iraqi News](<https://www.iraqinews.com/iraq-war/22-iraqis-killed-wounded-in-random-shooting-attack-in-baghdad/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-02-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** The UK Royal Air Force admits killing a civilian with a drone strike in Syria, the first time the force has accepted responsibility for civilian deaths in the country since starting operations there four years ago.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/02/syria-raf-airstrike-kills-civilian-uk-campaign>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-05-02-1-1"></a>

Context: Multiannual Financial Framework.

**Archived source account.** The European Commissioner for Budget and Human Resources Günther Oettinger formally unveils proposed budget rules for the European Union to run from 2021 to 2027.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.eu/article/eu-budget-live-mff-multiannual-financial-framework-blog/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-02-1-3"></a>

Context: Facebook–Cambridge Analytica data scandal.

**Archived source account.** Cambridge Analytica announces that it is closing down as a result of the scandal.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-43983958>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-05-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Malaysia Airlines Flight 370.

**Archived source account.** Searches led by Ocean Infinity move to a new section of the Indian Ocean after the initial search area was cleared without success. If the missing aircraft, which was carrying over 200 people, is not found by mid-June the search will be called off.

Source citations (as archived): [The South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/2144321/mh370-us-search-team-extends-indian-ocean-mission-after>).

<a id="event-2018-05-02-2-3"></a>

Context: 2018 U.S. Air National Guard C-130 crash.

**Archived source account.** A Puerto Rico Air National Guard C-130 Hercules transport plane crashes during a training flight near Savannah, Georgia, United States, killing all five crew members and four passengers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-georgia-crash/u-s-military-c-130-plane-crashes-during-training-survivors-unlikely-idUSKBN1I32C5>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-43983718>).

<a id="event-2018-05-02-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Firefighters say 44 people are missing after the collapse of the Edifício Wilton Paes de Almeida tower block in São Paulo, Brazil, yesterday. One missing man was within seconds of rescue when the building came down during a fire.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/05/02/world/44-missing-sao-paulo-squatter-building-blaze-collapse-firefighters/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-05-02-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea has released the three remaining American detainees ahead of the upcoming summit meeting with Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un. The news came after National Security Adviser John R. Bolton stated that they should be released as a way for North Korea to demonstrate its sincerity in talks.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://www.businessinsider.com/north-korea-releases-us-prisoners-2018-5>).

#### Law and crime

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-02-5-1"></a>

Context: Abortion in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Iowa's House of Representatives approves a bill restricting abortions in the state. If approved by Republican Governor Kim Reynolds, abortions after six weeks of pregnancy will be banned.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43978510>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-05-02-6-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Helium has been detected for the first time in the atmosphere of an exoplanet by scientists observing WASP-107b.

<a id="event-2018-05-02-6-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA announces it has completed its first full-power test of the Kilopower nuclear reactor for space. NASA intends to use the technology to power exploration missions to the Moon and Mars.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/science/nasa-kilopower-nuclear-power-space-reactor-latest-update-mars-moon-energy-a8332746.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-03-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** A Palestinian man was arrested by Israel Defence Forces (IDF) while attempting to damage the security fence around the northern Gaza Strip. He was shot and injured during the arrest, and is now receiving medical treatment at Soroka Medical Center.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-shoots-arrests-palestinian-damaging-gaza-fence/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-0-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian teenager Anas Abu Asr dies of wounds sustained when he was shot during protests near Gaza City last Friday, bringing the death toll to 40.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/gaza-man-dies-of-wounds-sustained-in-border-protest/2018/05/03/7146988e-4ec0-11e8-85c1-9326c4511033_story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-0-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** The Israeli High Court rules the protests to be a state of war and that human rights are therefore not applicable.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/.premium-israel-gaza-protests-are-state-of-war-human-rights-law-doesn-t-apply-1.6052794>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-0-6"></a>

Context: Yemeni Crisis (2011–present) / United Arab Emirates takeover of Socotra.

**Archived source account.** The United Arab Emirates deploys troops on the Yemeni island of Socotra in the Arabian Sea, taking over key installations such as Socotra Airport from Yemeni soldiers. Yemeni Prime Minister Ahmed Obeid bin Daghr denounces the Emirati ground incursion and hundreds protest demanding their immediate withdrawal. Local media reports the UAE claims to have "leased" the island.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/05/anger-erupts-yemen-socotra-uae-deploys-100-troops-180503072636773.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-0-8"></a>

Context: Piracy in the 21st century.

**Archived source account.** The government of Guyana reports that pirates attacked fishermen off the coast of neighboring Suriname.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-43999237>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-0-10"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of State freezes funding to the White Helmets humanitarian group, which conducts urban search and rescue in rebel-held areas of Syria. The U.S. provides one-third of the group's total funding.

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/homenews/administration/386169-state-dept-freezes-funding-for-famed-syrian-humanitarian-group>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-05-03-1-1"></a>

Context: Bill Cosby sexual assault cases, Roman Polanski sexual abuse case.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-43994591>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-1-3"></a>

Context: Sovereign Military Order of Malta.

**Archived source account.** Fra' Giacomo dalla Torre del Tempio di Sanguinetto takes oath of office as 80th Prince and Grand Master of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta, after being elected yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [Order of Malta](<https://www.orderofmalta.int/2018/05/03/fra-giacomo-dalla-torre-oath/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-05-03-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Indian dust storms.

**Archived source account.** Around 110 people are killed in a dust storm in northwestern India, with Uttar Pradesh being the hardest hit.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/05/03/asia/india-dust-storms-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-2-3"></a>

Context: 2018 lower Puna eruption.

**Archived source account.** After over 600 earthquakes, including a magnitude 5.0 at Kīlauea, parts of Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park have struck, causing the nearby Puʻu ʻŌʻō, to close due to fears of an eruption. The volcano erupted and evacuations were issued.

Source citations (as archived): [Big Island Now](<https://bigislandnow.com/2018/05/02/portion-of-hawaii-volcanoes-national-park-closed-due-to-potential-volcanic-hazards/>); [ABC7](<http://abc7.com/amp/hawaiis-kilauea-volcano-erupts-county-issues-evacuations/3426564/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Russian Sukhoi-30SM crashes after leaving an airbase in Khmeimim, Latakia, Syria. Both crew die.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/03/russian-jet-crashes-after-takeoff-from-syria-airbase-killing-crew>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-05-03-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 North Korea–United States summit.

**Archived source account.** Vice President of the United States Mike Pence postpones his trip to Brazil to focus foreign policy resources on Donald Trump's planned meeting with North Korean leader Kim Jong-un.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-brazil/u-s-vice-president-pence-postpones-brazil-trip-as-north-korea-talks-loom-idUSKBN1I41QK>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-3-3"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal.

**Archived source account.** The head of the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons, Ahmet Uzumcu says that up to 100 grams of liquid nerve agent were used in the chemical attack on Sergei and Yulia Skripal – around half a cup of liquid, suggesting it was intended for use as a weapon and was not created for research purposes.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/may/04/skripals-poisoned-by-novichok-in-liquid-form-watchdog-says>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-03-4-1"></a>

Context: Pan Am Flight 103.

**Archived source account.** The Scottish Criminal Cases Review Commission says it will review claims of a possible miscarriage of justice in the conviction of Abdelbasset Ali al-Megrahi for the Lockerbie bombing, in which over 200 people were murdered.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/scottish-appeals-board-review-lockerbie-bomb-conviction-54902344>).

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** Donald Trump signs an executive order to give greater freedoms to federally funded faith-based initiatives.

Context: Terrorism in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Islamic State recruiter Hamdi Alqudsi's wife Moutia Elzahed becomes the first person convicted of an offence for refusing to stand for a judge in court, with a magistrate finding her guilty of nine counts of disrespectful behaviour in court.

<a id="event-2018-05-03-4-9"></a>

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-05-03-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The fossilized remains of a rhinoceros are found in the Philippines, with cut marks suggesting it was butchered with stone tools. The remains, dated to 709,000 years old by electron spin resonance, suggest a human presence earlier than expected in Southeast Asia.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/02/world/early-humans-philippine-islands/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-03-5-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/us-twitter-passwords/twitter-urges-all-users-to-change-passwords-after-glitch-idUKKBN1I42JG>).

<a id="event-2018-05-04-1-1"></a>

Context: Nobel Prize in Literature.

Context: 2017–18 North Korea crisis / North Korea–South Korea relations.

<a id="event-2018-05-04-4-1"></a>

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-05-04-5-1"></a>

Context: Volcanology.

**Archived source account.** A new model suggests that supervolcano eruptions occur more often in regions being pulled by tectonics.

Source citations (as archived): [Brinkwire](<http://en.brinkwire.com/303509/when-will-the-next-supervolcano-erupt-new-model-suggests-it-depends-on-local-plate-tectonics/>).

Context: Physical cosmology.

**Archived source account.** Using recent data from the Gaia spacecraft, the value of the Hubble constant is determined to be \{\{val\|73.52\|1.62\}\}, which confirms a disagreement with other methods of measuring the constant with a confidence of 99.993%.

Source citations (as archived): [Inquisitr](<https://www.inquisitr.com/4885533/the-hubble-constant-study-finds-simpler-approach-to-measuring-how-fast-the-universe-is-expanding/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-05-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An earthquake strikes a coal mine near Jastrzębie-Zdrój, Poland; rescuers have thus far recovered two miners alive and located a third, while four remain unaccounted for.

Context: 2018 Kentucky Derby.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-05-06-1-1"></a>

Context: Economy of France.

**Archived source account.** French economy minister Bruno Le Maire says Air France may collapse over ongoing strike action and the state will not bail the firm out despite owning 14.3% of parent Air France-KLM.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-44021431>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-05-06-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Flash floods cause transportation issues and damage buildings in Ankara, the capital of Turkey.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-europe-44022350/turkey-floods-cars-swept-away-in-ankara-streets>).

<a id="event-2018-05-06-2-2"></a>

Context: 2018 lower Puna eruption.

**Archived source account.** At Leilani Estates, 26 homes and 4 buildings were destroyed by Kīlauea, forcing 1700 people to leave their homes.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hawaii-volcano/go-now-hawaii-residents-warned-as-eruptions-spread-idUSKBN1I80M7>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Malaysian authorities announce sixteen arrests connected to an international human trafficking ring. The arrests follow the seizure of modified tanker ship MV Etra in Malaysian waters on Tuesday with 127 Sri Lankan migrants on board being smuggled to New Zealand and Australia. The arrests include seven people captured aboard a fishing vessel used to transfer migrants onto MV Etra.

Source citations (as archived): [The South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/2144887/people-smuggling-ship-127-sri-lankans-board-busted-route>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-06-4-1"></a>

Context: Lebanese general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Lebanon holds its first parliamentary election since 2009.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-44020061>).

<a id="event-2018-05-06-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Electoral Commission of Zambia says it will disqualify anybody who commits violence in the campaign for upcoming by-elections slated for June.

Source citations (as archived): [The Lusaka Times](<https://www.lusakatimes.com/2018/05/06/electoral-commission-of-zambia-to-disqualify-violent-parties/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-06-4-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** In an interview granted to the newspaper El Comercio, the Peruvian president, Martín Vizcarra, ruled out presenting himself for re-election in 2021 or calling early elections. Vizcarra, as vice president, took office late March after former President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski resigned due to a corruption scandal and strong pressures of the Congress.

Source citations (as archived): [América Televisión](<http://www.americatv.com.pe/noticias/actualidad/martin-vizcarra-no-sere-candidato-presidencial-2021-n320819>).

<a id="event-2018-05-06-4-5"></a>

Context: Far-right politics in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Thousands of far-right activists attend a protest in London, United Kingdom amid a recent crackdown on far-right activity on social media. Guest speakers included former English Defence League leader Tommy Robinson, Vice magazine co-founder Gavin McInnes, and UK Independence Party (UKIP) leader Gerard Batten.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/06/thousands-of-far-right-protesters-march-in-london-in-support-of-free-speech>).

### 2018-05-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1215217405](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20May%207&oldid=1215217405>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Yemeni Civil War (2015–present).

**Archived source account.** Airstrikes by the Saudi-led coalition destroy the Presidential Palace in Sana'a, Yemen, with at least six killed and 30 injuries reported, coalition officials claim they had targeted high-ranking Houthi officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/residents-strikes-presidential-palace-yemeni-capital-092529011.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hamas has offered Israel a longterm ceasefire including prisoner exchanges, in return for reductions to the Gaza blockade, and infrastructural improvement.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-05-07-1-1"></a>

Context: List of highest-grossing films.

**Archived source account.** American superhero film Avengers: Infinity War becomes the fastest film to make US$1 billion worldwide, in just eleven days.

Source citations (as archived): [BGR](<http://bgr.com/2018/05/07/avengers-infinity-war-box-office-billion/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Large sections of the old Tappan Zee Bridge are to be sunk and used as material to build an artificial reef off the coast of Long Island.

Source citations (as archived): [MNN](<https://www.mnn.com/green-tech/transportation/blogs/new-yorks-tappan-zee-bridge-recycled-artificial-reef>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-05-07-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Latvian bank ABLV sues the European Central Bank in the Court of Justice of the European Union, saying the ECB triggered ABLV's collapse. The bank failed following allegations by the United States that ABLV was laundering money on behalf of North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-latvia-banking/latvian-bank-takes-ecb-to-court-for-triggering-collapse-idUKKBN1I81HS>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-2-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Defense says it has resumed accepting deliveries of F-35 Lightning II fighter jets from manufacturer Lockheed Martin after resolving a dispute over a production error which was leading to corrosion.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lockheed-f35-exclusive/exclusive-lockheed-resumes-f-35-jet-deliveries-to-pentagon-official-idUSKBN1I827Q>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Oliver North is announced to be the next president of the National Rifle Association.

Source citations (as archived): [NRA](<https://home.nra.org/lt-colonel-oliver-north-poised-to-become-nra-president/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-2-4"></a>

Context: Legal status of cryptocurrency.

**Archived source account.** In a landmark bankruptcy case the Ninth Arbitration Court of Appeal in Moscow rules cryptocurrencies are property and demands access to a party's Bitcoin reserves.

Source citations (as archived): [Bitcoinist](<http://bitcoinist.com/russian-court-rules-bitcoin-property/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-05-07-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 lower Puna eruption.

**Archived source account.** About 35 structures in Leilani Estates are destroyed during the Kīlauea eruption in Hawaii.

Source citations (as archived): [KFOR-TV](<http://kfor.com/2018/05/07/35-structures-destroyed-after-hawaiis-volcanic-eruption/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A collision of two trains near Aichach in Germany leaves two people dead and at least 14 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [DW](<http://www.dw.com/en/trains-collide-in-bavaria-two-dead/a-43693631>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-05-07-4-1"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States imposes sanctions on three Venezuelans and 20 drug entities for trafficking activity.

Source citations (as archived): [Yahoo\! News](<https://www.yahoo.com/news/u-imposes-sanctions-three-venezuelans-under-drug-kingpin-180504279.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-4-2"></a>

Context: United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** United States Vice President Mike Pence calls on Venezuela to suspend its presidential election later this month citing corruption concerns. This follows a similar announcement made by the European Union.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-05-07/pence-is-said-to-call-on-venezuela-to-suspend-may-20-elections>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-4-4"></a>

Context: Israel–Paraguay relations.

**Archived source account.** Paraguay announces that it will move its embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem by the end of May. Paraguay is the third country to relocate its embassy to Jerusalem after the United States and Guatemala.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-paraguay/paraguay-to-move-its-embassy-in-israel-to-jerusalem-idUSKBN1I81TX>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-07-5-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** Egyptian chief prosecutor Nabil Sadek refers 555 ISIL suspects suspected of 63 terror attacks to a military court, while the Giza Criminal Court in Cairo sentences nine terrorists to life imprisonment and two others to five years imprisonment each.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/egypt-refers-555-to-military-court-on-terror-related-charges/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-5-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Israel.

**Archived source account.** The Knesset approves by 55 votes to 14 a bill designed to confiscate payments made by the Palestinian Authority to terrorists in Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [Arutz Sheva](<http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/245566>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-5-5"></a>

Context: Murder of Kim Wall.

**Archived source account.** Danish inventor Peter Madsen appeals his life sentence for murdering Swedish journalist Kim Wall onboard his homemade submarine. He has not appealed his conviction.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44032334>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-5-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Indiana accused serial killer Shawn Grate is convicted of two murders. He has previously confessed to, but not been charged with, two more murders and entered guilty pleas to crimes including rape.

Source citations (as archived): [10tv](<https://www.10tv.com/article/shawn-grate-found-guilty-killing-2-women-ashland-county>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-5-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** An Indonesian court rejects a bid by Islamic group Hizb ut-Tahrir to overturn its ban in the country. The group was outlawed by presidential decree in 2017 on national security grounds.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/07/indonesia-jakarta-court-rejects-hizb-ut-tahrir-attempt-to-reverse-ban>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-5-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Finland says compensation payouts for wrongful convictions and imprisonments have quadrupled in ten years, with three million euros paid in 2017 versus 720,000 euros in 2007.

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-07-6-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Japan.

**Archived source account.** Centrist opposition party Democratic Party merges with centre-right Party of Hope, forming the Democratic Party for the People. Members of both parties that disapproved of the merger choose to either join the Constitutional Democratic Party, become independents or remain in the Party of Hope.

Source citations (as archived): [The Asahi Shimbun](<http://www.asahi.com/ajw/articles/AJ201805070046.html>).

Context: Fourth inauguration of Vladimir Putin.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin is inaugurated at the Grand Kremlin Palace in Moscow for a fourth term as President of Russia following his victory in March's presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44024184>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-6-5"></a>

Context: Lebanese general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** In official results, Hezbollah and allied parties win a slight majority of seats in Parliament.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-lebanon-election/hezbollah-allies-gain-in-lebanon-vote-underscoring-iran-sway-idUSKBN1I804D>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-6-7"></a>

Context: 2017–18 United States political sexual scandals, Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Attorney General of New York Eric Schneiderman, whose office sued The Weinstein Company for sexual harassment and discrimination, resigns amid allegations of violence towards four women during his tenure as Attorney General.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/harvey-weinstein-scandal/n-y-attorney-general-schneiderman-accused-violence-toward-women-n872181>).

<a id="event-2018-05-07-6-8"></a>

**Archived source account.** Italian President Sergio Mattarella says either fresh elections must be held or a neutral caretaker government installed following the collapse of a third round of talks aiming to form a coalition after March's general election failed to produce a clear winner.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44034610>).

Context: 2018 Stanley Cup playoffs.

Source citations (as archived): [Sporting News](<http://www.sportingnews.com/nhl/news/nhl-playoffs-2018-washington-capitals-advance-to-eastern-conference-finals-pittsburgh-penguins-highlights-result-score-overtime-win/1c6fze1im6pzp1j7kz55temgc2>).

<a id="event-2018-05-08-2-1"></a>

Context: USS Fitzgerald and MV ACX Crystal collision.

### 2018-05-09

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

The IDF reports the Iron Dome missile defence system has intercepted a number of missiles and reports no injuries. Israeli forces respond with artillery into Syria.

<a id="event-2018-05-09-3-3"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** After the United States withdrew from the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action, a group of conservative Iranian lawmakers burned American flags and chanted Death to America.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/09/middleeast/iran-reacts-nuclear-deal-intl/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-09-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Moroccan national is extradited from Bulgaria to Morocco to face trial for terrorism and ISIL membership.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-05/09/c_137167158.htm>).

<a id="event-2018-05-09-4-2"></a>

Context: Inn Din massacre § Arrest of journalists.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar police captain Moe Yan Naing testifies in court for the second time during the trial of Reuters journalists Wa Lone and Kyaw Soe Oo, which has become a landmark case of press freedom in the country. Naing accused his superior, police brigadier general Tin Ko Ko, of orchestrating a plot to entrap the journalists and threatening Naing and his colleagues with arrest if they did not "get Wa Lone". Naing was arrested for violating Myanmar's Police Disciplinary Act and sentenced to a one-year prison term prior to his testimony.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-journalists/myanmar-policeman-who-said-reuters-reporters-were-framed-details-sting-operation-idUSKBN1IA1SG>); [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/myanmar-police-whistleblower-testifies-warning/4386456.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-09-4-4"></a>

Context: Far-right terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Four neo-Nazis are convicted of attempting to incite racial hatred at Aston University in England by carrying out a sticker recruitment campaign for National Action. A fifth is acquitted and sentencing alongside two other convicts is set for June 1. National Action has since been banned as a terror group.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/national-action-neo-nazi-stickers-birmingham-aston-university-racist-convicted-a8343596.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-09-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Australian parliamentary eligibility crisis.

**Archived source account.** The High Court of Australia disqualifies Senator Katy Gallagher because she held dual citizenship with the United Kingdom when elected, not renouncing it in time. Four MPs in similar situations have also resigned, setting up four by-elections.

Source citations (as archived): [The Sydney Morning Herald](<https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/high-court-rules-labor-s-katy-gallagher-ineligible-and-sets-up-four-likely-byelections-20180509-p4ze5f.html>); [ABC](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-05-09/high-court-katy-gallagher-citizenship-political-reax/9742130>).

<a id="event-2018-05-09-5-3"></a>

Context: Malaysian general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** The opposition Pakatan Harapan has obtained a majority in the Parliament, defeating the incumbent Barisan Nasional government led by Najib Razak. This marks the first ever change of government in Malaysia's 61-year history.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysia-general-election-2018-live-blog-10214248>).

Source citations (as archived): [Africa News](<http://www.africanews.com/2018/05/10/explosion-in-somali-khat-market-kills-5-people-10-wounded/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-10-0-4"></a>

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-05-10-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Pacific hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** A tropical depression forms in the Pacific ocean. It is not supposed to threaten land, and is also the first storm of the season.

<a id="event-2018-05-10-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The National Transportation Safety Board opens an investigation into an automobile accident in Florida, involving a Tesla Model S where two teenagers died. According to a statement by Tesla, the car's Autopilot feature was not engaged at the time.,

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-tesla-crash/autopilot-was-not-engaged-during-florida-model-s-crash-tesla-idUSKBN1IB1HX>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/ntsb-investigating-tesla-crash-fire-killed-florida-teens/story?id=55062449>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-05-10-2-1"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations, Iran–United Arab Emirates relations.

**Archived source account.** In cooperation with United Arab Emirates, the United States Treasury implements new sanctions on six persons and three corporate entities having alleged ties to Iran's Quds Force.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-nuclear-usa-sanctions/us-uae-crack-down-on-network-for-smuggling-funds-to-elite-iran-group-idUSKBN1IB2I3>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-10-3-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in England.

**Archived source account.** Safaa Boular, a teenager, goes on trial at the Old Bailey accused of two counts of planning terrorism after allegedly planning to attack the British Museum in London after failing to travel to Syria to marry an Islamic extremist fighter.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44072265>).

<a id="event-2018-05-10-3-2"></a>

Context: Terrorism in England.

**Archived source account.** UK Prime Minister Theresa May apologises to the family of Abdul Hakim Belhaj, accepting the fact that the UK's actions led to his rendition to Libya where he was tortured. Belhaj was detained in Thailand by US authorities in 2004. His wife accepts the apology and £500,000.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44070304>).

<a id="event-2018-05-10-3-4"></a>

Context: Bangladesh Liberation War.

**Archived source account.** A court in Bangladesh sentences Riaz Uddin Fakir to death for war crimes during the 1971 Liberation War.

Source citations (as archived): [Bangladesh Daily News 24](<https://bdnews24.com/bangladesh/2018/05/10/mymensinghs-riaz-uddin-fakir-to-die-for-war-crimes>).

<a id="event-2018-05-10-3-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Wu Xiaohui, head of Chinese insurance firm Anbang, is jailed for eighteen years for fraud and corruption. He is further sentenced to have 10.5 billion yuan confiscated.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-44063780>).

<a id="event-2018-05-10-3-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Peruvian police rescues 96 young women, including two Venezuelan citizens and one teenager, who had been intercepted by human traffickers in a police operation in different nightclubs of the area of La Pampa, Madre de Dios, better known for its mining camps. In total, seven people were arrested.

Source citations (as archived): [El Comercio](<https://elcomercio.pe/peru/madre-de-dios/trata-personas-rescatan-96-jovenes-prostibares-pampa-madre-dios-noticia-519063?foto=3>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-10-4-1"></a>

Context: Net neutrality in the United States.

**Archived source account.** The Federal Communications Commission sends out a notice which states that the 2015 US Open-Internet Rules will cease on June 11, 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-internet/fcc-says-net-neutrality-rules-will-end-on-june-11-idUSKBN1IB1UN>).

<a id="event-2018-05-10-4-3"></a>

Context: Malaysian general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Mahathir Mohamad is sworn in as the 7th Prime Minister of Malaysia after leading the opposition Pakatan Harapan coalition to victory in the May 9 general election. Outgoing Prime Minister Najib Razak pledges to assist with the transition of power.

Source citations (as archived): [Malaysiakini](<https://www.malaysiakini.com/news/424180>).

### 2018-05-11

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086794128](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20May%2011&oldid=1086794128>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-11-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** The Israel Defense Forces again open fire with tear gas and live ammunition on Palestinian protesters, following 6 weeks of protests. One person is killed and 146 others wounded, with some protesters throwing stones and burning tyres.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/gaza-protests-latest-israel-shot-dead-border-march-gunfire-palestine-sinwar-hamas-a8347366.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-11-0-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Three Israelis are arrested after filming themselves attempting to fly a kite carrying an incendiary device into the Gaza Strip, in reference to the same tactic used by protestors in Gaza. The kite crashes on Israeli territory where it starts a small fire.

Source citations (as archived): [Haaretz](<https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/video-shows-israelis-failed-attempt-to-send-flaming-kite-to-gaza-1.6076149>).

<a id="event-2018-05-11-0-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Egypt announces that the Rafah Crossing into Gaza will be opened for four days starting next Saturday. Egypt usually opens the border for humanitarian reasons every two or three months for two or three days at a time.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-05-11-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The owner of Cheeki Rafiki, a yacht that capsized in the Atlantic in 2014 with the loss of four lives, is given a suspended sentence in England for the accident. He was earlier convicted of operating the vessel unsafely but acquitted of manslaughter.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-hampshire-44077513>).

<a id="event-2018-05-11-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Mount Merapi in Java, Indonesia, erupts. Authorities order evacuations and the closure of Adisucipto Airport in Yogyakarta.

Source citations (as archived): [Newshub](<http://www.newshub.co.nz/home/world/2018/05/java-s-merapi-volcano-erupts.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-11-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A fire destroys almost all of the approximately 710 commercial premises of an important market in Lima, Peru. The fire is exacerbated by flammable products stored in many of the stores. One person was injured and also there were allegations of looting.

Source citations (as archived): [La República](<https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/1240603-puente-piedra-incendio-consume-mercado-monumental-video>); [Radio Capital](<http://www.capital.com.pe/actualidad/video-puente-piedra-asi-fue-el-incendio-que-anoche-consumio-cientos-de-puestos-de-mercado-noticia-1122034>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2018-05-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** James Harrison, an 81-year-old Australian whose blood was used in the development of a treatment for Rh disease that has been credited with saving the lives of over 2 million infants in his country alone, donates blood plasma for the final time, after having regularly donated for over 60 years.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/11/health/james-harrison-blood-donor-retires-trnd/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-11-3-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Russia.

**Archived source account.** Russian authorities say that they foiled a plot by Siberian terrorists to attack a Victory Day march attended by President Vladimir Putin and visiting Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Twenty suspects are detained.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/russia-says-terror-attack-foiled-at-wwii-memorial-march-attended-by-netanyahu/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-11-3-3"></a>

Context: Foreign fighters in the Syrian and Iraqi Civil Wars.

**Archived source account.** Conservative MP Candice Bergen calls for action on Abu Huzaifa al-Kanadi, a man living in Toronto who claimed to have shot a Sunni prisoner in the head for the Islamic State in Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2018/05/11/conservative-mps-call-for-action-on-self-described-terror-recruit-for-daesh-reportedly-in-toronto.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-11-3-5"></a>

Context: Osmington shooting.

**Archived source account.** Three adults and four children are found shot dead at a property in Margaret River, Western Australia. Police suspect murder-suicide.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2018/may/11/margaret-river-tragedy-seven-people-found-dead-on-property-south-of-perth>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-11-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of the Philippines votes 8–6 to grant the quo warranto petition by the Solicitor General against Chief Justice Maria Lourdes Sereno, removing her from office for violating requirements on the Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/202236-sereno-ousted-supreme-court-quo-warranto-decision>).

<a id="event-2018-05-11-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Polish MPs vote to vote to cut their pay by 20% after opposition lawmakers boycott the vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<http://www.dw.com/en/poland-slashes-lawmakers-pay-by-20-percent-after-hard-work-bonuses/a-43747376>).

Context: 2018 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** SpaceX launches Bangabandhu-1, Bangladesh's first geostationary communications satellite, from Cape Canaveral Air Force Station in Florida, United States.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://uk.businessinsider.com/spacex-rocket-launch-falcon-9-block-5-live-webcast-2018-5>).

<a id="event-2018-05-11-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Scientists at MetService record a wave measuring 23.8 m high in the Southern Ocean near Campbell Island, New Zealand, making it the largest wave ever recorded in the Southern Hemisphere.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-44078255>); [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/science/2018/05/11/massive-wave-sets-southern-hemisphere-record-scientists-say.html>).

### 2018-05-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1362368326](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20May%2012&oldid=1362368326>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-12-0-1"></a>

Context: Burundian unrest (2015–2018).

**Archived source account.** 26 people are killed in Cibitoke Province, Burundi. The country's security minister attributes the attack on civilians in their houses to an unnamed "terrorist group".

**Archived source account.** Israel closes the Kerem Shalom border crossing into Gaza after it is heavily damaged by a Palestinian arson attack, saying that humanitarian cases will still be allowed through while the damage is being repaired. Kerem Shalom is the border crossing where most goods transit into the blockaded territory.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/israel-closes-kerem-shalom-border-crossing-after-palestinians-break-in/4391205.html>).

**Archived source account.** One person is killed and four wounded in a knife attack in Paris, France. The attacker is killed by police.

<a id="event-2018-05-12-1-1"></a>

Context: Eurovision Song Contest 2018.

**Archived source account.** Israeli singer Netta Barzilai wins the Eurovision Song Contest in Lisbon, Portugal, with her song Toy. This is Israel's first Eurovision win in the 21st century and fourth overall.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio/live/2018/may/12/eurovision-song-contest-2018-live-lisbon>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-05-12-2-1"></a>

Context: EgyptAir Flight 804.

**Archived source account.** Relatives of the 66 people killed in the crash sue Apple alleging that an overheating iPad caused the disaster.

Source citations (as archived): [Patently Apple](<http://www.patentlyapple.com/patently-apple/2018/05/apple-sued-by-grieving-relatives-who-blame-the-crash-of-egyptair-flight-804-on-apple-devices-causing-a-fire.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-05-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Japan–North Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** After Japanese Prime Minister Shinzō Abe insisted North Korea settle the issue of Japanese citizens adbucted by North Korea, North Korean state media KCNA accuses Japan of disrupting peace efforts before the planned North Korea–U.S. summit.

Source citations (as archived): [The Japan Times](<https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2018/05/13/national/politics-diplomacy/pyongyang-blasts-japan-intervening-nuke-talks-washington/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-12-3-3"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea stated that it would dismantle the Punggye-ri Nuclear Test Site between May 23–25 ahead of the Donald Trump-Kim Jong-un summit meeting. Furthermore, North Korea invited journalists from the United States, South Korea, China, Russia, and the United Kingdom to cover the process.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2018/05/12/north-korea-dismantling-nuclear-test-site-may-23-25/604654002/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-12-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak is banned from leaving the country due to the ongoing investigation into the 1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal. He subsequently resigns as president of UMNO and as head of the BN coalition.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-44092143>); [Malaysiakini](<https://www.malaysiakini.com/news/424466>).

<a id="event-2018-05-12-4-2"></a>

Context: Politics of Malaysia.

**Archived source account.** Former opposition leader Anwar Ibrahim, jailed during Najib's term, is due to be released next Tuesday after receiving a royal pardon. Anwar is the leader of the Pakatan Harapan coalition that won the May 9 general election. The pardon will enable Anwar to immediately run for public office again.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/12/malaysia-date-set-for-release-of-opposition-leader-anwar-ibrahim>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-12-5-1"></a>

Context: Iraqi parliamentary election, 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/05/12/middleeast/iraq-elections-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-12-5-2"></a>

Context: Iraqi parliamentary election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** A low turnout is reported, but no bombings at polling stations.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.spokesman.com/stories/2018/may/12/polls-close-across-iraq-in-first-vote-since-victor/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-12-5-4"></a>

Context: Politics of Italy.

**Archived source account.** A court in Milan lifts the consequences of Silvio Berlusconi's 2013 tax evasion sentence. He is now allowed to participate in elections again.

<a id="event-2018-05-12-5-6"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Writer and radical independentist Quim Torra faces his first investiture debate after being nominated yesterday for President of the Generalitat of Catalonia. In his speech, he reaffirms to continue with the republican project, to undertake a constituent process and to be under Carles Puigdemont's directions.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://elpais.com/ccaa/2018/05/12/catalunya/1526117680_759709.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/11/carles-puigdemont-proposes-quim-torra-successor-catalonia-government>).

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Quim Torra gets 66 votes, 2 short of the 68 votes needed to be elected by an absolute majority of the 135-seat Parliament of Catalonia. A second round is to be held on Monday, in which he would need a simple majority to be elected.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/catalan-secessionists-fail-to-elect-new-regional-leader-idUSKCN1ID0R5>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-13-0-2"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Indonesia / Surabaya bombings.

**Archived source account.** At least 13 people are killed and more than 40 others wounded after a series of suicide bombings at three churches in Surabaya, Indonesia.

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-05-13-1-1"></a>

Context: Economic policy of the Donald Trump administration.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump says in a tweet that he is working with Chinese President Xi Jinping to get the Chinese telecom company ZTE "back into business, fast." ZTE suspended its main operations after the U.S. Department of Commerce banned American companies from selling to the firm for seven years as punishment for ZTE breaking an agreement reached after it was caught illegally shipping U.S. goods to Iran.

Context: Sanctions against North Korea.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-usa-pompeo/pompeo-u-s-to-lift-sanctions-if-north-korea-dismantles-nuclear-weapons-program-idUSKCN1IE0NC>).

Context: 2017–18 Premier League.

### 2018-05-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1071730496](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20May%2014&oldid=1071730496>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-14-0-1"></a>

Context: Surabaya bombings.

**Archived source account.** An Indonesian family believed to be connected to the terrorist group Jamaah Ansharut Daulah attacks police headquarters in Surabaya. The attack kills all four perpetrators and injures the perpetrator's daughter, six civilians, and four police officers.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-05-14/blast-at-suabaya-police-station/9758730>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-05-14-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Dutch government, following similar moves by the United States and the United Kingdom, announces that it is phasing out the use of antivirus software products from the Russian company Kaspersky Lab "as a precautionary measure".

Source citations (as archived): [Nasdaq](<https://www.nasdaq.com/article/dutch-government-to-phase-out-use-of-kaspersky-antivirus-software-20180514-01084>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-05-14-2-1"></a>

Context: Natural disasters in India.

**Archived source account.** Thunderstorms and lightning strikes kill up to 80 people in five states in India, mainly in Uttar Pradesh.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/india/80-dead-136-injured-in-5-states-due-to-lightning-strikes-thunderstorms/articleshow/64162709.cms>).

<a id="event-2018-05-14-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A pilot is injured when a cockpit window breaks and he is partially sucked out of the Airbus A319 operating Sichuan Airlines Flight 8633. The aircraft lands safely at Chengdu.

Source citations (as archived): [The Aviation Herald](<http://avherald.com/h?article=4b890953&amp;opt=0>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-05-14-3-1"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as capital of Israel.

**Archived source account.** On the 70th anniversary of the formation of Israel, the United States becomes the first country with an embassy in Jerusalem after a dedication ceremony featuring Israeli leaders and White House advisers.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/05/14/610944471/u-s-dedicates-new-embassy-in-jerusalem>).

<a id="event-2018-05-14-3-2"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as capital of Israel.

**Archived source account.** Tens of thousands of Palestinians protest on the border of Gaza. The Israel Defense Forces reports some in the crowds were planting or hurling explosives, and that many were flying flaming kites into Israel. The Gaza Health Ministry reports at least 58 killed and over 2,400 wounded by Israeli forces using live fire and tear gas.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/05/14/world/middleeast/gaza-protests-palestinians-us-embassy.html>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/14/israel-palestine-defiance-death-gaza-jerusalem-suffers-horrific-day-of-violence-for-four-years>).

<a id="event-2018-05-14-3-3"></a>

Context: United States recognition of Jerusalem as capital of Israel.

**Archived source account.** Six-time Israeli Premier League champion Beitar Jerusalem F.C. officially renames itself Beitar Trump Jerusalem F.C. for U.S. President Donald Trump's decision to move the embassy.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/may/13/beitar-jerusalem-donald-trump-us-embassy-israel>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-14-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Supreme Court, in a case brought by New Jersey challenging the Professional and Amateur Sports Protection Act (PASPA), which prohibited state-sponsored sports betting outside of four grandfathered states, holds that PASPA is unconstitutional, opening the door for all states to authorize sports betting.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/14/politics/sports-betting-ncaa-supreme-court/index.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-14-5-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Catalan parliament elects hard-line separatist Quim Torra to become the President of the Generalitat of Catalonia after obtaining 66 votes in favor, 65 against and four abstentions.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics-catalonia/catalonia-parliament-elects-quim-torra-as-new-regional-leader-idUSKCN1IF1MJ>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44109500>).

<a id="event-2018-05-24-3-7"></a>
