#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-24-4-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** The National Assembly of Pakistan votes a constitutional amendment merging the Federally Administered Tribal Areas with Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province. This will abolish colonial-era rules and provide the five million people from the tribal areas with equal rights as the other people of Pakistan. The measure is expected to pass the next stages without fuss.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/05/pakistan-parliament-passes-landmark-tribal-areas-reform-180524111258832.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-24-4-3"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump posthumously pardons boxer Jack Johnson who was convicted for "taking his white girlfriend across state lines for 'immoral' purposes" in 1912.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/24/politics/sylvester-stallone-jack-johnson-donald-trump/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-24-4-4"></a>

Context: Presidency of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** President Trump awards the Medal of Honor to Navy Seal Britt K. Slabinski for his actions during the Battle of Takur Ghar.

Source citations (as archived): [Tampa Bay Times](<http://www.tampabay.com/trump-awards-medal-of-honor-to-navy-seal-in-afghan-assault-ap_national30109fcb932b447aa119c131fcfe6c2f>).

<a id="event-2018-05-24-4-6"></a>

Context: Aftermath of Venezuelan presidential election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** The president of Venezuela, Nicolás Maduro, during a ceremony to celebrate his re-election, ordered the military high command that the Armed Forces sign a "loyalty" document, after claims to have frustrated a supposed conspiration that sought to avoid holding the presidential elections of May 20 and blamed the United States and Colombia for being behind it. Maduro also said that the leader of the alleged conspiration "was a fugitive and that he had escaped to Colombia".

Source citations (as archived): [El Universal](<http://www.eluniversal.com.mx/mundo/maduro-revela-complot-y-exige-lealtad-los-militares>).

<a id="event-2018-05-24-4-7"></a>

Context: Aftermath of Venezuelan presidential election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** The Human Rights NGO, Foro Penal, reported the arrest of an aviation major, which is added to the imprisonment on May 22 by order of the military justice of eleven officers of the Armed Forces. Other versions, of press and activists, affirm that there would be at least 15 detentions by this presumed plot.

Source citations (as archived): [Canal N](<http://canaln.pe/internacionales/venezuela-maduro-dispuso-detencion-militares-conspiracion-n323445>).

### 2018-05-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1077679782](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20May%2029&oldid=1077679782>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-29-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Liège attack.

**Archived source account.** Three people, including two police officers, are killed in Liège, Belgium, and four police officers are injured in a shooting. The gunman took a woman hostage, but was later killed by police.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44289404>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/29/belgium-gunman-kills-two-police-officers-and-passerby-liege>).

<a id="event-2018-05-29-0-3"></a>

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** Palestinian militants in Gaza fire dozens of mortars at Israel in the heaviest such barrage in years. The Israeli Air Force responds with airstrikes on militant positions.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-44287594>).

<a id="event-2018-05-29-0-5"></a>

Context: Ukrainian crisis.

**Archived source account.** It is reported that Russian journalist Arkady Babchenko is shot dead near his home in Kiev, Ukraine. The day after, the event is revealed by the Ukrainian Security Service to have been staged as part of an operation to catch those who were trying to kill him.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-russia-journalist/prominent-russian-journalist-shot-dead-in-kiev-police-idUSKCN1IU2K7>); [NBC New York](<https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/national-international/Russian-Journalist-Shot-Killed-Ukrainian-Capital-483983981.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-05-29-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. television network ABC cancels its recently revived sitcom Roseanne following a controversial tweet from Roseanne Barr about former U.S. President Barack Obama aide Valerie Jarrett.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-44294632>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/05/29/abc-cancels-roseanne-barrs-sitcom-after-her-tweet-about-black-obama-aide-valerie-jarrett.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-29-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 in video gaming.

**Archived source account.** The studio behind battle royale game PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds (PUBG) sues Epic Games for allegedly copying their game with Fortnite Battle Royale.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/technology-44287860>); [The Verge](<https://www.theverge.com/2018/5/29/17404516/pubg-epic-games-fortnite-lawsuit>).

Context: 2018 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Subtropical Storm Alberto, the first named Atlantic storm of 2018, makes landfall on the west coast of Florida, United States.

<a id="event-2018-05-29-3-2"></a>

Context: 2018 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** At least 50 people are reported to have died amid heavy thunder and lightning storms in northern India.

<a id="event-2018-05-29-4-1"></a>

Context: International recognition of Abkhazia and South Ossetia.

**Archived source account.** Syria recognizes the disputed territories of Abkhazia and South Ossetia as independent states which in turn prompts Georgia to sever its relations with Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-georgia-syria/georgia-to-sever-diplomatic-ties-with-syria-after-recognition-of-separatists-idUSKCN1IU22U>).

<a id="event-2018-05-29-4-3"></a>

Context: 2018 China–United States trade dispute.

**Archived source account.** The U.S. Government announces a 25% import tariff on US$50 billion of Chinese goods with "industrially significant technology". A full list of affected products will be published on June 15. Investment restrictions and enhanced export controls are to be announced on June 30.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2018/05/29/615117323/white-house-announces-tariffs-trade-restrictions-to-be-placed-on-china>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-29-5-1"></a>

Context: Crime in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** It is reported today that right-wing British activist Tommy Robinson was sentenced to 13 months in prison for contempt of court within five hours after being arrested outside Leeds Crown Court on 25 May. A ban on reporting his sentence is lifted today following a legal challenge by journalists.

Source citations (as archived): [The Mirror](<https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/uk-news/english-defence-league-founder-tommy-12616030>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/may/29/edl-founder-tommy-robinson-jailed-13-months>).

<a id="event-2018-05-29-5-3"></a>

Context: Censorship of Facebook, Health in Papua New Guinea.

**Archived source account.** Papua New Guinea bans Facebook for a month "in order to research the social network’s effects on the population and to crack down on fake accounts."

Source citations (as archived): [The Hill](<http://thehill.com/policy/technology/389657-papua-new-guinea-to-ban-facebook-for-a-month>).

<a id="event-2018-05-29-5-5"></a>

Context: Kidnapping of Joshua Boyle and Caitlan Coleman.

**Archived source account.** Former Taliban hostage Joshua Boyle, awaiting trial on assault charges, is expected to hear Friday whether he'll be released on bail.

Source citations (as archived): [The Star](<https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2018/05/29/bail-decision-for-former-afghanistan-hostage-joshua-boyle-expected-friday.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-29-6-1"></a>

Context: Libyan general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Four Libyan leaders – Fayez al-Sarraj, Khalifa Haftar, Aguila Saleh and head of the Council of State Khaled al-Mishri – endorse a statement calling to hold "credible, peaceful" elections on 10 December.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/29/macron-hosts-libyan-factions-in-paris-in-push-to-secure-elections>).

<a id="event-2018-05-29-6-3"></a>

Context: 2017–18 United States political sexual scandals.

**Archived source account.** Governor of Missouri Eric Greitens announces that he is resigning amid sexual misconduct and misuse of a charity donor list allegations against him. Greitens claims that he is the victim of a "political witch hunt". Lt. Governor Mike Parson will assume the governorship once Greitens' resignation takes effect on June 1.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-44297378>); [St Louis Post-Dispatch](<http://www.stltoday.com/news/local/govt-and-politics/who-is-mike-parson-the-next-governor-of-missouri/collection_aeeaa244-8fee-5bdf-b9d2-98a037af2389.html>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Cincinnati Enquirer](<https://www.cincinnati.com/story/sports/soccer/fc-cincinnati/2018/05/29/its-official-fc-cincinnati-has-joined-mls-begin-play-2019/652201002/>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-30-1-3"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** Amid concerns that the value of the company's stocks would fall after the decision to cease the sales of certain firearms, Dick's Sporting Goods reports a stronger than expected quarter, with shares up 27%.

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2018-05-30-3-1"></a>

Context: Japanese whaling, Whaling controversy.

**Archived source account.** A consortium led by the Institute of Cetacean Research, which is linked to Japan's Ministry of Fisheries, reports that 333 Antarctic minke whales were killed in last summer's scientific survey. 122 of the whales were pregnant, and 114 immature.

### 2018-05-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1273224765](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20May%2031&oldid=1273224765>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-05-31-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Nicaraguan protests.

**Archived source account.** Catholic bishops cancel the planned Episcopal Conference talks with the government after protests against Nicaraguan President Daniel Ortega turn violent. According to the Nicaraguan Human Rights Center, pro-government armed groups killed 11 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nicaragua-protests/eleven-killed-in-nicaragua-protests-including-attack-on-mothers-day-march-idUSKCN1IW27E>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-05-31-1-1"></a>

Context: Transport in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Truck owners' strikes continue for the tenth consecutive day in 177 cities. Fuel shortages and long lines at petrol stations are reported in all major Iranian cities.

Source citations (as archived): [Open Democracy](<https://www.opendemocracy.net/jubin-afshar/iran-truckers-join-nationwide-push-for-change>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-1-3"></a>

Context: Trump tariffs, Protectionism in the United States.

**Archived source account.** United States tariffs of 25% on steel and 10% on aluminium imports from Canada, Mexico and the European Union are set to take effect at midnight.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-44320221>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-1-4"></a>

Context: Trump tariffs, Protectionism in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Mexico retaliates with equivalent levies on pork legs, apples, grapes, cheeses and steel. The Secretariat of Economy says that the measures will be in place until the U.S. eliminates their new tariffs.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-mexico/mexico-hits-back-at-u-s-steel-aluminum-tariffs-with-equivalent-measures-idUSKCN1IW1ZI>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-1-5"></a>

Context: Trump tariffs, Protectionism in the United States.

**Archived source account.** President of the European Commission Jean-Claude Juncker vows "counterbalancing measures" from the EU soon. The EU is expected to respond with tariffs on a little more than US$3 billion worth of American goods including motorcycles, bourbon, and blue jeans. Juncker also says that the EU will proceed with a case against the US in the World Trade Organization. US Secretary of Commerce Wilbur Ross replies that the EU measures are "unlikely" to have much impact on the US economy.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.newsobserver.com/news/business/article212244199.html>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.nl/trump-steel-aluminum-tariffs-trade-war-europe-canada-mexico-2018-5/>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-ross-retaliation/us-commerce-chief-any-reprisals-over-metals-tariffs-unlikely-to-hit-us-economy-idUSKCN1IW20F>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-1-6"></a>

Context: Trump tariffs, Protectionism in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Foreign Minister Chrystia Freeland announces dollar-for-dollar retaliatory tariffs of 10% or 25% on a list of goods – steel, aluminum, whiskey, orange juice and other food products – worth $16.6 billion. Prime Minister Justin Trudeau denounces an "affront" to the security partnership between the US and Canada.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/05/31/canada-announces-retaliatory-tariffs.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-05-31-2-1"></a>

Context: Support for military action against Iran.

**Archived source account.** Ex-Israeli spy chief Tamir Pardo reveals that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had ordered the Israeli Defence Forces to prepare for military action against Iran in 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/israeli-spy-chief-netanyahu-planned-iran-strike-2011-55553336>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-05-31-3-1"></a>

Context: European Convention on Human Rights.

**Archived source account.** The European Court of Human Rights rules that the Romanian and Lithuanian governments each knowingly hosted CIA secret prisons around 2005. Both countries also participated in the US extraordinary rendition program: one case by each country is acknowledged. Four years ago, Poland was also condemned for running a CIA secret jail.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-rights-cia-prisons/romania-and-lithuania-knowingly-hosted-secret-cia-jails-european-court-rules-idUSKCN1IW1PF>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-3-3"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** A British man named Husnain Rashid pleaded guilty after supporting ISIS and admitting that he threatened to attack Prince George at school.

Source citations (as archived): [Global News](<https://globalnews.ca/news/4245398/prince-george-terrorism-attack-isis/>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Denmark's parliament votes 75–30 to ban garments that cover the face, which includes Islamic veils such as the niqāb and burqa. Those violating the law risk a fine of 1,000 kroner. Similar bans already exist in Austria, Belgium and France.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/31/denmark-passes-law-banning-burqa-and-niqab>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-05-31-4-1"></a>

Context: 2018 vote of no confidence in the government of Mariano Rajoy, Gürtel case.

**Archived source account.** The debate on a motion of no confidence against Spanish Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy's government takes place at the Congress of Deputies, with a vote scheduled tomorrow. With an expected 180 votes against 176 needed, leader of the Opposition, socialist Pedro Sánchez, could immediately become the next Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/spain-mariano-rajoy-no-confidence-vote-basque-catalan-corruption-a8377331.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-spain-politics/opposition-secures-enough-votes-to-topple-spains-rajoy-idUSKCN1IW0TM>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-4-3"></a>

Context: Thirty-first Amendment to the Constitution of Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Pakistani President Mamnoon Hussain signs into law the official merger of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas with the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa administrative province.

Source citations (as archived): [RFE/RL](<https://www.rferl.org/a/pakistani-president-signs-law-merging-tribal-areas-with-khyber-pakhtunkhwa/29261314.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A large march, which included students, citizen collectives and political groups of the left, toured the streets of Lima, Peru to demand the closure of the Congress of the Republic, seat of the legislative power, in response to the constant corruption scandals involving congressmen, in addition to excessive economic expenses that, for the demonstrators, makes this power of the State. The protest, initially peaceful, turned violent when the police prevented the demonstrators from approaching precisely the Congress and the presidential palace.

Source citations (as archived): [Perú 21](<https://peru21.pe/lima/desarrolla-marcha-denominada-cerremos-congreso-lima-video-408861?foto=10>); [La República](<https://larepublica.pe/politica/1253191-marcha-congreso-gasolinazo-termino-enfrentamientos-fotos/6>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-05-31-5-1"></a>

Context: Plutinos.

**Archived source account.** Astronomers announce the discovery of 380-680 km wide plutino 2017 OF69, the fifth-largest known plutino, and the largest discovered since 90482 Orcus in 2004.

Source citations (as archived): [Minor Planet Center](<https://minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K18/K18KA9.html>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-5-2"></a>

Context: Plutinos.

**Archived source account.** Pluto, the eponymous member of the plutino group, is discovered to have dunes of methane ice.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-44317367>).

<a id="event-2018-05-31-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Paleontologists at the University of Bristol announce, through the Nature journal, the discovery of the world's oldest lizard fossil, estimated to be 240 million years old. The fossil, Megachirella wachtleri, is the most ancient known ancestor of all modern lizards and snakes.

Source citations (as archived): [Science Daily](<https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2018/05/180530142043.htm>); [CBC](<http://www.cbc.ca/news/technology/megachirella-lizard-1.4682553>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-06-01-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The CDC reports that five people have died and 197 have been hospitalized in the United States, in the largest incidence of E. coli since the 2006 North American E. coli outbreak.

<a id="event-2018-06-01-3-1"></a>

Context: Shangri-La Dialogue.

Context: 2018 North Korea–United States summit, North Korea–United States relations.

Members of the UNHCR and the UNDP will be allowed to work in Rakhine State to monitor the process.

<a id="event-2018-06-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in Burkina Faso.

**Archived source account.** Burkina Faso's National Assembly votes to abolish the death penalty.

<a id="event-2018-06-01-4-3"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Federal prosecutors in Germany apply in a Schleswig-Holstein court for the extradition of Carles Puigdemont to Spain, arguing that the treason charges are valid according to German law, because, according to the prosecutors, "the violence in Catalonia on election day can be attributed to the wanted individual".

<a id="event-2018-06-01-4-5"></a>

Context: Crime in Canada.

**Archived source account.** Former Taliban hostage Joshua Boyle is released from jail with strict bail conditions, including an electronic tracking bracelet.

<a id="event-2018-06-01-4-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** A Department of Defense report presented to the United States Congress estimates at 499 the number of civilian deaths in US military actions during the year 2017, with more than 450 reports remaining to be assessed. The casualties occurred in Syria, Iraq, Afghanistan and Yemen.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/06/01/politics/us-military-report-civilian-deaths/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-06-01-4-8"></a>

Context: Crime in Colorado.

**Archived source account.** An Uber driver in Denver, Colorado, United States, fatally shoots a passenger after a conflict on the Interstate 25 highway. A portion of the highway is placed on lockdown following the incident.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/crime/uber-driver-shoots-passenger-dead-on-denver-highway-police-say/ar-AAy6LgO?ocid=spartanntp>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-06-01-5-1"></a>

Context: 2018 vote of no confidence in the government of Mariano Rajoy, Gürtel case.

**Archived source account.** The Government of Mariano Rajoy is ousted after a motion of no confidence passes 180–169. Pedro Sánchez of the Socialist Workers' Party is sworn in as the new Prime Minister. This is the first time in Spanish history that a vote of no confidence has resulted in a change of government.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44327573>).

<a id="event-2018-06-01-5-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Italian government formation.

**Archived source account.** Giuseppe Conte is sworn in as the new Prime Minister of Italy at the head of a populist coalition, formed by the Five Star Movement and the Northern League. Conte had previously given up on trying to form a government after President Sergio Mattarella had vetoed Conte's original choice for Minister of Finance, but a different candidate was agreed to yesterday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44322429>).

### 2018-06-17

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-06-17-1-0"></a>

<a id="event-2018-06-17-1-2"></a>

Context: Mass shootings in the United States.

**Archived source account.** A shooting takes place at the Art All Night art festival in Trenton, New Jersey. A suspect is killed and 20 other people injured.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/new-jersey-arts-festival-shooting-leaves-20-injured-1-suspect-dead-officials-say/ar-AAyKOnD?ocid=spartanntp>).

<a id="event-2018-06-17-2-1"></a>

Context: Colombian presidential election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Iván Duque wins the second round presidential election to become the new President of Colombia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-44513368>).

<a id="event-2018-06-17-2-3"></a>

Context: Cambodian general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** A FUNCINPEC party SUV's head-on collision in southwest Cambodia with a taxi seriously injures former Prime Minister Prince Norodom Ranariddh and kills his wife Ouk Phalla; both were standing as candidates in the upcoming election. Seven other people were also injured.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.stuff.co.nz/world/asia/104807695/wife-of-cambodian-prince-killed-in-car-crash>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-06-17-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 FIFA World Cup.

**Archived source account.** In an upset victory, Mexico beats Germany 1–0, handing them their first opening loss in a World Cup since 1982.

Source citations (as archived): [TSN](<https://www.tsn.ca/lozano-leads-mexico-to-upset-victory-over-germany-1.1115195>).

<a id="event-2018-06-17-3-3"></a>

Context: 2018 U.S. Open (golf).

**Archived source account.** Brooks Koepka wins his second consecutive U.S. Open Championship of Golf, held in 2018 at Shinnecock Hills Golf Club in Shinnecock Hills, New York.

Source citations (as archived): [PGA](<https://www.pga.com/archive/events/usopen/brooks-koepka-becomes-second-player-last-66-years-win-back-back-us-open-titles%3famp=1>).

<a id="event-2018-06-18-3-1"></a>

<a id="event-2018-06-18-3-4"></a>

### 2018-06-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 880406984](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20June%2020&oldid=880406984>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-06-20-0-1"></a>

Context: Sinking of MV Sinar Bangun.

**Archived source account.** The MV Sinar Bangun, a ferry designed to hold 43 people, sinks at Tigaras port in Lake Toba, North Sumatra, leaving 192 reported missing.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/indonesia-raises-number-ferry-sinking-missing-166-56018425>).

<a id="event-2018-06-20-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A pile of mining waste collapses in the Copperbelt Province of Zambia, killing ten people and injuring ten more.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFKBN1JG1I8-OZATP>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-06-20-1-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of China.

**Archived source account.** China expresses regret over the United States' decision to leave the United Nations Human Rights Council.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-un-rights-usa-china/china-says-it-regrets-u-s-quitting-u-n-rights-council-idUSKBN1JG0W1>).

<a id="event-2018-06-20-1-3"></a>

Context: Nuclear sharing.

**Archived source account.** Germany reportedly asks the U.S. Department of Defense if the Eurofighter Typhoon could be certified to carry nuclear bombs.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-military-fighter/germany-presses-u-s-on-potential-eurofighter-nuclear-role-idUSKBN1JG1J4>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-06-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany.

**Archived source account.** German authorities arrest a Tunisian man accused of building a ricin bomb.

Source citations (as archived): [The South China Morning Post](<http://www.scmp.com/news/world/europe/article/2151681/germany-foils-ricin-bomb-biological-attack-tunisian-migrant>).

<a id="event-2018-06-20-2-3"></a>

Context: Trump administration family separation policy.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump signs an executive order to "maintain family unity", amid global outrage over the separation of migrant children from their families, reversing the administration's policy. It affirms the U.S. policy of "detaining alien families together where appropriate and consistent with law and available resources".

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-44552852>); [Boston Globe](<https://www.bostonglobe.com/news/politics/2018/06/20/read-text-executive-order-trump-just-signed-family-separation/e9aW9Jh3LQj2CsPIEA70FP/story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-06-20-2-5"></a>

Context: Operation Impact.

**Archived source account.** The terror trial of accused ISIL recruiter Awso Peshdary is adjourned after three days of hearings in which the court hears testimony about the path to jihad allegedly taken by two of his associates, Ottawa students John Maguire and Khadar Khalib.

Source citations (as archived): [Ottawa Citizen](<https://ottawacitizen.com/news/local-news/peshdary-trial-adjourns-after-three-days-of-testimony-on-alleged-terror-recruits>).

<a id="event-2018-06-20-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following a battery short circuit causing an explosion a London Underground station last night, a 26-year-old man is arrested and bailed on suspicion of causing it deliberately to cause damage or endanger life. Metropolitan Police counterterror investigators hand the probe back to British Transport Police, concluding the incident which injured five was not a terror attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/jun/20/man-arrested-over-southgate-tube-station-explosion-north-london>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-06-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern goes into labour with her first child. Deputy Prime Minister Winston Peters is now Acting Prime Minister, and will be for six weeks while Ardern is on maternity leave.

Source citations (as archived): [The New Zealand Herald](<https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&amp;objectid=12066441>); [Newshub](<https://www.newshub.co.nz/home/politics/2018/06/live-updates-jacinda-ardern-admitted-to-hospital-to-have-her-baby.html>).

#### Science and technology

**Archived source account.** The International Space Station (ISS) successfully deploys the UK-led RemoveDEBRIS satellite, which is designed to test the removal of space debris in low Earth orbit. At 100 kg, RemoveDEBRIS is the biggest satellite deployed from the ISS.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-44550082>).

<a id="event-2018-06-20-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United States government releases a Near-Earth Object Preparedness Plan for reducing risks of asteroid or comet impacts.

Source citations (as archived): [NASA](<https://www.nasa.gov/feature/federal-government-releases-national-near-earth-object-preparedness-plan>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Shares in African international airline Fastjet fall by 72% amid equity talks amongst shareholders, with the airline warning that trading may be suspended entirely and the company liquidated if a solution is not found.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-44625882>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-06-27-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 United Kingdom wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Greater Manchester Police declares a major incident as a wildfire continues to spread on Saddleworth Moor, forcing nearby homes to be evacuated. The fire is described as the "biggest in living memory" in the United Kingdom. Army assistance is granted to tackle the blaze.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/jun/27/manchester-moorland-fire-declared-a-major-incident-by-police>); [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/saddleworth-moor-fire-latest-homes-evacuated-greater-manchester-blaze-carrbrook-residents-a8418831.html>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-1-2"></a>

Context: 2018 United Kingdom wildfires.

**Archived source account.** A large wildfire has broken out in Glenshane Pass in County Londonderry, Northern Ireland, rapidly growing to cover around one square mile of dry gorse. High temperatures hamper efforts to tackle the wildfire, and firefighters have to be airlifted close to the front line.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-northern-ireland-foyle-west-44627939>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two cars collide near Waverley, Taranaki, New Zealand, killing seven people. It is the nation's deadliest road accident since 2005.

Source citations (as archived): [Newshub](<https://www.newshub.co.nz/home/new-zealand/2018/06/waverley-crash-nz-s-worst-road-accident-in-13-years.html>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion at a hospital in the U.S. state of Texas kills one person and injures multiple others. Search dogs are brought in to search the rubble; the building and nearby care homes are evacuated.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-44624389>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-1-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** An SUV and a bus collide in Marishda, East Midnapore, West Bengal, India, killing the SUV's six occupants.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-06/27/c_137284818.htm>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Sierra Negra erupts on the island of Isabela, the largest island of the Galápagos archipelago. Authorities have arranged evacuations and banned tourists from the area.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-44627725>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-06-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons is granted the power to assign blame for chemical attacks by its constituent countries. The move, proposed by the United Kingdom, received wide support, but was condemned by Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44634434>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-06-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Trump administration family separation policy.

**Archived source account.** A federal judge in California orders a halt to most family separations at the US-Mexico border and the reunification of all families.

Source citations (as archived): [WAVY-TV](<https://www.wavy.com/news/national/judge-orders-trump-administration-to-reunite-families-separated-at-border/1266632235>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** At appeal, Australian actress Rebel Wilson is ordered to pay back A$4.7m that she won in damages and interest from Bauer Media Group in what was Australia's largest ever libel payout. Wilson is also ordered to pay 80% of the group's appeal costs. The case stemmed from allegations that libelous articles portraying her as a serial liar had resulted in her losing acting jobs. The Victorian Court of Appeal finds that Wilson has not proved a connection between the libel and any failure to land roles. The case prompted national discussion over potential chilling effects on legitimate journalism.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-44625076>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-3-4"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in Australia.

**Archived source account.** Police in New South Wales, Australia, reclassify 27 murders from 1976 to 2000 as possible homophobic hate crimes following a review prompted by an Australian Institute of Criminology report that suggested crimes against LGBT victims had been insufficiently investigated.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-44624269>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-3-6"></a>

Context: Supreme Court of the United States.

**Archived source account.** US Supreme Court Associate Justice Anthony Kennedy announces his retirement, effective July 31, 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-44634176>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-3-8"></a>

Context: 2017-18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Spain confirms the prosecution of the independentists leaders accused of the crime of rebellion, embezzlement and disobedience.

Source citations (as archived): [El País](<https://politica.elpais.com/politica/2018/06/27/actualidad/1530101703_182548.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-06-27-4-1"></a>

Context: Elections in Indonesia.

**Archived source account.** Local elections take place across Indonesia, including races for 17 governors.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera English](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/06/indonesia-election-season-kicks-crucial-local-polls-180626132525097.html>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-4-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Maltese Prime Minister Joseph Muscat says that migrant rescue ship MV Lifeline, stranded in international waters with over 200 rescued people on board for five days, has been granted permission to dock on the island and will do so later today. Muscat says that those on board will be split among Malta and seven other European Union nations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44613344>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-4-4"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Austrian troops and police conduct a border exercise simulating a possible mass arrival of migrants similar to one in 2015, amid tensions within the European Union over migrant rescue ships and fears that Germany may close its borders.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/austria-carries-out-border-exercise-as-eu-states-refuse-to-allow-migrant-rescue-ship-to-dock-11417885>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-4-6"></a>

Context: Politics of Scotland.

**Archived source account.** Scottish First Minister Nicola Sturgeon reshuffles her cabinet. Nine new junior ministers are appointed, with the devolved Parliament set to vote on the changes tomorrow.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-44628099>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-4-8"></a>

Context: United States House of Representatives elections in New York, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez defeats Democratic incumbent New York leader Joseph Crowley in what has been described as the "biggest Democratic primary upset victory in years".

Source citations (as archived): [Mother Jones](<https://www.motherjones.com/politics/2018/06/alexandria-ocasio-cortez-joe-crowley-primary-new-york/>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-4-10"></a>

Context: Politics of Romania.

**Archived source account.** The cabinet of Romanian Prime Minister Viorica Dăncilă survives a motion of no confidence. During the vote, several thousand opposition supporters protest outside Parliament, calling for the resignation of the government.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Review](<http://business-review.eu/business/legal/romanias-psd-alde-government-survives-vote-of-no-confidence-in-parliament-174749>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-06-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japanese space probe Hayabusa2 arrives at its target, 162173 Ryugu, an Apollo asteroid. It is planned to return material from the asteroid to Earth by the end of 2020.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-44603120>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Enceladus, a moon of Saturn, is reported to host complex carbon-based molecules. Considered a precursor to life, the compounds were only previously known to exist on Earth and some meteorites.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-44630121>).

<a id="event-2018-06-27-5-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The first known interstellar object to pass through the Solar System, ʻOumuamua, has been identified as a very inactive comet and not an asteroid, as previously thought.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://in.reuters.com/article/space-comet/cigar-shaped-interstellar-visitor-oumuamua-classified-as-comet-idINKBN1JN2O5>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-06-27-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** FIFA World Cup title-holders Germany's football team are knocked out of the 2018 competition in the group stage for the first time since 1938 after losing to South Korea. This is the fourth time that the reigning champions have been knocked out in the group stage in the last five tournaments.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/live/football/43975530>).

<a id="event-2018-06-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Aftermath of first impeachment process against Pedro Pablo Kuczynski.

**Archived source account.** The Prosecutor's Office of Peru opens a preliminary investigation to determine if there were alleged political benefits – among them the humanitarian pardon granted to former President Alberto Fujimori – offered by former President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski to avoid being removed from his office during the first impeachment process against him in December 2017. ### 2018-07-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1362368179](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20July%202&oldid=1362368179>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-07-02-0-1"></a>

Context: Crossing the Ditch.

**Archived source account.** New Zealander Scott Donaldson becomes the first solo kayaker to successfully cross the Tasman Sea. After 62 days at sea, he landed in Ngāmotu Beach, New Plymouth, at 8.44 p.m. local time (08:44 UTC).

Source citations (as archived): [The New Zealand Herald](<https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&amp;objectid=12081843>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-07-02-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Tham Luang cave rescue.

**Archived source account.** Rescue teams find all 12 boys and their soccer coach alive in Tham Luang Nang Non cave in Chiang Rai, Thailand, after being trapped for 10 days.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/07/02/asia/thai-cave-rescue-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-07-02-1-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Malta detains German migrant rescue boat MV Sea Watch 3, which had been docked in Valletta for repairs, as it attempts to head into the Mediterranean Sea to rescue migrants off the Libyan coast.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-malta-ngo/malta-detains-second-charity-ship-as-death-toll-at-sea-rises-idUSKBN1JS19S>).

<a id="event-2018-07-02-1-4"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** The captain of MV Lifeline, a German migrant rescue ship that docked in Malta last week with 130 rescued migrants after Italy refused access, makes an initial court appearance in Valletta. He is charged with operating his ship illegally.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-malta-ngo/malta-detains-second-charity-ship-as-death-toll-at-sea-rises-idUSKBN1JS19S>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-07-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Crime in the Philippines and Philippine Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Antonio Halili, the mayor of Tanauan, Philippines, is shot dead by a sniper during a flag raising ceremony outside the city hall. Halili was known for parading people arrested on drug offenses through the city's streets.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/07/01/asia/philippines-mayor-halili-tanuan-shot-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-07-02-2-3"></a>

Context: Harvey Weinstein sexual abuse allegations.

**Archived source account.** Harvey Weinstein is expected to face additional sexual assault charges in connection with a third woman in a July 2006 incident.

Source citations (as archived): [WSJ](<https://www.wsj.com/articles/harvey-weinstein-to-face-additional-sex-assault-charges-1530547851?mod=hp_lead_pos4>).

<a id="event-2018-07-02-2-5"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** Militants ambush a paramilitary convoy in Awaran, Baluchistan, Pakistan and kill six people.

Source citations (as archived): [Associated Press](<https://newsok.com/article/feed/3590488/bomb-kills-3-oil-company-employees-in-southwestern-pakistan>).

<a id="event-2018-07-02-2-7"></a>

Context: Terrorism in the United States.

**Archived source account.** Demetrius Pitts, accused of planning an al-Qaeda bombing in Cleveland, makes his first court appearance.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-julyfourth-security/fbi-says-arrests-man-who-planned-to-bomb-cleveland-july-4-event-idUSKBN1JS1DJ>).

<a id="event-2018-07-02-2-9"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Belgium, Terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** Belgian authorities announce the arrest and charge of a Belgian man and his Iranian wife suspected of plotting a bomb attack against a Mujahedeen Khalq rally in France.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/07/02/world/europe/iran-france-belgium-bomb.html>).

<a id="event-2018-07-02-2-11"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** A US federal judge orders PricewaterhouseCoopers to pay US$625.3 million compensation to Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. The judge rules PwC negligently caused losses to F.D.I.C. by failing to uncover fraud during audits of Colonial BancGroup. Colonial, one the nation's 25 largest banks, and Taylor, Bean &amp; Whitaker, the 12th-largest mortgage broker in the US, both collapsed in August 2009 as a result of fraud between the two. F.D.I.C. was the receiver for Colonial.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-at-t-directv-now/pwc-must-pay-fdic-625-3-million-over-banks-collapse-u-s-judge-idUSKBN1JS2CB>).

<a id="event-2018-07-02-2-12"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Bataan Coast Guard detains cruise ship MV Forever Lucky on suspicion of involvement in human trafficking. The National Bureau of Investigation rescues 139 alleged victims from the vessel and charges Johnny Cabrera, the alleged lessor of the ship.

Source citations (as archived): [Inquirer](<http://newsinfo.inquirer.net/1006540/cruise-ship-in-bataan-stopped-from-sailing-for-human-trafficking>).

Context: 2018 German government crisis, European migrant crisis.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/chancellor-angela-merkel-and-horst-seehofer-agree-on-a-migration-compromise/a-44485481>).

<a id="event-2018-07-03-3-1"></a>

### 2018-07-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1022415156](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20July%204&oldid=1022415156>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-07-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Israeli–Palestinian conflict.

**Archived source account.** Clashes break out between Israeli security forces and Bedouin residents in Khan al-Ahmar, West Bank, as Israeli bulldozers prepare to demolish the village. The Supreme Court of Israel ruled that its residents could be evicted on May 24, while such relocation is considered illegal under international humanitarian law.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-bedouin/protests-erupt-at-bedouin-village-israel-plans-to-demolish-idUSKBN1JU1RN>).

<a id="event-2018-07-04-0-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Amesbury poisonings.

**Archived source account.** Police determine two British nationals found unconscious at a property in Amesbury, Wiltshire, on Saturday were poisoned using Novichok nerve agent of the same kind used in the poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal in Salisbury, seven miles from Amesbury, almost four months ago.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-44719639>).

<a id="event-2018-07-04-0-4"></a>

Context: 2018 Amesbury poisonings.

**Archived source account.** A major incident has been declared in Amesbury and several areas of the town have been evacuated as the National Counter Terrorism Policing Network investigate the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-wiltshire-44707052>).

<a id="event-2018-07-04-0-6"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** Philippine soldiers clash with militants from the ISIL-affiliated Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters (BIFF), in the southern province of Maguindanao. The fighting began when BIFF militants attempted to occupy a town center, and lasted for 12 hours until the BIFF militants withdrew to the hills. Four militants were killed, while two militants, a Philippine soldier and a local militiaman were wounded.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-philippines-militants/philippine-troops-retake-town-after-12-hour-standoff-with-islamists-idUSKBN1JV06O>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-07-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Survivors trapped overnight on a stricken ferry are rescued off the Indonesian island of Sulawesi after the ferry began sinking the day before. Out of the 139 passengers aboard, 31 have been confirmed dead, while three remain missing.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/passengers-rescued-stricken-indonesia-ferry-29-dead-56355287>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2018-07-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Eastern Canada heat wave.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from a heat wave in Quebec rises to 17.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/07/04/americas/quebec-heat-deaths/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-07-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Rise and Resist.

**Archived source account.** At least six people are arrested for hanging a sign that read "Abolish ICE" from the base below the Statue of Liberty, where no banners are permitted hung under federal law. Another is arrested after scaling the base of the statue, prompting an evacuation of the island on the busy Fourth of July holiday.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/arrests-after-abolish-ice-sign-hung-from-statue-of-liberty/2018/07/04/827e94e8-7fc7-11e8-a63f-7b5d2aba7ac5_story.html>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/protester-climbs-statue-liberty-prompting-evacuation-island/story?id=56370410>).

<a id="event-2018-07-04-4-1"></a>

Context: Directive on Copyright in the Digital Single Market.

**Archived source account.** The Polish, Spanish, Estonian and Latvian Wikipedias shut down in protest of the European Union's proposed copyright reform, blocking access for all users. This follows identical actions taken by Italian Wikipedia the previous day.

Source citations (as archived): [ERR](<https://news.err.ee/844168/estonian-wikipedia-protests-eu-plans-to-curtail-internet-freedom>); [TechCrunch](<https://techcrunch.com/2018/07/04/wikipedia-goes-dark-in-spanish-italian-ahead-of-key-eu-vote-on-copyright/>).

Context: 1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal.

**Archived source account.** Former Malaysian Prime Minister Najib Razak is charged with abuse of power and three counts of criminal breach of trust. He pleads not guilty to all charges and accuses the government of seeking "political vengeance."

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/najib-razak-charged-in-court-1mdb-10497402>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna888801>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-07-09-2-1"></a>

Context: Inn Din massacre § Arrest of Reuters journalists.

**Archived source account.** A court in Myanmar charges two Reuters journalists with obtaining secret state documents in violation of the colonial-era Official Secrets Act, taking the landmark press freedom case to trial after a period of preliminary hearings that lasted six months. The two journalists were investigating mass graves in the village of Inn Din in northern Rakhine State prior to their arrest and imprisonment on 12 December 2017.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-myanmar-journalists-ruling/myanmar-court-presses-secrets-act-charges-against-reuters-reporters-idUSKBN1JZ095>); [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/07/myanmar-charges-reuters-reporters-official-secrets-act-180709042144322.html>).

<a id="event-2018-07-09-2-3"></a>

Context: Weinstein effect.

**Archived source account.** Eugene Gu, a doctor famous for successfully suing President Donald Trump for blocking him on Twitter, has been accused of sexual assault by a woman who says she’s his ex.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Dot](<https://www.dailydot.com/irl/eugene-gu-accused-sexual-assault/>).

### 2018-07-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086600264](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20July%2026&oldid=1086600264>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-07-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Facebook stocks drop 20% (US$118 billion), setting a record as the biggest single stock market loss in one day, and marking the first time that a stock lost over $100 billion in one day.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/07/26/facebook-on-pace-for-biggest-one-day-loss-in-value-for-any-company-sin.html>).

<a id="event-2018-07-26-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Disney announces plans to eliminate all plastic straws and plastic stirrers from their parks by mid-2019.

Source citations (as archived): [NOLA](<https://articles.nola.com/business/index.ssf/2018/07/disney_no_more_plastic_straws.amp>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-07-26-1-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Hundreds of Sub-Saharan African migrants storm a border fence in Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta, using home-made flamethrowers and other improvised weapons. The Spanish Civil Guard reports that 602 people succeeded in reaching Ceuta, of whom 586 were taken to a temporary reception centre, while 16 others are being treated in a hospital. Fifteen border guards were also hurt.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jul/26/hundreds-storm-border-fence-spanish-enclave-north-africa-ceuta-spain-migration>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-07-26-2-1"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Japan.

**Archived source account.** The six remaining cult members of Aum Shinrikyo who perpetrated the 1995 Tokyo subway sarin attack and were on death row are executed by hanging.

Source citations (as archived): [Japan Today](<https://japantoday.com/category/crime/Japan-hangs-all-6-remaining-AUM-death-row-inmates>).

<a id="event-2018-07-26-2-3"></a>

Context: Cannabis in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** The UK Home Secretary Sajid Javid announces that medicinal cannabis products are to be legalized by the end of this year, allowing cannabis treatments to be legally prescribed by specialist doctors following several high profile cases.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-44968386>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-cannabis/britain-to-legalize-medicinal-use-of-cannabis-idUSKBN1KG29E>).

<a id="event-2018-07-26-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb explodes outside the U.S. Embassy in China, wounding the lone assailant.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-blast/suspected-self-immolation-near-u-s-embassy-in-china-state-media-idUSKBN1KG0KP>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-07-26-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A team of Russian scientists in collaboration with Princeton University announce in a new report that they have brought two female nematodes frozen in permafrost from around 42,000 years ago back to life. The two nematodes are now the oldest confirmed living animals on the planet.

Source citations (as archived): [The Siberian Times](<http://siberiantimes.com/science/casestudy/news/worms-frozen-in-permafrost-for-up-to-42000-years-come-back-to-life/>).

<a id="event-2018-07-26-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Astronomers say they have observed Albert Einstein's theory of gravitational redshift for the first time while observing a star known as S2 interact with a supermassive black hole using the Very Large Telescope (VLT).

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-44967491>).

## August

### 2018-08-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1071052449](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%201&oldid=1071052449>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-08-01-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Eiffel Tower in Paris shuts down after workers go on a strike over ticketing changes.

Source citations (as archived): [Upi](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/08/01/Eiffel-Tower-closed-after-workers-strike-over-ticketing-changes/1901533154462/>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-01-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Vietnam floods.

**Archived source account.** Two children and a man drown as new floods overflow one bank of the Bui River, engulf several villages, and threaten to submerge parts of Hanoi.

Source citations (as archived): [NHK World](<https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20180802_04/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-01-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An intense heat wave hits South Korea, which started at the end of July and is forecast to reach its highest temperature in the coming days. The heat wave kills 27 people, while more than 2,200 are taken to the hospital.

Source citations (as archived): [The Straits Times](<https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/east-asia/extreme-heatwave-in-south-korea-to-peak-in-coming-days>).

<a id="event-2018-08-01-1-4"></a>

Context: Grenfell Tower fire.

**Archived source account.** England announces that the Ministry of Housing will manage Grenfell Tower in London once the investigation into the fire that gutted the building and killed 72 people is complete.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-45032803>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-01-2-1"></a>

Context: Turkey–United States relations, 2016–present purges in Turkey.

**Archived source account.** The White House imposes sanctions on two Turkish officials over the detention of Andrew Brunson, an American pastor who is being tried on espionage and terror-related charges.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/sanctions-turkey-officials-detention-pastor-180801180200672.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-01-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** An orb and two crowns, part of the Regalia of Sweden, are stolen from Strängnäs Cathedral.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45028732>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-01-4-1"></a>

Context: Zimbabwean general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Violence breaks out in Zimbabwe amid allegations of election-rigging by the ruling Zanu-PF party.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45035533>).

<a id="event-2018-08-01-4-3"></a>

Context: Afghan presidential election, 2019.

**Archived source account.** The Afghan government says that it will hold presidential elections on April 20, 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [AL Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/afghanistan-hold-presidential-elections-april-20-2019-180801082206475.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-08-01-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers from Australia report the success of a plan to use mosquitoes infected with Wolbachia bacteria to prevent the spread of dengue fever in an Australian town, stating that they intend to bring the program to other locales.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-45028733>).

<a id="event-2018-08-01-5-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Reddit reports a data breach consisting of emails and usernames. The site states that the perpetrators had access to information on accounts which were subscribed to their newsletter between the 3rd and 17th of June, as well as those created between 2005 and 2007.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<https://www.nbcnews.com/tech/tech-news/reddit-announces-data-breach-threatens-anonymity-users-n896686>).

### 2018-08-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086195159](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%202&oldid=1086195159>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: Saudi Arabian-led intervention in Yemen, Battle of Al Hudaydah.

**Archived source account.** Alleged Saudi-led coalition airstrikes on a fish market and hospital entrance kill at least 20 people in Al Hudaydah, Yemen. A Saudi spokesman denies that its jets were in the area at the time, and blames rebels instead.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-45050927>).

<a id="event-2018-08-02-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Archeologists of the Romano-Germanic Museum report the discovery of the foundations of a Roman library building in Cologne. Dating from the 2nd century CE, it is the oldest library yet discovered in Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [TC Palm](<https://www.tcpalm.com/story/weather/2018/08/02/hurricane-season-enters-busy-period-heat-index-could-hit-101-today/887583002/>).

Context: Crisis in Venezuela (2012-present), Colombia-Venezuela relations.

Protesters also call for Chicago Police Superintendent Eddie T. Johnson and Mayor Rahm Emanuel to step down for their handling of racial incidents in communities of color.

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

Context: Greenhouse gas, Plastic pollution.

**Archived source account.** The United States reimposes sanctions on Iran after the US pulled out of the international agreement three months prior.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-nuclear/u-s-revives-sanctions-to-further-damage-irans-economy-idUSKBN1KR1N3>).

<a id="event-2018-08-06-1-2"></a>

Context: Iran–United States relations, Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action.

**Archived source account.** The European Union announces that its blocking statute against the US sanctions will take effect tomorrow, protecting European companies from US sanctions and encouraging them to keep trading with Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [The Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/08/06/america-dismisses-eu-blocking-statute-iran-sanctions-finally/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-06-1-4"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Brazil, Crisis in Venezuela (2012–present).

**Archived source account.** Brazil closes its international border with Venezuela, following a similar move enacted but then rescinded by Colombia earlier in 2018, as a response to an increase in Venezuelans fleeing their country to neighbouring states.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/06/brazil-shuts-border-venezuelan-migrants>).

<a id="event-2018-08-06-1-6"></a>

Context: Tajikistan–Uzbekistan relations.

**Archived source account.** Commercial flights have resumed between the Tajikistan capital, Dushanbe, and the Uzbekistan city of Bukhara amid improving ties.

Source citations (as archived): [rferl](<https://www.rferl.org/a/flights-between-dushanbe-bukhara-resume-amid-improving-tajik-uzbek-ties/29415799.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-06-2-1"></a>

Context: Caracas drone explosions.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro skips a rally in Caracas following weekend drone blasts that he called an assassination attempt, surprising and confusing some supporters in attendance.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-politics/venezuelas-maduro-rallies-supporters-after-drone-blasts-idUSKBN1KR1SM>).

<a id="event-2018-08-06-2-2"></a>

Context: Caracas drone explosions.

**Archived source account.** The Colombian Civil Aviation Authority announces a ban on drones within a 2 nautical mile radius and altitude of Plaza Bolívar, Bogotá during the Presidential Inauguration of Iván Duque the following afternoon.

Source citations (as archived): [Tele13](<http://www.t13.cl/noticia/mundo/prohiben-drones-acto-posesion-duque-colombia>).

<a id="event-2018-08-06-2-4"></a>

Context: Second Ivorian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The government of Ivory Coast grants amnesty to former First Lady Simone Gbagbo a week after the Supreme Court of Ivory Coast overturned her acquittal for crimes against humanity.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20180806-ivory-coast-announces-amnesty-former-first-lady-simone-gbagbo>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-08-06-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Facebook removes several InfoWars-related pages from its platform, for what it describes as glorification of violence and dehumanizing language. YouTube deletes Alex Jones's main account for repeated Terms of Service violations. Apple and Spotify pull Jones's podcasts. Editor Paul Joseph Watson calls Facebook's move "political censorship" on Twitter.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna897861>).

<a id="event-2018-08-07-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A German couple is jailed for twelve years each for selling the woman's son to a Spanish pedophile on the dark web, who repeatedly abused him. The couple themselves previously abused the boy and a three-year-old girl, whom they are ordered to pay €42,500 in compensation. The Spaniard is sentenced to ten years.

<a id="event-2018-08-07-4-1"></a>

Context: Ohio's 12th congressional district special election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Representative Chris Collins (R–NY) is arrested on charges of securities and wire fraud, conspiracy and lying to investigators. He is accused of passing nonpublic information about Innate Immunotherapeutics, a biotech company, to his son, who traded on the information and passed it along to others. Collins was a director of the company and also a major investor.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/08/08/636666323/new-york-congressman-indicted-on-insider-trading-charges>).

Context: Gaza–Israel conflict.

**Archived source account.** Over 180 rockets and mortars are launched toward Israel by Hamas militants, injuring seven people. In retaliation, IDF launches an air assault on 150 targets in Gaza, in which three people are killed, including an 18-month-old child.
