### 2018-08-12

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086319729](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2012&oldid=1086319729>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-12-0-1"></a>

Context: August 2018 Lombok earthquake.

**Archived source account.** The BNPB spokesperson Sutopo Purwo Nugroho confirmed that the death toll from the earthquake in Lombok rises to 436.

Source citations (as archived): [Tempo.co](<https://en.tempo.co/read/news/2018/08/13/055920764/Lombok-Quake-Death-Toll-Reaches-392-Lives>).

<a id="event-2018-08-12-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A report by the SOHR says that the explosion of an arms depot in Sarmada, Idlib Governorate, Syria, kills at least 69 people, including 17 children. The cause of the blast is "not yet clear". Most of the victims were reportedly family members of Hayat Tahrir al-Sham militants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-toll/death-toll-in-syria-blast-climbs-to-69-observatory-idUSKBN1KY0VT>).

<a id="event-2018-08-12-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 15 people die after a bus falls into a ravine in the western region of Ancash, in Peru.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-08/13/c_137385758.htm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-12-1-1"></a>

Context: Convention on the legal status of the Caspian Sea.

**Archived source account.** After more than 20 years of negotiations, the five countries bordering the Caspian Sea sign an agreement in Aktau, Kazakhstan, on its shared use and the distribution of its resources. The convention legally defines the body of water as a sea rather than a lake, but with special provisions.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/russia-iran-and-other-states-agree-on-caspian-sea-access/a-45051799>).

<a id="event-2018-08-12-1-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Foreign relations of South Africa.

**Archived source account.** South African President Cyril Ramaphosa meets with President Joseph Kabila of DR Congo in Kinshasa, praising him for his "respect for the constitution" by agreeing to step down and not take part in the upcoming December 2018 Congolese general election.

Source citations (as archived): [The South African](<https://www.thesouthafrican.com/ramaphosa-praises-kabilas-respect-for-dr-congo-constitution/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-12-2-1"></a>

Context: Moss Side mass shooting.

**Archived source account.** Ten people are injured in a mass shooting in Manchester, United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-45160462>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-12-3-1"></a>

Context: Unite the Right 2.

**Archived source account.** Around twenty white nationalists hold a protest march in Washington, D.C. on the first anniversary of the Unite the Right rally, with thousands of counter-protesters.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/charlottesville-year-later-washington-1.4782450>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-08-12-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA launches the Parker Solar Probe, an unpiloted spacecraft designed to study the sun.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-45160722>).

### 2018-08-13

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1364059725](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2013&oldid=1364059725>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-08-13-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** More than 100 Afghan soldiers and police, 13 civilians and hundreds of Taliban are killed during the ongoing offensive in Ghazni.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45168890>).

<a id="event-2018-08-13-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban captures Camp Chenaya, an Afghan Army base in Ghormach District, Faryab Province.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/taliban-capture-afghan-army-base-after-intense-fighting/4527662.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-13-0-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 40 people are killed by paramilitary forces in eastern Ethiopia, in the latest spate of violence driven by ethnic divisions.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/at-least-40-killed-by-paramilitaries-in-eastern-ethiopia/4526733.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-08-13-1-1"></a>

Context: Turkish currency and debt crisis.

**Archived source account.** Asian stock prices sink as Turkey’s financial turmoil fuels fears contagion might spread to other emerging markets.

Source citations (as archived): [Market Watch](<https://www.marketwatch.com/story/turkish-currency-crisis-drags-down-asian-stock-markets-2018-08-12>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-13-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Laos dam collapse.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from a dam collapse in Laos on 23 July rises to 36, while 98 people are still missing.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Standard](<https://wap.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/death-toll-reaches-36-in-laos-dam-collapse-98-missing-118081300164_1.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-13-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Authorities in India confirm that 774 people have been killed so far during monsoon rains.

Source citations (as archived): [Financial Express](<https://www.financialexpress.com/india-news/monsoon-in-india-staggering-774-people-died-due-to-heavy-rains-floods-in-these-states/1278828/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-13-2-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nine people are killed and 16 others injured after a fire breaks out in a ward on the seventh floor of a hospital in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45166240>).

<a id="event-2018-08-13-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** More than 300 people are injured, five seriously, after a section of wooden jetty collapsed at an urban sports and music festival in Vigo, Spain.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45165660>).

<a id="event-2018-08-13-2-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Twelve fans of Ecuadorian football team Barcelona S.C. are killed and 30 others are injured after the bus they were traveling on overturns in Azuay, Ecuador.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://spanish.xinhuanet.com/2018-08/13/c_137386716.htm>).

<a id="event-2018-08-13-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Three Russian climbers and two Tajik pilots die while 12 other people are injured in a helicopter crash in Tajikistan.

Source citations (as archived): [Tampa Bay Times](<https://www.tampabay.com/-die-in-helicopter-crash-in-tajikistans-pamir-mountains-ap_worldeb7d9400a9c843faab98c3e09995a939>).

<a id="event-2018-08-13-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** 41 people are injured when a coach overturns in Kent, England, United Kingdom.

Source citations (as archived): [Kent Live](<https://www.kentlive.news/news/kent-news/live-m25-traffic-updates-crash-1892999>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-13-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** North Korea and South Korea officials begin high-level negotiations, with reports suggesting that Kim Jong-un and Moon Jae-in could be planning for a summit in Pyongyang later this month.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-southkorea-talks/north-south-korea-begin-talks-before-possible-pyongyang-summit-idUSKBN1KY00U>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-13-4-1"></a>

Context: Mueller special counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** The lawyer of Peter Strzok, a former agent of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) who was removed from Robert Mueller's Special Counsel investigation, announces that his client has been fired by the FBI.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/us/fbi-agent-peter-strzok-fired-over-anti-trump-texts/ar-BBLSuUI>).

### 2018-08-14

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1367362149](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2014&oldid=1367362149>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-08-14-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Norma Azucena Rodríguez Zamora, a recently elected member of the Congress of Mexico, is kidnapped by gunmen in the state of Hidalgo.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45195184>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-14-1-1"></a>

Context: Ponte Morandi collapse.

**Archived source account.** The Ponte Morandi viaduct collapses on the A10 motorway in Genoa, Italy. 38 people are confirmed dead, 16 others are seriously injured, 5 are missing and 632 displaced. 35 cars and three heavy vehicles are involved in the accident. Several homes are also damaged and people inside them also injured.

Source citations (as archived): [TGCom](<http://www.tgcom24.mediaset.it/cronaca/liguria/lutto-a-genova-per-il-crollo-del-ponte-almeno-35-le-vittime-3-sono-bambini_3158009-201802a.shtml>).

<a id="event-2018-08-14-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** A road accident in Quito, Ecuador involving a bus and a truck leaves 24 people dead and 18 others injured.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN en Español](<https://cnnespanol.cnn.com/2018/08/14/accidente-de-transito-en-ecuador-deja-decenas-de-muertos-y-varios-heridos/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-14-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten people are killed and another injured in a fire at a care home in Chiguayante, Chile.

Source citations (as archived): [24 Horas](<http://www.24horas.cl/nacional/incendio-en-hogar-de-ancianos-de-chiguayante-deja-10-mujeres-fallecidas-2790765>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-14-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Following a period of quiet, Israel reopens the Kerem Shalom crossing into Gaza.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-45185306>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-14-3-1"></a>

Context: Grand jury investigation of Catholic Church sexual abuse in Pennsylvania.

**Archived source account.** A grand jury report alleging that more than 300 priests abused over 1,000 children in six Pennsylvania Catholic diocese -- Allentown, Scranton, Harrisburg, Pittsburgh, Greensburg, and Erie -- is released by state Attorney General Josh Shapiro.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/acts-of-faith/wp/2018/08/14/pennsylvania-grand-jury-report-on-sex-abuse-in-catholic-church-will-list-hundreds-of-accused-predator-priests/?noredirect=on>); [Times Leader](<https://www.timesleader.com/news/714975/pa-clergy-sex-abuse-report-releasedhttps://www.timesleader.com/news/714975/pa-clergy-sex-abuse-report-released>).

<a id="event-2018-08-14-3-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Westminster car crash.

**Archived source account.** A man is arrested near the Palace of Westminster in London after a Ford Fiesta hit pedestrians, cyclists and a security barrier.

Source citations (as archived): [The Daily Telegraph](<https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2018/08/14/car-crashes-barrier-outside-parliament-armed-police-surround/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-14-3-5"></a>

Context: Stand-your-ground law in Florida.

**Archived source account.** Michael Drejka is charged with manslaughter by a state attorney after a reversal of an earlier decision made by police. The case stems from a controversial video that shows Drejka shooting another man over a handicapped parking space and claiming self defense.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/nbcblk/michael-drejka-charged-florida-stand-your-ground-killing-why-wasn-n900406>).

<a id="event-2018-08-14-3-7"></a>

Context: Capital punishment in Nebraska.

**Archived source account.** Nebraska executes convicted murderer Carey Dean Moore, becoming the first U.S. state to execute an inmate with fentanyl, and what is also the state's first execution in 21 years, and its first by lethal injection.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-45185687>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-14-4-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Spain, Portugal, France, Germany and Luxembourg agree to take in 141 migrants, 67 of them unaccompanied children, who were rescued on Friday by the MV Aquarius; Malta allows the ship to dock.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/14/aquarius-migrant-rescue-ship-to-be-allowed-dock-in-malta>).

<a id="event-2018-08-14-4-3"></a>

Context: Kansas gubernatorial election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Incumbent Governor of Kansas Jeff Colyer concedes defeat to Republican challenger Kris Kobach in the primary election.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/08/14/politics/kris-kobach-wins-kansas-republican-governor-primary/index.html>).

### 2018-08-15

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 855813124](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2015&oldid=855813124>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-08-15-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** At least 48 people, mostly students, are killed and a further 67 are injured in a suicide bomb attack at an education centre in Kabul. The Taliban denies any involvement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45199904>).

<a id="event-2018-08-15-0-2"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** The Taliban attacks two units of Afghan security forces in the Baghlan-e-Markazi district of Baghlan Province, killing at least 39 soldiers and police officers.

Source citations (as archived): [SFGate](<https://www.sfgate.com/world/article/At-least-87-killed-in-latest-violence-in-13158923.php>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-08-15-1-1"></a>

Context: Me Too movement § China.

**Archived source account.** Following accusations by fellow monks of sexual misconduct and embezzling funds—accusations which were subsequently posted on social media—the Buddhist Association of China announces Shi Xuecheng's resignation from the office of president of that organization. Xuecheng had dismissed the records as a fabrication.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/15/senior-chinese-monk-shi-xuecheng-resigns-sexual-misconduct-claims>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-08-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Automotive industry in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** The government of South Korea announces that it will ban 20,000 BMW vehicles following engine fires.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45191874>).

<a id="event-2018-08-15-2-3"></a>

Context: Economy of New Zealand.

**Archived source account.** New Zealand's parliament votes to ban the sale of homes to non-resident foreign nationals amid a housing affordability crisis. Australians and Singaporeans are exempt due to free-trade deals.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-45199034>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-15-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Officials lift all mandatory evacuation orders for the deadly Carr Fire in Northern California that destroyed nearly 1,100 homes and killed eight people.

Source citations (as archived): [KHQ](<http://www.khq.com/story/38894087/all-mandatory-evacuations-lifted-for-carr-fire-in-california>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Technology/wireStory/latest-evacuations-lifted-california-blaze-57205654>).

<a id="event-2018-08-15-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** 22 children and a woman drown after their boat sinks in the Nile in Sudan while travelling to school.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Standard](<https://wap.business-standard.com/article/pti-stories/22-children-dead-in-nile-boat-accident-sudan-media-118081501158_1.htm>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-15-4-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of South Korea.

**Archived source account.** South Korean President Moon Jae-in announces plans to create a Northeast Asian railroad community with North Korea, the United States, China, Japan, Russia, and Mongolia.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/08/15/south-korea-proposes-asian-railway-community-with-pyongyang.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-15-5-1"></a>

Context: Transgender rights in Germany.

**Archived source account.** The Cabinet of Germany approves a third gender option for official identification records. The change will come into force by the end of the year.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/german-cabinet-approves-third-gender-identity/a-45090243>).

<a id="event-2018-08-15-5-3"></a>

Context: Caracas drone explosions.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan authorities arrest a military general, a colonel, and a dozen others in connection to a failed assassination attempt on President Nicolás Maduro.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/08/15/2-high-ranking-military-officers-among-14-arrested-in-Maduro-plot/9811534343947/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-15-5-5"></a>

Context: Iraqi Civil War (2014–2017).

**Archived source account.** Omar Ameen, an ISIL member who lived in California as a refugee, is arrested in Sacramento for a 2014 murder in Rawa, Iraq.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/08/15/world/middleeast/sacramento-al-qaeda-isis-arrest.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-15-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** President Donald Trump revokes the security clearance of former Central Intelligence Agency director John Brennan, and the White House announces clearance reviews for other current and former national security officials.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/trump-makes-good-threat-revoke-brennans-clearance-57199822>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-08-15-7-1"></a>

Context: Indian Space Research Organisation.

**Archived source account.** Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi says India will launch its first manned space mission by 2022, which would make it the fourth nation to do so after Russia, the United States, and China.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-independenceday/india-to-launch-first-manned-space-mission-by-2022-idUSKBN1L009E>).

<a id="event-2018-08-15-7-3"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Scientists observe the signal of iron and titanium atoms in the atmosphere of KELT-9b, an exoplanet located 600 light-years from Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [Gizmodo](<https://gizmodo.com/astronomers-directly-detect-iron-and-titanium-on-an-exo-1828356086>).

### 2018-08-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256042882](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2016&oldid=1256042882>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-08-16-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Washington Veterans Day Parade.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of Defense postpones President Donald Trump's military parade, which was slated to take place on 10 November, until 2019. The estimates for the parade's cost have risen from $12 million to $92 million.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/trumps-military-parade-estimated-cost-92-million/story?id=57218363>); [Market Watch](<https://www.marketwatch.com/story/pentagon-delays-trumps-big-military-parade-until-at-least-2019-2018-08-16>).

<a id="event-2018-08-16-0-3"></a>

Context: Freedom of the press in the United States.

**Archived source account.** In coordinated editorials defending press freedom, hundreds of U.S. newspapers rebuke President Donald Trump's repeated accusations that the news media reports "fake news" and that journalists are "enemies of the people".

Source citations (as archived): [RTÉ News](<https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2018/0816/985420-trump/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-16-0-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** American soul singer and songwriter Aretha Franklin dies at the age of 76.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/08/16/entertainment/aretha-franklin-dead/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-08-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Constellation Brands, the owner of Corona Beer, announces plans to invest in Canadian marijuana producer Canopy Growth.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45204186>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-16-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Analysis shows that a rare fire tornado that barreled into the city of Redding on July 26 during the Carr Fire was responsible for the death of a firefighter as he raced towards a neighborhood in flames.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/local/lanow/la-me-ln-fire-tornado-redding-20180816-story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-16-2-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Kerala floods.

**Archived source account.** Authorities in India say that 350 people are confirmed dead in the heavy floods in Kerala.

Source citations (as archived): [Times of India](<https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/kochi/kerala-floods-live-updates-more-ndrf-teams-rushed-to-kerala-as-flood-situation-worsens/liveblog/65403405.cms>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-16-3-1"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** The Mexican government announces that they are offering up to MXN$30 million (equivalent to US$1.56 million) for anyone who provides information that leads to the arrest of Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes (alias "El Mencho"), the suspected leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and one of Mexico's most-wanted.

Source citations (as archived): [El Universal](<http://www.eluniversal.com.mx/nacion/seguridad/el-mencho-el-capo-por-el-que-mexico-ofrece-15-mdd-de-recompensa>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-16-4-1"></a>

Context: Elections in Canada, Premiership of Justin Trudeau.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau dismisses speculation that he would call an early election this fall and states that his government remains focused on renegotiating NAFTA and strengthening the economy.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-canada-politics/canadas-trudeau-rules-out-early-election-this-fall-idUSKBN1L123I>).

<a id="event-2018-08-16-4-3"></a>

Context: Dog meat consumption in South Korea.

**Archived source account.** Animal rights groups hold protests against dog meat consumption in Seoul.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/08/17/Animal-rights-groups-protest-dog-meat-consumption-in-Seoul/4561534470906/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-16-4-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Amid controversy, the Trump Administration of the United States revokes the security clearance of former CIA chief John Brennan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45203277>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-08-16-5-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Major League Baseball season.

**Archived source account.** The Texas Rangers pull off a triple play against the Los Angeles Angels without retiring the batter, the first such triple play in MLB since 1912.

Source citations (as archived): [HuffPost](<https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/texas-rangers-pull-a-rare-triple-play-not-seen-in-106-years_us_5b76cd4fe4b05906b412e9dd>).

### 2018-08-17

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1133947204](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2017&oldid=1133947204>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-08-17-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Gaza border protests.

**Archived source account.** Around 20,000 Palestinians protest near the Israel–Gaza barrier. Medical sources say that Israel Defense Forces killed two people and wounded at least 270 others, 50 of them with live bullets.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-israel-palestinians-violence/israeli-troops-kill-two-palestinians-in-gaza-border-protests-medics-idUSKBN1L21WR>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-17-1-1"></a>

Context: XiamenAir Flight 8667.

**Archived source account.** A Boeing 737 skids off a runway at Ninoy Aquino International Airport, Philippines, while landing in a downpour. All aboard are unharmed but the aircraft is severely damaged with one engine and some of the landing gear being ripped away.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/world/2018/08/16/chinese-plane-skids-off-manila-runway-in-downpour-all-safe.amp.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-21-3-4"></a>

He is released on $500,000 bail until his sentencing on December 12. He faces up to 65 years, though prosecutors recommend 46 to 63 months.

Context: 2018 Pacific hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Lane strengthens to a Category 5 hurricane for around three hours as it heads toward Hawaii, before returning to Category 4.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.abc15.com/news/national/hurricane-lane-is-the-dangerous-category-5-storm-thats-headed-toward-hawaii>).

<a id="event-2018-08-22-1-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Venezuela earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** A 5.8 magnitude earthquake hits close to yesterday's 7.3 earthquake, this one inland near Yaguaraparo, Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.miamiherald.com/news/business/article217120635.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-22-1-4"></a>

Context: 2018 Venezuela earthquakes.

**Archived source account.** It is revealed that 5 people died from heart attack due to shock in yesterday's earthquake.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.miamiherald.com/news/business/article217120635.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-22-1-6"></a>

Context: Earthquakes in 2018.

**Archived source account.** A 6.2 earthquake, 100 miles from the Oregon coast, rocks the Western States of America.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/oregon-eathquake-today-tsunami-latest-offshore-coast-portland-magnitude-richter-a8502876.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-22-2-2"></a>

Context: Personal and business legal affairs of Donald Trump / List of lawsuits involving Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** The lawyer of Michael Cohen, ex-lawyer of U.S. President Donald Trump who pleaded guilty to eight felonies a day prior, says his client would refuse to accept a presidential pardon.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/americas/michael-cohen-donald-trump-pardon-trial-guilty-russia-investigation-a8502451.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-22-2-4"></a>

Context: Personal and business legal affairs of Donald Trump / Donald J. Trump Foundation § Investigations by New York State.

**Archived source account.** New York state investigators subpoena Michael Cohen as part of their investigation into the Trump Foundation.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.startribune.com/new-york-state-subpoenas-cohen-in-trump-foundation-probe/491476621/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-22-2-6"></a>

Context: Terrorism in Germany.

**Archived source account.** In Berlin, police raid an apartment and arrest a suspected Russian Islamic extremist who had allegedly stored a large amount of TATP in October 2016 and plotted with a Frenchman to bomb an unspecified public place in Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2018-08-22/germany-detains-russian-man-suspected-of-planning-islamist-attack>).

<a id="event-2018-08-22-2-8"></a>

Context: Human rights in Saudi Arabia.

**Archived source account.** According to human rights campaigners, Saudi Arabian prosecutors seek the death penalty for six activists for inciting anti-government protests and morally supporting rioters.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/saudi-arabia-seeks-unprecedented-death-penalty-woman-activist-n902771>).

<a id="event-2018-08-22-2-10"></a>

Context: Killing of Mollie Tibbetts.

**Archived source account.** Cristhian Bahena Rivera, a Mexican man accused of killing University of Iowa student Mollie Tibbetts after entering the U.S. illegally, appears in a Poweshiek County court for arraignment on first-degree murder. His bail is set at US$5 million. If released by local police, he may be arrested by ICE.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/08/22/us/mollie-tibbetts-iowa-student-autopsy/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-22-2-12"></a>

Context: Corruption in Venezuela, Crisis in Bolivarian Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** The Venezuelan National Assembly supports and enforces a ruling made by exiled members of the Venezuelan Supreme Court, sentencing Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro to 18 years and 3 months in prison for a litany of charges largely related to corruption. The Maduro government calls the court "illegitimate".

Source citations (as archived): [El Telégrafo](<https://www.eltelegrafo.com.ec/noticias/mundo/8/parlamento-venezuela-sentencia-tribunal-exilio-nicolas-maduro>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-22-3-1"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro says that the wages for workers in Venezuela must be linked to the petro.

Source citations (as archived): [El Nacional](<http://www.el-nacional.com/noticias/politica/maduro-colombia-medico-lujo_249298>); [El Universal](<http://www.eluniversal.com/politica/18536/nicolas-maduro-propuso-a-anc-establecer-tablas-salariales-en-petros>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-08-22-4-1"></a>

Context: Interbreeding between archaic and modern humans.

**Archived source account.** A bone fragment found in Denisova Cave, Denisova 11, is identified as that of a girl who died 50,000 years ago aged at least 13. Genome-wide signatures tell that she had a Neanderthal mother and a mostly-Denisovan father. This first find of a prehistoric first-generation mixed offspring shows that different archaic human subtypes sometimes migrated, and then mixed more frequently than previously thought.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/science/science-news/dna-tells-story-neanderthal-mom-denisovan-dad-n902961>); [Live Science](<https://www.livescience.com/63400-neanderthals-denisovans-mated-leg-bone.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-22-4-3"></a>

Context: 2018 in spaceflight, Living Planet Programme.

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency's ADM-Aeolus global wind mapping satellite is successfully launched via a Vega rocket from Guiana Space Centre.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-45100090>).

### 2018-08-23

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086523149](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2023&oldid=1086523149>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-08-23-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 China–United States trade war.

**Archived source account.** American tariffs of 25% on approximately $16 billion worth of Chinese goods come into effect. China immediately responds with equivalent tariffs of its own.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china/u-s-china-impose-further-tariffs-escalating-trade-war-idUSKCN1L809K>).

<a id="event-2018-08-23-0-3"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** The government of the United Kingdom publishes the first 25 of 80 planned "technical notices" providing practical guidance to businesses in case of a no-deal Brexit.

Source citations (as archived): [Fortune](<http://fortune.com/2018/08/23/uk-business-guidance-no-deal-brexit/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-23-0-4"></a>

Context: Brexit.

**Archived source account.** Austrian Chancellor Sebastian Kurz, whose country holds the rotating European Union presidency, expresses interest in avoiding a hard Brexit.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-austria/austrias-kurz-wants-to-help-eus-barnier-avoid-a-hard-brexit-idUSKCN1L829F>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-23-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Pacific hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Lane causes flash flooding, and threatens a direct hit towards Hawaii as it passes through Oahu. Over \{\{convert\|19\|inch\|cm\|sigfig=2\}\} of rain has already fallen in some areas.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/08/23/us/hurricane-lane-hawaii-wxc/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-23-2-1"></a>

Context: South Africa–United States relations, South African farm attacks, Fox News controversies.

**Archived source account.** The government of South Africa rejects a tweet by U.S. President Donald Trump as "based on false information", in which he appeared to respond to a Fox News report stating that the South African government is "now seizing land from white farmers." \{\{Contradict-inline\|date=August 2018\}\}

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/08/23/africa/trump-south-africa-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-23-2-4"></a>

Context: Crisis in Bolivarian Venezuela / Ecuador–Venezuela relations, Bolivarian Alliance.

**Archived source account.** Ecuador leaves the Bolivarian alliance of nations run in Latin America, citing the behaviour of the Venezuelan government in several areas including attempting to impose Chavism in America, creating major crises, and ineffectual control of migration.,

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/ecuador-leaves-venezuelan-run-regional-alliance-57371446>); [El Comercio](<https://www.elcomercio.com/actualidad/ecuador-fueraalba-crisismigracion-venezuela-hugochavez.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-23-2-6"></a>

Context: Crisis in Bolivarian Venezuela / Colombia-Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** In response to the Venezuelan Bolivarian National Guard's armed infiltration of Norte de Santander, Colombia four days ago, Venezuela releases a statement calling it "supposed" and "fake news", despite clear video of Venezuelan helicopters in Colombian territory.

Source citations (as archived): [NTN24](<http://www.ntn24.com/america-latina/el-informativo-ntn24/colombia/revelan-video-del-momento-de-incursion-venezolana-en>).

<a id="event-2018-08-23-2-8"></a>

Context: Crisis in Bolivarian Venezuela / Bolivarian diaspora, Venezuela–Colombia migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Colombia announces that it will host a summit in Bogotá with migration officials from Peru and Ecuador in an attempt to seek a solution for the growing illegal immigration of Venezuelans through their nations.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-venezuela-migration-summit/colombia-to-host-meeting-with-ecuador-peru-on-venezuelan-migrant-issue-idUSKCN1L82H3>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-23-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** Authorities arrest 32-year old John Colin Eagle Skoda after investigators concluded that a debris fire he started turned into a 60-square-mile blaze that killed one person and destroyed 35 homes.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/northern-california-man-arrested-deadly-wildfire-57369418>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-23-4-1"></a>

Context: Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Australian MP Peter Dutton claims that Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull has lost the support of the majority of the Liberal Party and calls for another leadership vote. Turnbull states that he will resign if another spill is called.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-08-23/live-peter-dutton-poised-to-challenge-malcolm-turnbull-again/10155008?section=politics>); [The Sydney Morning Herald](<https://www.smh.com.au/politics/federal/liberal-leadership-crisis-dutton-forces-intensify-push-for-second-challenge-20180823-p4zz66.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-australia-politics-turnbull/australia-pm-unlikely-to-contest-another-leadership-vote-sky-news-idUSKCN1L802C>).

### 2018-08-24

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086524574](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2024&oldid=1086524574>).

#### Art and culture

<a id="event-2018-08-24-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Spanish government passes a decree which amends the Historical Memory Law to allow the government to exhume Francisco Franco's remains from the Valle de los Caídos.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/general-franco-valley-fallen-spain-body-exhumed-fascist-dictator-a8506541.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-08-24-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two weeks after Elon Musk expressed his intentions of making Tesla, Inc. private, he and the company's board announce that the company will remain publicly listed.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/08/25/641803323/tesla-to-remain-public-elon-musk-says>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-24-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus plunges off a bridge onto a train track due to a malfunction near Kuopio, Finland, killing four people and injuring 20 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Yle News](<https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/four_die_in_bus_accident_in_eastern_finland/10369857>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-24-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 North Korea crisis, North Korea–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump asks his Secretary of State Mike Pompeo to cancel a planned trip to North Korea, citing the country's insufficient progress in denuclearizing the Korean peninsula. "

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/08/24/trump-cancels-pompeo-trip-to-north-korea-cites-lack-of-sufficient-progress-on-denuclearization.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-24-3-3"></a>

Context: Palestine–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States Department of State redirects more than $200 million in aid for the Palestinian National Authority to "high priority projects elsewhere". The Palestine Liberation Organization denounces the "use of cheap blackmail as a political tool".

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/politics/2018/08/24/us-cuts-aid-to-palestinians-by-more-than-200-million.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-24-4-1"></a>

Context: Liberal Party of Australia leadership spills, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull loses spill motion and resigns.

Source citations (as archived): [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/video/malcolm-turnbull-resigns-as-australian-prime-minister-11480575>).

<a id="event-2018-08-24-4-2"></a>

Context: Liberal Party of Australia leadership spills, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Treasurer Scott Morrison wins the second leadership spill, 45 votes to 40 against Peter Dutton, and becomes Prime Minister.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC](<http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-08-24/live-turnbull-leadership-challenge-looms/10159462>).

<a id="event-2018-08-24-4-4"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Representatives from 12 European Union countries do not reach an agreement on Italy's request to take in the 150 migrants still remaining on the Diciotti-class vessel in Catania, Sicily, after their rescue by the Italian Coast Guard nine days ago.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/italy-clashes-with-eu-over-diciotti-migrant-boat/a-45215364>); [ANSA](<http://www.ansa.it/english/news/politics/2018/08/24/consequences-from-eu-migrant-decisions_5dcdb573-d40f-4f36-8e7a-3804a028389e.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-24-4-6"></a>

Context: Democratic Republic of the Congo general election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** The electoral commission publishes the list of approved candidates. Jean-Pierre Bemba and two former prime ministers are excluded.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<http://uk.businessinsider.com/r-congo-rejects-presidential-bid-of-opposition-leader-bemba-2018-8>).

<a id="event-2018-08-24-4-8"></a>

Context: Corruption in Venezuela, United States–Venezuela relations.

**Archived source account.** A United States court case gains new evidence and a guilty plea in relation to investigations of corruption and money laundering in Venezuela, adding a group who are suspected to be relatives of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro to the list of suspected accomplices.

Source citations (as archived): [Business Insider](<http://uk.businessinsider.com/ap-maduros-stepsons-face-scrutiny-in-12-billion-graft-case-2018-8>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/sources-us-prosecutors-relatives-venezuelas-maduro-benefited-12-57384718>).

<a id="event-2018-08-24-4-9"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator John McCain (R–AZ) has announced that he will not continue his cancer treatment.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2018/08/24/politics/john-mccain-cancer-treatment/index.html>).

### 2018-08-25

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086524750](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2025&oldid=1086524750>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-08-25-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 1962 Ferrari 250 GTO is sold for $48.4 million at an auction in California, making it the most expensive car ever sold through auction.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-26/rare-ferrari-250-gto-sells-for-record-48-4-million-at-auction>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-25-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Harbin hotel fire.

**Archived source account.** A hotel fire in Harbin, China, kills 19 people and injures 23 others. The fire broke out at the four-story Beilong Hot Spring Hotel in Harbin's Sun Island recreation area.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-08/25/c_137418591.htm>).

<a id="event-2018-08-25-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The collapse of three buildings in Mashhad, Iran, kills ten people and injures nine others.

Source citations (as archived): [Mehr News Agency](<https://en.mehrnews.com/news/137080/Water-heater-explosion-ruins-3-buildings-kills-10-in-NE-Iran>).

<a id="event-2018-08-25-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus falls into the Iskar Gorge near Svoge, Bulgaria, leaving 17 people dead and 17 injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BGNES](<http://www.bgnes.com/bylgariia/intsidenti/4605066/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-25-2-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Thirteen sick people are taken off the stranded Diciotti vessel in Catania, Italy. Albania offers to take in 20 migrants.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-europe-migrants-italy/doctors-order-16-migrants-off-stranded-italian-boat-as-salvini-defies-u-n-idUSKCN1LA0IF>).

<a id="event-2018-08-25-2-2"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Italian Minister of the Interior Matteo Salvini is placed under investigation for possible illegal detention and kidnapping. He subsequently gives permission for the remaining 134 migrants to disembark. Ireland will take 25 migrants, Albania 20. The Italian church says it will take in the others.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/25/matteo-salvini-formally-investigated-over-migrant-ship-standoff>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-25-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. Senator and 2008 presidential nominee John McCain (R–AZ) dies at the age of 81.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/08/25/obituaries/john-mccain-dead.html>).

#### Sport

<a id="event-2018-08-25-4-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Challenge Cup.

**Archived source account.** In the Rugby League, the Catalans Dragons beat the Warrington Wolves in the 2018 Challenge Cup Final. It is the first time a team that is not from Northern England has won the competition.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/rugby-league/45310995>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

**Archived source account.** Afghan authorities say that, in a joint ground and air operation on Saturday night, Afghan and foreign forces killed the head of ISIL/K, along with ten other members of the militant group.

Context: Pope Francis's visit to Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis holds Sunday Mass at Phoenix Park in Dublin, Ireland, for the World Meeting of Families.

<a id="event-2018-08-26-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Kerala floods.

**Archived source account.** The death toll from the Kerala floods rise to 445, while 15 remain missing.

<a id="event-2018-08-26-2-2"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/iran-earthquake-injures-hundreds-fatalities-reported/a-45230105>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-26-3-1"></a>

Context: Jacksonville Landing shooting.

**Archived source account.** The sheriff's office reports a mass shooting at a Madden 19 tournament at the Jacksonville Landing shopping mall in Jacksonville, Florida. Two attendees are killed, and nine others are taken to nearby hospitals. The suspected shooter is reported dead at the scene.

<a id="event-2018-08-26-4-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Zimbabwean general election.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-27-0-1"></a>

Context: United States free-trade agreements, Mexico–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** The United States and Mexico reach common ground on key trade terms in the North American Free Trade Agreement. Canada has yet to sign off on the agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45323634>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-trade-nafta/u-s-mexico-reach-nafta-deal-pressure-turns-to-canada-idUSKCN1LC1E7>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A United Nations Human Rights Council report based on 875 interviews recommends Min Aung Hlaing and five other generals in Myanmar be investigated and prosecuted for genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes since the 1960s.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/amp/Top_News/World-News/2018/08/27/UN-report-calls-for-Myanmar-military-leaders-to-face-genocide-charges/7301535364181/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-27-1-2"></a>

Context: Aftermath of the Sri Lankan Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Forensic anthropologists from the University of Kelaniya, Sri Lanka, report that more than 90 sets of human remains have been discovered near the town of Mannar. The mass grave is situated in an area that saw heavy fighting during the country's civil war.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45296871>).

<a id="event-2018-08-27-1-4"></a>

Context: 2018 Chemnitz protests.

**Archived source account.** Violent protests break out across Germany after a stabbing attack the day before. Several instances of racial violence are reported, and riot police have been attacked.

Source citations (as archived): [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/violence-in-chemnitz-as-leftist-and-far-right-protesters-clash/a-45250620>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-27-2-1"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Home Secretary Sajid Javid comes under criticism for describing Leader of the Opposition Jeremy Corbyn on Twitter as "one of the biggest threat's\{\{sic\}\} to our national security".

Source citations (as archived): [Talk Radio UK](<http://talkradio.co.uk/news/sajid-javid-calls-jeremy-corbyn-threat-national-security-18082727647>).

### 2018-08-28

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 977612730](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2028&oldid=977612730>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-08-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** A suspected improvised explosive device planted by the Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters explodes at a town festival in Isulan, Sultan Kudarat, Philippines, killing two people and injuring 35 others.

Source citations (as archived): [Rappler](<https://www.rappler.com/nation/210614-sultan-kudarat-explosion-august-28-2018>).

<a id="event-2018-08-28-0-2"></a>

Context: Moro conflict.

**Archived source account.** A Catholic priest held hostage for almost four months by Muslim militants in Marawi city in the southern Philippines says he still believes in inter-religious dialogue despite experiencing horrors that included seeing a fellow captive gunned down in crossfire and another one killed during an airstrike.

Source citations (as archived): [BenarNews](<https://www.benarnews.org/english/news/philippine/Priest-Marawi-08292018151129.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-08-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The European Space Agency (ESA) unveils two titanium plaques etched with artwork, which will be part of the outside of the CHEOPS exoplanet-characterization satellite during its orbit around Earth.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2018-08-artwork-unveiled-exoplanet-satellite.amp>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-08-28-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Irish paper production and packaging firm Smurfit Kappa release a statement explaining that one of its production facilities was seized a week earlier on August 21 by the Venezuelan government and its managers were arrested, with the company accused of not setting their prices at government-approved levels and smuggling. It says that the government have taken over operation of the plant.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-45343310>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-28-3-1"></a>

Context: Hurricane Maria death toll controversy.

**Archived source account.** A study from the Milken Institute School of Public Health finds that a total of 2,975 people died in Puerto Rico due to Hurricane Maria, bringing the official death toll up from 64.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/death-toll-hurricane-maria-3000-puerto-rico-study/story?id=57179291>).

<a id="event-2018-08-28-3-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven states in Venezuela are affected as the Orinoco River floods.

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanoticias.com/a/venezuela-inundaciones-ayuda-reporta-alvaro-algarra-/4547865.html>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2018-08-28-4-1"></a>

Context: Water supply and sanitation in Iraq.

**Archived source account.** Health officials state that the Iraqi city of Basra has recorded 17,000 infection cases due to water contamination. A cholera outbreak is feared as salinity rates continue to increase in the unprocessed water.

Source citations (as archived): [Iraqi News](<https://amp.iraqinews.com/features/iraqs-basra-declares-17000-infection-cases-from-water-pollution/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-28-4-3"></a>

Context: Phase-out of lightweight plastic bags.

**Archived source account.** Anchorage, Alaska, passes a strict ban on plastic shopping bags, and imposes a fee on the use of store-issued paper bags. The law goes into effect on March 1, 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [Anchorage Daily News](<https://www.adn.com/alaska-news/anchorage/2018/08/28/anchorage-approves-strict-plastic-bag-ban-fees-for-paper-bags/?outputType=amp-type>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-28-5-1"></a>

Context: Bolivarian diaspora.

**Archived source account.** The Brazilian government sends armed forces to be stationed along its Venezuelan border for two weeks, due to a large increase in migrants from Venezuela.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-45338769>).

<a id="event-2018-08-28-5-2"></a>

Context: Bolivarian diaspora.

**Archived source account.** Peru declares a 60-day public health crisis in its northern provinces, with concern of the Venezuelan migrants spreading diseases.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-45338769>); [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-30/venezuela-s-neighbors-join-to-contain-crushing-flow-of-refugees>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-28-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former Texas police officer Roy Oliver is found guilty in the murder of 15-year old Mesquite High School freshman Jordan Edwards.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://na01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.nbcnews.com%2Fnews%2Fus-news%2Fex-texas-police-officer-roy-oliver-found-guilty-murder-shooting-n904166&amp;amp;data=02%7C01%7CMark.Marji%40uky.edu%7Cbdc6b811c47448cbdd3708d60db7a516%7C2b30530b69b64457b818481cb53d42ae%7C0%7C0%7C636711479732626845&amp;amp;sdata=hJtaWXIkqvyk6Gt6BsQn4Eg7YQmf85rYgMvllp0AbwU%3D&amp;amp;reserved=0>); [Star Local Media](<https://na01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fstarlocalmedia.com%2Fmesquitenews%2Fnews%2Fex-balch-springs-officer-found-guilty-of-murdering-mesquite-teen%2Farticle_ac4a6cf6-aa48-11e8-81b6-f7ba92685574.html&amp;amp;data=02%7C01%7CMark.Marji%40uky.edu%7Cbdc6b811c47448cbdd3708d60db7a516%7C2b30530b69b64457b818481cb53d42ae%7C0%7C0%7C636711479732626845&amp;amp;sdata=uOKZbxInbFvUaNcSNN4BtlVrdvTZPSazPpXv74Wzje8%3D&amp;amp;reserved=0>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-28-7-1"></a>

Context: Politics of France.

**Archived source account.** Nicolas Hulot resigns as Minister of Ecology during a live interview on France Inter radio, citing French President Emmanuel Macron's record on environmental issues and his own frustration over feeling alone in prioritizing reform.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/nicolas-hulot-quits-france-emmanuel-macron-environment-resigns-green-a8510606.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-28-7-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Iran.

**Archived source account.** The Parliament of Iran questions President Hassan Rouhani on weak economic growth, banking restrictions and rising prices. It is not satisfied by four of his five answers and refers the case to the judiciary. He chiefly blames the United States' sanctions, and vows the "plot" will not succeed.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-economy-rouhani-sanctions/irans-parliament-blames-rouhani-for-economic-troubles-refers-him-to-judiciary-idUSKCN1LD0DD>); [(Tehran Times\}](<http://www.tehrantimes.com/news/426937/Rouhani-in-parliament-answers-questions-by-MPs>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-08-28-8-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The world's first autonomous taxi service begins operating in Tokyo, Japan. The pilot project will run until September 8, with full commercial operations expected to start in 2020, when the city hosts the 2020 Summer Olympics.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2018/aug/28/driverless-taxi-debuts-in-tokyo-in-world-first-trial-ahead-of-olympics>); [Reuters](<http://www.reuters.tv/v/Ppkf/2018/08/27/japan-trials-robot-taxi-ahead-of-2020-olympics>).

<a id="event-2018-08-28-8-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** For the first time, scientists observe the Higgs Boson decay into bottom quarks. This supports a prediction in the Standard Model of particle physics.

Source citations (as archived): [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2018-08-long-sought-higgs-boson.html>).

### 2018-08-29

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 858374165](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20August%2029&oldid=858374165>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-08-29-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 7.1 magnitude earthquake hits the Loyalty Islands, New Caledonia.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuff](<https://www.stuff.co.nz/world/106675451/strong-quake-strikes-in-pacific-ocean>).

<a id="event-2018-08-29-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Swar Chaung dam bursts in Yedashe Township, Bago Region, Myanmar, flooding around a hundred villages and forcing roughly 50,000 people to flee their homes. One person is missing and the country's main highway is flooded.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/aug/29/myanmar-dam-breach-people-evacuate-homes-officials-say>).

<a id="event-2018-08-29-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Philippine Navy's Gregorio del Pilar-class frigate BRP Gregorio del Pilar (FF-15) runs aground on the disputed Half Moon Shoal in the South China Sea.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-08-29-1-1"></a>

Context: Germany–Namibia relations.

**Archived source account.** Germany hands over to Namibia the human remains—19 skulls, a scalp and bones—of Herero and Nama tribespeople among the tens of thousands killed by the German Empire between 1904 and 1908.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/08/tears-anger-germany-returns-human-remains-seized-namibia-180829141921679.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-29-1-3"></a>

Context: Bolivarian diaspora.

**Archived source account.** A meeting is held in Lima attended by representatives from Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, and Brazil, to develop requests for aid in regards to Venezuelan immigrants, which will be sent to organisations including the United Nations and International Red Cross. Yesterday, there was a similar meeting in Bogotá. A larger meeting has been set-up to be held in Quito in early September, to be attended by representatives from 14 countries and 10 international organisations.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-08-30/venezuela-s-neighbors-join-to-contain-crushing-flow-of-refugees>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-29-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Air Canada reports a data breach in which passport information was accessed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/technology-45349056>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-08-29-3-1"></a>

Context: Pension Fund of the Russian Federation.

**Archived source account.** Russian President Vladimir Putin announces a softening of the pension plan presented in June. The plan's original announcement has led to protests and a dip in Putin's approval ratings.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.mynews13.com/fl/orlando/ap-top-news/2018/08/29/facing-protests-russias-putin-offers-pension-concessions>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-08-29-4-1"></a>

Context: 2018 NFL season.

**Archived source account.** The Cleveland Browns release linebacker Mychal Kendricks following charges of insider trading.

Source citations (as archived): [Bleacher Report](<https://bleacherreport.com/articles/2793331-mychal-kendricks-released-by-browns-after-insider-trading-charges>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/cleveland-browns-drop-linebacker-mychal-kendricks-after-admits-he-engaged-in-insider-trading/>).

#### Business and economy

Context: Economy of Argentina.

**Archived source account.** Argentina hikes interest rate to 60%, the highest in the world, as its currency plunges.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://money.cnn.com/2018/08/30/news/economy/argentina-interest-rates-currency/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Economy of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Panasonic announces their intent to move their European headquarters from London to Amsterdam, citing concern over Brexit.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45351288>).

<a id="event-2018-08-30-0-4"></a>

Context: Economy of the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Wonga, the largest payday lender in the United Kingdom, collapses into administration.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/business-45359395>).

<a id="event-2018-08-30-0-6"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** The petro, a Venezuelan government-backed cryptocurrency, has not been trading and is not publicly accessible, despite government claims that it has sold $3.3 billion worth of units and the fact that it is linked to the nation's physical currency and wages.

Source citations (as archived): [Le Soir](<http://www.lesoir.be/175854/article/2018-08-30/tarifs-douaniers-trump-juge-que-loffre-de-lunion-europeenne-sur-lautomobile-est>).

<a id="event-2018-08-30-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bus crash in Karoo, South Africa, leaves ten people dead and 30 injured.

<a id="event-2018-08-30-1-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** The National Hurricane Center issues advisories for what forecasters call a Potential Tropical Cyclone Six. If it strengthens to a tropical storm, it would be known as Florence.

Source citations (as archived): [Sun Sentinel](<http://www.sun-sentinel.com/news/weather/hurricane/fl-reg-tropical-weather-aug-28-story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-30-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least eight people are reported dead and many sent to hospitals after a bus crash on a New Mexico highway.

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-08-30-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration is considering sending captured ISIL fighters to a prison in Iraq, as well as sending "high-valued fighters", who participated in the murder of Americans and other Western hostages, to the Guantanamo Bay detention camp. Human rights groups and the Democratic Party are opposed to holding these people indefinitely without charges and say they should be tried in federal courts.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/storyline/isis-terror/trump-admin-may-send-captured-isis-fighters-iraq-prison-guantanamo-n905066>); [NBC San Diego](<https://www.nbcsandiego.com/news/national-international/Trump-Admin-ISIS-Fighters-Iraq-Prison-Guantanamo-492090491.html>).

<a id="event-2018-08-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protesters against Mayor of London Sadiq Khan plan to fly a balloon of him in which he is wearing a yellow bikini over Parliament Square, London on 1 September in the same spot where the Donald Trump baby balloon was flown on 13 July.

<a id="event-2018-08-30-4-0"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Donbass.

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-08-31-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Catholic bishops in Australia reject a recommendation from the Royal Commission into Institutional Responses to Child Sexual Abuse that would force priests by law to report abuse to the police when they hear about it in confession.

<a id="event-2018-08-31-2-0"></a>

<a id="event-2018-08-31-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ahead of an expected U.S. announcement that it will cut all aid to the UNRWA, which supports more than 5 million registered Palestinian refugees, Germany calls on European Union states to help bridge the expected US$217 million deficit. Yesterday, Jordan made a similar appeal to the Arab League.

<a id="event-2018-08-31-3-1"></a>

Context: Crisis in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** The European Union announces an aid package of €35 million ($40.6 million) for Venezuelans, both inside the country and for those displaced in neighbouring countries.

<a id="event-2018-08-31-5-1"></a>

Context: Summer Time in Europe.

**Archived source account.** The European Commission is proposing to end the practice of adjusting clocks by an hour in spring and autumn after a survey found most Europeans opposed it. The Commission proposal requires support from the 28 national governments and MEPs to become law.

<a id="event-2018-08-31-5-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Guatemalan President Jimmy Morales announces that he will not renew the mandate of the International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala (CICIG) and orders the immediate transfer of functions to the Public Ministry and the Ministry of the Interior. The mandate of the UN anti-corruption commission ends on September 3, 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-guatemala-corruption/guatemala-says-wont-renew-mandate-of-u-n-anti-corruption-body-idUKKCN1LG2KJ?il=0>).

<a id="event-2018-08-31-5-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** President Morales deploys the armed forces near the headquarters of the International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala.

<a id="event-2018-08-31-5-5"></a>

Context: Government of Jimmy Morales.

**Archived source account.** The third impeachment against President Jimmy Morales for illicit electoral financing during his electoral campaign in 2015, is discussed in the Congress. It is the third impeachment that was requested by the Attorney General and the CICIG.

Source citations (as archived): [Insight Crime](<https://www.insightcrime.org/news/analysis/guatemala-president-announces-end-cicig-mandate/>).

<a id="event-2018-08-31-5-7"></a>

Context: Brazilian general election, 2018.

The Court also ruled that PT cannot run political ads featuring Lula.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/08/31/world/americas/lula-president-brazil.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-08-31-6-1"></a>

Context: Trans Mountain Pipeline, Premiership of Justin Trudeau.

**Archived source account.** Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau reaffirms his support for the Trans Mountain expansion project after the Federal Court of Appeal rules suspension of the project.

## September

### 2018-09-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1366583349](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20September%201&oldid=1366583349>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-09-01-0-1"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/09/ethiopia-reopens-embassy-eritrea-thaw-ties-180906082705189.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-09-06-3-1"></a>

Context: LGBT rights in India.

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of India strikes down Article 377, a colonial-era law which criminalized homosexuality, declaring it unconstitutional.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-45429664>).

<a id="event-2018-09-06-3-3"></a>

Context: Poisoning of Sergei and Yulia Skripal, 2018 Amesbury poisonings.

**Archived source account.** Ben Wallace, British Security Minister, says in an interview that Russian President Vladimir Putin bears the responsibility for multiple Novichok poisonings in the U.K., in which British citizens were harmed and killed.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-45429894>).

<a id="event-2018-09-06-3-5"></a>

Context: 6 September 2018 Cincinnati shooting.

**Archived source account.** A gunman kills three people and injures two others at the Fifth Third Bank headquarters in Cincinnati, United States, before police fatally shoot him.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/us/2018/09/06/active-shooter-reported-at-bank-building-in-downtown-cincinnati-police-say.html>).

<a id="event-2018-09-06-3-7"></a>

Context: Sony Pictures hack, WannaCry ransomware attack.

**Archived source account.** The Justice Department unseals charges made in June against an alleged hacker for the North Korean government in connection with a series of cyber attacks, including the 2014 assaults on Sony Pictures. The Federal Bureau of Investigation accuses Park Jin Hyok of conspiring the hack on behalf of Reconnaissance General Bureau, the country's intelligence agency, and conspiring to commit wire fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/national-security/justice-department-to-announce-hacking-charges-against-north-korean-operative-the-charge--stemming-from-the-2014-sony-pictures-case--is-the-first-against-a-pyongyang-spy/2018/09/06/f477bfb2-b1d0-11e8-9a6a-565d92a3585d_story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-09-06-3-9"></a>

Context: Nisour Square massacre.

**Archived source account.** The second trial of U.S. citizen Nicholas Slatten, the former Blackwater (now Academi) employee who was found guilty in 2013 of first-degree murder in connection to the killing in 2007 of fourteen unarmed civilians on Baghdad's Nisour Square and sentenced to life in prison, ends in a mistrial.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/09/06/645176400/blackwater-guards-2nd-murder-trial-ends-without-a-verdict>).

<a id="event-2018-09-06-3-11"></a>

Context: Trump administration family separation policy.

**Archived source account.** The Trump administration proposes regulatory changes which would allow the children of illegal immigrants to be imprisoned for more than 20 days.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/09/06/645195329/trump-administration-proposes-rule-to-allow-longer-detention-of-migrant-children>).

<a id="event-2018-09-06-3-13"></a>

Context: Mexican Drug War.

**Archived source account.** Mexican officials report the discovery of the remains of at least 166 people in a mass grave in Veracruz.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-45442402>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-09-06-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ñuble becomes the 16th region of Chile after new administrative divisions in Chile come into effect.

Source citations (as archived): [Biobío](<https://www.biobiochile.cl/noticias/nacional/region-de-nuble/2018/09/06/los-hitos-que-marcaran-el-primer-dia-de-nuble-como-la-nueva-region-del-pais.shtml>).

<a id="event-2018-09-06-4-2"></a>

Context: Jair Bolsonaro presidential campaign, 2018.

**Archived source account.** Brazilian presidential candidate Jair Bolsonaro is stabbed in the abdomen and seriously injured at a campaign rally. He is expected to be in intensive care for at least seven days. Police arrest a 40-year-old man they say appears mentally disturbed.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/amp/e4ec161a5c20414c8922776376a71dec>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-09-06-5-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Wolf 503b, a super-Earth exoplanet twice the size of Earth, is discovered orbiting Wolf 503 145 light years away by American, German, and Canadian researchers via the NASA Kepler Space Telescope.

Source citations (as archived): [Fox News](<http://www.foxnews.com/science/2018/09/06/exoplanet-twice-size-earth-discovered-145-light-years-away.html>); [Astrobio](<https://www.astrobio.net/also-in-news/twice-the-size-of-earth-new-exoplanet-discovery-ideal-for-detailed-characterization/>).

<a id="event-2018-09-06-5-3"></a>

Context: Twitter suspensions.

**Archived source account.** Twitter permanently suspends the accounts of far-right conspiracy theorist Alex Jones and his website InfoWars. According to Twitter, the accounts were suspended under their policies against abusive behavior.

Source citations (as archived): [Politico](<https://www.politico.com/story/2018/09/06/alex-jones-infowars-twitter-809364>).

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1127423943](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20September%207&oldid=1127423943>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-09-07-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The presidents of Russia and Iran disagree with the Turkish president's proposal for a ceasefire in Idlib after meeting in Tehran, because it would not include the Islamist militants those nations aim to defeat.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria/russia-turkey-iran-fail-to-agree-on-ceasefire-for-syrias-idlib-idUSKCN1LN0ZD>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-09-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Tesla stock drops 9% the day after CEO Elon Musk was seen drinking whiskey and smoking cannabis in California while discussing space colonization, life after the technological singularity and whether reality is a simulation on The Joe Rogan Experience, and two executives resign.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://globalnews.ca/news/4435710/elon-musk-weed-tesla-shares-drop/>); [Space.com](<https://www.space.com/41749-elon-musk-living-in-simulation-rogan-podcast.html>).

<a id="event-2018-09-07-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Starbucks opens its first shop in Italy, in the city of Milan. The 25,000 square-foot Reserve Roastery creates 300 jobs.

<a id="event-2018-09-07-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi earthquake.

**Archived source account.** Energy specialists and executives say a power outage from the earthquake could have been lessened if Hokkaido Electric did not rely so exclusively on the Tomato-Atsuma coal plant. The company has restored electricity to just over half of its affected customers.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-japan-quake-power/power-returning-to-hokkaido-but-quake-exposes-flaws-of-japan-grid-idUSKCN1LN1EM>).

**Archived source account.** Passengers who were planning on visiting Bermuda are forced to change plans and go to Maine and Canada thanks to a threat of safety posed by Hurricane Florence.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-09-07-3-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021).

**Archived source account.** U.S. Defense Secretary Jim Mattis makes an unannounced visit to Afghanistan, to attempt to discuss peace with the Taliban, which has declined such talks with the Afghan government.

Source citations (as archived): [UPI](<https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2018/09/07/Mattis-makes-surprise-visit-to-Afghanistan-to-talk-peace-with-Taliban/5581536320752/>).

<a id="event-2018-09-07-3-3"></a>

Context: 2015–2018 Iraqi protests.

**Archived source account.** Protesters storm the Iranian consulate in Basra, in protest of corruption and misrule by Iraq's political elite, damaging the consulate's offices and shouting anti-Iranian slogans while others briefly take workers hostage at a nearby oilfield.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iraq-protests-iran/protesters-storm-iranian-consulate-in-iraqs-basra-idUSKCN1LN20R>); [Ynet News](<https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-5343944,00.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-09-07-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Ministry of Justice of the United Kingdom announces that divorce laws in England and Wales will be altered to allow for "no fault" divorces.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-45452146>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-09-07-5-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Malagasy presidential election.

**Archived source account.** Madagascar President Hery Rajaonarimampianina resigns from office in order to contest the November presidential election, as required by the Constitution. Senate president Riko Rakotovao becomes interim President of Madagascar until the January 2019 inauguration of a new president.

Source citations (as archived): [News24](<https://www.news24.com/Africa/News/madagascan-president-steps-down-ahead-of-election-20180907>); [The East African](<http://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/news/africa/Madagascar-president-resigns-/4552902-4749800-cef07nz/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-09-07-5-3"></a>

Context: Mueller special counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** George Papadopoulos, former 2016 presidential campaign aide to Donald Trump, receives a prison sentence of 14 days for lying to investigators regarding his ties to Russian contacts. He also receives a fine, probation and a community service obligation.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/09/07/politics/george-papadopoulos-sentencing-hearing/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-09-08-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Middle East respiratory syndrome outbreak.

**Archived source account.** A South Korean man is diagnosed with the potentially deadly MERS virus and is being treated at a hospital in Seoul, the first such case in three years.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-southkorea-health-mers/south-korean-man-infected-by-mers-virus-first-case-in-three-years-idUSKCN1LO0EU>).

<a id="event-2018-09-08-3-2"></a>
