Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/sep/08/first-ever-case-of-monkeypox-recorded-in-the-uk>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-09-08-4-1"></a>

Context: Human rights in Iran.

**Archived source account.** Iran's judiciary executes three Iranian Kurdish prisoners, including Ramin Panahi, for terrorism offences. Two United Nations special rapporteurs condemn the executions and Amnesty International alleges their trials were unfair, due to the denial of legal counsel and confessions obtained through torture.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-iran-rights-executions/iran-executes-three-kurdish-prisoners-accused-of-militant-attacks-idUSKCN1LO0PA>).

<a id="event-2018-09-08-4-3"></a>

Context: Human rights in Egypt.

**Archived source account.** A court in Egypt sentences 75 people to death for participating in a pro-Morsi sit-in protest in a Cairo suburb in 2013. The breakup of that protest at Rabaa Square by Egyptian authorities resulted in over 600 deaths. Of the 739 defendants, Muslim Brotherhood leader Mohamed Badie and 46 others are sentenced to life in prison, 374 receive 15-year jail terms, 22 are sentenced to 10 years and 215 people, including Mahmoud Abu Zeid (Shawkan), to five years in jail.

Source citations (as archived): [France 24](<https://www.france24.com/en/20180908-egypt-court-sentence-photographer-2013-protest-mohamed-badie-morsi-abu-zaid>); [The Evening Standard](<https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/egypt-sentences-75-islamist-demonstrators-to-death-over-morsi-protest-a3930766.html>).

**Archived source account.** Super Typhoon Mangkhut (Ompong), one of the strongest in the history of the Philippines, kills at least 59 people. The typhoon struck also Hong Kong, injuring more than 200 people while four persons died in China. A woman died in Taiwan after being swept out to sea.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45546795>); [Taiwan News](<https://www.taiwannews.com.tw/en/news/3530561>).

<a id="event-2018-09-15-2-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Atlantic hurricane season, Hurricane Florence.

**Archived source account.** 17 people are confirmed dead after Hurricane Florence-related incidents. Florence is expected to dump an additional 10 to 15 inches of rain in parts of the Carolinas.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-45544424>).

<a id="event-2018-09-15-2-4"></a>

Context: 2018 Atlantic hurricane season, Hurricane Florence.

**Archived source account.** A record 30.5 in of rain falls at Swansboro, North Carolina, breaking the state record of 24 in.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/post-nation/wp/2018/09/15/hurricane-florence-storm-continues-to-pummel-carolinas/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-09-15-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The United Launch Alliance successfully launches NASA's ICESat-2 satellite from Vandenberg Air Force Base. The satellite will provide more precise information on Earth's polar ice caps. It is the final mission for the Delta II rocket.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-45523524>).

<a id="event-2018-09-15-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Researchers with Stanford University report the discovery of the oldest known evidence of beer. Dating to approximately 11,000 BCE, the primitive brewery was located near modern Haifa, Israel.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-45534133>).

### 2018-09-16

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1085825624](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20September%2016&oldid=1085825624>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2018-09-16-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Sunspot Solar Observatory in New Mexico is set to reopen on Monday after being closed due to "an on-going law enforcement investigation of criminal activity that occurred at Sacramento Peak" in which "a suspect in the investigation potentially posed a threat to the safety of local staff and residents".

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/news/aliens-sadly-not-to-blame-for-closure-of-new-mexico-solar-observatory/>).

<a id="event-2018-09-16-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** A man and a woman are taken ill after a medical incident in Salisbury, United Kingdom. Police seal off a restaurant as a precautionary measure. According to The Guardian, tensions are high due to recent Novichok poisonings. According to the BBC, "there's no suggestion that this is connected". According to Sky News, at least one of the individuals who fell ill is a Russian.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/sep/16/emergency-services-attend-medical-incident-in-salisbury-restaurant>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-45541249>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/salisbury-restaurant-cordoned-off-by-police-after-pair-taken-ill-11500197>).

<a id="event-2018-09-16-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Two people die and 700 others seek medical attention, including three people in critical condition at the Defqon.1 Festival in Sydney, Australia, for drug-related issues. Premier of New South Wales Gladys Berejiklian says that the event is dangerous and will never take place again, effectively banning the music festival.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-australia-45539671>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-09-16-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Forty-one inmates escape from Hpa-an Township's main prison in Kayin State, Myanmar, after hijacking a garbage truck and driving it through the prison gates. Eleven of the escapees are apprehended by police, but 30 remain at large.

Source citations (as archived): [The Myanmar Times](<https://www.mmtimes.com/news/police-pursue-30-inmates-after-daring-hpa-prison-break.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-09-16-2-1"></a>

Context: Politics of Syria.

**Archived source account.** Local elections are held in government-held areas of Syria for the first time since 2011.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<http://tass.com/world/1021781>).

<a id="event-2018-09-16-2-3"></a>

Context: Government of Jimmy Morales.

**Archived source account.** The Constitutional Court of Guatemala annuls the decision of President Jimmy Morales to prevent the entrance to Guatemala to the head of the International Commission against Impunity in Guatemala Iván Velásquez Gómez. In the resolution, President Morales is forced to exhaust the dialogue with the United Nations.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/guatemalas-constitutional-court-orders-president-jimmy-morales-head-57870300>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-09-16-3-1"></a>

Context: British space programme.

**Archived source account.** The first of a series of British satellites, known as NovaSAR, is launched from Satish Dhawan Space Centre in India. The Surrey Satellite Technology satellite is designed to monitor suspicious shipping activity.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-45523677>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-09-16-4-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Berlin Marathon.

**Archived source account.** Eliud Kipchoge of Kenya sets a new world record for the fastest marathon time, at 2:01:39.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics/45539546>).

<a id="event-2018-09-16-4-3"></a>

Context: Décastar.

**Archived source account.** At the season's last IAAF Combined Events Challenge in Talence, French athlete Kevin Mayer breaks the decathlon world record with a score of 9,126 points.

Source citations (as archived): [IAAF](<https://www.iaaf.org/news/report/decastar-talence-2018-mayer-world-record>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-09-17-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War, Syria missile strikes (September 2018).

**Archived source account.** Russia and Turkey announce a demilitarized zone in Syria's Idlib Governorate and rule out any military operations.

**Archived source account.** Several missiles are launched from the sea at the coastal city of Latakia, some of which are destroyed by air defence systems. It is not immediately clear who was behind the attack.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-mideast-crisis-syria-attack/syrian-air-defences-down-missiles-fired-at-city-of-latakia-state-media-idUKKCN1LX2BS>).

A U.S. official claims the Syrian Army inadvertently shot it down while attempting to intercept missiles, while Russia detected a missile launch from a French FREMM multipurpose frigate.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/09/17/politics/syrian-regime-shoots-down-russian-plane/index.html>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-russia/russia-says-a-military-aircraft-vanishes-near-syria-during-israeli-french-strikes-idUSKCN1LY057>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45556290>).

**Archived source account.** The Taliban launches multiple attacks on security checkpoints in Afghanistan, killing at least 27 members of the security forces. Twenty-two Taliban members are also killed and 16 others are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [news.com.au](<https://www.news.com.au/world/breaking-news/taliban-kills-27-afghan-police-soldiers/news-story/fd07a6ad3de216f6d4d4e753c807cd7e>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/economy/us-and-canada-closing-in-on-a-new-nafta-deal-as-deadline-looms/2018/09/30/2ef72018-c50b-11e8-b1ed-1d2d65b86d0c_story.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-09-30-2-1"></a>

Context: Macedonian referendum, 2018, Macedonia naming dispute.

**Archived source account.** A referendum is held in the Republic of Macedonia on whether to change the country's name in order to join NATO and the EU.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-macedonia-referendum/macedonians-vote-on-whether-to-change-countrys-name-idUSKCN1M90U1>).

<a id="event-2018-09-30-2-2"></a>

Context: Macedonian referendum, 2018, Macedonia naming dispute.

**Archived source account.** 91.5% of votes are in favor of the change. The voter turnout is only 36.9%, below the 50% threshold set by the government. Prime Minister Zoran Zaev still vows to propose the change in a parliament vote.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-macedonia-referendum/macedonia-leader-vows-to-press-on-with-name-change-despite-referendum-failure-idUSKCN1M90U1>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/10/01/europe/macedonia-name-referendum/index.html>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-09-30-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Ryder Cup.

**Archived source account.** In golf, Team Europe retains the Ryder Cup, defeating Team USA 17½–10½ at Le Golf National near Paris.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.espn.com/golf/story/_/id/24847263/2018-ryder-cup-europe-defeats-united-states-maintain-home-dominance>).

<a id="event-2018-09-30-3-3"></a>

Context: 2018 UCI Road World Championships.

**Archived source account.** Alejandro Valverde wins his first title after a four-man sprint, ahead of Romain Bardet and Michael Woods.

Source citations (as archived): [VeloNews](<https://www.velonews.com/2018/09/news/valverde-takes-world-title-in-a-four-man-sprint_479555>).

<a id="event-2018-09-30-3-5"></a>

Context: 2018 NRL Grand Final.

**Archived source account.** The Sydney Roosters defeat Melbourne Storm 21-6 in the National Rugby League premiership at ANZ Stadium, Sydney Australia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/sport/amp/rugby-league/45698698>).


## October

### 2018-10-01

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 866667152](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20October%201&oldid=866667152>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: 2018 Eastern Euphrates missile strike.

**Archived source account.** Iran fires six ballistic missiles from its own territory at ISIL targets near the Euphrates river valley in eastern Syria, in response to the Ahvaz military parade attack.

Source citations (as archived): [The Independent](<https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/middle-east/iran-syria-bombing-missiles-air-strike-abu-kamal-attack-latest-ahvaz-parade-shooting-a8562776.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-10-01-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Danish airline Primera Air collapses into bankruptcy and announces that it is ceasing all operations at midnight on Monday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-45712063>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-10-01-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Naga, Cebu landslide.

**Archived source account.** The death toll of the landslide in Cebu, Philippines rise to 77. Eight others are still missing and presumed dead.

Source citations (as archived): [ABS-CBN News](<https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/10/02/18/dig-for-more-bodies-in-cebu-landslide-nears-end>).

<a id="event-2018-10-01-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Thirteen people are killed and at least 30 others are injured when a military transport truck flips over on a major road in Freetown, Sierra Leone.

<a id="event-2018-10-01-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Walaka becomes a category 5 hurricane. It is expected to hit the Johnston Atoll.

Source citations (as archived): [Star-Advertiser](<http://www.staradvertiser.com/2018/09/30/breaking-news/walaka-intensifies-but-storm-remains-southwest-of-hawaii/>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-10-01-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** North Korea and South Korea begin removing landmines and other explosives from the Korean Demilitarized Zone.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/north-korea-south-korea-removing-land-mines-dmz-panmunjom-arrow-head-hill/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-10-01-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A hand grenade explodes in a night club in the city of Yambio in South Sudan, killing at least ten people and injuring dozens of others. The police commissioner in the city confirmed that the explosion is not related to the ongoing civil war in the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/at-least-10-die-after-grenade-thrown-in-night-club-in-south-sudan---police-10778346>).

<a id="event-2018-10-01-5-2"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** After an independentist demonstration, the Mossos d'Esquadra evicts riots demanding the implantation of the Republic before the main door of the Catalan Parliament in a failed attempt to assault it.

Source citations (as archived): [La Vanguardia](<https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20181001/452131455589/catalunya-barcelona-1-octubre-manifestacion-parlament-manifestantes-mossos-hoy-video-seo-lv.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-europe-45710447>).

**Archived source account.** Mirko Tomassoni and Luca Santolini take office as Captains Regents of San Marino.

Source citations (as archived): [San Marino RTV](<http://www.smtvsanmarino.sm/politica/2018/10/01/notizia-senza-titolo-255522>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-10-01-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine is awarded to James P. Allison and Tasuku Honjo for their discoveries in cancer therapy.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/10/01/health/nobel-prize-medicine.html>).

<a id="event-2018-10-01-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The discovery of a third Sednoid, 2015 TG387, is announced. The 200–600 km wide asteroid never approaches less than 65 astronomical units from the Sun, more than twice Neptune's distance.

Source citations (as archived): [Nature](<https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-018-06885-1>).

### 2018-10-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1086875422](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20October%202&oldid=1086875422>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

Context: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021), Afghan parliamentary election, 2018.

**Archived source account.** A suicide bomber kills 13 people and injures more than 30 others at an election rally in Nangarhar Province, Afghanistan.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45718603>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-10-02-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Sulawesi earthquake and tsunami.

**Archived source account.** At least 1,347 people are now known to have died in the aftermath of the Indonesian earthquake and tsunami.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45716915>).

<a id="event-2018-10-02-1-3"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Thirty-four migrants drown in a shipwreck in the western Mediterranean Sea. The Moroccan Navy rescues 26 survivors and recovers 11 bodies.

Source citations (as archived): [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/at-least-34-migrants-drown-in-mediterranean-shipwreck--26-survivors---un-10783192>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-10-02-2-1"></a>

Context: Saudi Arabia–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** In a public speech in Southaven, Mississippi, U.S. President Donald Trump claims that Salman of Saudi Arabia's power wouldn't last "for two weeks" without the support of the U.S. military.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-saudi/trump-i-told-saudi-king-he-wouldnt-last-without-us-support-idUSKCN1MD066>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-10-02-3-1"></a>

Context: Terrorism in France.

**Archived source account.** French RAID and BRI police units raid the headquarters of a Shiite association in Grande-Synthe and the homes of its leaders for "strong support" to "many" terrorist organizations. Assets are frozen and three people remanded in custody.

Source citations (as archived): [France-Soir](<https://kozpost.com/blog/north-anti-terror-operation-in-grande-synthe-against-an-association-of-shiite/9850/>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-10-02-4-1"></a>

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom, Brexit.

**Archived source account.** DUP leader Arlene Foster says that extra border checks between Northern Ireland and Great Britain are the "one red line" for her party.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-10-02/key-may-ally-warns-u-k-against-brexit-concessions-on-ireland>).

<a id="event-2018-10-02-4-3"></a>

Context: Government of Iraq.

**Archived source account.** The Council of Representatives of Iraq elects Barham Salih as president. Salih then appoints Adil Abdul al-Mahdi as prime minister.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/10/03/middleeast/iraq-prime-minister-president-intl/index.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-10-02-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Nobel Prize in Physics is awarded to Arthur Ashkin, Gérard Mourou, and Donna Strickland for their work using lasers to manipulate microscopic objects. Strickland is the first woman to win this award in 55 years.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/10/02/science/physics-nobel-prize.html>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/10/02/world/nobel-physics-prize-2018-intl/index.html>).

#### Business and economy

**Archived source account.** The United States announces its withdrawal from the optional protocol concerning compulsory settlement of disputes of the Vienna Convention on Diplomatic Relations.

<a id="event-2018-10-03-5-1"></a>

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-10-07-0-1"></a>

Context: War in Afghanistan.

**Archived source account.** Afghan officials say that the Taliban destroyed highway bridges in Maidan Wardak Province, cutting off road traffic between the capital Kabul and the provinces of Ghazni, Zabul and Kandahar. Electricity was cut off in four provinces, and fighting was reported in Ghazni Province. At least ten Afghan police officers were killed. Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in two weeks.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<http://www.tampabay.com/ap/world/taliban-destroy-highway-bridges-cut-off--afghan-provinces-ap_worldabefcf4fe2c64e97bd22010bb6119c1d>); [Reuters](<https://www.thenational.ae/world/asia/afghan-taliban-launch-deadly-attacks-in-wardak-and-ghazni-1.778012>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/israeli-military-west-bank-shooting-attack-wounds-3/2018/10/07/706ad5a6-c9f4-11e8-9c0f-2ffaf6d422aa_story.html>); [Reuters](<https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-israel-palestinians-shooting/palestinian-gunman-kills-two-israelis-in-west-bank-israeli-military-idUKKCN1MH05T>); [Ynet News](<https://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-5365228,00.html>).

<a id="event-2018-10-07-2-0"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/10/07/world/asia/china-interpol-men-hongwei.html>); [Twitter](<https://twitter.com/INTERPOL_HQ/status/1049003122046259201/photo/1>).

<a id="event-2018-10-11-0-2"></a>

Context: 2018 European floods.

**Archived source account.** Heavy floods affect France and Italy: in the French city of Sainte Maxime, two people drown after their vehicle is swept away by floodwater. In the Italian city of Cagliari, a woman is found dead inside her car, while another man is missing. A bridge also collapses and roads are damaged.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45821680>).

<a id="event-2018-10-11-0-4"></a>

Context: 2018 Atlantic hurricane season.

**Archived source account.** Hurricane Michael is downgraded to a tropical storm, but tornadoes are spotted in Georgia and Florida.

<a id="event-2018-10-11-0-5"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eight children die and three are injured when the wall of a house collapses in the suburban area of Sukkur, Pakistan.

<a id="event-2018-10-11-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Keiko Fujimori, leader of the opposition in the Congress of Peru and daughter of former President Alberto Fujimori, is arrested on charges related to illicit campaign finance received from the Odebrecht corporation.

<a id="event-2018-10-11-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Inter-American Commission of Human Rights releases an official charge for the protection of Juan Requesens, laying out actions that the Venezuelan government must take to ensure the imprisoned politician's welfare, specifically stating that he must not be "object to acts of violence against \[his health\]". This comes after a two-month investigation, and days after the death in custody of another Venezuelan politician.,

#### Armed attacks and conflicts

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-10-15-2-1"></a>

Context: Economy of the United States.

**Archived source account.** American retailer Sears files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after accumulating USD $134 million in debt.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/sears-files-chapter-11-amid-plunging-sales-massive-58498980>).

Context: Hydraulic fracturing in the United Kingdom.

**Archived source account.** Fracking for shale gas begins in the United Kingdom for the first time since it was suspended in 2011 after being linked to a series of earthquakes. Cuadrilla Resources say they will spend at least three months fracking two horizontal wells in Lancashire.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-10-15-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 European floods, Hurricane Leslie (2018).

**Archived source account.** At least 10 people have been killed by flash floods in the Aude region of south-western France. A bridge also collapsed in the locality of Villegailhenc, while all roads are inaccessible in Carcassonne.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45861428>).

<a id="event-2018-10-15-3-3"></a>

Context: 2018 California wildfires.

**Archived source account.** The Pacific Gas and Electric Company, a major California utility based in San Francisco, announces they temporarily turned off power to 60,000 customers in 12 Northern California counties due to threats of wildfires. Red flag warnings are issued to 22 million people in the state.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/10/15/us/california-fire-season/index.html>); [Mercury News](<https://www.mercurynews.com/2018/10/14/pge-cuts-north-bay-towns-power-citing-fire-risk/>).

<a id="event-2018-10-15-4-1"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations, Schism of 2018.

**Archived source account.** The Russian Orthodox Church announces it will break communion with the Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople over Eastern Orthodox Church official plans to recognize the autocephaly of two Ukrainian Orthodox Churches. Moscow says it hopes Constantinople will change its mind to avoid this schism. This marks an important new aspect in the rift between Russia and Ukraine.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/oct/15/russian-orthodox-church-cuts-ties-with-constantinople>).

<a id="event-2018-10-17-3-1"></a>

Context: Kerch Polytechnic College massacre.

**Archived source account.** A double bombing-mass shooting attack leaves 20 dead in a college in Kerch, Crimea. An 18-year-old student carried out the gun and bomb attack and then committed suicide. The attacker "hated the technical school very much" and had vowed "revenge" on his teacher.

<a id="event-2018-10-24-1-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump acknowledges that the Saudi Arabia crown prince "could have been" involved in the killing of Khashoggi, noting that "the prince is running things over there".

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/oct/23/jamal-khashoggi-trump-cover-up-sanctions-visas>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-10-24-2-1"></a>

Context: Russian interference in the 2018 United States elections, cyberwarfare by Russia.

**Archived source account.** The United States Cyber Command contacts individual Russians with the hope to deter them from interfering with upcoming American elections, including the November midterms.

Source citations (as archived): [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/10/23/us-warning-individual-russians-over-midterm-election-interference.html>).

<a id="event-2018-10-24-2-3"></a>

Context: October 2018 United States mail bombing attempts.

**Archived source account.** The United States Secret Service intercepts two suspicious packages described as "potential explosive devices" addressed to former President Barack Obama and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton. One addressed to former CIA director John O. Brennan was received at CNN's New York studios, which were evacuated. Other politicians who received similar packages include U.S. Representatives Debbie Wasserman Schultz (whose name and address was on the return label of a package meant for former Attorney General Eric Holder but had the wrong recipient address) and Maxine Waters. Authorities are also attempting to locate a suspicious package sent to former Vice President Joe Biden that was marked return to sender due to a bad address.

Source citations (as archived): [Washington Examiner](<https://www.washingtonexaminer.com/news/authorities-searching-for-package-addressed-to-joe-biden-amid-bomb-scare>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/10/24/660161491/u-s-intercepts-suspicious-packages-addressed-to-clinton-and-obama>).

<a id="event-2018-10-24-2-5"></a>

Context: 2018 Jeffersontown shooting.

**Archived source account.** A shooter kills two people in a Kroger store near Louisville, Kentucky.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/multiple-people-shot-at-kroger-grocery-store-outside-louisville-kentucky/>).

<a id="event-2018-10-24-2-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Junpei Yasuda, a Japanese journalist kidnapped by Al-Nusra Front in Syria, is released.

Source citations (as archived): [Time](<http://www.time.com/5432820/japanese-journalist-syria-released-turkey/>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-10-24-3-1"></a>

Context: Settlement of the Americas.

**Archived source account.** Stone tools are found in Texas dating back 15,000 years, being the oldest evidence of humans in North America.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<https://www.dailymail.co.uk/sciencetech/article-6313785/Oldest-weapons-discovered-North-America-reveal-Americans-arrived-earlier-thought.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-10-27-0-1"></a>

Context: Pittsburgh synagogue shooting.

**Archived source account.** A gunman opens fire at the Tree of Life - Or L'Simcha Congregation synagogue in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, killing at least 11 people. The perpetrator 46-years old Robert Bowers was an active user of the social media service Gab where he had posted anti-Semitic and racist content as well as one before the shooting that said "HIAS likes to bring invaders in that kill our people. I can't sit by and watch my people get slaughtered. Screw your optics, I'm going in".,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-46002549>); [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/pittsburgh-active-shooter-near-synagogue-1.4881234>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-10-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Pittsburgh synagogue shooting.

**Archived source account.** American online payments system company PayPal bans American social media site Gab, known for its association with the alt-right movement, while Joyent, Gab's American hosting provider, states that they will terminate their service tomorrow. The move comes after it was revealed that the suspect in yesterday's 11 deaths, Robert Bowers, was an active member on the social network.

Source citations (as archived): [CNET](<https://www.cnet.com/news/after-pittsburgh-synagogue-shooting-paypal-bans-gab-social-network/>).

#### Health and environment

<a id="event-2018-10-30-1-1"></a>

Context: Complications of pregnancy.

**Archived source account.** Research published in JAMA Internal Medicine describes that mothers should wait at least a year between giving birth and getting pregnant again to reduce health risks to mother and baby.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/health-46017789>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-10-30-2-1"></a>

Context: List of serial killers by number of victims.

**Archived source account.** German convicted serial killer and former nurse Niels Högel begins his third trial (previous convictions were in 2008 and 2015), this time in Oldenburg, for additional patient murders by administering fatal doses of medication between 1999–2005 which may include his assignment as one of Germany's worst serial killers since World War II. At the beginning of the trial, Högel confesses to the murder of 100 of his patients.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46027355>); [Deutsche Welle](<https://www.dw.com/en/german-former-nurse-confesses-to-killing-100-patients/a-46084584>).

<a id="event-2018-10-30-2-3"></a>

Context: Assange v Swedish Prosecution Authority.

**Archived source account.** A judge in Ecuador rules against WikiLeaks co-founder Julian Assange, who had contested new rules imposed on him in the country's embassy in London. Assange had argued that the conditions violated his "fundamental rights and freedoms", and were intended to force him to leave. His lawyers have appealed against the ruling. Assange took refuge in the embassy six years ago to avoid extradition to Sweden in a sexual assault case that has since been dropped.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46027963>).

<a id="event-2018-10-30-2-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Boston convicted organized crime boss and former FBI Ten Most Wanted Fugitive Whitey Bulger dies in the United States Penitentiary at Hazelton, West Virginia.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/10/30/us/james-whitey-bulger-killed/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-10-30-2-6"></a>

Context: Arrest of Juan Requesens, Human rights in Venezuela.

**Archived source account.** It is reported that imprisoned Venezuelan opposition leader Juan Requesens has been transferred from isolation to a military hospital in Caracas, after days of reports that he has been suffering an untreated dental infection as well as wounds of torture.

Source citations (as archived): [Venezuela al día](<http://www.venezuelaaldia.com/2018/10/27/regimen-tortura-y-niega-asistencia-dental-al-diputado-juan-requesens/>).

<a id="event-2018-10-30-2-7"></a>

**Archived source account.** John Letts, the father of the alleged British-Canadian Islamic State fighter Jack Letts who is being held by Kurdish forces in Syria, calls for the Canadian government to help secure his release.,

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46039145>); [CTV News](<https://www.ctvnews.ca/canada/father-of-alleged-isis-fighter-pleads-with-ottawa-to-help-free-son-in-syria-1.4156578>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-10-30-3-1"></a>

Context: United States Constitution.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump vows to revoke the right to automatic citizenship given to children born on United States land to illegal immigrants. According to most authorities, birthright citizenship in the United States is protected in the Citizenship Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46032075>).

<a id="event-2018-10-30-3-3"></a>

Context: Taliban in Qatar.

**Archived source account.** Five members of the Taliban who were freed by the Obama administration from Guantanamo Bay in exchange for former captive Bowe Bergdahl join the insurgent group’s political office in Qatar.,

Source citations (as archived): [Military Times](<https://www.militarytimes.com/news/your-military/2018/10/30/5-freed-from-gitmo-in-exchange-for-bergdahl-join-insurgents-in-qatar-taliban-says/>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/the_americas/taliban-5-freed-from-us-military-prison-now-in-qatar-office/2018/10/31/5fe3f448-dcc7-11e8-8bac-bfe01fcdc3a6_story.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-10-30-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA's Parker Solar Probe spacecraft becomes the closest ever sent to the sun, by passing 42.7 million km (26.6 million miles) from the sun's surface. The previous record was set in 1976 by the Helios 2 spacecraft. Parker's elliptical orbit will eventually take it to within 6.1 million km (3.8 million miles) of the sun.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-46030852>).

<a id="event-2018-10-30-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** NASA announces that the Kepler spacecraft has expended all its fuel and will be retired after nearly 10 years of service, having found more than 2,600 exoplanets.

Source citations (as archived): [Los Angeles Times](<http://www.latimes.com/science/sciencenow/la-sci-sn-nasa-kepler-retires-20181030-story.html>).

<a id="event-2018-10-30-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Hawaii Supreme Court affirms the permit for the Thirty Meter Telescope on Mauna Kea.

Source citations (as archived): [Thirty Meter Telescope](<https://www.tmt.org/news/361>).

### 2018-10-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1344689952](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20October%2031&oldid=1344689952>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-10-31-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A 17-year-old local student, who studied at a nearby polytechnic school, detonates an explosive device inside a Federal Security Service building in Arkhangelsk, Russia, killing himself and wounding three FSB officers. The agency is Russia's primary state security agency and a successor to the KGB.

Source citations (as archived): [Meduza](<https://meduza.io/en/feature/2018/10/31/the-terrorist-attack-on-a-federal-security-service-branch-in-arkhangelsk-what-we-know-so-far>).

<a id="event-2018-10-31-0-2"></a>

Context: Boko Haram insurgency.

**Archived source account.** Boko Haram militants kill at least 15 people in a village on the outskirts of Maiduguri, in northeast Nigeria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-nigeria-security-insurgency/suspected-boko-haram-militants-kill-15-in-northeast-nigeria-residents-idUSKCN1N64EU>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-10-31-1-1"></a>

Context: List of tallest statues.

**Archived source account.** Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi unveils the Statue of Unity, which depicts the first Deputy Prime Minister of India, first Home Minister of India and recipient of the highest civilian award of the Republic of India, the Bharat Ratna, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. The statue is located near the Narmada Dam in the Indian state of Gujarat. At 182 metres, it is the world’s tallest statue.

Source citations (as archived): [NDTV](<https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/statue-of-unity-on-the-banks-of-narmada-opens-today-see-stunning-pics-1940390>).

**Archived source account.** A helicopter carrying senior Afghan National Army officials crashes, killing all 25 people on board in the western Farah Province, Afghanistan. The Taliban claims responsibility for shooting it down, however Afghan officials blame bad weather as the cause of the crash.,

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/amp/news/2018/10/afghanistan-army-helicopter-crash-senior-officials-25-dead-181031063548900.html>); [Sky News](<https://news.sky.com/story/twenty-five-people-killed-in-afghanistan-army-helicopter-crash-11540625>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-10-31-3-1"></a>

Context: North Korea and weapons of mass destruction.

**Archived source account.** North Korea is set to allow inspections of its Punggye-ri Nuclear Test Site, which officially closed in May 2018.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/oct/31/north-korea-set-to-allow-inspectors-into-nuclear-test-site>).

Context: Blasphemy law in Pakistan.

**Archived source account.** A Pakistani court overturns the death sentence of Asia Bibi, a Christian woman convicted of blasphemy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46040515>).

<a id="event-2018-10-31-4-3"></a>

Context: Killing of Jamal Khashoggi.

**Archived source account.** The Turkish chief Istanbul prosecutor İrfan Fidan’s office states that Jamal Khashoggi was, with premeditation, strangled and his body was dismembered as soon as he entered the Saudi consulate building in Istanbul. This is the first such accusation against Saudi Arabia by any Turkish official.

Source citations (as archived): [AP](<https://apnews.com/7b064bec9b1448d7b2c1ec259b37503c>).

<a id="event-2018-10-31-4-5"></a>

Context: Legality of cannabis, Cannabis in Mexico.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-drugs/mexico-supreme-court-says-ban-on-recreational-marijuana-unconstitutional-idUSKCN1N638D?il=0>).

<a id="event-2018-10-31-4-6"></a>

Source citations (as archived): [Voice of America](<https://www.voanews.com/a/venezuela-names-new-spy-chief-after-uproar-over-politician-death/4636878.html>).

<a id="event-2018-10-31-4-8"></a>

Context: Timeline of investigations into Trump and Russia (July–December 2018).

**Archived source account.** After three prominent legal analysts (Geoff Shepard, Benjamin Wittes, Jack Goldsmith, and Stephen Bates) filed separate lawsuits seeking its unsealing and Chief Judge Beryl A. Howell, of the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia, on October 11 ordered the disclosure, the National Archives releases a set of documents from the Watergate investigation as a possible "road map" for the Mueller probe, including a would-be indictment against former president Richard Nixon.,

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/10/31/politics/richard-nixon-watergate-national-archives-mueller/index.html>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/us-archivists-release-watergate-report-that-could-be-possible-road-map-for-mueller/2018/10/31/841cc938-dbb5-11e8-85df-7a6b4d25cfbb_story.html>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-11-04-2-1"></a>

Context: 2018 European floods.

**Archived source account.** Heavy floods affect Palermo in Sicily, Italy, killing twelve people. The total death toll of the floods and strong winds in the country rises to 31 people.

Source citations (as archived): [Teleacras](<http://www.teleacras.com/wp1/2018/11/05/maltempo-in-sicilia-12-morti/>).

<a id="event-2018-11-04-2-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** 69.1 tonnes of C9 aromatic hydrocarbon are leaked into the ocean at a port in Quangang District, Quanzhou, China when a petrochemical company loads the cargo from its terminal into a chemical tanker and the aged hose coupling gasket breaks. Nearby aquaculture farms are contaminated, resulting in huge loss. Many fishermen and residents get sick from the leaked chemical, and 52 of them are hospitalized. Local authorities are accused of playing down the severity of the leakage. Discussion of the accident is suppressed on Weibo after the accident has become a hot topic. The company lies that the amount of leakage is 6.97 tonnes.

**Archived source account.** A new definition of SI units, e.g., the kilogram, the ampere, etc., is decided by the General Conference on Weights and Measures. Source citations (as archived): [National Physical Laboratory](<http://www.npl.co.uk/news/international-system-of-units-overhauled-in-historic-vote>).

### 2018-11-25

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-11-25-0-1"></a>

Context: Kerch Strait incident.

**Archived source account.** Russia stops three Ukrainian Navy vessels from passing under the Kerch Strait Bridge by blocking it with a cargo ship. Russia claims they violated her territorial waters and ignored warnings. The navy vessels and their crews are seized after shots were fired. Russia says three Ukrainians were wounded. According to Ukraine, six of their sailors are wounded. Ukraine denies their ships did anything wrong.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ukraine-crisis-russia/russia-blocks-ukrainian-navy-from-entering-sea-of-azov-idUSKCN1NU0DL>); [AP](<https://www.apnews.com/b9e44a0c2dce40aebfc117e1490c51b9>).

<a id="event-2018-11-25-0-2"></a>

Context: Kerch Strait incident.

**Archived source account.** An emergency National Security and Defense Council of Ukraine meeting is convened in response to the Russian blockade of the Kerch Strait and the seizure of its vessels, after which President Petro Poroshenko says he will ask the Verkhovna Rada to support a declaration of martial law in Ukraine. The parliament is set to have an emergency meeting at 4 p.m. local time on November 26.

Source citations (as archived): [Kyiv Post](<https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/ukrainian-navy-russias-coast-guard-opens-fire-on-ukrainian-boats-in-the-azov-sea-developing.html>).

<a id="event-2018-11-25-1-3"></a>

Context: Camp Fire.

**Archived source account.** Two more bodies are found in Paradise and one in nearby Magalia, raising the death toll to 85. Another 249 people are still missing.

<a id="event-2018-11-25-1-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** The chemical spill accident in Quangang District, Quanzhou, China on November 4 is found to be 10 times worse than initially reported. According to the government of Quanzhou, the actual leak of C9 aromatics was 69.1 tonnes instead of 6.97 tonnes understated by the Fujian Donggang Petrochemical Company. Several officials of Quangang District have been suspended from their posts and seven company employees have been arrested by the police in connection with the cover-up.

Source citations (as archived): [Global Times](<http://www.globaltimes.cn/content/1128922.shtml>).

The events were triggered by Mexican police breaking up a migrant protest, resulting in a rush toward the border.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://reuters.com/article/uk-usa-immigration/u-s-mexico-border-crossing-closed-after-migrant-protest-halted-in-tijuana-idUKKCN1NU0YW>).

### 2018-11-30

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1217305920](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20November%2030&oldid=1217305920>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-11-30-0-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Anchorage earthquake.

**Archived source account.** A magnitude 7.0 earthquake hits Alaska, with the epicenter in Anchorage. Severe damage is reported.

Source citations (as archived): [USGS](<https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us1000hyfh/executive>); [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/news/alaska-earthquake-today-anchorage-tsunami-alert-issued-live-updates/>).

<a id="event-2018-11-30-0-3"></a>

Context: Tornadoes of 2018.

**Archived source account.** A severe storm system brings tornado watches and warnings throughout the U.S. states of Oklahoma, Texas, Arkansas, and Missouri. A "large and dangerous" tornado is confirmed near Gore, Oklahoma. Several other tornadoes are seen by storm chasers.

Source citations (as archived): [4029 News](<https://www.4029tv.com/article/tracking-severe-storms-for-friday-night/25346439>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-11-30-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Marriott International discloses that its Starwood Hotel brand had been subject to a data breach.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/11/30/tech/marriott-breach-what-to-do/index.html>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-11-30-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** A South Korean train arrives towards Panmun Station and crosses the DMZ border for the first time since 2008, when a South Korean cargo train operated five times a week.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/south-korea-sends-a-train-into-north-for-the-first-time-in-a-decade/2018/11/30/e4942e66-f459-11e8-9240-e8028a62c722_story.html>); [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46395408>); [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/2175776/south-korean-trains-venture-over-border-first-time-decade-fix>).

<a id="event-2018-11-30-2-3"></a>

Context: Russia–Ukraine relations, Martial law in Ukraine.

**Archived source account.** Ukraine bans Russian men aged between 16 and 60 from entering the country following the imposition of martial law. President Petro Poroshenko says the ban is to prevent the formation of "private armies" in Ukraine. Russia says it does not plan to retaliate.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46397644>).

<a id="event-2018-11-30-2-5"></a>

Context: 2018 G20 Buenos Aires summit.

**Archived source account.** The United States, Canada and Mexico sign the United States–Mexico–Canada Agreement in Buenos Aires, replacing the North American Free Trade Agreement.

Source citations (as archived): [TTNews](<https://www.ttnews.com/articles/nafta-replacement-usmca-signed-awaits-ratification-congress>); [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/11/30/672150010/usmca-trump-signs-new-trade-agreement-with-mexico-and-canada>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-11-30-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Nigerian police killed 104 cattle thieves in operations in the north-western state of Zamfara.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-africa-46342363?ns_mchannel=social&amp;ns_source=twitter&amp;ns_campaign=bbc_live&amp;ns_linkname=5c0168e80aa1a306815ec31e%26%27Cattle%20thieves%27%20killed%20by%20Nigerian%20police%262018-11-30T16%3A48%3A34.610Z&amp;ns_fee=0&amp;pinned_post_locator=urn:asset:ea5dd9ca-5a98-4145-a60e-ee3f451cedf3&amp;pinned_post_asset_id=5c0168e80aa1a306815ec31e&amp;pinned_post_type=share>).

<a id="event-2018-11-30-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Supreme Court of Canada says that Vice Media reporter Ben Makuch must give the Royal Canadian Mounted Police material he gathered for stories about an accused Islamic State terrorist.

Source citations (as archived): [CBC](<https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/supreme-court-vice-ben-makush-decision-1.4926102>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-11-30-4-1"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** Sam Gyimah resigns as British Minister of State for the Department for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy in protest to Prime Minister Theresa May's Brexit withdrawal deal.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2018/nov/30/sam-gyimah-resigns-over-theresa-mays-brexit-deal>).

<a id="event-2018-11-30-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Former U.S. President George H. W. Bush dies of Parkinsonism at the age of 94, at about 10:10 p.m. CST.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/11/30/423556608/former-president-george-h-w-bush-dies-at-94>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/01/politics/george-h-w-bush-dead/index.html>).


## December

### 2018-12-01

#### Disasters and accidents

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-latin-america-46413196>); [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/trump-agrees-temporarily-halt-us-trade-war-china-n942676>).

**Archived source account.** Protesters clash with police in Paris.

Source citations (as archived): [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/europe/spain-2-catalan-separatists-start-hunger-strike-in-prison/2018/12/01/b12e1dfa-f55f-11e8-99c2-cfca6fcf610c_story.html?noredirect=on&amp;utm_term=.c2e3010ce660>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2018/12/01/world/europe/ap-eu-spain-catalonia.html>).

### 2018-12-02

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1360594802](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20December%202&oldid=1360594802>).

<a id="event-2018-12-02-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Seven people are killed and seven others injured after a landslide an Inn in North Sumatra Province, Indonesia.

Source citations (as archived): [Xinhua](<http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-12/02/c_137646056.htm>).

<a id="event-2018-12-02-2-1"></a>

<a id="event-2018-12-02-2-4"></a>

<a id="event-2018-12-02-2-5"></a>

Context: Elections in Spain, 2018 Andalusian regional election.

**Archived source account.** The far-right and anti-immigration Vox enters a legislative chamber after winning 12 seats, for the first time in the history of Spanish democracy.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/12/03/europe/spain-far-right-vox-andalucia-intl/index.html>); [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/12/02/world/europe/spain-andalusia-election.html>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-12-03-2-1"></a>

Context: Death and state funeral of George H. W. Bush.

<a id="event-2018-12-03-2-2"></a>

Context: Death and state funeral of George H. W. Bush.

**Archived source account.** The United States Postal Service announces it will suspend regular mail deliveries, retail services and administrative office activity on December 5 as part of President Trump's declared national day of mourning.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/03/politics/us-postal-service-suspend-deliveries-h-w-bush-national-mourning/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-03-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 in spaceflight.

**Archived source account.** NASA's space probe OSIRIS-REx arrives at the asteroid Bennu.

**Archived source account.** Soyuz MS-11 successfully launches from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan carrying Roscosmos cosmonaut Oleg Kononenko, NASA astronaut Anne McClain, and CSA astronaut David Saint-Jacques for Expedition 58 to the International Space Station.

Context: 2018 Ballon d'Or.

**Archived source account.** In association football, Croatian midfielder Luka Modrić wins the Ballon d'Or and becomes the first player other than Lionel Messi or Cristiano Ronaldo to win the award since Kaká in 2007.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-soccer-ballon/soccer-modric-wins-2018-ballon-dor-breaks-messi-ronaldo-dominance-idUSKBN1O22KR>).

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/dec/03/ballon-dor-ada-hegerberg-twerk-luka-modric>).

### 2018-12-04

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1085404438](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20December%204&oldid=1085404438>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-12-04-0-1"></a>

Context: Operation Northern Shield.

**Archived source account.** Israel announces an operation to clear Hezbollah tunnels from Lebanon-Israeli border.

Source citations (as archived): [The Times of Israel](<https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-launches-operation-on-lebanon-border-to-destroy-hezbollah-attack-tunnels>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-12-04-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russians vote to rename the two main airports of Moscow, Sheremetyevo and Domodedovo, after poet Alexander Pushkin and scientist Mikhail Lomonosov, respectively.

Source citations (as archived): [TASS](<http://tass.com/society/1034348>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-12-04-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The alleged boss of the Cosa Nostra mafia clan is arrested along with 45 suspected accomplices in the province of Palermo, Italy. They are accused of aggravated extortion.

Source citations (as archived): [Euronews](<https://www.euronews.com/2018/12/04/new-mafia-boss-settimo-mineo-arrested-in-raid>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-12-04-3-1"></a>

Context: Yellow vests movement.

**Archived source account.** Following large protests against French President Emmanuel Macron's planned increases on fuel taxes, French Prime Minister Édouard Philippe announces that these plans will be suspended for at least six months.

Source citations (as archived): [Bloomberg](<https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-12-04/french-govt-to-suspend-fuel-tax-to-end-yellow-vests-protest>).

<a id="event-2018-12-04-3-3"></a>

Context: Brexit negotiations.

**Archived source account.** The Government of the United Kingdom is found to be in contempt of parliament for the first time in history. The motion, which passed by 311 to 293 votes in the House of Commons, was triggered by Theresa May's government failing to publish its legal advice on its Brexit withdrawal plan.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/12/04/uk/brexit-legal-advice-contempt-of-court-gbr-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-04-3-4"></a>

**Archived source account.** Frank Scott Jr. is elected Mayor of Little Rock, Arkansas, defeating Baker Kurrus in the runoff. Scott will become the city's first African-American mayor.

Source citations (as archived): [USA Today](<https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation/2018/12/05/little-rock-arkansas-elects-frank-scott-first-black-mayor/2212383002/>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-12-04-4-1"></a>

Context: NHL expansion.

**Archived source account.** In ice hockey, the National Hockey League announces that its board of governors unanimously approved a new franchise for Seattle. The new team will start play in the 2021–22 season, bringing the league's membership to 32 teams.

Source citations (as archived): [ESPN](<http://www.espn.com/nhl/story/_/id/25451216/nhl-votes-give-expansion-franchise-seattle>).

### 2018-12-06

<a id="event-2018-12-06-5-3"></a>

Context: Death and state funeral of George H. W. Bush.

**Archived source account.** Former U.S. President George H. W. Bush is laid to rest at his Presidential Library in College Station, Texas.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/courage-warrior-george-h-w-bush-remember-family-friends-texas-n944806>).

<a id="event-2018-12-06-5-5"></a>

Context: Yellow vests movement.

**Archived source account.** The French police union Vigi calls on police officers to begin an indefinite strike on December 8 and join anti-government protesters, noting that "a majority of the French continue to back the movement".

Source citations (as archived): [Sputnik News](<https://sputniknews.com/europe/201812061070444941-french-police-union-calls-police-join-yellow-vests-protests/>).

<a id="event-2018-12-06-5-6"></a>

Context: Yellow vests movement.

**Archived source account.** Major landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre are to shut down amid expected protests this weekend.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/06/french-government-warns-of-weekend-of-great-violence-protesters>).

### 2018-12-07

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1301792949](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20December%207&oldid=1301792949>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-12-07-0-1"></a>

Context: European migrant crisis.

**Archived source account.** Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) rescue vessel Aquarius 2 ends migrant rescue operations in the Mediterranean Sea, citing sustained attacks on search and rescue by European governments, particularly Italy.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46477158>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-12-07-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Eleven people die, including five hostages, as armed police battle robbers who had tried to raid two banks in Milagres, Ceará, Brazil.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-46487147>).

<a id="event-2018-12-07-1-2"></a>

Context: Mueller special counsel investigation.

**Archived source account.** American attorney Robert Mueller is set to reveal more details about the Special Counsel investigation as he faces court deadlines in the cases of two men who worked closely with Donald Trump.

Source citations (as archived): [Huffington Post](<https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/court-deadlines-set-stage-for-more-russia-probe-details_us_5c0aad1ae4b0a606a9a86533>).

<a id="event-2018-12-07-1-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** Jamaican reggae artist Buju Banton (Mark Anthony Myrie) is released from a U.S. prison and deported back to Jamaica, after serving 7 years of a 10-year drug charge conviction.

Source citations (as archived): [Tampa Bay Times](<https://www.tampabay.com/breaking-news/reggae-star-buju-banton-convicted-in-tampa-freed-from-prison-20181207/>).

<a id="event-2018-12-07-1-5"></a>

Context: Charlottesville car attack.

**Archived source account.** A jury finds James Alex Fields guilty of the murder, in the first degree, of Heather Heyer at a 2017 white nationalist rally in Charlottesville, Virginia.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/12/charlottesville-james-alex-fields-guilty-degree-murder-181207221122049.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-07-1-6"></a>

**Archived source account.** Huawei CFO Meng Wanzhou attends a bail hearing in Vancouver while she awaits extradition to the United States. She is charged by Canadian and American prosecutors with conspiracy to defraud multiple financial institutions in order to commit evasion of United States sanctions against Iran so as to conduct business with Iran.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-china-huawei/u-s-wants-huawei-cfo-to-face-charges-over-iran-sanctions-court-hears-idUSKBN1O60FY>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-12-07-2-1"></a>

Context: Political appointments by Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump nominates William Barr to be the new United States Attorney General, a position he held under George H. W. Bush from 1991 to 1993. Heather Nauert, a former journalist and the incumbent Spokesperson for the United States Department of State, is proposed as U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/amp/world-us-canada-46487122>); [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump/trump-picks-attorney-general-and-u-n-envoy-in-fresh-staff-shake-up-idUSKBN1O61YN>).

<a id="event-2018-12-07-2-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Christian Democratic Union of Germany leadership election.

**Archived source account.** Annegret Kramp-Karrenbauer succeeds Angela Merkel as the new chairperson of the Christian Democratic Union, one of the major political parties in Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/07/annegret-kramp-karrenbauer-elected-merkels-successor-as-christian-democrat-leader>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-12-07-3-1"></a>

Context: Discoveries of exoplanets.

**Archived source account.** Scientists from the University of Geneva announce that a previously-known Neptune-sized exoplanet, HAT-P-11b, has a slowly-escaping helium atmosphere.

Source citations (as archived): [International Business Times](<https://www.ibtimes.com/strange-neptune-sized-exoplanet-resembling-inflated-balloon-discovered-may-hold-key-2740075>); [Phys.org](<https://phys.org/news/2018-12-helium-exoplanet-inflated-balloon.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-07-3-3"></a>

Context: Chinese Lunar Exploration Program.

**Archived source account.** The China National Space Administration successfully launches Chang'e 4 from Xichang Satellite Launch Center which will attempt the first ever robotic landing on the far side of the Moon in 2019.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-46471668>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-12-08-1-1"></a>

<a id="event-2018-12-08-1-2"></a>

<a id="event-2018-12-08-1-4"></a>

Context: Yellow vests movement.

**Archived source account.** 125,000 people demonstrate across France, according to the Minister of the Interior, with about 89,000 police officers on duty. 1,385 people are detained. Tear gas and pepper spray are used against the protesters and 135 people are injured.

**Archived source account.** Prime Minister Charles Michel says that the New Flemish Alliance (N-VA) party quits the coalition. N-VA cites its disagreement over the signing of the United Nations Global Compact for Migration. Michel plans to continue with a minority cabinet until the next scheduled election.

Source citations (as archived): [Het Laatste Nieuws](<https://www.hln.be/nieuws/binnenland/alles-wat-je-moet-onthouden-over-de-dag-dat-n-va-uit-de-regering-stapte~adc130e6/>); [Channel NewsAsia](<https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/belgian-pm-set-for-minority-after-biggest-ally-quits-coalition-11014684>).

<a id="event-2018-12-10-2-4"></a>

He had been tried and found not guilty of the crimes in 1987, but the acquittal was quashed as new evidence in the form of DNA was now available. Bishop had been convicted in December 1990 of the abduction, indecent assault and attempted murder of a seven-year-old girl in February of that year.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/dec/10/man-found-guilty-of-1986-brighton-babes-in-the-wood-murders-karen-hadaway-nicola-fellows>).

<a id="event-2018-12-12-0-3"></a>

<a id="event-2018-12-12-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Pope Francis removes Australian prelate George Pell and Chilean prelate Francisco Javier Errázuriz Ossa from the Council of Cardinal Advisers. Both are accused of covering up child sexual abuse scandals. Former Archbishop of Kinshasa Laurent Monsengwo Pasinya also leaves the Council for unrelated reasons.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-46539341>).

<a id="event-2018-12-12-2-1"></a>

Context: North Korea–South Korea relations.

**Archived source account.** Soldiers from North Korea and South Korea peacefully cross the Korean Demilitarized Zone for the first time since it was created in 1953.

Source citations (as archived): [CBS News](<https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/north-korea-south-korea-troops-cross-demilitarized-zone-in-peace-first-time/>).

<a id="event-2018-12-12-2-3"></a>

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-12-12-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Michael Cohen, the former lawyer of U.S. President Donald Trump, is sentenced to three years in prison for making illegal hush money payments to two women with whom Trump allegedly had affairs, and a concurrent sentence of two months for making false statements to Congress about a possible Trump Tower deal in Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/united-states-canada/article/2177721/donald-trumps-former-lawyer-michael-cohen-sentenced>).

<a id="event-2018-12-12-3-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Prosecutors in Goiás, Brazil request the preventive detention of medium João de Deus over more than 200 allegations of sexual abuse. João de Deus became internationally famous in 2013, when his controversial psychic healing methods were broadcast on Oprah Winfrey's show Oprah's Next Chapter.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-brazil-healer-abuse/brazil-miracle-healer-who-appeared-on-oprah-faces-arrest-in-sex-probe-idUSKBN1OB2VS>).

Context: Politics of the United Kingdom, Future Conservative Party leadership election.

<a id="event-2018-12-18-2-3"></a>

Context: Politics of Belgium.

**Archived source account.** Belgian Prime Minister Charles Michel submits the resignation of his cabinet to King Philippe, after the biggest party in his coalition, the New Flemish Alliance, formally quit on 9 December over the government's support for the Global Compact for Migration. The King is withholding his decision.

Source citations (as archived): [ABC News (Australia)](<https://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-12-19/belgium-pm-resigns-over-migration-spat/10633300>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-12-18-3-1"></a>

Context: Transportation in Los Angeles.

**Archived source account.** Elon Musk opens the 1.6km-long Boring Test Tunnel in Hawthorne, California, which is designed to demonstrate technology that will transport cars at high speeds below the city.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-46616902>).

<a id="event-2018-12-18-3-3"></a>

Context: Kamchatka meteor.

**Archived source account.** A meteor, which measured several metres in size, exploded 26km over the Bering Sea, near the Kamchatka Peninsula, Russia.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC News](<https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-47607696>).

### 2018-12-19

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 875206290](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20December%2019&oldid=875206290>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-12-19-0-1"></a>

Context: American intervention in Syria, Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Pentagon reports it has begun withdrawing U.S. troops from Syria, with a spokesperson saying that the coalition has liberated ISIL-held territory but also that the campaign is not over.

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-12-19-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Kivu Ebola outbreak.

**Archived source account.** Over 300 people have died of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and the World Health Organization is concerned the outbreak is not being contained.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/18/health/ebola-democratic-republic-of-congo-intl/index.html>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-12-19-2-1"></a>

Context: Nisour Square massacre.

**Archived source account.** In a third trial, former Blackwater private military contractor Nicholas Slatten is convicted on one count of first-degree murder over the 2007 mass shooting.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/former-blackwater-contractor-accused-firing-first-shots-iraq-massacre-found-n949966>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-12-19-3-1"></a>

Context: 2017–18 Spanish constitutional crisis.

**Archived source account.** Carles Puigdemont calls on Jordi Sànchez and Jordi Turull to end the hunger strike they started on 1 December.

Source citations (as archived): [eldiario.es](<https://www.eldiario.es/catalunya/politica/expresidentes-Generalitat-Parlament-presos-huelga_0_847966230.html>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-12-19-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** EnviroBuild, a sustainable building materials company, pays $US 25,000 to name a newly discovered limbless amphibian Dermophis donaldtrumpi, after U.S President Donald Trump, in disagreement with his environmental policy.

Source citations (as archived): [HuffPost](<https://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/trump-amphibian-blind-sand_us_5c19b4d3e4b02d2cae8e520d>); [Business Insider](<https://www.businessinsider.com/amphibian-named-dermophis-donaldtrumpi-to-warn-trump-on-climate-change-2018-12>).

### 2018-12-20

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1256519734](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20December%2020&oldid=1256519734>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-12-20-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Parts of the Ventura Freeway in Southern California is renamed as “President Barack H. Obama Highway” in honor of former President Barack Obama.

Source citations (as archived): [Pasadena Star News](<https://www.pasadenastarnews.com/2018/12/20/welcome-to-the-president-barack-h-obama-highway-a-section-of-the-134-freeway-between-glendale-and-pasadena/>); [ABC News](<https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/los-angeles-area-freeway-named-barack-obama-59942210>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-12-20-1-1"></a>

Context: International military intervention against ISIL, Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** Reacting to yesterday's announcement by the United States on the withdrawal of their forces from Syria, France's Defense Minister Florence Parly says on Twitter that ISIL has not yet been driven out of Syria.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mideast-crisis-syria-france/france-says-islamic-state-has-not-been-wiped-from-map-in-syria-idUSKCN1OJ0U6>).

<a id="event-2018-12-20-1-3"></a>

Context: Northern Rakhine State clashes.

**Archived source account.** Myanmar's military announces it will resume "clearance operations" in Rakhine State after a recent spike in attacks by unidentified assailants. In the past week, two Rakhine fishermen and a teenager were found murdered after they were reported missing, while two Maramagyi villagers were kidnapped and stabbed but managed to escape their abductors.

Source citations (as archived): [AFP](<https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/2178972/myanmar-forces-resume-clearance-operations-after-two>); [Radio Free Asia](<https://www.rfa.org/english/news/myanmar/myanmar-forces-begin-new-clearance-operations-12202018162920.html>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-12-20-2-1"></a>

Context: Gatwick Airport drone incident.

**Archived source account.** Gatwick Airport in West Sussex, England, is shut down intermittently since Wednesday night, after drones are seen flying over the airfield. Police believe it is "a deliberate act to disrupt the airport". Hundreds of thousands of passengers are affected.

Source citations (as archived): [The Argus](<https://www.theargus.co.uk/news/17310835.gatwick-drone-attack-was-deliberate-act-to-disrupt-airport/>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/12/20/uk/gatwick-airport-drones-gbr-intl/index.html>).

#### Disasters and incidents

<a id="event-2018-12-20-3-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The annual Thomson Reuters poll among aid agencies shows that the situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with its war, hunger and Ebola outbreak, is perceived as the most neglected crisis of 2018. The Central African Republic, with its civil war, is a close second.

Source citations (as archived): [South China Morning Post](<https://www.scmp.com/news/world/africa/article/2178847/dr-congo-ravaged-ebola-and-war-most-neglected-crisis-2018>).

<a id="event-2018-12-20-3-2"></a>

Context: December 2018 British Columbia storms.

**Archived source account.** Severe windstorms in Vancouver and Vancouver Island damage houses, damage roads, and destroy a 100 year old pier in White Rock, British Columbia. One person stranded on the pier is rescued by helicopter. Several highways were closed due to trees falling.

Source citations (as archived): [Surrey Now](<https://www.surreynowleader.com/news/white-rock-pier-damaged-by-storm/>).

<a id="event-2018-12-20-3-3"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Mayor of Skagway, Alaska, Monica Carlson, as well as her mother, are killed after being struck by a tour bus in Washington, D.C. while preparing to visit the White House.

Source citations (as archived): [WTOP](<https://wtop.com/dc/2018/12/2-seriously-injured-in-dc-after-being-struck-by-tour-bus/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-12-20-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Ten years after the collapse of Belgian financial group Fortis in the financial crisis of 2007–2008, the prosecutor in Brussels decides to drop the case against seven former directors. The prosecution argues that it found insufficient evidence that they knowingly misled shareholders with over-optimistic company information.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-crime-belgium-fortis/ten-years-on-belgium-drops-case-against-fortis-ex-directors-idUSKCN1OJ0YK>).

<a id="event-2018-12-20-4-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Denmark passes a law that requires new citizens to shake hands with a Danish official at their naturalization ceremony. It is widely believed that the law was made to spite potential Muslim immigrants, who usually refuse to shake hands with people of the opposite gender. Several Danish municipalities are openly looking for loopholes in the law.

Source citations (as archived): [The New York Times](<https://www.nytimes.com/2018/12/20/world/europe/denmark-muslims-handshake-law.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-20-4-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** Protests break out across Sudan over rising prices of bread and fuel, resulting in at least eight deaths.

Source citations (as archived): [Al-Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/12/protests-rising-prices-spread-sudan-khartoum-181220132130661.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-20-4-4"></a>

Context: Abortion in the Republic of Ireland.

**Archived source account.** Irish President Michael D. Higgins signs a bill making abortion legal in the Republic of Ireland for the first time.

Source citations (as archived): [Irish Times](<https://www.irishtimes.com/news/health/abortion-becomes-legal-in-ireland-for-first-time-after-bill-signed-by-president-1.3738504>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-12-20-5-1"></a>

Context: Cabinet of Donald Trump.

**Archived source account.** U.S. Secretary of Defence Jim Mattis announces his resignation at the end of February 2019. Mattis says that his views are not well "aligned" with those of the President.

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-mattis/pentagon-chief-mattis-quits-citing-policy-differences-with-trump-idUSKCN1OJ2WR>); [CNN](<https://edition.cnn.com/2018/12/20/politics/donald-trump-james-mattis-out/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-20-5-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Democratic Republic of the Congo general election.

**Archived source account.** The CENI electoral commission delays the election to 30 December after 80% of the voting machines in the capital were destroyed in a suspected arson last week.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/12/20/678598019/derailed-by-fire-and-disarray-congo-delays-presidential-election-again>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-12-20-6-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Soyuz MS-09 lands safely on the steppe in Kazakhstan.

Source citations (as archived): [NASASpaceFlight.com](<https://www.nasaspaceflight.com/2018/12/soyuz-ms-09-land-unprecedented-orbit-repairs/>).

<a id="event-2018-12-20-6-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. researchers say that the Marburg virus has been found for the first time in West African bats, notably in Egyptian rousette fruit bats in Sierra Leone. Marburg is a "cousin" of the Ebola virus disease, which too may be spread by bats.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/deadly-ebola-cousin-marburg-found-west-african-bats-n950331>).

#### Sports

<a id="event-2018-12-20-7-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Cuba's baseball federation and Major League Baseball reach a deal that will allow Cuban players to compete in the USA without defecting.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46626521>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-12-21-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** At least 23 people are killed and 14 injured in Dang Deukhuri District, Nepal, when a bus carrying students and their teachers returning from a botanical trip runs off a road and plunges 700 meters into a ravine.

<a id="event-2018-12-21-2-1"></a>

<a id="event-2018-12-21-3-2"></a>

Context: 2019 United States federal budget.

<a id="event-2018-12-21-5-1"></a>

Context: Largest known prime number.

**Archived source account.** The Great Internet Mersenne Prime Search announces the discovery of a new Mersenne prime, 282,589,933-1. It has 24,862,048 decimal digits, which surpasses the previous record by over 1.5 million digits.

Source citations (as archived): [NPR](<https://www.npr.org/2018/12/21/679207604/the-world-has-a-new-largest-known-prime-number>).

Context: 2018 Sunda Strait tsunami.
