Context: Cannabis in Thailand.

**Archived source account.** Thailand approves marijuana for medical use and research. The country voted to amend the Narcotic Act of 1979 prior to the New Year’s holiday.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46679098>); [CNBC](<https://www.cnbc.com/2018/12/25/thailand-approves-medical-marijuana-in-new-years-gift.html>).

### 2018-12-26

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1306973781](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20December%2026&oldid=1306973781>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-12-26-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** U.S. President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump make an unannounced post-Christmas visit to troops at the Al Asad Airbase in Iraq, their first visit to a combat zone since taking office.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-46687909>); [The Washington Post](<https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/trump-visits-us-troops-in-iraq-for-first-trip-to-a-conflict-zone/2018/12/26/d3f7d272-055e-11e9-b5df-5d3874f1ac36_story.html?utm_term=.013e2c844d37>).

<a id="event-2018-12-26-0-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** After a 53-day trek, American professional endurance athlete Colin O'Brady allegedly becomes the first person to cross Antarctica alone and unaided; his claim of being unaided has been disputed, and the first person to really cross Antarctica alone and unaided was Børge Ousland in 1996 and 1997.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-46687892>).

#### Business and economy

<a id="event-2018-12-26-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Japan announces its intention to resume commercial whaling in July 2019 after withdrawing from the International Whaling Commission.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna951871>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-12-26-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Martial law in Ukraine ends a month after an attack on three Ukrainian Navy vessels near the Kerch Strait.

Source citations (as archived): [NBC News](<https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/ncna951936>).

### 2018-12-27

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1085410346](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20December%2027&oldid=1085410346>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-12-27-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Street battles between anti-government protesters and riot police in Sudan leave at least 19 people dead, including two policemen, as well as hundreds injured. Amnesty International puts the death toll at 37.

Source citations (as archived): [Al Jazeera](<https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/12/sudan-government-19-killed-200-injured-protests-181227191854282.html>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-12-27-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Richard Arvin Overton, the oldest U.S. veteran from World War II, as well as the oldest American man, dies at age 112.,

Source citations (as archived): [Newsweek](<https://www.newsweek.com/americas-oldest-living-world-war-ii-veteran-richard-overton-dies-112-1273249?amp=1>); [CNN](<https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2018/12/27/us/richard-overton-oldest-ww-ii-vet-died/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-27-1-1"></a>

**Archived source account.** Argentina lifts a travel ban on Canadian singer Justin Bieber, who had been previously banned from the country for his role in the beating of a photographer in November 2013. A Document of Resolution was signed last week, officially ending Bieber's ban, so Bieber may now freely return to the country.

Source citations (as archived): [Daily Mail](<https://www.dailymail.co.uk/tvshowbiz/article-6533603/Justin-Bieber-free-return-Argentina-Supreme-Court-clears-2013-attack-snapper.html>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-12-27-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The New York City sky lights up in blue after a transformer in Astoria, Queens, explodes.,

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://amp.theguardian.com/us-news/2018/dec/28/new-york-sky-bright-blue-lights-explosion-astoria-power-plant-queens>); [NBC New York](<https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/Blue-Light-Sky-Explosion-Queens-503589291.html?amp=y>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-12-27-3-1"></a>

Context: Iraq–United States relations.

**Archived source account.** Iraqi politicians from both parliamentary blocs in the Council of Representatives of Iraq demand the withdrawal of U.S. forces from the country, following U.S. President Donald Trump's unannounced visit to troops stationed at Al Asad Airbase. An extraordinary session to debate the matter is planned.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/27/iraq-trump-visit-us-troops-lawmakers-demand-leave>).

<a id="event-2018-12-27-3-3"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

**Archived source account.** The DRC government gives the European Union 48 hours to recall its envoy in the country after the EU imposed sanctions on 14 Congolese officials.

Source citations (as archived): [Vanguard News Nigeria](<https://www.vanguardngr.com/2018/12/dr-congo-gives-eu-48-hours-to-withdraw-envoy/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-12-27-4-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Five Christian monks are tied up and then left injured, one of them seriously, after a robbery at a church in Vienna, Austria.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/27/manhunt-after-monks-injured-in-church-robbery-in-vienna>).

#### Science and technology

<a id="event-2018-12-27-5-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** The Chaos Computer Club holds their 35th Chaos Communication Congress, a hacker convention, in Leipzig, Germany.

Source citations (as archived): [Handelsblatt](<https://www.handelsblatt.com/today/politics/hack-the-planet-unleashing-chaos-at-europes-biggest-hacker-convention/23573566.html>).

### 2018-12-28

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-12-28-0-1"></a>

Context: Syrian Civil War.

**Archived source account.** The Kurdish YPG calls on Syrian government troops to protect Manbij against what it calls a "Turkish invasion".

Source citations (as archived): [Reuters](<https://www.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKCN1OR0IQ>); [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/cnn/2018/12/28/middleeast/syria-army-manbij-ypg-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-28-0-2"></a>

**Archived source account.** An explosion caused by a roadside bomb hits a tourist bus in Cairo, Egypt, near the Giza pyramid complex. Three Vietnamese tourists and an Egyptian tour guide are killed, while 12 others are injured.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-46702301>).

#### Arts and culture

<a id="event-2018-12-28-1-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** After a 56-day trek, British Army captain Lou Rudd becomes the second person to cross Antarctica alone and unaided, over two decades after the first solo crossing by Norwegian Børge Ousland.

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-12-28-2-1"></a>

Context: Foreign relations of Bahrain.

**Archived source account.** Bahrain announces it will reopen its embassy in Damascus, Syria, a day after the UAE made the same decision.

Source citations (as archived): [RT](<https://www.rt.com/news/447603-bahrain-embassy-damascus-open/>).

#### Law and crime

<a id="event-2018-12-28-3-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Leicester explosion.

**Archived source account.** The three men suspected of causing an explosion at a shop in Leicester in February are convicted of murder. The explosion destroyed the shop and the flat above it, killing five people. The three men were also convicted of conspiracy with one of the victims to commit insurance fraud.

Source citations (as archived): [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2018/dec/28/three-men-convicted-of-in-leicester-shop-explosion>).

### 2018-12-31

[Pinned Wikipedia revision 1085410467](<https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Portal%3ACurrent%20events%2F2018%20December%2031&oldid=1085410467>).

#### Armed conflicts and attacks

<a id="event-2018-12-31-0-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** A bomb explosion outside a busy shopping mall in the city of Cotabato, Philippines, kills 2 people and injures 34 others.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/31/asia/philippines-blast-intl/index.html>).

<a id="event-2018-12-31-0-2"></a>

Context: Manchester Victoria stabbing attack.

**Archived source account.** Three people are injured after being stabbed in an attack at Manchester Victoria station. The attacker shouted "Allah" during the attack. The attack is being treated as a terror-related incident, police have confirmed, and due to concerns over his mental health, the suspect is being held under the Mental Health Act.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-manchester-46728702>).

#### Disasters and accidents

<a id="event-2018-12-31-1-1"></a>

Context: 2018 Pacific typhoon season.

**Archived source account.** At least 69 people are reported dead from flooding caused by Tropical Depression Usman in the Philippines.

Source citations (as archived): [Stuff.co.nz](<https://www.stuff.co.nz/world/asia/109671504/flooding-in-the-philippines-leaves-56-dead>); [The Guardian](<https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/31/death-toll--philippine-storm-usman-devastating>).

<a id="event-2018-12-31-1-3"></a>

Context: 2018 Magnitogorsk building collapse.

**Archived source account.** An explosion caused by a gas leak devastated a block of flats in Magnitogorsk, Russia, killing 14 people while 27 others are missing.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46728114>).

#### International relations

<a id="event-2018-12-31-2-0"></a>

**Archived source account.** Russia's FSB state security agency says it has arrested a U.S. citizen "caught spying" in Moscow. According to former CIA officials the arrest was done as a retaliation for the arrest of alleged Russian spy Maria Butina.

Source citations (as archived): [BBC](<https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-46720262>); [Daily Beast](<https://www.thedailybeast.com/russias-arrest-of-paul-whelan-is-payback-for-marina-butina-cia-veterans-say?ref=home>).

#### Politics and elections

<a id="event-2018-12-31-3-1"></a>

Context: 2020 United States presidential election, 2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries.

**Archived source account.** Joining several other Democrats in the race, Senator Elizabeth Warren of Massachusetts announces the formation of a presidential exploratory committee for running in the 2020 presidential election.

Source citations (as archived): [CNN](<https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/31/politics/elizabeth-warren-exploratory-committee-2020/index.html>).
